text: So they went on until they came upon a boy, whereat he slew him. He said, ‘Did you slay an innocent soul, without [his having slain] anyone? You have certainly done a dire thing!’

citation.arabic_text: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمࣰ ا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسࣰ ا زَكِيَّةَۢ بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسࣲ لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا نُّكۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: So they went on until they came upon a boy, whereat he slew him. He said, ‘Did you slay an innocent soul, without [his having slain] anyone? You have certainly done a dire thing!’

text: He said, ‘Did I not tell you that you cannot have patience with me?’

citation.arabic_text: ۞قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘Did I not tell you that you cannot have patience with me?’

text: He said, ‘If I question you about anything after this, do not keep me in your company. You already have enough excuse on my part.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِن سَأَلۡتُكَ عَن شَيۡءِۭ بَعۡدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبۡنِيۖ قَدۡ بَلَغۡتَ مِن لَّدُنِّي عُذۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘If I question you about anything after this, do not keep me in your company. You already have enough excuse on my part.’

text: So they went on until they came to the people of a town. They asked its people for food, but they refused to extend them any hospitality. There they found a wall which was about to collapse, so he erected it. He said, ‘Had you wished, you could have taken a wage for it.’

citation.arabic_text: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةٍ ٱسۡتَطۡعَمَآ أَهۡلَهَا فَأَبَوۡاْ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارࣰ ا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥۖ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: So they went on until they came to the people of a town. They asked its people for food, but they refused to extend them any hospitality. There they found a wall which was about to collapse, so he erected it. He said, ‘Had you wished, you could have taken a wage for it.’

text: He said, ‘This is where you and I shall part. I will inform you about the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنِكَۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأۡوِيلِ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡتَطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًا
citation.translation: He said, ‘This is where you and I shall part. I will inform you about the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience

text: As for the boat, it belonged to some poor people who work on the sea. I wanted to make it defective, for behind them was a king seizing every ship usurpingly

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنۡ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكࣱ يَأۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصۡبࣰ ا
citation.translation: As for the boat, it belonged to some poor people who work on the sea. I wanted to make it defective, for behind them was a king seizing every ship usurpingly

text: As for the boy, his parents were faithful [persons], and We feared he would overwhelm them with rebellion and unfaith

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَٰنࣰ ا وَكُفۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: As for the boy, his parents were faithful [persons], and We feared he would overwhelm them with rebellion and unfaith

text: So We desired that their Lord should give them in exchange one better than him in respect of purity and closer in mercy

citation.arabic_text: فَأَرَدۡنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُ زَكَوٰةࣰ وَأَقۡرَبَ رُحۡمࣰ ا
citation.translation: So We desired that their Lord should give them in exchange one better than him in respect of purity and closer in mercy

text: As for the wall, it belonged to two boy orphans in the city. Under it there was a treasure belonging to them. Their father had been a righteous man. So your Lord desired that they should come of age and take out their treasure—as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do that out of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيۡنِ يَتِيمَيۡنِ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهُۥ كَنزࣱ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبۡلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهُۥ عَنۡ أَمۡرِيۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأۡوِيلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: As for the wall, it belonged to two boy orphans in the city. Under it there was a treasure belonging to them. Their father had been a righteous man. So your Lord desired that they should come of age and take out their treasure—as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do that out of my own accord. This is the interpretation of that over which you could not maintain patience.’

text: They question you concerning Dhul Qarnayn. Say, ‘I will relate to you an account of him.’

citation.arabic_text: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِي ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِۖ قُلۡ سَأَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًا
citation.translation: They question you concerning Dhul Qarnayn. Say, ‘I will relate to you an account of him.’

text: Indeed We had granted him power in the land and given him the means to all things

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ سَبَبࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed We had granted him power in the land and given him the means to all things

text: So he directed a means

citation.arabic_text: فَأَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
citation.translation: So he directed a means

text: When he reached the place where the sun sets, he found it setting over a warm sea, and by it he found a people. We said, ‘O Dhul Qarnayn! You will either punish them, or treat them with kindness.’

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغۡرُبُ فِي عَيۡنٍ حَمِئَةࣲ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوۡمࣰ اۖ قُلۡنَا يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمۡ حُسۡنࣰ ا
citation.translation: When he reached the place where the sun sets, he found it setting over a warm sea, and by it he found a people. We said, ‘O Dhul Qarnayn! You will either punish them, or treat them with kindness.’

text: He said, ‘As for him who is a wrongdoer, we will punish him. Then he shall be returned to his Lord and He will punish him with a dire punishment

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوۡفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابࣰ ا نُّكۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘As for him who is a wrongdoer, we will punish him. Then he shall be returned to his Lord and He will punish him with a dire punishment

text: But as for him who has faith and acts righteously, he shall have the best reward, and we will assign him easy tasks under our command.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِنَا يُسۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: But as for him who has faith and acts righteously, he shall have the best reward, and we will assign him easy tasks under our command.’

text: Thereafter he directed another means

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
citation.translation: Thereafter he directed another means

text: When he reached the place where the sun rises, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not provided any shield against it

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطۡلِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطۡلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ لَّمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: When he reached the place where the sun rises, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not provided any shield against it

text: So it was, and We were fully aware of whatever [means] he possessed

citation.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَقَدۡ أَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: So it was, and We were fully aware of whatever [means] he possessed

text: Thereafter he directed another means

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا
citation.translation: Thereafter he directed another means

text: When he reached [the place] between the two barriers, he found between them a people who could hardly understand a word [of his language]

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيۡنَ ٱلسَّدَّيۡنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوۡمࣰ ا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفۡقَهُونَ قَوۡلࣰ ا
citation.translation: When he reached [the place] between the two barriers, he found between them a people who could hardly understand a word [of his language]

text: They said, ‘O Dhul Qarnayn! Indeed Gog and Magog are causing disaster in this land. Shall we pay you a tribute on condition that you build a barrier between them and us?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَٰذَا ٱلۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ إِنَّ يَأۡجُوجَ وَمَأۡجُوجَ مُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدࣰّ ا
citation.translation: They said, ‘O Dhul Qarnayn! Indeed Gog and Magog are causing disaster in this land. Shall we pay you a tribute on condition that you build a barrier between them and us?’

text: He said, ‘What my Lord has furnished me is better. Yet help me with some strength, and I will make a bulwark between you and them

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِيهِ رَبِّي خَيۡرࣱ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًا
citation.translation: He said, ‘What my Lord has furnished me is better. Yet help me with some strength, and I will make a bulwark between you and them

text: Bring me pieces of iron!’ When he had levelled up between the flanks, he said, ‘Blow!’ When he had turned it into fire, he said, ‘Bring me molten copper to pour over it.’

citation.arabic_text: ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ ٱلۡحَدِيدِۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيۡنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيۡنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُواْۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارࣰ ا قَالَ ءَاتُونِيٓ أُفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡهِ قِطۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Bring me pieces of iron!’ When he had levelled up between the flanks, he said, ‘Blow!’ When he had turned it into fire, he said, ‘Bring me molten copper to pour over it.’

text: So they could neither scale it, nor could they make a hole in it

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا ٱسۡطَٰعُوٓاْ أَن يَظۡهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ لَهُۥ نَقۡبࣰ ا
citation.translation: So they could neither scale it, nor could they make a hole in it

text: He said, ‘This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord is fulfilled, He will level it; and my Lord’s promise is true.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّيۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَۖ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّي حَقࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord is fulfilled, He will level it; and my Lord’s promise is true.’

text: That day We shall let them surge over one another, the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall gather them all

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَتَرَكۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعۡضࣲۖ وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعۡنَٰهُمۡ جَمۡعࣰ ا
citation.translation: That day We shall let them surge over one another, the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall gather them all

text: and on that day We shall bring hell into view visibly for the faithless

citation.arabic_text: وَعَرَضۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَرۡضًا
citation.translation: and on that day We shall bring hell into view visibly for the faithless

text: —Those whose eyes were blind to My remembrance and who could not hear

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتۡ أَعۡيُنُهُمۡ فِي غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكۡرِي وَكَانُواْ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَمۡعًا
citation.translation: —Those whose eyes were blind to My remembrance and who could not hear

text: Do the faithless suppose that they have taken My servants for guardians in My stead? Indeed, We have prepared hell for the hospitality of the faithless

citation.arabic_text: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن يَتَّخِذُواْ عِبَادِي مِن دُونِيٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۚ إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Do the faithless suppose that they have taken My servants for guardians in My stead? Indeed, We have prepared hell for the hospitality of the faithless

text: Say, ‘Shall we inform you who are the biggest losers in their works

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ أَعۡمَٰلًا
citation.translation: Say, ‘Shall we inform you who are the biggest losers in their works

text: Those whose efforts are misguided in the life of the world, while they suppose they are doing good.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُونَ صُنۡعًا
citation.translation: Those whose efforts are misguided in the life of the world, while they suppose they are doing good.’

text: They are the ones who deny the signs of their Lord and encounter with Him. So their works have failed. On the Day of Resurrection We will not give them any weight

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَزۡنࣰ ا
citation.translation: They are the ones who deny the signs of their Lord and encounter with Him. So their works have failed. On the Day of Resurrection We will not give them any weight

text: That is their requital—hell—because of their unfaith and for deriding My signs and apostles

citation.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُواْ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا
citation.translation: That is their requital—hell—because of their unfaith and for deriding My signs and apostles

text: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, they shall have the gardens of Firdaws for abode

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلًا
citation.translation: As for those who have faith and do righteous deeds, they shall have the gardens of Firdaws for abode

text: to remain in them [forever]; they will not seek to leave it for another place

citation.arabic_text: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبۡغُونَ عَنۡهَا حِوَلࣰ ا
citation.translation: to remain in them [forever]; they will not seek to leave it for another place

text: Say, ‘If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be spent before the words of my Lord are finished, though We replenish it with another like it.’

citation.arabic_text: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادࣰ ا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ ٱلۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّي وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهِۦ مَدَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be spent before the words of my Lord are finished, though We replenish it with another like it.’

text: Say, ‘I am just a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So whoever expects to encounter his Lord—let him act righteously, and not associate anyone with the worship of his Lord.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهࣱ وَٰحِدࣱۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلۡيَعۡمَلۡ عَمَلࣰ ا صَٰلِحࣰ ا وَلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدَۢا
citation.translation: Say, ‘I am just a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is the One God. So whoever expects to encounter his Lord—let him act righteously, and not associate anyone with the worship of his Lord.’

text: Kaf, Ha, Ya, ‘Ayn, Suad

citation.arabic_text: كٓهيعٓصٓ
citation.translation: Kaf, Ha, Ya, ‘Ayn, Suad

text: [This is] an account of your Lord’s mercy on His servant, Zechariah

citation.arabic_text: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
citation.translation: [This is] an account of your Lord’s mercy on His servant, Zechariah

text: when he called out to his Lord with a secret cry

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: when he called out to his Lord with a secret cry

text: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed my bones have become feeble, and my head has turned white with age, yet never have I, my Lord, been disappointed in supplicating You

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ ٱلۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّي وَٱشۡتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأۡسُ شَيۡبࣰ ا وَلَمۡ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed my bones have become feeble, and my head has turned white with age, yet never have I, my Lord, been disappointed in supplicating You

text: Indeed I fear my kinsmen, after me, and my wife is barren. So grant me from Yourself an heir

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنِّي خِفۡتُ ٱلۡمَوَٰلِيَ مِن وَرَآءِي وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا فَهَبۡ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Indeed I fear my kinsmen, after me, and my wife is barren. So grant me from Yourself an heir

text: who may inherit from me and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]!’

citation.arabic_text: يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ ءَالِ يَعۡقُوبَۖ وَٱجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: who may inherit from me and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]!’

text: ‘O Zechariah! Indeed We give you the good news of a son, whose name is ‘‘John.’’ Never before have We made anyone his namesake.’

citation.arabic_text: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسۡمُهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ لَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ سَمِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: ‘O Zechariah! Indeed We give you the good news of a son, whose name is ‘‘John.’’ Never before have We made anyone his namesake.’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I am already advanced in age?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرࣰ ا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I am already advanced in age?’

text: He said, ‘So shall it be. Your Lord has said, ‘‘It is simple for Me.’’ Certainly I created you before when you were nothing.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱ وَقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘So shall it be. Your Lord has said, ‘‘It is simple for Me.’’ Certainly I created you before when you were nothing.’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! Appoint a sign for me.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three complete nights.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةࣰۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالࣲ سَوِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! Appoint a sign for me.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three complete nights.’

text: So he emerged before his people from the Temple, and signalled to them that they should glorify [Allah] morning and evening

citation.arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: So he emerged before his people from the Temple, and signalled to them that they should glorify [Allah] morning and evening

text: ‘O John!’ [We said,] ‘Hold on with power to the Book!’ And We gave him judgement while still a child

citation.arabic_text: يَٰيَحۡيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةࣲۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: ‘O John!’ [We said,] ‘Hold on with power to the Book!’ And We gave him judgement while still a child

text: and a compassion and purity from Us. He was Godwary

citation.arabic_text: وَحَنَانࣰ ا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةࣰۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and a compassion and purity from Us. He was Godwary

text: and good to his parents, and was not self-willed or disobedient

citation.arabic_text: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and good to his parents, and was not self-willed or disobedient

text: Peace be to him, the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he is raised alive

citation.arabic_text: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Peace be to him, the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the day he is raised alive

text: And mention in the Book Mary, when she withdrew from her family to an easterly place

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مَرۡيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ أَهۡلِهَا مَكَانࣰ ا شَرۡقِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: And mention in the Book Mary, when she withdrew from her family to an easterly place

text: Thus did she seclude herself from them, whereupon We sent to her Our Spirit and he became incarnate for her as a well-proportioned human

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّخَذَتۡ مِن دُونِهِمۡ حِجَابࣰ ا فَأَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Thus did she seclude herself from them, whereupon We sent to her Our Spirit and he became incarnate for her as a well-proportioned human

text: She said, ‘I seek the protection of the All-beneficent from you, should you be Godwary!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَتۡ إِنِّيٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: She said, ‘I seek the protection of the All-beneficent from you, should you be Godwary!’

text: He said, ‘I am only a messenger of your Lord that I may give you a pure son.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمࣰ ا زَكِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘I am only a messenger of your Lord that I may give you a pure son.’

text: She said, ‘How shall I have a child seeing that no human being has ever touched me, nor have I been unchaste?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَتۡ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمࣱ وَلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِي بَشَرࣱ وَلَمۡ أَكُ بَغِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: She said, ‘How shall I have a child seeing that no human being has ever touched me, nor have I been unchaste?’

text: He said, ‘So shall it be. Your Lord says, ‘‘It is simple for Me.’’ And so that We may make him a sign for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter [already] decided.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنࣱۖ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ أَمۡرࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘So shall it be. Your Lord says, ‘‘It is simple for Me.’’ And so that We may make him a sign for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter [already] decided.’

text: Thus she conceived him, then withdrew with him to a distant place

citation.arabic_text: ۞فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتۡ بِهِۦ مَكَانࣰ ا قَصِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Thus she conceived him, then withdrew with him to a distant place

text: The birth pangs brought her to the trunk of a date palm. She said, ‘I wish I had died before this and become a forgotten thing, beyond recall.’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلۡمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ قَالَتۡ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسۡيࣰ ا مَّنسِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: The birth pangs brought her to the trunk of a date palm. She said, ‘I wish I had died before this and become a forgotten thing, beyond recall.’

text: Thereupon he called her from below her [saying,] ‘Do not grieve! Your Lord has made a spring to flow at your feet

citation.arabic_text: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحۡتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحۡزَنِي قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Thereupon he called her from below her [saying,] ‘Do not grieve! Your Lord has made a spring to flow at your feet

text: Shake the trunk of the palm tree, freshly picked dates will drop upon you

citation.arabic_text: وَهُزِّيٓ إِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ تُسَٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبࣰ ا جَنِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Shake the trunk of the palm tree, freshly picked dates will drop upon you

text: Eat, drink, and be comforted. Then if you see any human, say, ‘‘Indeed I have vowed a fast to the All-beneficent, so I will not speak to any human today.’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: فَكُلِي وَٱشۡرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيۡنࣰ اۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡبَشَرِ أَحَدࣰ ا فَقُولِيٓ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ صَوۡمࣰ ا فَلَنۡ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِنسِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Eat, drink, and be comforted. Then if you see any human, say, ‘‘Indeed I have vowed a fast to the All-beneficent, so I will not speak to any human today.’’ ’

text: Then carrying him she brought him to her people. They said, ‘O Mary, you have certainly come up with an odd thing

citation.arabic_text: فَأَتَتۡ بِهِۦ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهُۥۖ قَالُواْ يَٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا فَرِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Then carrying him she brought him to her people. They said, ‘O Mary, you have certainly come up with an odd thing

text: O sister of Aaron[’s lineage]! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother unchaste.’

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأُخۡتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمۡرَأَ سَوۡءࣲ وَمَا كَانَتۡ أُمُّكِ بَغِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: O sister of Aaron[’s lineage]! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother unchaste.’

text: Thereat she pointed to him. They said, ‘How can we speak to one who is yet a baby in the cradle?’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَشَارَتۡ إِلَيۡهِۖ قَالُواْ كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Thereat she pointed to him. They said, ‘How can we speak to one who is yet a baby in the cradle?’

text: He said, ‘Indeed I am a servant of Allah! He has given me the Book and made me a prophet

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِيَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘Indeed I am a servant of Allah! He has given me the Book and made me a prophet

text: He has made me blessed, wherever I may be, and He has enjoined me to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakat as long as I live

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوۡصَٰنِي بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He has made me blessed, wherever I may be, and He has enjoined me to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakat as long as I live

text: and to be good to my mother, and He has not made me self-willed and wretched

citation.arabic_text: وَبَرَّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِي وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِي جَبَّارࣰ ا شَقِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and to be good to my mother, and He has not made me self-willed and wretched

text: Peace to me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised alive.’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوۡمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوۡمَ أُبۡعَثُ حَيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Peace to me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am raised alive.’

text: That is Jesus, son of Mary, a Word of the Real concerning whom they are in doubt

citation.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۖ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يَمۡتَرُونَ
citation.translation: That is Jesus, son of Mary, a Word of the Real concerning whom they are in doubt

text: It is not for Allah to take a son. Immaculate is He! When He decides on a matter, He just says to it, ‘Be!’ and it is

citation.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدࣲۖ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥٓۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣰ ا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
citation.translation: It is not for Allah to take a son. Immaculate is He! When He decides on a matter, He just says to it, ‘Be!’ and it is

text: [And Jesus said,] ‘Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a straight path.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: [And Jesus said,] ‘Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a straight path.’

text: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the faithless at the scene of a tremendous day

citation.arabic_text: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡۖ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
citation.translation: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the faithless at the scene of a tremendous day

text: How well they will hear and how well they will see on the day when they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are in manifest error

citation.arabic_text: أَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصِرۡ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: How well they will hear and how well they will see on the day when they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are in manifest error

text: Warn them of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be decided, while they are [yet] heedless and do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحَسۡرَةِ إِذۡ قُضِيَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ وَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: Warn them of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be decided, while they are [yet] heedless and do not have faith

text: Indeed We shall inherit the earth and whoever there is on it, and to Us they shall be brought back

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَإِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed We shall inherit the earth and whoever there is on it, and to Us they shall be brought back

text: And mention in the Book Abraham. Indeed, he was a truthful man and a prophet

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيًّا
citation.translation: And mention in the Book Abraham. Indeed, he was a truthful man and a prophet

text: When he said to his father, ‘Father! Why do you worship that which neither hears nor sees, and is of no avail to you in any way

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنكَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
citation.translation: When he said to his father, ‘Father! Why do you worship that which neither hears nor sees, and is of no avail to you in any way

text: Father! Indeed a knowledge has already come to me, which has not come to you. So follow me that I may guide you to a right path

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّي قَدۡ جَآءَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعۡنِيٓ أَهۡدِكَ صِرَٰطࣰ ا سَوِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Father! Indeed a knowledge has already come to me, which has not come to you. So follow me that I may guide you to a right path

text: Father! Do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan is disobedient to the All-beneficent

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَصِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Father! Do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan is disobedient to the All-beneficent

text: Father! I am indeed afraid that a punishment from the All-beneficent will befall you, and you will become Satan’s accomplice.’

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابࣱ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Father! I am indeed afraid that a punishment from the All-beneficent will befall you, and you will become Satan’s accomplice.’

text: He said, ‘Abraham! Are you renouncing my gods? If you do not desist, I will stone you. Get away from me for a long while.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِي يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ لَأَرۡجُمَنَّكَۖ وَٱهۡجُرۡنِي مَلِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘Abraham! Are you renouncing my gods? If you do not desist, I will stone you. Get away from me for a long while.’

text: He said, ‘Peace be to you! I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you. Indeed, He is gracious to me

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۖ سَأَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِي حَفِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘Peace be to you! I shall plead with my Lord to forgive you. Indeed, He is gracious to me

text: I dissociate myself from you and whatever you invoke besides Allah. I will supplicate my Lord. Hopefully, I will not be disappointed in supplicating my Lord.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: I dissociate myself from you and whatever you invoke besides Allah. I will supplicate my Lord. Hopefully, I will not be disappointed in supplicating my Lord.’

text: So when he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each We made a prophet

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا ٱعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۖ وَكُلࣰّ ا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: So when he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each We made a prophet

text: And We gave them out of Our mercy, and conferred on them a worthy and lofty repute

citation.arabic_text: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: And We gave them out of Our mercy, and conferred on them a worthy and lofty repute

text: And mention in the Book Moses. Indeed he was exclusively dedicated [to Allah], and an apostle and prophet

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخۡلَصࣰ ا وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: And mention in the Book Moses. Indeed he was exclusively dedicated [to Allah], and an apostle and prophet

text: We called him from the right side of the Mount and We drew him near [to Ourselves] for confidential discourse

citation.arabic_text: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنَٰهُ نَجِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: We called him from the right side of the Mount and We drew him near [to Ourselves] for confidential discourse

text: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet

citation.arabic_text: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحۡمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet

text: And mention in the Book Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and an apostle and prophet

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: And mention in the Book Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and an apostle and prophet

text: He used to bid his family to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakat, and was pleasing to his Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَكَانَ يَأۡمُرُ أَهۡلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرۡضِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: He used to bid his family to [maintain] the prayer and to [pay] the zakat, and was pleasing to his Lord

text: And mention in the Book Idrees. Indeed, he was a truthful one and a prophet

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقࣰ ا نَّبِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: And mention in the Book Idrees. Indeed, he was a truthful one and a prophet

text: and We raised him to an exalted station

citation.arabic_text: وَرَفَعۡنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
citation.translation: and We raised him to an exalted station

text: They are the ones whom Allah has blessed from among the prophets of Adam’s progeny, and from [the progeny of] those We carried with Noah, and from among the progeny of Abraham and Israel, and from among those that We guided and chose. When the signs of the All-beneficent were recited to them, they would fall down weeping in prostration

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوحࣲ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَٱجۡتَبَيۡنَآۚ إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدࣰ اۤ وَبُكِيࣰّ ا۩
citation.translation: They are the ones whom Allah has blessed from among the prophets of Adam’s progeny, and from [the progeny of] those We carried with Noah, and from among the progeny of Abraham and Israel, and from among those that We guided and chose. When the signs of the All-beneficent were recited to them, they would fall down weeping in prostration

text: But they were succeeded by an evil posterity who neglected the prayer, and followed [their base] appetites. So they will soon encounter [the reward of] perversity

citation.arabic_text: ۞فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ أَضَاعُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّا
citation.translation: But they were succeeded by an evil posterity who neglected the prayer, and followed [their base] appetites. So they will soon encounter [the reward of] perversity

text: barring those who repent, believe, and act righteously. Such will enter paradise, and they will not be wronged in the least

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُونَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
citation.translation: barring those who repent, believe, and act righteously. Such will enter paradise, and they will not be wronged in the least

text: Gardens of Eden promised by the All-beneficent to His servants, [while they were still] unseen. Indeed His promise is bound to come to pass

citation.arabic_text: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَأۡتِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Gardens of Eden promised by the All-beneficent to His servants, [while they were still] unseen. Indeed His promise is bound to come to pass

text: Therein they will not hear vain talk, but only ‘Peace!’ Therein they will have their provision morning and evening

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيهَا بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Therein they will not hear vain talk, but only ‘Peace!’ Therein they will have their provision morning and evening

text: This is the paradise We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who are Godwary

citation.arabic_text: تِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: This is the paradise We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who are Godwary

text: [O Gabriel, tell the Prophet,] ‘We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is in between that, and your Lord does not forget

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِينَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: [O Gabriel, tell the Prophet,] ‘We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is in between that, and your Lord does not forget

text: —the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. So worship Him and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know anyone who could be His namesake?’

citation.arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: —the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. So worship Him and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know anyone who could be His namesake?’

text: Man says, ‘What? Shall I be brought forth alive [from the grave], when I have been dead?’

citation.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ أُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا
citation.translation: Man says, ‘What? Shall I be brought forth alive [from the grave], when I have been dead?’

text: Does not man remember that We created him before when he was nothing

citation.arabic_text: أَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
citation.translation: Does not man remember that We created him before when he was nothing

text: By your Lord, We will surely gather them with the devils; then We will surely bring them up around hell [scrambling] on their knees

citation.arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: By your Lord, We will surely gather them with the devils; then We will surely bring them up around hell [scrambling] on their knees

text: Then from every group We shall draw whichever of them was more defiant towards the All-beneficent

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمۡ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عِتِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Then from every group We shall draw whichever of them was more defiant towards the All-beneficent

text: Then surely We will know best those who deserve most to enter it

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Then surely We will know best those who deserve most to enter it

text: There is none of you but will come to it: a [matter that is a] decided certainty with your Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن مِّنكُمۡ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتۡمࣰ ا مَّقۡضِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: There is none of you but will come to it: a [matter that is a] decided certainty with your Lord

text: Then We will deliver those who are Godwary, and leave the wrongdoers in it, fallen on their knees

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَواْ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Then We will deliver those who are Godwary, and leave the wrongdoers in it, fallen on their knees

text: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, the faithless say to the faithful, ‘Which of the two groups is superior in station and better with respect to company?’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتࣲ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَيُّ ٱلۡفَرِيقَيۡنِ خَيۡرࣱ مَّقَامࣰ ا وَأَحۡسَنُ نَدِيࣰّ ا
citation.translation: When Our manifest signs are recited to them, the faithless say to the faithful, ‘Which of the two groups is superior in station and better with respect to company?’

text: How many a generation We have destroyed before them, who were superior in furnishings and appearance

citation.arabic_text: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَٰثࣰ ا وَرِءۡيࣰ ا
citation.translation: How many a generation We have destroyed before them, who were superior in furnishings and appearance

text: Say, ‘Whoever abides in error, the All-beneficent shall prolong his respite until they sight what they have been promised: either punishment, or the Hour.’ Then they will know whose position is worse, and whose host is weaker

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ مَن كَانَ فِي ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَدًّاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرࣱّ مَّكَانࣰ ا وَأَضۡعَفُ جُندࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘Whoever abides in error, the All-beneficent shall prolong his respite until they sight what they have been promised: either punishment, or the Hour.’ Then they will know whose position is worse, and whose host is weaker

text: Allah enhances in guidance those who are [rightly] guided, and lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward, and better at the return [to Allah]

citation.arabic_text: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدࣰ ىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابࣰ ا وَخَيۡرࣱ مَّرَدًّا
citation.translation: Allah enhances in guidance those who are [rightly] guided, and lasting righteous deeds are better with your Lord in reward, and better at the return [to Allah]

text: Have you not regarded him who defies Our signs, and says, ‘I will surely be given wealth and children’

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالࣰ ا وَوَلَدًا
citation.translation: Have you not regarded him who defies Our signs, and says, ‘I will surely be given wealth and children’

text: Has he come to know the Unseen, or taken a promise from the All-beneficent

citation.arabic_text: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Has he come to know the Unseen, or taken a promise from the All-beneficent

text: No indeed! We will write down what he says, and We will prolong his punishment endlessly

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّاۚ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ مَدࣰّ ا
citation.translation: No indeed! We will write down what he says, and We will prolong his punishment endlessly

text: We shall take over from him what he talks about, and he will come to Us alone

citation.arabic_text: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأۡتِينَا فَرۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: We shall take over from him what he talks about, and he will come to Us alone

text: They have taken gods besides Allah that they may be a [source of] might to them

citation.arabic_text: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لِّيَكُونُواْ لَهُمۡ عِزࣰّ ا
citation.translation: They have taken gods besides Allah that they may be a [source of] might to them

text: No Indeed! Soon they will disown their worship, and they will be their opponents

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّاۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّا
citation.translation: No Indeed! Soon they will disown their worship, and they will be their opponents

text: Have you not regarded that We unleash the devils upon the faithless to urge them vigorously

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ أَزࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Have you not regarded that We unleash the devils upon the faithless to urge them vigorously

text: So do not make haste against them; indeed We are counting for them, a counting [down]

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
citation.translation: So do not make haste against them; indeed We are counting for them, a counting [down]

text: The day We shall gather the Godwary toward the All-beneficent, on mounts

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَفۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: The day We shall gather the Godwary toward the All-beneficent, on mounts

text: and drive the guilty as a thirsty herd towards hell

citation.arabic_text: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: and drive the guilty as a thirsty herd towards hell

text: no one will have the power to intercede [with Allah], except for him who has taken a covenant with the All-beneficent

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يَمۡلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَهۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: no one will have the power to intercede [with Allah], except for him who has taken a covenant with the All-beneficent

text: They say, ‘The All-beneficent has taken a son!’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: They say, ‘The All-beneficent has taken a son!’

text: You have certainly advanced something hideous

citation.arabic_text: لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِدࣰّ ا
citation.translation: You have certainly advanced something hideous

text: The heavens are about to be rent apart at it, the earth to split open, and the mountains to collapse into bits

citation.arabic_text: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
citation.translation: The heavens are about to be rent apart at it, the earth to split open, and the mountains to collapse into bits

text: that they should ascribe a son to the All-beneficent

citation.arabic_text: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: that they should ascribe a son to the All-beneficent

text: It does not behoove the All-beneficent to take a son

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
citation.translation: It does not behoove the All-beneficent to take a son

text: There is none in the heavens and the earth but he comes to the All-beneficent as a servant

citation.arabic_text: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: There is none in the heavens and the earth but he comes to the All-beneficent as a servant

text: Certainly He has counted them [all] and numbered them precisely

citation.arabic_text: لَّقَدۡ أَحۡصَىٰهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Certainly He has counted them [all] and numbered them precisely

text: and each of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection

citation.arabic_text: وَكُلُّهُمۡ ءَاتِيهِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا
citation.translation: and each of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection

text: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—the All-beneficent will endear them [to His creation]

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—the All-beneficent will endear them [to His creation]

text: Indeed We have made it simple in your language so that you may give good news thereby to the Godwary and warn with it a disputatious lot

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمࣰ ا لُّدࣰّ ا
citation.translation: Indeed We have made it simple in your language so that you may give good news thereby to the Godwary and warn with it a disputatious lot

text: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! Can you descry any one of them, or hear from them so much as a murmur

citation.arabic_text: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا
citation.translation: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! Can you descry any one of them, or hear from them so much as a murmur

text: Ta Ha

citation.arabic_text: طه
citation.translation: Ta Ha

text: We did not send down to you the Quran that you should be miserable

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ
citation.translation: We did not send down to you the Quran that you should be miserable

text: but only as an admonition to him who fears [his Lord]

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةࣰ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: but only as an admonition to him who fears [his Lord]

text: A sending down [of the Revelation] from Him who created the earth and the lofty heavens

citation.arabic_text: تَنزِيلࣰ ا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى
citation.translation: A sending down [of the Revelation] from Him who created the earth and the lofty heavens

text: —the All-beneficent, settled on the Throne

citation.arabic_text: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ
citation.translation: —the All-beneficent, settled on the Throne

text: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and whatever is between them, and whatever is under the ground

citation.arabic_text: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
citation.translation: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and whatever is between them, and whatever is under the ground

text: Whether you speak loudly [or in secret tones,] He indeed knows the secret and what is still more hidden

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى
citation.translation: Whether you speak loudly [or in secret tones,] He indeed knows the secret and what is still more hidden

text: Allah—there is no god except Him—to Him belong the Best Names

citation.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: Allah—there is no god except Him—to Him belong the Best Names

text: Did the story of Moses come to you

citation.arabic_text: وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Did the story of Moses come to you

text: when he sighted a fire, and said to his family, ‘Wait! Indeed, I descry a fire! Maybe I will bring you a brand from it, or find some guidance at the fire.’

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ رَءَا نَارࣰ ا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارࣰ ا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدࣰ ى
citation.translation: when he sighted a fire, and said to his family, ‘Wait! Indeed, I descry a fire! Maybe I will bring you a brand from it, or find some guidance at the fire.’

text: So when he came to it, he was called, ‘O Moses

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
citation.translation: So when he came to it, he was called, ‘O Moses

text: Indeed I am your Lord! So take off your sandals. You are indeed in the sacred valley of Tuwa

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوࣰ ى
citation.translation: Indeed I am your Lord! So take off your sandals. You are indeed in the sacred valley of Tuwa

text: I have chosen you; so listen to what is revealed

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
citation.translation: I have chosen you; so listen to what is revealed

text: Indeed I am Allah—there is no god except Me. So worship Me, and maintain the prayer for My remembrance

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ
citation.translation: Indeed I am Allah—there is no god except Me. So worship Me, and maintain the prayer for My remembrance

text: Indeed the Hour is bound to come: I will have it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded for its endeavour

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ
citation.translation: Indeed the Hour is bound to come: I will have it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded for its endeavour

text: So do not let yourself be distracted from it by those who do not believe in it and who follow their desires, or you will perish.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ
citation.translation: So do not let yourself be distracted from it by those who do not believe in it and who follow their desires, or you will perish.’

text: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’

text: He said, ‘It is my staff. I lean on it, and with it I beat down leaves for my sheep; and I have other uses for it.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘It is my staff. I lean on it, and with it I beat down leaves for my sheep; and I have other uses for it.’

text: He said, ‘Moses, throw it down.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Moses, throw it down.’

text: So he threw it down, and behold, it was a snake, moving swiftly

citation.arabic_text: فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةࣱ تَسۡعَىٰ
citation.translation: So he threw it down, and behold, it was a snake, moving swiftly

text: He said, ‘Take hold of it, and do not fear. We will restore it to its former state

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Take hold of it, and do not fear. We will restore it to its former state

text: Now clasp your hand to your armpit: it will emerge white, without any harm—[this is yet] another sign

citation.arabic_text: وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: Now clasp your hand to your armpit: it will emerge white, without any harm—[this is yet] another sign

text: that We may show you some of Our great signs

citation.arabic_text: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى
citation.translation: that We may show you some of Our great signs

text: Go to Pharaoh. He has indeed rebelled.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
citation.translation: Go to Pharaoh. He has indeed rebelled.’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! Open my breast for me

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! Open my breast for me

text: Make my task easy for me

citation.arabic_text: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي
citation.translation: Make my task easy for me

text: Remove the hitch from my tongue

citation.arabic_text: وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةࣰ مِّن لِّسَانِي
citation.translation: Remove the hitch from my tongue

text: [so that] they may understand my speech

citation.arabic_text: يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي
citation.translation: [so that] they may understand my speech

text: Appoint for me a minister from my family

citation.arabic_text: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرࣰ ا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي
citation.translation: Appoint for me a minister from my family

text: Aaron, my brother

citation.arabic_text: هَٰرُونَ أَخِي
citation.translation: Aaron, my brother

text: Strengthen my back through him

citation.arabic_text: ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي
citation.translation: Strengthen my back through him

text: and make him my associate in my task

citation.arabic_text: وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي
citation.translation: and make him my associate in my task

text: so that we may glorify You greatly

citation.arabic_text: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: so that we may glorify You greatly

text: and remember You greatly

citation.arabic_text: وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
citation.translation: and remember You greatly

text: Indeed You see us best.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed You see us best.’

text: He said, ‘Moses, your request has been granted

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Moses, your request has been granted

text: Certainly, We have done you a favour another time

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Certainly, We have done you a favour another time

text: when We revealed to your mother whatever was to be revealed

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
citation.translation: when We revealed to your mother whatever was to be revealed

text: “Put him in the casket, and cast it into the river. Then the river will cast it on the bank, and he shall be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.” And I made you endearing, and that you might be reared under My [watchful] eyes

citation.arabic_text: أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوࣱّ لِّي وَعَدُوࣱّ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةࣰ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ
citation.translation: “Put him in the casket, and cast it into the river. Then the river will cast it on the bank, and he shall be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.” And I made you endearing, and that you might be reared under My [watchful] eyes

text: When your sister walked up [to Pharaoh’s palace] saying, “Shall I show you someone who will take care of him?” Then We restored you to your mother, that she might not grieve and be comforted. Then you slew a soul, whereupon We delivered you from anguish, and We tried you with various ordeals. Then you stayed for several years among the people of Midian. Then you turned up as ordained, O Moses

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسࣰ ا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونࣰ اۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرࣲ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: When your sister walked up [to Pharaoh’s palace] saying, “Shall I show you someone who will take care of him?” Then We restored you to your mother, that she might not grieve and be comforted. Then you slew a soul, whereupon We delivered you from anguish, and We tried you with various ordeals. Then you stayed for several years among the people of Midian. Then you turned up as ordained, O Moses

text: And I chose you for Myself.’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي
citation.translation: And I chose you for Myself.’

text: ‘Go ahead, you and your brother, with My signs and do not flag in My remembrance

citation.arabic_text: ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي
citation.translation: ‘Go ahead, you and your brother, with My signs and do not flag in My remembrance

text: Both of you go to Pharaoh, for he has indeed rebelled

citation.arabic_text: ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
citation.translation: Both of you go to Pharaoh, for he has indeed rebelled

text: Speak to him in a soft manner; maybe he will take admonition or fear.’

citation.arabic_text: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلࣰ ا لَّيِّنࣰ ا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: Speak to him in a soft manner; maybe he will take admonition or fear.’

text: They said, ‘Our Lord! We are indeed afraid that he will forestall us or will exceed all bounds.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Our Lord! We are indeed afraid that he will forestall us or will exceed all bounds.’

text: He said, ‘Do not be afraid, for I will be with the two of you, hearing and seeing [whatever happens]

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Do not be afraid, for I will be with the two of you, hearing and seeing [whatever happens]

text: So approach him and say, ‘‘We are the apostles of your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not torture them! We certainly bring you a sign from your Lord, and may peace be upon him who follows guidance

citation.arabic_text: فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
citation.translation: So approach him and say, ‘‘We are the apostles of your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not torture them! We certainly bring you a sign from your Lord, and may peace be upon him who follows guidance

text: Indeed it has been revealed to us that punishment shall befall those who impugn us and turn their backs [on us].’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: Indeed it has been revealed to us that punishment shall befall those who impugn us and turn their backs [on us].’’ ’

text: He said, ‘Who is your Lord, Moses?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Who is your Lord, Moses?’

text: He said, ‘Our Lord is He who gave everything its creation and then guided it.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Our Lord is He who gave everything its creation and then guided it.’

text: He said, ‘What about the former generations?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘What about the former generations?’

text: He said, ‘Their knowledge is with my Lord, in a Book. My Lord neither makes any error nor forgets.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبࣲۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى
citation.translation: He said, ‘Their knowledge is with my Lord, in a Book. My Lord neither makes any error nor forgets.’

text: He, who made the earth for you a cradle, and in it threaded for you ways, and sent down water from the sky, and with it We brought forth various kinds of vegetation

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدࣰ ا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلࣰ ا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا مِّن نَّبَاتࣲ شَتَّىٰ
citation.translation: He, who made the earth for you a cradle, and in it threaded for you ways, and sent down water from the sky, and with it We brought forth various kinds of vegetation

text: ‘Eat and pasture your cattle.’ There are indeed signs in that for those who have sense

citation.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ
citation.translation: ‘Eat and pasture your cattle.’ There are indeed signs in that for those who have sense

text: From it did We create you, into it shall We return you, and from it shall We bring you forth another time

citation.arabic_text: ۞مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: From it did We create you, into it shall We return you, and from it shall We bring you forth another time

text: Certainly We showed him all Our signs. But he denied [them] and refused [to believe them]

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
citation.translation: Certainly We showed him all Our signs. But he denied [them] and refused [to believe them]

text: He said, ‘Moses, have you come to us to expel us from our land with your magic

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Moses, have you come to us to expel us from our land with your magic

text: Yet we [too] will bring you a magic like it! So fix a tryst between us and you, which neither we shall fail nor you, at a middle place.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدࣰ ا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانࣰ ا سُوࣰ ى
citation.translation: Yet we [too] will bring you a magic like it! So fix a tryst between us and you, which neither we shall fail nor you, at a middle place.’

text: He said, ‘Your tryst shall be the Day of Adornment, and let the people be assembled in early forenoon.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحࣰ ى
citation.translation: He said, ‘Your tryst shall be the Day of Adornment, and let the people be assembled in early forenoon.’

text: Then Pharaoh withdrew [to consult privately], summoned up his guile, and then arrived [at the scene of the contest]

citation.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
citation.translation: Then Pharaoh withdrew [to consult privately], summoned up his guile, and then arrived [at the scene of the contest]

text: Moses said to them, ‘Woe to you! Do not fabricate lies against Allah, or He will obliterate you with a punishment. Whoever fabricates lies certainly fails.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابࣲۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ
citation.translation: Moses said to them, ‘Woe to you! Do not fabricate lies against Allah, or He will obliterate you with a punishment. Whoever fabricates lies certainly fails.’

text: So they disputed their matter among themselves, and kept their confidential talks secret

citation.arabic_text: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ
citation.translation: So they disputed their matter among themselves, and kept their confidential talks secret

text: They said, ‘These two are indeed magicians who intend to expel you from your land with their magic, and to abolish your excellent tradition

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ
citation.translation: They said, ‘These two are indeed magicians who intend to expel you from your land with their magic, and to abolish your excellent tradition

text: So summon up your ingenuity, then come in ranks. Today he who has the upper hand will be felicitous!’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفࣰّ اۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ
citation.translation: So summon up your ingenuity, then come in ranks. Today he who has the upper hand will be felicitous!’

text: They said, ‘O Moses! Will you throw first, or shall we?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ
citation.translation: They said, ‘O Moses! Will you throw first, or shall we?’

text: He said, ‘No, you throw first.’ Thereupon, behold, their ropes and staffs appeared to him by their magic to wriggle swiftly

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘No, you throw first.’ Thereupon, behold, their ropes and staffs appeared to him by their magic to wriggle swiftly

text: Then Moses felt a fear within his heart

citation.arabic_text: فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةࣰ مُّوسَىٰ
citation.translation: Then Moses felt a fear within his heart

text: We said, ‘Do not be afraid. Indeed, you will have the upper hand

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
citation.translation: We said, ‘Do not be afraid. Indeed, you will have the upper hand

text: Throw down what is in your right hand, and it will swallow what they have conjured. What they have conjured is only a magician’s trick, and the magician does not fare well wherever he may show up.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرࣲۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ
citation.translation: Throw down what is in your right hand, and it will swallow what they have conjured. What they have conjured is only a magician’s trick, and the magician does not fare well wherever he may show up.’

text: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating. They said, ‘We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses!’

citation.arabic_text: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدࣰ ا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating. They said, ‘We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses!’

text: He said, ‘Did you believe in him before I should permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Surely, I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will know which of us can inflict a severer and more lasting punishment.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفࣲ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِي جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخۡلِ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابࣰ ا وَأَبۡقَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Did you believe in him before I should permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Surely, I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will know which of us can inflict a severer and more lasting punishment.’

text: They said, ‘We will never prefer you to the clear proofs which have come to us, and to Him who originated us. Decide whatever you want to decide. You can only decide about the life of this world

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنَاۖ فَٱقۡضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍۖ إِنَّمَا تَقۡضِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ
citation.translation: They said, ‘We will never prefer you to the clear proofs which have come to us, and to Him who originated us. Decide whatever you want to decide. You can only decide about the life of this world

text: We have indeed believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our offences and the magic you compelled us to perform. Allah is better and more lasting.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحۡرِۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرࣱ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
citation.translation: We have indeed believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our offences and the magic you compelled us to perform. Allah is better and more lasting.’

text: Whoever comes to his Lord laden with guilt, for him shall be hell, where he will neither live nor die

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأۡتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجۡرِمࣰ ا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
citation.translation: Whoever comes to his Lord laden with guilt, for him shall be hell, where he will neither live nor die

text: But whoever comes to Him with faith and he has done righteous deeds, for such shall be the highest ranks

citation.arabic_text: وَمَن يَأۡتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا قَدۡ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلۡعُلَىٰ
citation.translation: But whoever comes to Him with faith and he has done righteous deeds, for such shall be the highest ranks

text: —the Gardens of Eden, with streams running in them, to abide in them [forever], and that is the reward of him who keeps pure

citation.arabic_text: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
citation.translation: —the Gardens of Eden, with streams running in them, to abide in them [forever], and that is the reward of him who keeps pure

text: We revealed to Moses, [saying], ‘Set out with My servants at night, and strike out for them a dry path through the sea. Do not be afraid of being overtaken, and have no fear [of getting drowned]

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي فَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيقࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسࣰ ا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكࣰ ا وَلَا تَخۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: We revealed to Moses, [saying], ‘Set out with My servants at night, and strike out for them a dry path through the sea. Do not be afraid of being overtaken, and have no fear [of getting drowned]

text: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, whereat they were engulfed by what engulfed them of the sea

citation.arabic_text: فَأَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡ
citation.translation: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, whereat they were engulfed by what engulfed them of the sea

text: Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide them

citation.arabic_text: وَأَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
citation.translation: Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide them

text: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We appointed with you a tryst on the right side of the Mount and We sent down to you manna and quails

citation.arabic_text: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدۡ أَنجَيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوَٰعَدۡنَٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰ
citation.translation: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We appointed with you a tryst on the right side of the Mount and We sent down to you manna and quails

text: ‘Eat of the good things We have provided you, but do not overstep the bounds therein, lest My wrath should descend on you, and he on whom My wrath descends certainly perishes

citation.arabic_text: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۖ وَمَن يَحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدۡ هَوَىٰ
citation.translation: ‘Eat of the good things We have provided you, but do not overstep the bounds therein, lest My wrath should descend on you, and he on whom My wrath descends certainly perishes

text: Indeed I forgive those who repent, become faithful, act righteously, and follow guidance.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارࣱ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا ثُمَّ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
citation.translation: Indeed I forgive those who repent, become faithful, act righteously, and follow guidance.’

text: [God said,] ‘O Moses, what has prompted you to hasten ahead of your people?’

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَمَآ أَعۡجَلَكَ عَن قَوۡمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: [God said,] ‘O Moses, what has prompted you to hasten ahead of your people?’

text: He said, ‘They are close upon my heels, and I hurried on to You, my Lord, that You may be pleased.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ هُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضَىٰ
citation.translation: He said, ‘They are close upon my heels, and I hurried on to You, my Lord, that You may be pleased.’

text: He said, ‘Indeed We tried your people in your absence, and the Samiri has led them astray.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Indeed We tried your people in your absence, and the Samiri has led them astray.’

text: Thereupon Moses returned to his people, indignant and grieved. He said, ‘O my people! Did your Lord not give you a true promise? Did the period [of my absence] seem too long to you? Or did you desire that your Lord’s wrath should descend on you and so you failed your tryst with me?’

citation.arabic_text: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفࣰ اۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًاۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡعَهۡدُ أَمۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُم مَّوۡعِدِي
citation.translation: Thereupon Moses returned to his people, indignant and grieved. He said, ‘O my people! Did your Lord not give you a true promise? Did the period [of my absence] seem too long to you? Or did you desire that your Lord’s wrath should descend on you and so you failed your tryst with me?’

text: They said, ‘We did not fail our tryst with you of our own accord, but we were laden with the weight of those people’s ornaments, and we cast them [into the fire] and so did the Samiri.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ مَآ أَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَآ أَوۡزَارࣰ ا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ
citation.translation: They said, ‘We did not fail our tryst with you of our own accord, but we were laden with the weight of those people’s ornaments, and we cast them [into the fire] and so did the Samiri.’

text: Then he produced for them a calf—a [lifeless] body with a low—and they said, This is your god and the god of Moses, so he forgot

citation.arabic_text: فَأَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلࣰ ا جَسَدࣰ ا لَّهُۥ خُوَارࣱ فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ
citation.translation: Then he produced for them a calf—a [lifeless] body with a low—and they said, This is your god and the god of Moses, so he forgot

text: Did they not see that it did not answer them, nor could it bring them any benefit or harm

citation.arabic_text: أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلࣰ ا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا نَفۡعࣰ ا
citation.translation: Did they not see that it did not answer them, nor could it bring them any benefit or harm

text: Aaron had certainly told them earlier, ‘O my people! You are only being tested by it. Indeed your Lord is the All-beneficent. So follow me and obey my command!’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبۡلُ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرِي
citation.translation: Aaron had certainly told them earlier, ‘O my people! You are only being tested by it. Indeed your Lord is the All-beneficent. So follow me and obey my command!’

text: They had said, ‘We will keep on clinging to it until Moses returns to us.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ
