The parable of His Light is a niche wherein is a lamp—the lamp is in a glass, the glass as it were a glittering star—lit from a blessed olive tree, neither eastern nor western, whose oil almost lights up, though fire should not touch it. Light upon light. Allah guides to His Light whomever He wishes. Allah draws parables for mankind, and Allah has knowledge of all things

citation.arabic_text: ۞ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشۡكَوٰةࣲ فِيهَا مِصۡبَاحٌۖ ٱلۡمِصۡبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوۡكَبࣱ دُرِّيࣱّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةࣲ زَيۡتُونَةࣲ لَّا شَرۡقِيَّةࣲ وَلَا غَرۡبِيَّةࣲ يَكَادُ زَيۡتُهَا يُضِيٓءُ وَلَوۡ لَمۡ تَمۡسَسۡهُ نَارࣱۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورࣲۚ يَهۡدِي ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَ لِلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The parable of His Light is a niche wherein is a lamp—the lamp is in a glass, the glass as it were a glittering star—lit from a blessed olive tree, neither eastern nor western, whose oil almost lights up, though fire should not touch it. Light upon light. Allah guides to His Light whomever He wishes. Allah draws parables for mankind, and Allah has knowledge of all things

text: In houses Allah has allowed to be raised and wherein His Name is celebrated; He is glorified therein, morning and evening

citation.arabic_text: فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَن تُرۡفَعَ وَيُذۡكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُهُۥ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ
citation.translation: In houses Allah has allowed to be raised and wherein His Name is celebrated; He is glorified therein, morning and evening

text: by men whom neither trade nor bargaining distracts from the remembrance of Allah and the maintenance of prayer and the giving of zakat. They are fearful of a day wherein the hearts and the sights will be transformed

citation.arabic_text: رِجَالࣱ لَّا تُلۡهِيهِمۡ تِجَٰرَةࣱ وَلَا بَيۡعٌ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ يَخَافُونَ يَوۡمࣰ ا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
citation.translation: by men whom neither trade nor bargaining distracts from the remembrance of Allah and the maintenance of prayer and the giving of zakat. They are fearful of a day wherein the hearts and the sights will be transformed

text: so that Allah may reward them by the best of what they have done, and enhance them out of His grace, and Allah provides for whomever He wishes without any reckoning

citation.arabic_text: لِيَجۡزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنَ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
citation.translation: so that Allah may reward them by the best of what they have done, and enhance them out of His grace, and Allah provides for whomever He wishes without any reckoning

text: As for the faithless, their works are like a mirage in a plain, which the thirsty man supposes to be water. When he comes to it, he finds it to be nothing; but there he finds Allah, who will pay him his full account, and Allah is swift at reckoning

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَسَرَابِۭ بِقِيعَةࣲ يَحۡسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمۡـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمۡ يَجِدۡهُ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
citation.translation: As for the faithless, their works are like a mirage in a plain, which the thirsty man supposes to be water. When he comes to it, he finds it to be nothing; but there he finds Allah, who will pay him his full account, and Allah is swift at reckoning

text: Or like the manifold darkness in a deep sea, covered by billow upon billow, overcast by clouds; manifold [layers of] darkness, one on top of another: when he brings out his hand, he can hardly see it. One whom Allah has not granted any light has no light

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ كَظُلُمَٰتࣲ فِي بَحۡرࣲ لُّجِّيࣲّ يَغۡشَىٰهُ مَوۡجࣱ مِّن فَوۡقِهِۦ مَوۡجࣱ مِّن فَوۡقِهِۦ سَحَابࣱۚ ظُلُمَٰتُۢ بَعۡضُهَا فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ إِذَآ أَخۡرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمۡ يَكَدۡ يَرَىٰهَاۗ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَجۡعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورࣰ ا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ
citation.translation: Or like the manifold darkness in a deep sea, covered by billow upon billow, overcast by clouds; manifold [layers of] darkness, one on top of another: when he brings out his hand, he can hardly see it. One whom Allah has not granted any light has no light

text: Have you not regarded that Allah is glorified by everyone in the heavens and the earth, and the birds spreading their wings. Each knows his prayer and glorification, and Allah knows best what they do

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱلطَّيۡرُ صَٰٓفَّٰتࣲۖ كُلࣱّ قَدۡ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسۡبِيحَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded that Allah is glorified by everyone in the heavens and the earth, and the birds spreading their wings. Each knows his prayer and glorification, and Allah knows best what they do

text: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and toward Allah is the destination

citation.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
citation.translation: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and toward Allah is the destination

text: Have you not regarded that Allah drives the clouds, then He composes them, then He piles them up, whereat you see the rain issuing from its midst? And He sends down hail from the sky, out of the mountains that are in it, and He strikes with it whomever He wishes, and turns it away from whomever He wishes. The brilliance of its lightening almost takes away the sight

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزۡجِي سَحَابࣰ ا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيۡنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ رُكَامࣰ ا فَتَرَى ٱلۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلَٰلِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالࣲ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدࣲ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصۡرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرۡقِهِۦ يَذۡهَبُ بِٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded that Allah drives the clouds, then He composes them, then He piles them up, whereat you see the rain issuing from its midst? And He sends down hail from the sky, out of the mountains that are in it, and He strikes with it whomever He wishes, and turns it away from whomever He wishes. The brilliance of its lightening almost takes away the sight

text: Allah alternates the night and the day. There is indeed a lesson in that for those who have insight

citation.arabic_text: يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةࣰ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
citation.translation: Allah alternates the night and the day. There is indeed a lesson in that for those who have insight

text: Allah created every animal from water. Among them are some that creep upon their bellies, and among them are some that walk on two feet, and among them are some that walk on four. Allah creates whatever He wishes. Indeed Allah has power over all things

citation.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةࣲ مِّن مَّآءࣲۖ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ بَطۡنِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰ رِجۡلَيۡنِ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَمۡشِي عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡبَعࣲۚ يَخۡلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: Allah created every animal from water. Among them are some that creep upon their bellies, and among them are some that walk on two feet, and among them are some that walk on four. Allah creates whatever He wishes. Indeed Allah has power over all things

text: Certainly We have sent down illuminating signs, and Allah guides whomever He wishes to a straight path

citation.arabic_text: لَّقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ ءَايَٰتࣲ مُّبَيِّنَٰتࣲۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We have sent down illuminating signs, and Allah guides whomever He wishes to a straight path

text: They say, ‘We have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and we obey.’ Then, after that, a part of them refuse to comply, and they do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعۡنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقࣱ مِّنۡهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَۚ وَمَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: They say, ‘We have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and we obey.’ Then, after that, a part of them refuse to comply, and they do not have faith

text: When they are summoned to Allah and His Apostle that He may judge between them, behold, a part of them turn aside

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِذَا فَرِيقࣱ مِّنۡهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
citation.translation: When they are summoned to Allah and His Apostle that He may judge between them, behold, a part of them turn aside

text: But if justice be on their side, they come compliantly to him

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ يَأۡتُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مُذۡعِنِينَ
citation.translation: But if justice be on their side, they come compliantly to him

text: Is there a sickness in their hearts? Do they have doubts, or fear that Allah and His Apostle will be unjust to them? Indeed, it is they who are the wrongdoers

citation.arabic_text: أَفِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرۡتَابُوٓاْ أَمۡ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَرَسُولُهُۥۚ بَلۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
citation.translation: Is there a sickness in their hearts? Do they have doubts, or fear that Allah and His Apostle will be unjust to them? Indeed, it is they who are the wrongdoers

text: All the response of the faithful, when they are summoned to Allah and His Apostle that He may judge between them, is to say, ‘We hear and obey.’ It is they who are the felicitous

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوۡلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ أَن يَقُولُواْ سَمِعۡنَا وَأَطَعۡنَاۚ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
citation.translation: All the response of the faithful, when they are summoned to Allah and His Apostle that He may judge between them, is to say, ‘We hear and obey.’ It is they who are the felicitous

text: Whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle, and fears Allah and is wary of Him—it is they who will be the triumphant

citation.arabic_text: وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخۡشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقۡهِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ
citation.translation: Whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle, and fears Allah and is wary of Him—it is they who will be the triumphant

text: They swear by Allah with solemn oaths that if you order them they will surely march out. Say, ‘Do not swear! Honourable obedience [is all that is expected of you]. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.’

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَأَقۡسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ جَهۡدَ أَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ لَئِنۡ أَمَرۡتَهُمۡ لَيَخۡرُجُنَّۖ قُل لَّا تُقۡسِمُواْۖ طَاعَةࣱ مَّعۡرُوفَةٌۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: They swear by Allah with solemn oaths that if you order them they will surely march out. Say, ‘Do not swear! Honourable obedience [is all that is expected of you]. Allah is indeed well aware of what you do.’

text: Say, ‘Obey Allah, and obey the Apostle.’ But if you turn your backs, [you should know that] he is only responsible for his burden and you are responsible for your own burden, and if you obey him, you will be guided, and the Apostle’s duty is only to communicate in clear terms

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيۡهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيۡكُم مَّا حُمِّلۡتُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهۡتَدُواْۚ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
citation.translation: Say, ‘Obey Allah, and obey the Apostle.’ But if you turn your backs, [you should know that] he is only responsible for his burden and you are responsible for your own burden, and if you obey him, you will be guided, and the Apostle’s duty is only to communicate in clear terms

text: Allah has promised those of you who have faith and do righteous deeds that He will surely make them successors in the earth, just as He made those who were before them successors, and He will surely establish for them their religion which He has approved for them, and that He will surely change their state to security after their fear, while they worship Me, not ascribing any partners to Me. Whoever is ungrateful after that—it is they who are the transgressors

citation.arabic_text: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسۡتَخۡلِفَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمَا ٱسۡتَخۡلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمۡ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱرۡتَضَىٰ لَهُمۡ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَوۡفِهِمۡ أَمۡنࣰ اۚ يَعۡبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ بِي شَيۡـࣰٔ اۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ
citation.translation: Allah has promised those of you who have faith and do righteous deeds that He will surely make them successors in the earth, just as He made those who were before them successors, and He will surely establish for them their religion which He has approved for them, and that He will surely change their state to security after their fear, while they worship Me, not ascribing any partners to Me. Whoever is ungrateful after that—it is they who are the transgressors

text: Maintain the prayer and give the zakat, and obey the Apostle so that you may receive [Allah’s] mercy

citation.arabic_text: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
citation.translation: Maintain the prayer and give the zakat, and obey the Apostle so that you may receive [Allah’s] mercy

text: Do not suppose that those who are faithless can frustrate [Allah] on the earth. Their refuge shall be the Fire, and it is surely an evil destination

citation.arabic_text: لَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ وَلَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
citation.translation: Do not suppose that those who are faithless can frustrate [Allah] on the earth. Their refuge shall be the Fire, and it is surely an evil destination

text: O you who have faith! Your slaves and any of you who have not yet reached puberty should seek your permission three times: before the dawn prayer, and when you put off your garments at noon, and after the night prayer. These are three times of privacy for you. Apart from these, it is not sinful of you or them to frequent one another [freely]. Thus does Allah clarify the signs for you, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَبۡلُغُواْ ٱلۡحُلُمَ مِنكُمۡ ثَلَٰثَ مَرَّٰتࣲۚ مِّن قَبۡلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعۡدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡعِشَآءِۚ ثَلَٰثُ عَوۡرَٰتࣲ لَّكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ جُنَاحُۢ بَعۡدَهُنَّۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيۡكُم بَعۡضُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: O you who have faith! Your slaves and any of you who have not yet reached puberty should seek your permission three times: before the dawn prayer, and when you put off your garments at noon, and after the night prayer. These are three times of privacy for you. Apart from these, it is not sinful of you or them to frequent one another [freely]. Thus does Allah clarify the signs for you, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

text: When your children reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] just as those [who grew up] before them asked permission. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلۡأَطۡفَٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلۡحُلُمَ فَلۡيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُواْ كَمَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: When your children reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] just as those [who grew up] before them asked permission. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

text: As for women advanced in years who do not expect to marry, there will be no sin upon them if they put off their cloaks, without displaying their adornment. But it is better for them to be modest, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِي لَا يَرۡجُونَ نِكَاحࣰ ا فَلَيۡسَ عَلَيۡهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعۡنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيۡرَ مُتَبَرِّجَٰتِۭ بِزِينَةࣲۖ وَأَن يَسۡتَعۡفِفۡنَ خَيۡرࣱ لَّهُنَّۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: As for women advanced in years who do not expect to marry, there will be no sin upon them if they put off their cloaks, without displaying their adornment. But it is better for them to be modest, and Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing

text: There is no blame upon the blind, nor any blame upon the lame, nor any blame upon the sick, nor upon yourselves if you eat from your own houses, or your fathers’ houses, or your mothers’ houses, or your brothers’ houses, or your sisters’ houses, or the houses of your paternal uncles, or the houses of your paternal aunts, or the houses of your maternal uncles, or the houses of your maternal aunts, or those whose keys are in your possession, or those of your friends. There will be no blame on you whether you eat together or separately. So when you enter houses, greet yourselves with a salutation from Allah, blessed and good. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you so that you may exercise your reason

citation.arabic_text: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ إِخۡوَٰنِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَعۡمَٰمِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ عَمَّٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ أَخۡوَٰلِكُمۡ أَوۡ بُيُوتِ خَٰلَٰتِكُمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكۡتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوۡ صَدِيقِكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأۡكُلُواْ جَمِيعًا أَوۡ أَشۡتَاتࣰ اۚ فَإِذَا دَخَلۡتُم بُيُوتࣰ ا فَسَلِّمُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ تَحِيَّةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَٰرَكَةࣰ طَيِّبَةࣰۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
citation.translation: There is no blame upon the blind, nor any blame upon the lame, nor any blame upon the sick, nor upon yourselves if you eat from your own houses, or your fathers’ houses, or your mothers’ houses, or your brothers’ houses, or your sisters’ houses, or the houses of your paternal uncles, or the houses of your paternal aunts, or the houses of your maternal uncles, or the houses of your maternal aunts, or those whose keys are in your possession, or those of your friends. There will be no blame on you whether you eat together or separately. So when you enter houses, greet yourselves with a salutation from Allah, blessed and good. Thus does Allah clarify His signs for you so that you may exercise your reason

text: Indeed the faithful are those who have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and when they are with him in a collective affair, they do not leave until they have sought his permission. Indeed those who seek your permission are those who have faith in Allah and His Apostle. So when they seek your permission for some of theirs [private] work, give permission to whomever of them you wish and plead with Allah to forgive them. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُواْ مَعَهُۥ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣲ جَامِعࣲ لَّمۡ يَذۡهَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُوهُۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَـٔۡذِنُونَكَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنُوكَ لِبَعۡضِ شَأۡنِهِمۡ فَأۡذَن لِّمَن شِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the faithful are those who have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and when they are with him in a collective affair, they do not leave until they have sought his permission. Indeed those who seek your permission are those who have faith in Allah and His Apostle. So when they seek your permission for some of theirs [private] work, give permission to whomever of them you wish and plead with Allah to forgive them. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

text: Do not consider the Apostle’s summons amongst you to be like your summoning one another. Allah certainly knows those of you who slip away shielding one another. Those who disobey his orders should beware lest an affliction should visit them or a painful punishment should befall them

citation.arabic_text: لَّا تَجۡعَلُواْ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيۡنَكُمۡ كَدُعَآءِ بَعۡضِكُم بَعۡضࣰ اۚ قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمۡ لِوَاذࣰ اۚ فَلۡيَحۡذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمۡ فِتۡنَةٌ أَوۡ يُصِيبَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
citation.translation: Do not consider the Apostle’s summons amongst you to be like your summoning one another. Allah certainly knows those of you who slip away shielding one another. Those who disobey his orders should beware lest an affliction should visit them or a painful punishment should befall them

text: Behold! To Allah indeed belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. He certainly knows your present state. The day they are brought back to Him He will inform them about what they have done, and Allah has knowledge of all things

citation.arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ قَدۡ يَعۡلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَيَوۡمَ يُرۡجَعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمُۢ
citation.translation: Behold! To Allah indeed belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. He certainly knows your present state. The day they are brought back to Him He will inform them about what they have done, and Allah has knowledge of all things

text: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion to His servant that he may be a warner to all the nations

citation.arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
citation.translation: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion to His servant that he may be a warner to all the nations

text: He, to whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and who did not take any offspring, nor has He any partner in sovereignty, and He created everything and determined it in a precise measure

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدࣰ ا وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكࣱ فِي ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءࣲ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقۡدِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: He, to whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and who did not take any offspring, nor has He any partner in sovereignty, and He created everything and determined it in a precise measure

text: Yet they have taken gods besides Him who create nothing and have themselves been created, and who have no control over their own harm or benefit and have no control over [their own] death, life, or resurrection

citation.arabic_text: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّا يَخۡلُقُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا نَفۡعࣰ ا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مَوۡتࣰ ا وَلَا حَيَوٰةࣰ وَلَا نُشُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: Yet they have taken gods besides Him who create nothing and have themselves been created, and who have no control over their own harm or benefit and have no control over [their own] death, life, or resurrection

text: The faithless say, ‘This is nothing but a lie that he has fabricated, and other people have abetted him in it.’ Thus they have certainly come out with wrongdoing and falsehood

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفۡكٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ قَوۡمٌ ءَاخَرُونَۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءُو ظُلۡمࣰ ا وَزُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: The faithless say, ‘This is nothing but a lie that he has fabricated, and other people have abetted him in it.’ Thus they have certainly come out with wrongdoing and falsehood

text: They say, ‘He has taken down myths of the ancients, and they are dictated to him morning and evening.’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ ٱكۡتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: They say, ‘He has taken down myths of the ancients, and they are dictated to him morning and evening.’

text: Say, ‘It has been sent down by Him who knows the hidden in the heavens and the earth. Indeed He is all-forgiving, all-merciful.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورࣰ ا رَّحِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘It has been sent down by Him who knows the hidden in the heavens and the earth. Indeed He is all-forgiving, all-merciful.’

text: And they say, ‘What sort of apostle is this who eats food and walks in the marketplaces? Why has not an angel been sent down to him so as to be a warner along with him?’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأۡكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشِي فِي ٱلۡأَسۡوَاقِ لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡهِ مَلَكࣱ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
citation.translation: And they say, ‘What sort of apostle is this who eats food and walks in the marketplaces? Why has not an angel been sent down to him so as to be a warner along with him?’

text: Or, ‘[Why is not] a treasure thrown to him, or [why does] he [not] have a garden from which he may eat?’ And the wrongdoers say, ‘You are just following a bewitched man.’

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ يُلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِ كَنزٌ أَوۡ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةࣱ يَأۡكُلُ مِنۡهَاۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلࣰ ا مَّسۡحُورًا
citation.translation: Or, ‘[Why is not] a treasure thrown to him, or [why does] he [not] have a garden from which he may eat?’ And the wrongdoers say, ‘You are just following a bewitched man.’

text: Look, how they coin epithets for you; so they go astray, and cannot find the way

citation.arabic_text: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Look, how they coin epithets for you; so they go astray, and cannot find the way

text: Blessed is He who will grant you better than that if He wishes—gardens with streams running in them, and He will make for you palaces

citation.arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِيٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكَ قُصُورَۢا
citation.translation: Blessed is He who will grant you better than that if He wishes—gardens with streams running in them, and He will make for you palaces

text: Indeed, they deny the Hour, and We have prepared a Blaze for those who deny the Hour

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلسَّاعَةِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
citation.translation: Indeed, they deny the Hour, and We have prepared a Blaze for those who deny the Hour

text: When it sights them from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا رَأَتۡهُم مِّن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدࣲ سَمِعُواْ لَهَا تَغَيُّظࣰ ا وَزَفِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: When it sights them from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring

text: And when they are cast into a narrow place in it, bound together [in chains], they will pray for [their own] annihilation

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ مِنۡهَا مَكَانࣰ ا ضَيِّقࣰ ا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوۡاْ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: And when they are cast into a narrow place in it, bound together [in chains], they will pray for [their own] annihilation

text: [They will be told:] ‘Do not pray for a single annihilation today, but pray for many annihilations!’

citation.arabic_text: لَّا تَدۡعُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُورࣰ ا وَٰحِدࣰ ا وَٱدۡعُواْ ثُبُورࣰ ا كَثِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: [They will be told:] ‘Do not pray for a single annihilation today, but pray for many annihilations!’

text: Say, ‘Is that better, or the everlasting paradise promised to the Godwary, which will be their reward and destination?’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ جَنَّةُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۚ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ وَمَصِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘Is that better, or the everlasting paradise promised to the Godwary, which will be their reward and destination?’

text: There they will have whatever they wish, abiding [forever]—a promise [much] besought, [binding] on your Lord

citation.arabic_text: لَّهُمۡ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَٰلِدِينَۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعۡدࣰ ا مَّسۡـُٔولࣰ ا
citation.translation: There they will have whatever they wish, abiding [forever]—a promise [much] besought, [binding] on your Lord

text: On the day that He will muster them and those whom they worship besides Allah, He will say, ‘Was it you who led astray these servants of Mine, or did they themselves stray from the way?’

citation.arabic_text: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمۡ أَضۡلَلۡتُمۡ عِبَادِي هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمۡ هُمۡ ضَلُّواْ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
citation.translation: On the day that He will muster them and those whom they worship besides Allah, He will say, ‘Was it you who led astray these servants of Mine, or did they themselves stray from the way?’

text: They will say, ‘Immaculate are You! It does not behoove us to take any wali in Your stead! But You provided for them and their fathers until they forgot the Reminder, and they were a ruined lot.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِي لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ وَلَٰكِن مَّتَّعۡتَهُمۡ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ نَسُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: They will say, ‘Immaculate are You! It does not behoove us to take any wali in Your stead! But You provided for them and their fathers until they forgot the Reminder, and they were a ruined lot.’

text: So they will certainly impugn you in what you say, and you will neither be able to circumvent [punishment] nor find help, and whoever of you does wrong, We shall make him taste a terrible punishment

citation.arabic_text: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسۡتَطِيعُونَ صَرۡفࣰ ا وَلَا نَصۡرࣰ اۚ وَمَن يَظۡلِم مِّنكُمۡ نُذِقۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا كَبِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: So they will certainly impugn you in what you say, and you will neither be able to circumvent [punishment] nor find help, and whoever of you does wrong, We shall make him taste a terrible punishment

text: We did not send any apostles before you but that they indeed ate food and walked in marketplaces. We have made you a [means of] test for one another, [to see] if you will be patient and steadfast, and your Lord is all-seeing

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ لَيَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡوَاقِۗ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَعۡضَكُمۡ لِبَعۡضࣲ فِتۡنَةً أَتَصۡبِرُونَۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: We did not send any apostles before you but that they indeed ate food and walked in marketplaces. We have made you a [means of] test for one another, [to see] if you will be patient and steadfast, and your Lord is all-seeing

text: Those who do not expect to encounter Us say, ‘Why have angels not been sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord?’ Certainly, they are full of arrogance within their souls and have become terribly defiant

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوۡلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوۡ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَاۗ لَقَدِ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَعَتَوۡ عُتُوࣰّ ا كَبِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Those who do not expect to encounter Us say, ‘Why have angels not been sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord?’ Certainly, they are full of arrogance within their souls and have become terribly defiant

text: The day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the guilty on that day, and they will say, ‘Keep off [from paradise]!’

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشۡرَىٰ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجۡرࣰ ا مَّحۡجُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: The day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the guilty on that day, and they will say, ‘Keep off [from paradise]!’

text: Then We shall attend to the works they have done and then turn them into scattered dust

citation.arabic_text: وَقَدِمۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُواْ مِنۡ عَمَلࣲ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هَبَآءࣰ مَّنثُورًا
citation.translation: Then We shall attend to the works they have done and then turn them into scattered dust

text: On that day the inhabitants of paradise will be in the best abode and an excellent resting place

citation.arabic_text: أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَيۡرࣱ مُّسۡتَقَرࣰّ ا وَأَحۡسَنُ مَقِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: On that day the inhabitants of paradise will be in the best abode and an excellent resting place

text: The day when the sky with its clouds will be split open, and the angels will be sent down [in a majestic] descent

citation.arabic_text: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلۡغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
citation.translation: The day when the sky with its clouds will be split open, and the angels will be sent down [in a majestic] descent

text: on that day true sovereignty will belong to the All-beneficent, and it will be a hard day for the faithless

citation.arabic_text: ٱلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡحَقُّ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ وَكَانَ يَوۡمًا عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: on that day true sovereignty will belong to the All-beneficent, and it will be a hard day for the faithless

text: It will be a day when the wrongdoer will bite his hands, saying, ‘I wish I had followed the Apostle’s way

citation.arabic_text: وَيَوۡمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيۡهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي ٱتَّخَذۡتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: It will be a day when the wrongdoer will bite his hands, saying, ‘I wish I had followed the Apostle’s way

text: Woe to me! I wish I had not taken so and so as a friend

citation.arabic_text: يَٰوَيۡلَتَىٰ لَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Woe to me! I wish I had not taken so and so as a friend

text: Certainly he led me astray from the Reminder after it had come to me, and Satan is a deserter of man.’

citation.arabic_text: لَّقَدۡ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ جَآءَنِيۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولࣰ ا
citation.translation: Certainly he led me astray from the Reminder after it had come to me, and Satan is a deserter of man.’

text: And the Apostle will say, ‘O my Lord! Indeed my people consigned this Quran to oblivion.’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي ٱتَّخَذُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مَهۡجُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: And the Apostle will say, ‘O my Lord! Indeed my people consigned this Quran to oblivion.’

text: That is how for every prophet We assigned an enemy from among the guilty, and your Lord suffices as helper and guide

citation.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوࣰّ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيࣰ ا وَنَصِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: That is how for every prophet We assigned an enemy from among the guilty, and your Lord suffices as helper and guide

text: The faithless say, ‘Why has not the Quran been sent down to him all at once?’ So it was, that We may strengthen your heart with it, and We have recited it [to you] in a measured tone

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ جُمۡلَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۖ وَرَتَّلۡنَٰهُ تَرۡتِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: The faithless say, ‘Why has not the Quran been sent down to him all at once?’ So it was, that We may strengthen your heart with it, and We have recited it [to you] in a measured tone

text: They do not bring you any representation but that We bring you the truth [in reply to them] and the best exposition

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يَأۡتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيرًا
citation.translation: They do not bring you any representation but that We bring you the truth [in reply to them] and the best exposition

text: Those who will be mustered [fallen] on their faces toward hell, they are the worse situated and further astray from the [right] way

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحۡشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ شَرࣱّ مَّكَانࣰ ا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Those who will be mustered [fallen] on their faces toward hell, they are the worse situated and further astray from the [right] way

text: Certainly We gave Moses the Book and We made Aaron, his brother, accompany him as a minister

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Certainly We gave Moses the Book and We made Aaron, his brother, accompany him as a minister

text: Then We said, ‘Let the two of you go to the people who have denied Our signs.’ Then We destroyed them utterly

citation.arabic_text: فَقُلۡنَا ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Then We said, ‘Let the two of you go to the people who have denied Our signs.’ Then We destroyed them utterly

text: And Noah’s people, We drowned them when they impugned the apostles, and We made them a sign for mankind, and We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment

citation.arabic_text: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةࣰۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: And Noah’s people, We drowned them when they impugned the apostles, and We made them a sign for mankind, and We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment

text: And ‘Ad and Thamud, and the people of Rass, and many generations between them

citation.arabic_text: وَعَادࣰ ا وَثَمُودَاْ وَأَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونَۢا بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: And ‘Ad and Thamud, and the people of Rass, and many generations between them

text: For each of them We drew examples, and each We destroyed utterly

citation.arabic_text: وَكُلࣰّ ا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَۖ وَكُلࣰّ ا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: For each of them We drew examples, and each We destroyed utterly

text: Certainly they must have passed the town on which an evil shower was rained. Have they not seen it? Rather, they did not expect resurrection [to happen]

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَى ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ أَفَلَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوۡنَهَاۚ بَلۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ نُشُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: Certainly they must have passed the town on which an evil shower was rained. Have they not seen it? Rather, they did not expect resurrection [to happen]

text: When they see you they just take you in derision: ‘Is this the one whom Allah has sent as an apostle

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
citation.translation: When they see you they just take you in derision: ‘Is this the one whom Allah has sent as an apostle

text: Indeed he was about to lead us astray from our gods, had we not stood firm by them.’ Soon they will know, when they sight the punishment, who is further astray from the [right] way

citation.arabic_text: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَآ أَن صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَاۚ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوۡنَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
citation.translation: Indeed he was about to lead us astray from our gods, had we not stood firm by them.’ Soon they will know, when they sight the punishment, who is further astray from the [right] way

text: Have you seen him who has taken his desire to be his god? Is it your duty to watch over him

citation.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيلًا
citation.translation: Have you seen him who has taken his desire to be his god? Is it your duty to watch over him

text: Do you suppose that most of them listen or exercise their reason? They are just like cattle; indeed, they are further astray from the way

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُونَ أَوۡ يَعۡقِلُونَۚ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا كَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ بَلۡ هُمۡ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
citation.translation: Do you suppose that most of them listen or exercise their reason? They are just like cattle; indeed, they are further astray from the way

text: Have you not regarded how your Lord spreads the twilight? (Had He wished He would have made it stand still.) Then We made the sun a beacon for it

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنࣰ ا ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Have you not regarded how your Lord spreads the twilight? (Had He wished He would have made it stand still.) Then We made the sun a beacon for it

text: Then We retract it toward Ourselves, with a gentle retracting

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضࣰ ا يَسِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Then We retract it toward Ourselves, with a gentle retracting

text: It is He who made for you the night as a covering and sleep for rest and He made the day a recall to life

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسࣰ ا وَٱلنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: It is He who made for you the night as a covering and sleep for rest and He made the day a recall to life

text: And it is He who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy, and We send down from the sky purifying water

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ طَهُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: And it is He who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy, and We send down from the sky purifying water

text: with which We revive a dead country and provide water to many of the cattle and humans We have created

citation.arabic_text: لِّنُحۡـِۧيَ بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ ا وَنُسۡقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَآ أَنۡعَٰمࣰ ا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: with which We revive a dead country and provide water to many of the cattle and humans We have created

text: Certainly We distribute it among them so that they may take admonition. But most people are only intent on ingratitude

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: Certainly We distribute it among them so that they may take admonition. But most people are only intent on ingratitude

text: Had We wished, We would have sent a warner to every town

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَعَثۡنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرۡيَةࣲ نَّذِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Had We wished, We would have sent a warner to every town

text: So do not obey the faithless, but wage a great jihad against them with it

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدۡهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادࣰ ا كَبِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: So do not obey the faithless, but wage a great jihad against them with it

text: It is He who merged the two seas: this one sweet and agreeable, and that one briny and bitter, and between the two He set a barrier and a forbidding hindrance

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هَٰذَا عَذۡبࣱ فُرَاتࣱ وَهَٰذَا مِلۡحٌ أُجَاجࣱ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخࣰ ا وَحِجۡرࣰ ا مَّحۡجُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: It is He who merged the two seas: this one sweet and agreeable, and that one briny and bitter, and between the two He set a barrier and a forbidding hindrance

text: It is He who created the human being from water, then invested him with ties of blood and marriage, and your Lord is all-powerful

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ بَشَرࣰ ا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبࣰ ا وَصِهۡرࣰ اۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: It is He who created the human being from water, then invested him with ties of blood and marriage, and your Lord is all-powerful

text: They worship besides Allah that which neither brings them any benefit nor causes them any harm, and the faithless one is ever an abettor against his Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَيَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡۗ وَكَانَ ٱلۡكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: They worship besides Allah that which neither brings them any benefit nor causes them any harm, and the faithless one is ever an abettor against his Lord

text: We did not send you except as a bearer of good news and as a warner

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرࣰ ا وَنَذِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: We did not send you except as a bearer of good news and as a warner

text: Say, ‘I do not ask you any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes should take the way to his Lord.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘I do not ask you any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes should take the way to his Lord.’

text: Put your trust in the Living One who does not die, and celebrate His praise. He suffices as one all-aware of the sins of His servants

citation.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
citation.translation: Put your trust in the Living One who does not die, and celebrate His praise. He suffices as one all-aware of the sins of His servants

text: He, who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days, and then settled on the Throne, the All-beneficent; so ask someone who is well aware about Him

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهِۦ خَبِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: He, who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days, and then settled on the Throne, the All-beneficent; so ask someone who is well aware about Him

text: When they are told: ‘Prostrate yourselves before the All-beneficent,’ they say, ‘What is ‘‘the All-beneficent’’? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whatever you bid us?’ And it increases their aversion

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ أَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَأۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُورࣰ ا۩
citation.translation: When they are told: ‘Prostrate yourselves before the All-beneficent,’ they say, ‘What is ‘‘the All-beneficent’’? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whatever you bid us?’ And it increases their aversion

text: Blessed is He who appointed houses in the sky and set in it a lamp and a shining moon

citation.arabic_text: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجࣰ ا وَقَمَرࣰ ا مُّنِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Blessed is He who appointed houses in the sky and set in it a lamp and a shining moon

text: It is He who made the night and the day alternate for someone who desires to take admonition, or desires to give thanks

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةࣰ لِّمَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوۡ أَرَادَ شُكُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: It is He who made the night and the day alternate for someone who desires to take admonition, or desires to give thanks

text: The servants of the All-beneficent are those who walk humbly on the earth, and when the ignorant address them, say, ‘Peace!’

citation.arabic_text: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنࣰ ا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ ا
citation.translation: The servants of the All-beneficent are those who walk humbly on the earth, and when the ignorant address them, say, ‘Peace!’

text: Those who spend the night for their Lord, prostrating and standing [in worship]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدࣰ ا وَقِيَٰمࣰ ا
citation.translation: Those who spend the night for their Lord, prostrating and standing [in worship]

text: Those who say, ‘Our Lord! Turn away from us the punishment of hell. Indeed its punishment is enduring

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
citation.translation: Those who say, ‘Our Lord! Turn away from us the punishment of hell. Indeed its punishment is enduring

text: Indeed it is an evil station and abode.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرࣰّ ا وَمُقَامࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed it is an evil station and abode.’

text: Those who are neither wasteful nor tightfisted when spending, but balanced between these [two extremes]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامࣰ ا
citation.translation: Those who are neither wasteful nor tightfisted when spending, but balanced between these [two extremes]

text: Those who do not invoke another deity besides Allah, and do not kill a soul [whose life] Allah has made inviolable, except with due cause, and do not commit fornication. (Whoever does that shall encounter its retribution)

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدۡعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُونَۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ أَثَامࣰ ا
citation.translation: Those who do not invoke another deity besides Allah, and do not kill a soul [whose life] Allah has made inviolable, except with due cause, and do not commit fornication. (Whoever does that shall encounter its retribution)

text: the punishment being doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection. In it he will abide in humiliation forever

citation.arabic_text: يُضَٰعَفۡ لَهُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
citation.translation: the punishment being doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection. In it he will abide in humiliation forever

text: except those who repent, attain faith, and act righteously. For such, Allah will replace their misdeeds with good deeds, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلࣰ ا صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ حَسَنَٰتࣲۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣰ ا رَّحِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: except those who repent, attain faith, and act righteously. For such, Allah will replace their misdeeds with good deeds, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

text: And whoever repents and acts righteously indeed turns to Allah with due penitence

citation.arabic_text: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: And whoever repents and acts righteously indeed turns to Allah with due penitence

text: Those who do not give false testimony, and when they come upon frivolity, pass by with dignity

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشۡهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِٱللَّغۡوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامࣰ ا
citation.translation: Those who do not give false testimony, and when they come upon frivolity, pass by with dignity

text: Those who, when reminded of the signs of their Lord, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمࣰّ ا وَعُمۡيَانࣰ ا
citation.translation: Those who, when reminded of the signs of their Lord, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them

text: And those who say, ‘Our Lord! Give us joy and comfort in our spouses and offspring, and make us imams of the Godwary.’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنࣲ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
citation.translation: And those who say, ‘Our Lord! Give us joy and comfort in our spouses and offspring, and make us imams of the Godwary.’

text: Those shall be rewarded with sublime abodes for their patience and steadfastness, and they shall be met there with greetings and ‘Peace,’

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ ٱلۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةࣰ وَسَلَٰمًا
citation.translation: Those shall be rewarded with sublime abodes for their patience and steadfastness, and they shall be met there with greetings and ‘Peace,’

text: to abide in them [forever], an excellent station and abode

citation.arabic_text: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرࣰّ ا وَمُقَامࣰ ا
citation.translation: to abide in them [forever], an excellent station and abode

text: Say, ‘Were it not for the sake of summoning you [to faith], what store my Lord would have set by you? But you impugned [me and my summons], so it will soon follow as a result.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا
citation.translation: Say, ‘Were it not for the sake of summoning you [to faith], what store my Lord would have set by you? But you impugned [me and my summons], so it will soon follow as a result.’

text: Ta, Seen, Meem

citation.arabic_text: طسٓمٓ
citation.translation: Ta, Seen, Meem

text: These are the signs of the Manifest Book

citation.arabic_text: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
citation.translation: These are the signs of the Manifest Book

text: You are liable to imperil your life [out of distress] that they will not have faith

citation.arabic_text: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعࣱ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: You are liable to imperil your life [out of distress] that they will not have faith

text: If We wish We will send down to them a sign from the sky before which their heads will remain bowed in humility

citation.arabic_text: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةࣰ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
citation.translation: If We wish We will send down to them a sign from the sky before which their heads will remain bowed in humility

text: There does not come to them any new reminder from the All-beneficent but that they disregard it

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرࣲ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
citation.translation: There does not come to them any new reminder from the All-beneficent but that they disregard it

text: They have already denied [the truth], but soon there will come to them the news of what they have been deriding

citation.arabic_text: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
citation.translation: They have already denied [the truth], but soon there will come to them the news of what they have been deriding

text: Have they not regarded the earth, how many of every splendid kind [of vegetation] We have caused to grow in it

citation.arabic_text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجࣲ كَرِيمٍ
citation.translation: Have they not regarded the earth, how many of every splendid kind [of vegetation] We have caused to grow in it

text: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: When your Lord called out to Moses: [saying,] ‘Go to those wrongdoing people

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
citation.translation: When your Lord called out to Moses: [saying,] ‘Go to those wrongdoing people

text: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not be wary [of Allah]?’

citation.arabic_text: قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not be wary [of Allah]?’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! I fear they will impugn me

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! I fear they will impugn me

text: and I will become upset and my tongue will fail me. So send for Aaron [to join me]

citation.arabic_text: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
citation.translation: and I will become upset and my tongue will fail me. So send for Aaron [to join me]

text: Besides, they have a charge against me, and I fear they will kill me.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبࣱ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
citation.translation: Besides, they have a charge against me, and I fear they will kill me.’

text: He said, ‘Certainly not! Let both of you go with Our signs: We will indeed be with you, hearing [everything]

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Certainly not! Let both of you go with Our signs: We will indeed be with you, hearing [everything]

text: So approach Pharaoh and say, ‘‘We are indeed envoys of the Lord of the worlds

citation.arabic_text: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: So approach Pharaoh and say, ‘‘We are indeed envoys of the Lord of the worlds

text: that you let the Children of Israel leave with us.’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: أَنۡ أَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
citation.translation: that you let the Children of Israel leave with us.’’ ’

text: He [i.e. Pharaoh] said, ‘Did we not rear you as a child among us, and did you not stay with us for years of your life

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدࣰ ا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
citation.translation: He [i.e. Pharaoh] said, ‘Did we not rear you as a child among us, and did you not stay with us for years of your life

text: Then you committed that deed of yours, and you are an ingrate.’

citation.arabic_text: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
citation.translation: Then you committed that deed of yours, and you are an ingrate.’

text: He said, ‘I did that when I was astray

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذࣰ ا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘I did that when I was astray

text: So I fled from you, as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me sound judgement and made me one of the apostles

citation.arabic_text: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمࣰ ا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: So I fled from you, as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me sound judgement and made me one of the apostles

text: That you have enslaved the Children of Israel—is that the favour with which you reproach me?’

citation.arabic_text: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةࣱ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
citation.translation: That you have enslaved the Children of Israel—is that the favour with which you reproach me?’

text: He said, ‘And what is ‘‘the Lord of all the worlds?’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘And what is ‘‘the Lord of all the worlds?’’ ’

text: He said, ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them,—should you have conviction.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them,—should you have conviction.’

text: He said to those who were around him, ‘Don’t you hear?!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسۡتَمِعُونَ
citation.translation: He said to those who were around him, ‘Don’t you hear?!’

text: He said, ‘Your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!’

text: He said, ‘Indeed your messenger, who has been sent to you, is surely crazy!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
citation.translation: He said, ‘Indeed your messenger, who has been sent to you, is surely crazy!’

text: He said, ‘The Lord of the east and the west and whatever is between them—should you exercise your reason.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘The Lord of the east and the west and whatever is between them—should you exercise your reason.’

text: He said, ‘If you take up any god other than me, I will surely make you a prisoner!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘If you take up any god other than me, I will surely make you a prisoner!’

text: He said, ‘What if I bring you something [as an] unmistakable [proof]?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكَ بِشَيۡءࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: He said, ‘What if I bring you something [as an] unmistakable [proof]?’

text: He said, ‘Then bring it, should you be truthful.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Then bring it, should you be truthful.’

text: Thereat he threw down his staff, and behold, it was a manifest python

citation.arabic_text: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Thereat he threw down his staff, and behold, it was a manifest python

text: Then he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white and bright to the onlookers

citation.arabic_text: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
citation.translation: Then he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white and bright to the onlookers

text: He said to the elite [who stood] around him, ‘This is indeed an expert magician

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: He said to the elite [who stood] around him, ‘This is indeed an expert magician

text: who seeks to expel you from your land with his magic. So what do you advise?’

citation.arabic_text: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
citation.translation: who seeks to expel you from your land with his magic. So what do you advise?’

text: They said, ‘Put him and his brother off for a while, and send heralds to the cities

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Put him and his brother off for a while, and send heralds to the cities

text: to bring you every expert magician.’

citation.arabic_text: يَأۡتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: to bring you every expert magician.’

text: So the magicians were gathered for the tryst of a known day

citation.arabic_text: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
citation.translation: So the magicians were gathered for the tryst of a known day

text: and the people were told: ‘Will you all gather?!’

citation.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّجۡتَمِعُونَ
citation.translation: and the people were told: ‘Will you all gather?!’

text: ‘Maybe we will follow the magicians, if they are victors!’

citation.arabic_text: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
citation.translation: ‘Maybe we will follow the magicians, if they are victors!’

text: So when the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we have a reward if we were to be the victors?’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
citation.translation: So when the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we have a reward if we were to be the victors?’

text: He said, ‘Of course; and you will be among members of my inner circle.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذࣰ ا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Of course; and you will be among members of my inner circle.’

text: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you have to throw!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
citation.translation: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you have to throw!’

text: So they threw down their sticks and ropes, and said, ‘By the might of Pharaoh, we shall surely be victorious!’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
citation.translation: So they threw down their sticks and ropes, and said, ‘By the might of Pharaoh, we shall surely be victorious!’

text: Thereat Moses threw down his staff, and behold, it was swallowing what they had faked

citation.arabic_text: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
citation.translation: Thereat Moses threw down his staff, and behold, it was swallowing what they had faked

text: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating

citation.arabic_text: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
citation.translation: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating

text: They said, ‘We believe in the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘We believe in the Lord of all the worlds

text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’

citation.arabic_text: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
citation.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’

text: He [i.e. Pharaoh] said, ‘Do you profess faith in Him before I should permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Soon you will know! I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفࣲ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
citation.translation: He [i.e. Pharaoh] said, ‘Do you profess faith in Him before I should permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Soon you will know! I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.’

text: They said, ‘[There is] no harm [in that]! Indeed, we shall return to our Lord

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘[There is] no harm [in that]! Indeed, we shall return to our Lord

text: Indeed we hope our Lord will forgive us our offences for being the first to believe.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed we hope our Lord will forgive us our offences for being the first to believe.’

text: Then We revealed to Moses, [saying],‘Set out with My servants at night, for you will be pursued.’

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
citation.translation: Then We revealed to Moses, [saying],‘Set out with My servants at night, for you will be pursued.’

text: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities

citation.arabic_text: فَأَرۡسَلَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
citation.translation: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities

text: [proclaiming:] ‘These are indeed a small band

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرۡذِمَةࣱ قَلِيلُونَ
citation.translation: [proclaiming:] ‘These are indeed a small band

text: They have aroused our wrath

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
citation.translation: They have aroused our wrath

text: and we are alert and fully prepared.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
citation.translation: and we are alert and fully prepared.’

text: So We took them out of gardens and springs

citation.arabic_text: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: So We took them out of gardens and springs

text: and [made them leave behind] treasures and stately homes

citation.arabic_text: وَكُنُوزࣲ وَمَقَامࣲ كَرِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: and [made them leave behind] treasures and stately homes

text: So it was; and We bequeathed them to the Children of Israel

citation.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
citation.translation: So it was; and We bequeathed them to the Children of Israel

text: Then they pursued them at sunrise

citation.arabic_text: فَأَتۡبَعُوهُم مُّشۡرِقِينَ
citation.translation: Then they pursued them at sunrise

text: When the two hosts sighted each other, the companions of Moses said, ‘Indeed we have been caught up.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
citation.translation: When the two hosts sighted each other, the companions of Moses said, ‘Indeed we have been caught up.’

text: He said, ‘Certainly not! Indeed my Lord is with me. He will guide me.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Certainly not! Indeed my Lord is with me. He will guide me.’

text: Thereupon We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff!’ Whereupon it parted, and each part was as if it were a great mountain

citation.arabic_text: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقࣲ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: Thereupon We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff!’ Whereupon it parted, and each part was as if it were a great mountain

text: There, We brought the others near

citation.arabic_text: وَأَزۡلَفۡنَا ثَمَّ ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
citation.translation: There, We brought the others near

text: and We delivered Moses and all those who were with him

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنجَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
citation.translation: and We delivered Moses and all those who were with him

text: Then We drowned the rest

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
citation.translation: Then We drowned the rest

text: There is indeed a sign in that, but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: There is indeed a sign in that, but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: Relate to them the account of Abraham

citation.arabic_text: وَٱتۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَبَأَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
citation.translation: Relate to them the account of Abraham

text: when he said to his father and his people, ‘What is it that you are worshiping?!’

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
citation.translation: when he said to his father and his people, ‘What is it that you are worshiping?!’

text: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constant in our devotion to them.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامࣰ ا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constant in our devotion to them.’

text: He said, ‘Do they hear you when you call them

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ هَلۡ يَسۡمَعُونَكُمۡ إِذۡ تَدۡعُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Do they hear you when you call them

text: Or do they bring you any benefit, or cause you any harm?’

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ يَنفَعُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَضُرُّونَ
citation.translation: Or do they bring you any benefit, or cause you any harm?’

text: They said, ‘Indeed, we found our fathers doing likewise.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Indeed, we found our fathers doing likewise.’

text: He said, ‘Have you regarded what you have been worshipping

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Have you regarded what you have been worshipping

text: you and your ancestors

citation.arabic_text: أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلۡأَقۡدَمُونَ
citation.translation: you and your ancestors

text: They are indeed enemies to me, but the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: They are indeed enemies to me, but the Lord of all the worlds

text: who created me, it is He who guides me

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهۡدِينِ
citation.translation: who created me, it is He who guides me

text: and provides me with food and drink

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطۡعِمُنِي وَيَسۡقِينِ
citation.translation: and provides me with food and drink

text: and when I get sick, it is He who cures me

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَرِضۡتُ فَهُوَ يَشۡفِينِ
citation.translation: and when I get sick, it is He who cures me

text: who will make me die, then He will bring me to life

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحۡيِينِ
citation.translation: who will make me die, then He will bring me to life

text: and who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Retribution.’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: and who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Retribution.’

text: ‘My Lord! Grant me [unerring] judgement, and unite me with the Righteous

citation.arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمࣰ ا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
citation.translation: ‘My Lord! Grant me [unerring] judgement, and unite me with the Righteous

text: Confer on me a worthy repute among the posterity

citation.arabic_text: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقࣲ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: Confer on me a worthy repute among the posterity

text: and make me one of the heirs to the paradise of bliss

citation.arabic_text: وَٱجۡعَلۡنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
citation.translation: and make me one of the heirs to the paradise of bliss

text: Forgive my father, for he is one of those who are astray

citation.arabic_text: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
citation.translation: Forgive my father, for he is one of those who are astray

text: Do not disgrace me on the day that they will be resurrected

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تُخۡزِنِي يَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
citation.translation: Do not disgrace me on the day that they will be resurrected

text: the day when neither wealth nor children will avail

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالࣱ وَلَا بَنُونَ
citation.translation: the day when neither wealth nor children will avail

text: except him who comes to Allah with a sound heart,’

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبࣲ سَلِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: except him who comes to Allah with a sound heart,’

text: and paradise will be brought near for the Godwary

citation.arabic_text: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
citation.translation: and paradise will be brought near for the Godwary

text: and hell will be brought into view for the perverse

citation.arabic_text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِلۡغَاوِينَ
citation.translation: and hell will be brought into view for the perverse

text: and they shall be told: ‘Where is that which you used to worship

citation.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
citation.translation: and they shall be told: ‘Where is that which you used to worship

text: besides Allah? Do they help you, or do they help each other?’

citation.arabic_text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
citation.translation: besides Allah? Do they help you, or do they help each other?’

text: Then they will be cast into it on their faces—they and the perverse

citation.arabic_text: فَكُبۡكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمۡ وَٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ
citation.translation: Then they will be cast into it on their faces—they and the perverse

text: and the hosts of Iblis all together

citation.arabic_text: وَجُنُودُ إِبۡلِيسَ أَجۡمَعُونَ
citation.translation: and the hosts of Iblis all together

text: They will say, as they wrangle in it [together]

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
citation.translation: They will say, as they wrangle in it [together]

text: ‘By Allah, we had indeed been in manifest error

citation.arabic_text: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
citation.translation: ‘By Allah, we had indeed been in manifest error

text: when we equated you with the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: when we equated you with the Lord of all the worlds

text: No one led us astray except the guilty

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
citation.translation: No one led us astray except the guilty

text: Now we have no intercessors

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
citation.translation: Now we have no intercessors

text: nor do we have any sympathetic friend

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: nor do we have any sympathetic friend

text: Had there been another turn for us, we would be among the faithful.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةࣰ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: Had there been another turn for us, we would be among the faithful.’

text: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: The people of Noah impugned the apostles

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: The people of Noah impugned the apostles

text: when Noah, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: when Noah, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

text: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me

text: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me.’

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me.’

text: They said, ‘Shall we believe in you, when it is the riffraff who follow you?’
