citation.arabic_text: ۞قَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلۡأَرۡذَلُونَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Shall we believe in you, when it is the riffraff who follow you?’

text: He said, ‘What do I know as to what they used to do

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘What do I know as to what they used to do

text: Their reckoning is only with my Lord, should you be aware

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
citation.translation: Their reckoning is only with my Lord, should you be aware

text: I will not drive away the faithful

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: I will not drive away the faithful

text: I am just a manifest warner.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: I am just a manifest warner.’

text: They said, ‘Noah, if you do not desist, you will certainly be stoned [to death].’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Noah, if you do not desist, you will certainly be stoned [to death].’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed my people have impugned me

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي كَذَّبُونِ
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed my people have impugned me

text: So judge conclusively between me and them, and deliver me and the faithful who are with me.’

citation.arabic_text: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحࣰ ا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: So judge conclusively between me and them, and deliver me and the faithful who are with me.’

text: Thereupon We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark

citation.arabic_text: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
citation.translation: Thereupon We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark

text: Then We drowned the rest

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا بَعۡدُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
citation.translation: Then We drowned the rest

text: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: [The people of] ‘Ad impugned the apostles

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: [The people of] ‘Ad impugned the apostles

text: when Hud, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: when Hud, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

text: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me

text: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

text: Do you build futile a sign on every prominence

citation.arabic_text: أَتَبۡنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةࣰ تَعۡبَثُونَ
citation.translation: Do you build futile a sign on every prominence

text: You set up structures as if you will be immortal

citation.arabic_text: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَخۡلُدُونَ
citation.translation: You set up structures as if you will be immortal

text: and when you seize [someone for punishment], you seize [him] like tyrants

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ
citation.translation: and when you seize [someone for punishment], you seize [him] like tyrants

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me

text: Be wary of Him who has provided you with whatever you know

citation.arabic_text: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: Be wary of Him who has provided you with whatever you know

text: and aided you with sons and with cattle

citation.arabic_text: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنۡعَٰمࣲ وَبَنِينَ
citation.translation: and aided you with sons and with cattle

text: gardens and springs

citation.arabic_text: وَجَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونٍ
citation.translation: gardens and springs

text: Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.’

text: They said, ‘It is the same to us whether you exhort us or not

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘It is the same to us whether you exhort us or not

text: These are nothing but the traditions of the ancients

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: These are nothing but the traditions of the ancients

text: and we will not be punished.’

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
citation.translation: and we will not be punished.’

text: So they impugned him, whereupon We destroyed them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: So they impugned him, whereupon We destroyed them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: [The people of] Thamud impugned the apostles

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: [The people of] Thamud impugned the apostles

text: when Salih, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: when Salih, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

text: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me

text: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

text: Will you be left secure in that which is here

citation.arabic_text: أَتُتۡرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
citation.translation: Will you be left secure in that which is here

text: —amid gardens and springs

citation.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: —amid gardens and springs

text: farms and date palms with dainty spathes

citation.arabic_text: وَزُرُوعࣲ وَنَخۡلࣲ طَلۡعُهَا هَضِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: farms and date palms with dainty spathes

text: —while you skillfully hew out houses from the mountains

citation.arabic_text: وَتَنۡحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِبَالِ بُيُوتࣰ ا فَٰرِهِينَ
citation.translation: —while you skillfully hew out houses from the mountains

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me

text: and do not obey the dictates of the transgressors

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
citation.translation: and do not obey the dictates of the transgressors

text: who cause corruption in the land and do not bring about reform.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
citation.translation: who cause corruption in the land and do not bring about reform.’

text: They said, ‘Indeed you are one of the bewitched

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Indeed you are one of the bewitched

text: You are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign, should you be truthful.’

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: You are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign, should you be truthful.’

text: He said, ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink and you shall drink on known days

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةࣱ لَّهَا شِرۡبࣱ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
citation.translation: He said, ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink and you shall drink on known days

text: Do not cause her any harm, for then you shall be seized by the punishment of a terrible day.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءࣲ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Do not cause her any harm, for then you shall be seized by the punishment of a terrible day.’

text: But they hamstrung her, whereupon they became regretful

citation.arabic_text: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ نَٰدِمِينَ
citation.translation: But they hamstrung her, whereupon they became regretful

text: So the punishment seized them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: So the punishment seized them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: The people of Lot impugned the apostles

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطٍ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: The people of Lot impugned the apostles

text: when Lot, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: when Lot, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

text: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me

text: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

text: What! Of all people do you come to males

citation.arabic_text: أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلذُّكۡرَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: What! Of all people do you come to males

text: abandoning your wives your Lord has created for you? Indeed, you are a transgressing lot.’

citation.arabic_text: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
citation.translation: abandoning your wives your Lord has created for you? Indeed, you are a transgressing lot.’

text: They said, ‘Lot, if you do not desist, you will surely be banished.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Lot, if you do not desist, you will surely be banished.’

text: He said, ‘Indeed I detest your conduct.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقَالِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Indeed I detest your conduct.’

text: ‘My Lord! Deliver me and my family from what they do.’

citation.arabic_text: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهۡلِي مِمَّا يَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: ‘My Lord! Deliver me and my family from what they do.’

text: So We delivered him and all his family

citation.arabic_text: فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
citation.translation: So We delivered him and all his family

text: except an old woman who remained behind

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عَجُوزࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
citation.translation: except an old woman who remained behind

text: Then We destroyed [all] the rest

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
citation.translation: Then We destroyed [all] the rest

text: and rained down upon them a rain [of stones]. Evil was the rain of those who were warned

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرࣰ اۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
citation.translation: and rained down upon them a rain [of stones]. Evil was the rain of those who were warned

text: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: The inhabitants of Aykah impugned the apostles

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَ أَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: The inhabitants of Aykah impugned the apostles

text: when Shu‘ayb said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: when Shu‘ayb said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]

text: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

text: So be wary of Allah and obey me

citation.arabic_text: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: So be wary of Allah and obey me

text: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds

text: Observe the full measure, and do not be of those who give short measure

citation.arabic_text: ۞أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ
citation.translation: Observe the full measure, and do not be of those who give short measure

text: Weigh with an even balance

citation.arabic_text: وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ
citation.translation: Weigh with an even balance

text: and do not cheat the people of their goods. Do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
citation.translation: and do not cheat the people of their goods. Do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption

text: Be wary of Him who created you and the earlier generations.’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمۡ وَٱلۡجِبِلَّةَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: Be wary of Him who created you and the earlier generations.’

text: They said, ‘Indeed you are one of the bewitched

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَحَّرِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Indeed you are one of the bewitched

text: You are just a human being like us, and we indeed consider you to be a liar

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
citation.translation: You are just a human being like us, and we indeed consider you to be a liar

text: Make a fragment of the sky falls upon us, should you be truthful.’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: Make a fragment of the sky falls upon us, should you be truthful.’

text: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you are doing.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّيٓ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you are doing.’

text: So they impugned him, and then they were overtaken by the punishment of the day of the overshadowing cloud. It was indeed the punishment of a terrible day

citation.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
citation.translation: So they impugned him, and then they were overtaken by the punishment of the day of the overshadowing cloud. It was indeed the punishment of a terrible day

text: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith

text: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: This is indeed [a Book] sent down by the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: This is indeed [a Book] sent down by the Lord of all the worlds

text: brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit

citation.arabic_text: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلۡأَمِينُ
citation.translation: brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit

text: upon your heart (so that you may be one of the warners)

citation.arabic_text: عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ
citation.translation: upon your heart (so that you may be one of the warners)

text: in a clear Arabic language

citation.arabic_text: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيࣲّ مُّبِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: in a clear Arabic language

text: It is indeed [foretold] in the scriptures of the ancients

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: It is indeed [foretold] in the scriptures of the ancients

text: Is it not a sign for them that the learned of the Children of Israel recognize it

citation.arabic_text: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
citation.translation: Is it not a sign for them that the learned of the Children of Israel recognize it

text: Had We sent it down upon some non-Arab

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ نَزَّلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضِ ٱلۡأَعۡجَمِينَ
citation.translation: Had We sent it down upon some non-Arab

text: and had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it

citation.arabic_text: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: and had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it

text: This is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty

citation.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكۡنَٰهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: This is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty

text: they do not believe in it until they sight the painful punishment

citation.arabic_text: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
citation.translation: they do not believe in it until they sight the painful punishment

text: It will overtake them suddenly while they are unaware

citation.arabic_text: فَيَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةࣰ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
citation.translation: It will overtake them suddenly while they are unaware

text: Thereupon they will say, ‘Shall we be granted any respite?’

citation.arabic_text: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلۡ نَحۡنُ مُنظَرُونَ
citation.translation: Thereupon they will say, ‘Shall we be granted any respite?’

text: So do they seek to hasten on Our punishment

citation.arabic_text: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
citation.translation: So do they seek to hasten on Our punishment

text: Tell me, should We let them enjoy for some years

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ إِن مَّتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ سِنِينَ
citation.translation: Tell me, should We let them enjoy for some years

text: then there comes to them what they have been promised

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
citation.translation: then there comes to them what they have been promised

text: of what avail to them will be that which they were given to enjoy

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
citation.translation: of what avail to them will be that which they were given to enjoy

text: We have not destroyed any town without its having warners

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
citation.translation: We have not destroyed any town without its having warners

text: for the sake of admonition, and We were not unjust

citation.arabic_text: ذِكۡرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
citation.translation: for the sake of admonition, and We were not unjust

text: It has not been brought down by the devils

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتۡ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
citation.translation: It has not been brought down by the devils

text: Neither does it behoove them, nor are they capable [of doing that]

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُمۡ وَمَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
citation.translation: Neither does it behoove them, nor are they capable [of doing that]

text: Indeed, they are kept at bay [even] from hearing it

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّمۡعِ لَمَعۡزُولُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed, they are kept at bay [even] from hearing it

text: So do not invoke any god besides Allah, lest you should be among the punished

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
citation.translation: So do not invoke any god besides Allah, lest you should be among the punished

text: Warn the nearest of your kinsfolk

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنذِرۡ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلۡأَقۡرَبِينَ
citation.translation: Warn the nearest of your kinsfolk

text: and lower your wing to the faithful who follow you

citation.arabic_text: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: and lower your wing to the faithful who follow you

text: But if they disobey you, say, ‘I am absolved of what you do.’

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءࣱ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: But if they disobey you, say, ‘I am absolved of what you do.’

text: And put your trust in the All-mighty, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
citation.translation: And put your trust in the All-mighty, the All-merciful

text: who sees you when you stand [for prayer]

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
citation.translation: who sees you when you stand [for prayer]

text: and your going about among those who prostrate

citation.arabic_text: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
citation.translation: and your going about among those who prostrate

text: Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
citation.translation: Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing

text: Should I inform you on whom the devils descend

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
citation.translation: Should I inform you on whom the devils descend

text: They descend on every sinful liar

citation.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: They descend on every sinful liar

text: They eavesdrop, and most of them are liars

citation.arabic_text: يُلۡقُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ كَٰذِبُونَ
citation.translation: They eavesdrop, and most of them are liars

text: As for the poets, [only] the perverse follow them

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡغَاوُۥنَ
citation.translation: As for the poets, [only] the perverse follow them

text: Have you not regarded that they rove in every valley

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادࣲ يَهِيمُونَ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded that they rove in every valley

text: and that they say what they do not do

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
citation.translation: and that they say what they do not do

text: Barring those who have faith, do righteous deeds, and remember Allah much often, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know at what goal they will end up

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرࣰ ا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبࣲ يَنقَلِبُونَ
citation.translation: Barring those who have faith, do righteous deeds, and remember Allah much often, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know at what goal they will end up

text: Ta, Seen. These are the signs of the Quran and a manifest Book

citation.arabic_text: طسٓۚ تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَكِتَابࣲ مُّبِينٍ
citation.translation: Ta, Seen. These are the signs of the Quran and a manifest Book

text: a guidance and good news for the faithful

citation.arabic_text: هُدࣰ ى وَبُشۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: a guidance and good news for the faithful

text: —those who maintain the prayer and pay the zakat, and who are certain of the Hereafter

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ
citation.translation: —those who maintain the prayer and pay the zakat, and who are certain of the Hereafter

text: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds seem decorous to them, and so they are bewildered

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
citation.translation: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds seem decorous to them, and so they are bewildered

text: They are the ones for whom there is a terrible punishment, and they are the ones who will be the biggest losers in the Hereafter

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمۡ سُوٓءُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرُونَ
citation.translation: They are the ones for whom there is a terrible punishment, and they are the ones who will be the biggest losers in the Hereafter

text: Indeed you receive the Quran from One who is all-wise, all-knowing

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مِن لَّدُنۡ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
citation.translation: Indeed you receive the Quran from One who is all-wise, all-knowing

text: When Moses said to his family, ‘Indeed I descry a fire! I will bring you some news from it, or bring you a firebrand so that you may warm yourselves.’

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهۡلِهِۦٓ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارࣰ ا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوۡ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابࣲ قَبَسࣲ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُونَ
citation.translation: When Moses said to his family, ‘Indeed I descry a fire! I will bring you some news from it, or bring you a firebrand so that you may warm yourselves.’

text: When he came to it, he was called: ‘Blessed is He who is in the fire and who is [as well] around it, and immaculate is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds!’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: When he came to it, he was called: ‘Blessed is He who is in the fire and who is [as well] around it, and immaculate is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds!’

text: ‘O Moses! Indeed I am Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.’

citation.arabic_text: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
citation.translation: ‘O Moses! Indeed I am Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise.’

text: ‘Throw down your staff!’ When he saw it wriggling, as if it were a snake, he turned his back [to flee], without looking back. ‘O Moses! ‘Do not be afraid. Indeed the apostles are not afraid before Me

citation.arabic_text: وَأَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنࣱّ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرࣰ ا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Throw down your staff!’ When he saw it wriggling, as if it were a snake, he turned his back [to flee], without looking back. ‘O Moses! ‘Do not be afraid. Indeed the apostles are not afraid before Me

text: nor those who do wrong and then make up for [their] fault with goodness, for indeed I am all-forgiving, all-merciful.’

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءࣲ فَإِنِّي غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: nor those who do wrong and then make up for [their] fault with goodness, for indeed I am all-forgiving, all-merciful.’

text: ‘Insert your hand into your shirt. It will emerge white and bright, without any fault—among nine signs meant for Pharaoh and his people. Indeed they are a transgressing lot.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءࣲۖ فِي تِسۡعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
citation.translation: ‘Insert your hand into your shirt. It will emerge white and bright, without any fault—among nine signs meant for Pharaoh and his people. Indeed they are a transgressing lot.’

text: But when Our signs came to them, as eye-openers, they said, ‘This is plain magic.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةࣰ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: But when Our signs came to them, as eye-openers, they said, ‘This is plain magic.’

text: They impugned them, wrongfully and out of arrogance, though they were convinced in their hearts [of their veracity]. So observe how the fate of the agents of corruption was

citation.arabic_text: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمࣰ ا وَعُلُوࣰّ اۚ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
citation.translation: They impugned them, wrongfully and out of arrogance, though they were convinced in their hearts [of their veracity]. So observe how the fate of the agents of corruption was

text: Certainly, We gave knowledge to David and Solomon, and they said, ‘All praise belongs to Allah, who granted us an advantage over many of His faithful servants.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ عِلۡمࣰ اۖ وَقَالَا ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرࣲ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: Certainly, We gave knowledge to David and Solomon, and they said, ‘All praise belongs to Allah, who granted us an advantage over many of His faithful servants.’

text: Solomon inherited from David, and he said, ‘O people! We have been taught the speech of the birds, and we have been given out of everything. Indeed this is a manifest advantage.’

citation.arabic_text: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيۡرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
citation.translation: Solomon inherited from David, and he said, ‘O people! We have been taught the speech of the birds, and we have been given out of everything. Indeed this is a manifest advantage.’

text: [Once] Solomon’s hosts were marched out for him, comprising jinn, humans and birds, and they were held in check

citation.arabic_text: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
citation.translation: [Once] Solomon’s hosts were marched out for him, comprising jinn, humans and birds, and they were held in check

text: When they came to the Valley of Ants, an ant said, ‘O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Solomon and his hosts should trample on you while they are unaware.’

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمۡلِ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةࣱ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمۡلُ ٱدۡخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمۡ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
citation.translation: When they came to the Valley of Ants, an ant said, ‘O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Solomon and his hosts should trample on you while they are unaware.’

text: Whereat he smiled, amused at its words, and he said, ‘My Lord! Inspire me to give thanks for Your blessing with which You have blessed me and my parents, and that I may do righteous deeds which please You, and admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.’

citation.arabic_text: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكࣰ ا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَدۡخِلۡنِي بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
citation.translation: Whereat he smiled, amused at its words, and he said, ‘My Lord! Inspire me to give thanks for Your blessing with which You have blessed me and my parents, and that I may do righteous deeds which please You, and admit me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.’

text: [One day] he reviewed the birds, and said, ‘Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he absent?’

citation.arabic_text: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلۡهُدۡهُدَ أَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَآئِبِينَ
citation.translation: [One day] he reviewed the birds, and said, ‘Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he absent?’

text: ‘I will punish him with a severe punishment, or I will behead him, unless he brings me a credible excuse.’

citation.arabic_text: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابࣰ ا شَدِيدًا أَوۡ لَأَاْذۡبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوۡ لَيَأۡتِيَنِّي بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: ‘I will punish him with a severe punishment, or I will behead him, unless he brings me a credible excuse.’

text: He did not stay for long [before he turned up] and said, ‘I have alighted on something which you have not alighted on, and I have brought you from Sheba a definite report

citation.arabic_text: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدࣲ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهِۦ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِن سَبَإِۭ بِنَبَإࣲ يَقِينٍ
citation.translation: He did not stay for long [before he turned up] and said, ‘I have alighted on something which you have not alighted on, and I have brought you from Sheba a definite report

text: I found a woman ruling over them, and she has been given everything, and she has a great throne

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمۡرَأَةࣰ تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَأُوتِيَتۡ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: I found a woman ruling over them, and she has been given everything, and she has a great throne

text: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds seem decorous to them—thus he has barred them from the way [of Allah], so they are not guided—

citation.arabic_text: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُونَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ
citation.translation: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds seem decorous to them—thus he has barred them from the way [of Allah], so they are not guided—

text: so that they do not prostrate themselves to Allah, who brings forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and He knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose

citation.arabic_text: أَلَّاۤ يَسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡخَبۡءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُونَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُونَ
citation.translation: so that they do not prostrate themselves to Allah, who brings forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and He knows whatever you hide and whatever you disclose

text: Allah—there is no god except Him—is the Lord of the Great Throne.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ۩
citation.translation: Allah—there is no god except Him—is the Lord of the Great Throne.’

text: He said, ‘We shall see whether you are truthful, or if you are one of the liars

citation.arabic_text: ۞قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘We shall see whether you are truthful, or if you are one of the liars

text: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then draw away from them and observe what [response] they return.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱذۡهَب بِّكِتَٰبِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقِهۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
citation.translation: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then draw away from them and observe what [response] they return.’

text: She said, ‘O [members of the] elite! Indeed a noble letter has been delivered to me

citation.arabic_text: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ إِنِّيٓ أُلۡقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَٰبࣱ كَرِيمٌ
citation.translation: She said, ‘O [members of the] elite! Indeed a noble letter has been delivered to me

text: It is from Solomon, and it begins in the name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
citation.translation: It is from Solomon, and it begins in the name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful

text: [It states,] ‘‘Do not defy me, and come to me in submission.’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: أَلَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ
citation.translation: [It states,] ‘‘Do not defy me, and come to me in submission.’’ ’

text: She said, ‘O [members of the] elite! Give me your opinion concerning my matter. I do not decide any matter until you are present.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَتۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَفۡتُونِي فِيٓ أَمۡرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمۡرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشۡهَدُونِ
citation.translation: She said, ‘O [members of the] elite! Give me your opinion concerning my matter. I do not decide any matter until you are present.’

text: They said, ‘We are powerful and possess a great might. But it is up to you to command. So consider what orders you will give.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ نَحۡنُ أُوْلُواْ قُوَّةࣲ وَأُوْلُواْ بَأۡسࣲ شَدِيدࣲ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ إِلَيۡكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأۡمُرِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘We are powerful and possess a great might. But it is up to you to command. So consider what orders you will give.’

text: She said, ‘Indeed when kings enter a town, they devastate it, and make the mightiest of its people the weakest. That is how they act

citation.arabic_text: قَالَتۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرۡيَةً أَفۡسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهۡلِهَآ أَذِلَّةࣰۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
citation.translation: She said, ‘Indeed when kings enter a town, they devastate it, and make the mightiest of its people the weakest. That is how they act

text: I will send them a gift, and see what the envoys bring back.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنِّي مُرۡسِلَةٌ إِلَيۡهِم بِهَدِيَّةࣲ فَنَاظِرَةُۢ بِمَ يَرۡجِعُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
citation.translation: I will send them a gift, and see what the envoys bring back.’

text: So when he came to Solomon, he said, ‘Are you aiding me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Indeed, you are proud of your gift

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالࣲ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيۡرࣱ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمۡ تَفۡرَحُونَ
citation.translation: So when he came to Solomon, he said, ‘Are you aiding me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Indeed, you are proud of your gift

text: Go back to them, for we will come at them with hosts which they cannot face, and we will expel them from it, abased and degraded.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱرۡجِعۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودࣲ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخۡرِجَنَّهُم مِّنۡهَآ أَذِلَّةࣰ وَهُمۡ صَٰغِرُونَ
citation.translation: Go back to them, for we will come at them with hosts which they cannot face, and we will expel them from it, abased and degraded.’

text: He said, ‘O [members of the] elite! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَيُّكُمۡ يَأۡتِينِي بِعَرۡشِهَا قَبۡلَ أَن يَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘O [members of the] elite! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?’

text: An afreet from among the jinn said, ‘I will bring it to you before you rise from your place. I have the power to do it and am trustworthy.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ عِفۡرِيتࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَۖ وَإِنِّي عَلَيۡهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: An afreet from among the jinn said, ‘I will bring it to you before you rise from your place. I have the power to do it and am trustworthy.’

text: The one who had knowledge of the Book said, ‘I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.’ So when he saw it set near him, he said, ‘This is by the grace of my Lord, to test me if I will give thanks or be ungrateful. Whoever gives thanks, gives thanks only for his own sake. And whoever is ungrateful [should know that] my Lord is indeed all-sufficient, all-generous.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ ٱلَّذِي عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبۡلَ أَن يَرۡتَدَّ إِلَيۡكَ طَرۡفُكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسۡتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضۡلِ رَبِّي لِيَبۡلُوَنِيٓ ءَأَشۡكُرُ أَمۡ أَكۡفُرُۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيࣱّ كَرِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: The one who had knowledge of the Book said, ‘I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.’ So when he saw it set near him, he said, ‘This is by the grace of my Lord, to test me if I will give thanks or be ungrateful. Whoever gives thanks, gives thanks only for his own sake. And whoever is ungrateful [should know that] my Lord is indeed all-sufficient, all-generous.’

text: He said, ‘Disguise her throne for her, so that we may see whether she is discerning or if she is one of the undiscerning ones.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرۡشَهَا نَنظُرۡ أَتَهۡتَدِيٓ أَمۡ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهۡتَدُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Disguise her throne for her, so that we may see whether she is discerning or if she is one of the undiscerning ones.’

text: So when she came, it was said [to her], ‘Is your throne like this one?’ She said, ‘It seems to be the same, and we were informed before it, and we had submitted.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرۡشُكِۖ قَالَتۡ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مِن قَبۡلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسۡلِمِينَ
citation.translation: So when she came, it was said [to her], ‘Is your throne like this one?’ She said, ‘It seems to be the same, and we were informed before it, and we had submitted.’

text: She had been barred [from the way of Allah] by what she used to worship besides Allah, for she belonged to a faithless people

citation.arabic_text: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعۡبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتۡ مِن قَوۡمࣲ كَٰفِرِينَ
citation.translation: She had been barred [from the way of Allah] by what she used to worship besides Allah, for she belonged to a faithless people

text: It was said to her, ‘Enter the palace.’ So when she saw it, she supposed it to be a pool of water, and she bared her shanks. He said, ‘It is a palace paved with crystal.’ She said, ‘My Lord! Indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.’

citation.arabic_text: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدۡخُلِي ٱلصَّرۡحَۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتۡهُ حَسِبَتۡهُ لُجَّةࣰ وَكَشَفَتۡ عَن سَاقَيۡهَاۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرۡحࣱ مُّمَرَّدࣱ مِّن قَوَارِيرَۗ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي وَأَسۡلَمۡتُ مَعَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: It was said to her, ‘Enter the palace.’ So when she saw it, she supposed it to be a pool of water, and she bared her shanks. He said, ‘It is a palace paved with crystal.’ She said, ‘My Lord! Indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.’

text: Certainly We sent to Thamud Salih, their brother, [with the summons:] ‘Worship Allah!’ But thereat they became two groups contending with each other

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمۡ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمۡ فَرِيقَانِ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
citation.translation: Certainly We sent to Thamud Salih, their brother, [with the summons:] ‘Worship Allah!’ But thereat they became two groups contending with each other

text: He said, ‘O My people! Why do you press for evil sooner than for good? Why do you not plead to Allah for forgiveness so that you may receive His mercy?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ لَوۡلَا تَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘O My people! Why do you press for evil sooner than for good? Why do you not plead to Allah for forgiveness so that you may receive His mercy?’

text: They said, ‘We take you and those who are with you for a bad omen.’ He said, ‘Your bad omens are from Allah. Indeed, you are a people being tested.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ ٱطَّيَّرۡنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَۚ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۖ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ تُفۡتَنُونَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘We take you and those who are with you for a bad omen.’ He said, ‘Your bad omens are from Allah. Indeed, you are a people being tested.’

text: There were nine persons in the city who caused corruption in the land and did not set things right

citation.arabic_text: وَكَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطࣲ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
citation.translation: There were nine persons in the city who caused corruption in the land and did not set things right

text: They said, ‘Swear by Allah that we will attack him and his family by night. Then we will tell his heir that we were not present at the murder of his family and that we speak the truth.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ تَقَاسَمُواْ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدۡنَا مَهۡلِكَ أَهۡلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Swear by Allah that we will attack him and his family by night. Then we will tell his heir that we were not present at the murder of his family and that we speak the truth.’

text: They devised a plot, and We [too] devised a plan, but they were not aware

citation.arabic_text: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرࣰ ا وَمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرࣰ ا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
citation.translation: They devised a plot, and We [too] devised a plan, but they were not aware

text: So observe how was the outcome of their plotting, as We destroyed them and all their people

citation.arabic_text: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّا دَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ وَقَوۡمَهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
citation.translation: So observe how was the outcome of their plotting, as We destroyed them and all their people

text: So there lay their houses, fallen in ruin because of their wrongdoing. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who have knowledge

citation.arabic_text: فَتِلۡكَ بُيُوتُهُمۡ خَاوِيَةَۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: So there lay their houses, fallen in ruin because of their wrongdoing. There is indeed a sign in that for a people who have knowledge

text: And We delivered those who had faith and were Godwary

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنجَيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: And We delivered those who had faith and were Godwary

text: [We also sent] Lot, when he said to his people, ‘What! Do you commit this indecency while you look on

citation.arabic_text: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: [We also sent] Lot, when he said to his people, ‘What! Do you commit this indecency while you look on

text: Do you approach men with [sexual] desire instead of women?! Indeed, you are a senseless lot!’

citation.arabic_text: أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهۡوَةࣰ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ تَجۡهَلُونَ
citation.translation: Do you approach men with [sexual] desire instead of women?! Indeed, you are a senseless lot!’

text: But the only answer of his people was that they said, ‘Expel Lot’s family from your town! They are indeed a puritanical lot.’

citation.arabic_text: ۞فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓاْ أَخۡرِجُوٓاْ ءَالَ لُوطࣲ مِّن قَرۡيَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُمۡ أُنَاسࣱ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
citation.translation: But the only answer of his people was that they said, ‘Expel Lot’s family from your town! They are indeed a puritanical lot.’

text: So We delivered him and his family, except his wife. We ordained her to be among those who remained behind

citation.arabic_text: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرۡنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
citation.translation: So We delivered him and his family, except his wife. We ordained her to be among those who remained behind

text: Then We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. Evil was that rain for those who had been warned

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرࣰ اۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
citation.translation: Then We poured down upon them a rain [of stones]. Evil was that rain for those who had been warned

text: Say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah, and Peace be to the servants whom He has chosen.’ Is Allah better, or the partners they ascribe [to Him]

citation.arabic_text: قُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰٓۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيۡرٌ أَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah, and Peace be to the servants whom He has chosen.’ Is Allah better, or the partners they ascribe [to Him]

text: Is He who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water from the sky, whereby We grow delightful gardens, whose trees you could never cause to grow...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Indeed, they are a lot who equate [others with Allah]

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهۡجَةࣲ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمۡ أَن تُنۢبِتُواْ شَجَرَهَآۗ أَءِلَٰهࣱ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ يَعۡدِلُونَ
citation.translation: Is He who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water from the sky, whereby We grow delightful gardens, whose trees you could never cause to grow...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Indeed, they are a lot who equate [others with Allah]

text: Is He who made the earth an abode [for you], and made rivers [flowing] through it, and set firm mountains for it [’s stability], and set a barrier between the two seas...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Indeed, most of them do not know

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ قَرَارࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ حَاجِزًاۗ أَءِلَٰهࣱ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: Is He who made the earth an abode [for you], and made rivers [flowing] through it, and set firm mountains for it [’s stability], and set a barrier between the two seas...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Indeed, most of them do not know

text: Is He who answers the call of the distressed [person] when he invokes Him and removes his distress, and makes you successors on the earth...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Little is the admonition that you take

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلۡمُضۡطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكۡشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجۡعَلُكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَءِلَٰهࣱ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
citation.translation: Is He who answers the call of the distressed [person] when he invokes Him and removes his distress, and makes you successors on the earth...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Little is the admonition that you take

text: Is He who guides you in the darkness of land and sea and who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Exalted is Allah above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him]

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّن يَهۡدِيكُمۡ فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ وَمَن يُرۡسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشۡرَۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ رَحۡمَتِهِۦٓۗ أَءِلَٰهࣱ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
citation.translation: Is He who guides you in the darkness of land and sea and who sends the winds as harbingers of His mercy...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Exalted is Allah above [having] any partners that they ascribe [to Him]

text: Is He who originates the creation, then He will bring it back, and who provides for you from the sky and the earth...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Say, ‘Produce your evidence, if you are truthful.’

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّن يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَءِلَٰهࣱ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِۚ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: Is He who originates the creation, then He will bring it back, and who provides for you from the sky and the earth...? What! Is there a god besides Allah? Say, ‘Produce your evidence, if you are truthful.’

text: Say, ‘No one in the heavens or the earth knows the Unseen except Allah, and they are not aware when they will be resurrected.’

citation.arabic_text: قُل لَّا يَعۡلَمُ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُۚ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُونَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘No one in the heavens or the earth knows the Unseen except Allah, and they are not aware when they will be resurrected.’

text: Do they comprehend the knowledge of the Hereafter? No, they are in doubt about it. Indeed, they are blind to it

citation.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلۡمُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ مِّنۡهَاۖ بَلۡ هُم مِّنۡهَا عَمُونَ
citation.translation: Do they comprehend the knowledge of the Hereafter? No, they are in doubt about it. Indeed, they are blind to it

text: The faithless say, ‘What! When we and our fathers have become dust shall we be raised [from the dead]

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبࣰ ا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخۡرَجُونَ
citation.translation: The faithless say, ‘What! When we and our fathers have become dust shall we be raised [from the dead]

text: We and our fathers were promised this before. [But] these are just myths of the ancients.’

citation.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا هَٰذَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: We and our fathers were promised this before. [But] these are just myths of the ancients.’

text: Say, ‘Travel over the land and observe how was the fate of the guilty.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ سِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘Travel over the land and observe how was the fate of the guilty.’

text: Do not grieve for them, and do not be upset by their guile

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُن فِي ضَيۡقࣲ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُونَ
citation.translation: Do not grieve for them, and do not be upset by their guile

text: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?’

citation.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?’

text: Say, ‘Perhaps there is right behind you some of what you seek to hasten.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘Perhaps there is right behind you some of what you seek to hasten.’

text: Indeed your Lord is gracious to mankind, but most of them do not give thanks

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضۡلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is gracious to mankind, but most of them do not give thanks

text: Your Lord knows whatever their breasts conceal, and whatever they disclose

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
citation.translation: Your Lord knows whatever their breasts conceal, and whatever they disclose

text: There is no invisible thing in the heaven and the earth but it is in a manifest Book

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا مِنۡ غَآئِبَةࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبࣲ مُّبِينٍ
citation.translation: There is no invisible thing in the heaven and the earth but it is in a manifest Book

text: This Quran recounts for the Children of Israel most of what they differ about

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
citation.translation: This Quran recounts for the Children of Israel most of what they differ about

text: and it is indeed a guidance and mercy for the faithful

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدࣰ ى وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: and it is indeed a guidance and mercy for the faithful

text: Your Lord will decide between them by His judgement, and He is the All-mighty, the All-knowing

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُم بِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
citation.translation: Your Lord will decide between them by His judgement, and He is the All-mighty, the All-knowing

text: So put your trust in Allah, for you indeed stand on the manifest truth

citation.arabic_text: فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلۡحَقِّ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
citation.translation: So put your trust in Allah, for you indeed stand on the manifest truth

text: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf listen to your call when they turn their backs

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوۡاْ مُدۡبِرِينَ
citation.translation: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf listen to your call when they turn their backs

text: nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can make only those hear you who believe in Our signs and have submitted

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمۡۖ إِن تُسۡمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
citation.translation: nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can make only those hear you who believe in Our signs and have submitted

text: When the word [of judgement] falls upon them, We shall bring out for them an Animal from the earth who shall tell them that the people had no faith in Our signs

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةࣰ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ
citation.translation: When the word [of judgement] falls upon them, We shall bring out for them an Animal from the earth who shall tell them that the people had no faith in Our signs

text: On that day We shall resurrect from every nation a group of those who denied Our signs, and they will be held in check

citation.arabic_text: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةࣲ فَوۡجࣰ ا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
citation.translation: On that day We shall resurrect from every nation a group of those who denied Our signs, and they will be held in check

text: When they come, He will say, ‘Did you deny My signs without comprehending them in knowledge? What was it that you used to do?’

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبۡتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَمۡ تُحِيطُواْ بِهَا عِلۡمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: When they come, He will say, ‘Did you deny My signs without comprehending them in knowledge? What was it that you used to do?’

text: And the word [of judgement] shall fall upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak

citation.arabic_text: وَوَقَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُواْ فَهُمۡ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
citation.translation: And the word [of judgement] shall fall upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak

text: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِيَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest in it, and the day to provide visibility. There are indeed signs in that for a people who have faith

text: The day when the trumpet is blown, whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified, except such as Allah wishes, and all will come to Him in utter humility

citation.arabic_text: وَيَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوۡهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
citation.translation: The day when the trumpet is blown, whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified, except such as Allah wishes, and all will come to Him in utter humility

text: You see the mountains, which you suppose, to be stationary, while they drift like passing clouds—the handiwork of Allah who has made everything faultless. He is indeed well aware of what you do

citation.arabic_text: وَتَرَى ٱلۡجِبَالَ تَحۡسَبُهَا جَامِدَةࣰ وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِۚ صُنۡعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَتۡقَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
citation.translation: You see the mountains, which you suppose, to be stationary, while they drift like passing clouds—the handiwork of Allah who has made everything faultless. He is indeed well aware of what you do

text: Whoever brings virtue shall receive [a reward] better than it; and on that day they will be secure from terror

citation.arabic_text: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعࣲ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
citation.translation: Whoever brings virtue shall receive [a reward] better than it; and on that day they will be secure from terror

text: But whoever brings vice—they shall be cast on their faces into the Fire [and told:] ‘Shall you not be requited for what you used to do?’

citation.arabic_text: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتۡ وُجُوهُهُمۡ فِي ٱلنَّارِ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: But whoever brings vice—they shall be cast on their faces into the Fire [and told:] ‘Shall you not be requited for what you used to do?’

text: [Say], ‘I have been commanded to worship the Lord of this city who has made it inviolable and to whom all things belong, and I have been commanded to be among those who submit [to Allah]

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡبَلۡدَةِ ٱلَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَيۡءࣲۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
citation.translation: [Say], ‘I have been commanded to worship the Lord of this city who has made it inviolable and to whom all things belong, and I have been commanded to be among those who submit [to Allah]

text: and to recite the Quran.’ Whoever is guided is guided only for his own good, and as for him who goes astray, say, ‘I am just one of the warners.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنۡ أَتۡلُوَاْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِي لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ
citation.translation: and to recite the Quran.’ Whoever is guided is guided only for his own good, and as for him who goes astray, say, ‘I am just one of the warners.’

text: And say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah. Soon He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them.’ Your Lord is not oblivious of what you do

citation.arabic_text: وَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعۡرِفُونَهَاۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: And say, ‘All praise belongs to Allah. Soon He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them.’ Your Lord is not oblivious of what you do

text: Ta, Seen, Meem

citation.arabic_text: طسٓمٓ
citation.translation: Ta, Seen, Meem

text: These are the signs of the Manifest Book

citation.arabic_text: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
citation.translation: These are the signs of the Manifest Book

text: We relate to you truly some of the account of Moses and Pharaoh for a people who have faith

citation.arabic_text: نَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لِقَوۡمࣲ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: We relate to you truly some of the account of Moses and Pharaoh for a people who have faith

text: Indeed Pharaoh tyrannized over the land, reducing its people to factions, abasing one group of them, slaughtering their sons, and sparing their women. Indeed, He was one of the agents of corruption

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ عَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهۡلَهَا شِيَعࣰ ا يَسۡتَضۡعِفُ طَآئِفَةࣰ مِّنۡهُمۡ يُذَبِّحُ أَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيِۦ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed Pharaoh tyrannized over the land, reducing its people to factions, abasing one group of them, slaughtering their sons, and sparing their women. Indeed, He was one of the agents of corruption

text: And We desired to show favour to those who were abased in the land, and to make them imams, and to make them the heirs

citation.arabic_text: وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتُضۡعِفُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَنَجۡعَلَهُمۡ أَئِمَّةࣰ وَنَجۡعَلَهُمُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ
citation.translation: And We desired to show favour to those who were abased in the land, and to make them imams, and to make them the heirs

text: and to establish them in the land, and to show Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts from them that of which they were apprehensive

citation.arabic_text: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَنُرِيَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَحۡذَرُونَ
citation.translation: and to establish them in the land, and to show Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts from them that of which they were apprehensive

text: We revealed to Moses’ mother, [saying], ‘Nurse him; then, when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear or grieve, for We will restore him to you and make him one of the apostles.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَرۡضِعِيهِۖ فَإِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَأَلۡقِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيٓۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: We revealed to Moses’ mother, [saying], ‘Nurse him; then, when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear or grieve, for We will restore him to you and make him one of the apostles.’

text: Then Pharaoh’s kinsmen picked him up that he might be an enemy and a cause of grief to them. Indeed Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts were iniquitous

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمۡ عَدُوࣰّ ا وَحَزَنًاۗ إِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُواْ خَٰطِـِٔينَ
citation.translation: Then Pharaoh’s kinsmen picked him up that he might be an enemy and a cause of grief to them. Indeed Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts were iniquitous

text: Pharaoh’s wife said [to him], ‘[This infant will be] a [source of] comfort to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son.’ But they were not aware

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قُرَّتُ عَيۡنࣲ لِّي وَلَكَۖ لَا تَقۡتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدࣰ ا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
citation.translation: Pharaoh’s wife said [to him], ‘[This infant will be] a [source of] comfort to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son.’ But they were not aware

text: The heart of Moses’ mother became desolate, and indeed she was about to divulge it had We not fortified her heart so that she might have faith [in Allah’s promise]

citation.arabic_text: وَأَصۡبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَٰرِغًاۖ إِن كَادَتۡ لَتُبۡدِي بِهِۦ لَوۡلَآ أَن رَّبَطۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: The heart of Moses’ mother became desolate, and indeed she was about to divulge it had We not fortified her heart so that she might have faith [in Allah’s promise]

text: She said to his sister, ‘Follow him.’ So she watched him from a distance, while they were not aware

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَتۡ لِأُخۡتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِۖ فَبَصُرَتۡ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبࣲ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
citation.translation: She said to his sister, ‘Follow him.’ So she watched him from a distance, while they were not aware

text: Since before We had forbidden him to be suckled by any nurse. So she said, ‘Shall I show you a household that will take care of him for you and they will be his well-wishers?’

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَحَرَّمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَقَالَتۡ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِ بَيۡتࣲ يَكۡفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُۥ نَٰصِحُونَ
citation.translation: Since before We had forbidden him to be suckled by any nurse. So she said, ‘Shall I show you a household that will take care of him for you and they will be his well-wishers?’

text: That is how We restored him to his mother so that she might be comforted and not grieve, and that she might know that Allah’s promise is true, but most of them do not know

citation.arabic_text: فَرَدَدۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ وَلِتَعۡلَمَ أَنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقࣱّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: That is how We restored him to his mother so that she might be comforted and not grieve, and that she might know that Allah’s promise is true, but most of them do not know

text: When he came of age and became fully matured, We gave him judgement and knowledge, and thus do We reward the virtuous

citation.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمࣰ ا وَعِلۡمࣰ اۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: When he came of age and became fully matured, We gave him judgement and knowledge, and thus do We reward the virtuous

text: [One day] he entered the city at a time when its people were not likely to take notice. He found there two men fighting, this one from among his followers, and that one from his enemies. The one who was from his followers sought his help against him who was from his enemies. So Moses hit him with his fist, whereupon he expired. He said, ‘This is of Satan’s doing. Indeed he is clearly a misguiding enemy.’

citation.arabic_text: وَدَخَلَ ٱلۡمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيۡنِ يَقۡتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦۖ فَٱسۡتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِي مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِي مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهِۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنۡ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوࣱّ مُّضِلࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: [One day] he entered the city at a time when its people were not likely to take notice. He found there two men fighting, this one from among his followers, and that one from his enemies. The one who was from his followers sought his help against him who was from his enemies. So Moses hit him with his fist, whereupon he expired. He said, ‘This is of Satan’s doing. Indeed he is clearly a misguiding enemy.’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! I have wronged myself. Forgive me!’ So He forgave him. Indeed, He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! I have wronged myself. Forgive me!’ So He forgave him. Indeed, He is the All-forgiving, the All-merciful

text: He said, ‘My Lord! As You have blessed me, I will never be a supporter of the guilty.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنۡ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرࣰ ا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! As You have blessed me, I will never be a supporter of the guilty.’

text: He rose at dawn in the city, fearful and vigilant, when behold, the one who had sought his help the day before, shouted for his help [once again]. Moses said to him, ‘You are indeed clearly perverse!’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَصۡبَحَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ خَآئِفࣰ ا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي ٱسۡتَنصَرَهُۥ بِٱلۡأَمۡسِ يَسۡتَصۡرِخُهُۥۚ قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِيࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: He rose at dawn in the city, fearful and vigilant, when behold, the one who had sought his help the day before, shouted for his help [once again]. Moses said to him, ‘You are indeed clearly perverse!’

text: But when he wanted to strike him who was an enemy of both of them, he said, ‘Moses, do you want to kill me, just like the one you killed yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land, and you do not desire to be one who brings about reform.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَنۡ أَرَادَ أَن يَبۡطِشَ بِٱلَّذِي هُوَ عَدُوࣱّ لَّهُمَا قَالَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ أَتُرِيدُ أَن تَقۡتُلَنِي كَمَا قَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسَۢا بِٱلۡأَمۡسِۖ إِن تُرِيدُ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ جَبَّارࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا تُرِيدُ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡلِحِينَ
citation.translation: But when he wanted to strike him who was an enemy of both of them, he said, ‘Moses, do you want to kill me, just like the one you killed yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land, and you do not desire to be one who brings about reform.’

text: There came a man from the city outskirts, hurrying. He said, ‘Moses! The elite are indeed conspiring to kill you. So leave. I am indeed your well-wisher.’

citation.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ رَجُلࣱ مِّنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱلۡمَلَأَ يَأۡتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقۡتُلُوكَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ إِنِّي لَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّٰصِحِينَ
citation.translation: There came a man from the city outskirts, hurrying. He said, ‘Moses! The elite are indeed conspiring to kill you. So leave. I am indeed your well-wisher.’

text: So he left the city, fearful and vigilant. He said, ‘My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing lot.’

citation.arabic_text: فَخَرَجَ مِنۡهَا خَآئِفࣰ ا يَتَرَقَّبُۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
citation.translation: So he left the city, fearful and vigilant. He said, ‘My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing lot.’

text: And when he turned his face toward Midian, he said, ‘Maybe my Lord will show me the right way.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلۡقَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَن يَهۡدِيَنِي سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
citation.translation: And when he turned his face toward Midian, he said, ‘Maybe my Lord will show me the right way.’

text: When he arrived at the well of Midian, he found there a throng of people watering [their flocks], and he found, besides them, two women holding back [their flock]. He said, ‘What is your business?’ They said, ‘We do not water [our flock] until the shepherds have driven out [their flocks], and our father is an aged man.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيۡهِ أُمَّةࣰ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمُ ٱمۡرَأَتَيۡنِ تَذُودَانِۖ قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُمَاۖ قَالَتَا لَا نَسۡقِي حَتَّىٰ يُصۡدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُۖ وَأَبُونَا شَيۡخࣱ كَبِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: When he arrived at the well of Midian, he found there a throng of people watering [their flocks], and he found, besides them, two women holding back [their flock]. He said, ‘What is your business?’ They said, ‘We do not water [our flock] until the shepherds have driven out [their flocks], and our father is an aged man.’

text: So he watered [their flock] for them. Then he withdrew toward the shade and said, ‘My Lord! I am indeed in need of any good You may send down to me!’

citation.arabic_text: فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَآ أَنزَلۡتَ إِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرࣲ فَقِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: So he watered [their flock] for them. Then he withdrew toward the shade and said, ‘My Lord! I am indeed in need of any good You may send down to me!’

text: Then one of the two women approached him, walking bashfully. She said, ‘Indeed my father invites you to pay you the wages for watering [our flock] for us.’ So when he came to him and recounted the story to him, he said, ‘Do not be afraid. You have been delivered from the wrongdoing lot.’

citation.arabic_text: فَجَآءَتۡهُ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا تَمۡشِي عَلَى ٱسۡتِحۡيَآءࣲ قَالَتۡ إِنَّ أَبِي يَدۡعُوكَ لِيَجۡزِيَكَ أَجۡرَ مَا سَقَيۡتَ لَنَاۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُۥ وَقَصَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفۡۖ نَجَوۡتَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
citation.translation: Then one of the two women approached him, walking bashfully. She said, ‘Indeed my father invites you to pay you the wages for watering [our flock] for us.’ So when he came to him and recounted the story to him, he said, ‘Do not be afraid. You have been delivered from the wrongdoing lot.’

text: One of the two women said, ‘Father, hire him. Indeed the best you can hire is a powerful and trustworthy man.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱسۡتَـٔۡجِرۡهُۖ إِنَّ خَيۡرَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَـٔۡجَرۡتَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡأَمِينُ
citation.translation: One of the two women said, ‘Father, hire him. Indeed the best you can hire is a powerful and trustworthy man.’

text: He said, ‘Indeed I desire to marry you to one of these two daughters of mine, on condition that you hire yourself to me for eight years. And if you complete ten, that will be up to you, and I do not want to be hard on you. God willing, you will find me to a righteous person.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِّيٓ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أُنكِحَكَ إِحۡدَى ٱبۡنَتَيَّ هَٰتَيۡنِ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَأۡجُرَنِي ثَمَٰنِيَ حِجَجࣲۖ فَإِنۡ أَتۡمَمۡتَ عَشۡرࣰ ا فَمِنۡ عِندِكَۖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أَشُقَّ عَلَيۡكَۚ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Indeed I desire to marry you to one of these two daughters of mine, on condition that you hire yourself to me for eight years. And if you complete ten, that will be up to you, and I do not want to be hard on you. God willing, you will find me to a righteous person.’

text: He said, ‘This will be [by consent] between you and me. Whichever of the two terms I complete, there shall be no imposition upon me, and Allah is witness over what we say.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَۖ أَيَّمَا ٱلۡأَجَلَيۡنِ قَضَيۡتُ فَلَا عُدۡوَٰنَ عَلَيَّۖ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلࣱ‏
citation.translation: He said, ‘This will be [by consent] between you and me. Whichever of the two terms I complete, there shall be no imposition upon me, and Allah is witness over what we say.’
