citation.arabic_text: ۞أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: ‘Did I not exhort you, O children of Adam, saying, “Do not worship Satan. He is indeed your manifest enemy

text: Worship Me. That is a straight path”

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Worship Me. That is a straight path”

text: Certainly, he has led astray many of your generations. Have you not exercised your reason

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلࣰّ ا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
citation.translation: Certainly, he has led astray many of your generations. Have you not exercised your reason

text: This is the hell you had been promised

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
citation.translation: This is the hell you had been promised

text: Enter it today, because of what you used to deny

citation.arabic_text: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
citation.translation: Enter it today, because of what you used to deny

text: Today We shall seal their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness concerning what they used to earn.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
citation.translation: Today We shall seal their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness concerning what they used to earn.’

text: Had We wished We would have blotted out their eyes: then, were they to advance towards the path, how would have they seen

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: Had We wished We would have blotted out their eyes: then, were they to advance towards the path, how would have they seen

text: And had We wished We would have deformed them in their place; then they would neither have been able to move ahead nor to return

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيࣰّ ا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
citation.translation: And had We wished We would have deformed them in their place; then they would neither have been able to move ahead nor to return

text: And whomever We give a long life, We cause him to regress in creation. Then, will they not exercise their reason

citation.arabic_text: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
citation.translation: And whomever We give a long life, We cause him to regress in creation. Then, will they not exercise their reason

text: We did not teach him poetry, nor does it behoove him. This is just a reminder and a manifest Quran

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ وَقُرۡءَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: We did not teach him poetry, nor does it behoove him. This is just a reminder and a manifest Quran

text: so that anyone who is alive may be warned, and that the word may come due against the faithless

citation.arabic_text: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيࣰّ ا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
citation.translation: so that anyone who is alive may be warned, and that the word may come due against the faithless

text: Have they not seen that We have created for them—of what Our hands have worked—cattle, so they have become their masters

citation.arabic_text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمࣰ ا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
citation.translation: Have they not seen that We have created for them—of what Our hands have worked—cattle, so they have become their masters

text: And We made them tractable for them; so some of them make their mounts and some of them they eat

citation.arabic_text: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
citation.translation: And We made them tractable for them; so some of them make their mounts and some of them they eat

text: There are other benefits for them therein, and drinks. Will they not then give thanks

citation.arabic_text: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
citation.translation: There are other benefits for them therein, and drinks. Will they not then give thanks

text: They have taken gods besides Allah, [hoping] that they might be helped [by the fake deities]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
citation.translation: They have taken gods besides Allah, [hoping] that they might be helped [by the fake deities]

text: [But] they cannot help them, while they [themselves] are an army mobilized for their defence

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
citation.translation: [But] they cannot help them, while they [themselves] are an army mobilized for their defence

text: So do not let their remarks grieve you. We indeed know whatever they hide and whatever they disclose

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
citation.translation: So do not let their remarks grieve you. We indeed know whatever they hide and whatever they disclose

text: Does not man see that We created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid, and, behold, he is an open contender

citation.arabic_text: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةࣲ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Does not man see that We created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid, and, behold, he is an open contender

text: He draws comparisons for Us, and forgets his own creation. He says, ‘Who shall revive the bones when they have decayed?’

citation.arabic_text: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلࣰ ا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: He draws comparisons for Us, and forgets his own creation. He says, ‘Who shall revive the bones when they have decayed?’

text: Say, ‘He will revive them who produced them the first time, and He has knowledge of all creation

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةࣲۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
citation.translation: Say, ‘He will revive them who produced them the first time, and He has knowledge of all creation

text: He, who made for you fire out of the green tree, and, behold, you light fire from it

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارࣰ ا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
citation.translation: He, who made for you fire out of the green tree, and, behold, you light fire from it

text: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Yes indeed! He is the All-creator, the All-knowing

citation.arabic_text: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
citation.translation: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Yes indeed! He is the All-creator, the All-knowing

text: All His command, when He wills something, is to say to it ‘Be,’ and it is

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
citation.translation: All His command, when He wills something, is to say to it ‘Be,’ and it is

text: So immaculate is He in whose hand is the dominion of all things, and to whom you shall be brought back

citation.arabic_text: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
citation.translation: So immaculate is He in whose hand is the dominion of all things, and to whom you shall be brought back

text: By the [angels] ranged in ranks

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفࣰّ ا
citation.translation: By the [angels] ranged in ranks

text: by the ones who drive [the clouds] vigorously

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: by the ones who drive [the clouds] vigorously

text: by the ones who recite the reminder

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
citation.translation: by the ones who recite the reminder

text: indeed your God is certainly One

citation.translation: indeed your God is certainly One

text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and the Lord of the easts

citation.arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
citation.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and the Lord of the easts

text: Indeed We have adorned the lowest heaven with the finery of the stars

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
citation.translation: Indeed We have adorned the lowest heaven with the finery of the stars

text: and to guard from any froward devil

citation.arabic_text: وَحِفۡظࣰ ا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ مَّارِدࣲ‏
citation.translation: and to guard from any froward devil

text: They do not eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite—they are shot at from every side

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲ‏
citation.translation: They do not eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite—they are shot at from every side

text: to drive them away, and there is a perpetual punishment for them—

citation.arabic_text: دُحُورࣰ اۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ وَاصِبٌ
citation.translation: to drive them away, and there is a perpetual punishment for them—

text: except any who snatches a snatch, whereat a piercing flame pursues him

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱ‏
citation.translation: except any who snatches a snatch, whereat a piercing flame pursues him

text: Ask them, is their creation more prodigious or [that of other creatures] that We have created? Indeed, We created them from a viscous clay

citation.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّازِبِۭ
citation.translation: Ask them, is their creation more prodigious or [that of other creatures] that We have created? Indeed, We created them from a viscous clay

text: Indeed you wonder, while they engage in ridicule

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ عَجِبۡتَ وَيَسۡخَرُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed you wonder, while they engage in ridicule

text: and [even] when admonished do not take admonition

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ لَا يَذۡكُرُونَ
citation.translation: and [even] when admonished do not take admonition

text: and when they see a sign they make it an object of ridicule

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ ءَايَةࣰ يَسۡتَسۡخِرُونَ
citation.translation: and when they see a sign they make it an object of ridicule

text: and say, ‘This is nothing but plain magic!’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
citation.translation: and say, ‘This is nothing but plain magic!’

text: ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected

citation.arabic_text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
citation.translation: ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected

text: And our forefathers too?!’

citation.arabic_text: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
citation.translation: And our forefathers too?!’

text: Say, ‘Yes! And you will be utterly humble.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ نَعَمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ دَٰخِرُونَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘Yes! And you will be utterly humble.’

text: It will be only a single shout and, behold, they will look on

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
citation.translation: It will be only a single shout and, behold, they will look on

text: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Retribution!’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Retribution!’

text: ‘This is the Day of Judgement that you used to deny!’

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
citation.translation: ‘This is the Day of Judgement that you used to deny!’

text: ‘Muster the wrongdoers and their mates and what they used to worship

citation.arabic_text: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Muster the wrongdoers and their mates and what they used to worship

text: besides Allah, and show them the way to hell

citation.arabic_text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: besides Allah, and show them the way to hell

text: [But first] stop them! For they must be questioned.’

citation.arabic_text: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ
citation.translation: [But first] stop them! For they must be questioned.’

text: ‘Why is it that you do not support one another [today]?’

citation.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Why is it that you do not support one another [today]?’

text: ‘Indeed, they are [meek and] submissive today!’

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Indeed, they are [meek and] submissive today!’

text: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other

citation.arabic_text: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
citation.translation: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other

text: They will say, ‘Indeed you used to accost us peremptorily.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: They will say, ‘Indeed you used to accost us peremptorily.’

text: They will answer, ‘No, you [yourselves] had no faith

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: They will answer, ‘No, you [yourselves] had no faith

text: We had no authority over you. No, you [yourselves] were a rebellious lot

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا طَٰغِينَ
citation.translation: We had no authority over you. No, you [yourselves] were a rebellious lot

text: So our Lord’s word became due against us that we shall indeed taste [the punishment]

citation.arabic_text: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
citation.translation: So our Lord’s word became due against us that we shall indeed taste [the punishment]

text: So we perverted you, for we were perverse [ourselves].’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
citation.translation: So we perverted you, for we were perverse [ourselves].’

text: So, that day they will share the punishment

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
citation.translation: So, that day they will share the punishment

text: Indeed, that is how We deal with the guilty

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed, that is how We deal with the guilty

text: Indeed, it was they who, when they were told, ‘There is no god except Allah,’ used to be disdainful

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed, it was they who, when they were told, ‘There is no god except Allah,’ used to be disdainful

text: and [they would] say, ‘Shall we abandon our gods for a crazy poet?’

citation.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرࣲ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
citation.translation: and [they would] say, ‘Shall we abandon our gods for a crazy poet?’

text: Indeed, he has brought [them] the truth, and confirmed the [earlier] apostles

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed, he has brought [them] the truth, and confirmed the [earlier] apostles

text: Indeed you will taste the painful punishment

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ
citation.translation: Indeed you will taste the painful punishment

text: and you will be requited only for what you used to do

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: and you will be requited only for what you used to do

text: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
citation.translation: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

text: For such there is a known provision

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقࣱ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: For such there is a known provision

text: —fruits—and they will be held in honour

citation.arabic_text: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ
citation.translation: —fruits—and they will be held in honour

text: in the gardens of bliss

citation.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
citation.translation: in the gardens of bliss

text: [reclining] on couches, facing one another

citation.arabic_text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
citation.translation: [reclining] on couches, facing one another

text: served around with a cup, from a clear fountain

citation.arabic_text: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسࣲ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ
citation.translation: served around with a cup, from a clear fountain

text: snow-white, delicious to the drinkers

citation.arabic_text: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةࣲ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
citation.translation: snow-white, delicious to the drinkers

text: wherein there will be neither headache nor will it cause them stupefaction

citation.arabic_text: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
citation.translation: wherein there will be neither headache nor will it cause them stupefaction

text: and with them will be maidens, of restrained glances with big [beautiful] eyes

citation.arabic_text: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: and with them will be maidens, of restrained glances with big [beautiful] eyes

text: as if they were hidden ostrich eggs

citation.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
citation.translation: as if they were hidden ostrich eggs

text: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other

citation.arabic_text: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
citation.translation: Some of them will turn to others, questioning each other

text: One of them will say, ‘Indeed I had a companion

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ قَآئِلࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: One of them will say, ‘Indeed I had a companion

text: who used to say, ‘‘Are you really among those who affirm

citation.arabic_text: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ
citation.translation: who used to say, ‘‘Are you really among those who affirm

text: that when we have died and become dust and bones, we shall be brought to retribution?’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
citation.translation: that when we have died and become dust and bones, we shall be brought to retribution?’’ ’

text: He will say, ‘Will you have a look?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
citation.translation: He will say, ‘Will you have a look?’

text: Then he will take a look and sight him in the middle of hell

citation.arabic_text: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: Then he will take a look and sight him in the middle of hell

text: He will say, ‘By Allah, you had almost ruined me

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
citation.translation: He will say, ‘By Allah, you had almost ruined me

text: Had it not been for my Lord’s blessing, I too would have been among those mustered [in hell]!’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
citation.translation: Had it not been for my Lord’s blessing, I too would have been among those mustered [in hell]!’

text: ‘Is it [true] that we shall not die [anymore]

citation.arabic_text: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
citation.translation: ‘Is it [true] that we shall not die [anymore]

text: aside from our earlier death, and that we shall not be punished

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
citation.translation: aside from our earlier death, and that we shall not be punished

text: This is indeed the supreme triumph!’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
citation.translation: This is indeed the supreme triumph!’

text: Let all workers work for the like of this

citation.arabic_text: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ
citation.translation: Let all workers work for the like of this

text: Is this a better reception, or the Zaqqum tree

citation.arabic_text: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرࣱ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
citation.translation: Is this a better reception, or the Zaqqum tree

text: Indeed We have made it a punishment for the wrongdoers

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed We have made it a punishment for the wrongdoers

text: It is a tree that rises from the depths of hell

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةࣱ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: It is a tree that rises from the depths of hell

text: Its spathes are as if they were devils’ heads

citation.arabic_text: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
citation.translation: Its spathes are as if they were devils’ heads

text: They will eat from it and gorge with it their bellies

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
citation.translation: They will eat from it and gorge with it their bellies

text: On top of that they will take a solution of scalding water

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبࣰ ا مِّنۡ حَمِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: On top of that they will take a solution of scalding water

text: Then their retreat will be toward hell

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: Then their retreat will be toward hell

text: They had found their fathers astray

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ
citation.translation: They had found their fathers astray

text: yet they press onwards in their footsteps

citation.arabic_text: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ
citation.translation: yet they press onwards in their footsteps

text: Most of the former peoples went astray before them

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: Most of the former peoples went astray before them

text: and We had certainly sent warners among them

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
citation.translation: and We had certainly sent warners among them

text: So observe how was the fate of those who were warned

citation.arabic_text: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
citation.translation: So observe how was the fate of those who were warned

text: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
citation.translation: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

text: Certainly Noah called out to Us, and how well did We respond

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحࣱ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ
citation.translation: Certainly Noah called out to Us, and how well did We respond

text: We delivered him and his family from their great distress

citation.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: We delivered him and his family from their great distress

text: and made his descendants the survivors

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
citation.translation: and made his descendants the survivors

text: and left for him a good name among posterity

citation.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: and left for him a good name among posterity

text: ‘Peace to Noah, throughout the nations!’

citation.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحࣲ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: ‘Peace to Noah, throughout the nations!’

text: Thus do We reward the virtuous

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: Thus do We reward the virtuous

text: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants

text: Then We drowned the rest

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
citation.translation: Then We drowned the rest

text: Indeed Abraham was among his followers

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
citation.translation: Indeed Abraham was among his followers

text: when he came to his Lord with a sound heart [untainted by sin]

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبࣲ سَلِيمٍ
citation.translation: when he came to his Lord with a sound heart [untainted by sin]

text: When he said to his father and his people, ‘What is it that you are worshiping

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
citation.translation: When he said to his father and his people, ‘What is it that you are worshiping

text: Is it a lie, gods other than Allah, that you desire

citation.arabic_text: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةࣰ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
citation.translation: Is it a lie, gods other than Allah, that you desire

text: Then what is your idea about the Lord of all the worlds?’

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: Then what is your idea about the Lord of all the worlds?’

text: Then he made an observation of the stars

citation.arabic_text: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةࣰ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
citation.translation: Then he made an observation of the stars

text: and said, ‘Indeed I am sick!’

citation.arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: and said, ‘Indeed I am sick!’

text: So they went away leaving him behind

citation.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
citation.translation: So they went away leaving him behind

text: Then he stole away to their gods and said, ‘Will you not eat

citation.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
citation.translation: Then he stole away to their gods and said, ‘Will you not eat

text: Why do you not speak?’

citation.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
citation.translation: Why do you not speak?’

text: Then he attacked them, striking forcefully

citation.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: Then he attacked them, striking forcefully

text: They came running towards him

citation.arabic_text: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ
citation.translation: They came running towards him

text: He said, ‘Do you worship what you have yourselves carved

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Do you worship what you have yourselves carved

text: when Allah has created you and whatever you make?’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: when Allah has created you and whatever you make?’

text: They said, ‘Build a structure for him and cast him into a huge fire.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنࣰ ا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Build a structure for him and cast him into a huge fire.’

text: So they sought to outwit him, but We made them the lowermost

citation.arabic_text: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدࣰ ا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
citation.translation: So they sought to outwit him, but We made them the lowermost

text: He said, ‘Indeed I am going toward my Lord, who will guide me.’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
citation.translation: He said, ‘Indeed I am going toward my Lord, who will guide me.’

text: ‘My Lord! Give me [an heir], one of the righteous.’

citation.arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
citation.translation: ‘My Lord! Give me [an heir], one of the righteous.’

text: So We gave him the good news of a forbearing son

citation.arabic_text: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: So We gave him the good news of a forbearing son

text: When he was old enough to assist in his endeavour, he said, ‘My son! I see in dreams that I am sacrificing you. See what you think.’ He said, ‘Father! Do whatever you have been commanded. If Allah wishes, you will find me to be patient.’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
citation.translation: When he was old enough to assist in his endeavour, he said, ‘My son! I see in dreams that I am sacrificing you. See what you think.’ He said, ‘Father! Do whatever you have been commanded. If Allah wishes, you will find me to be patient.’

text: So when they had both surrendered [to Allah’s will], and he had laid him down on his forehead

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ
citation.translation: So when they had both surrendered [to Allah’s will], and he had laid him down on his forehead

text: We called out to him, ‘O Abraham

citation.arabic_text: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
citation.translation: We called out to him, ‘O Abraham

text: You have indeed fulfilled your vision! Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous

citation.arabic_text: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: You have indeed fulfilled your vision! Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous

text: This was indeed a manifest test.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
citation.translation: This was indeed a manifest test.’

text: Then We ransomed him with a great sacrifice

citation.arabic_text: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Then We ransomed him with a great sacrifice

text: and left for him a good name in posterity

citation.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: and left for him a good name in posterity

text: ‘Peace be to Abraham!’

citation.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
citation.translation: ‘Peace be to Abraham!’

text: Thus do We reward the virtuous

citation.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: Thus do We reward the virtuous

text: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants

text: And We gave him the good news of [the birth of] Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous

citation.arabic_text: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيࣰّ ا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
citation.translation: And We gave him the good news of [the birth of] Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous

text: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants [some] are virtuous, and [some] who manifestly wrong themselves

citation.arabic_text: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنࣱ وَظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among their descendants [some] are virtuous, and [some] who manifestly wrong themselves

text: Certainly We favoured Moses and Aaron

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
citation.translation: Certainly We favoured Moses and Aaron

text: and delivered them and their people from their great distress

citation.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: and delivered them and their people from their great distress

text: and We helped them so that they became the victors

citation.arabic_text: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
citation.translation: and We helped them so that they became the victors

text: We gave them the illuminating scripture

citation.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ
citation.translation: We gave them the illuminating scripture

text: and guided them to the straight path

citation.arabic_text: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
citation.translation: and guided them to the straight path

text: and left for them a good name in posterity

citation.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: and left for them a good name in posterity

text: ‘Peace be to Moses and Aaron!’

citation.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Peace be to Moses and Aaron!’

text: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous

text: They are indeed among Our faithful servants

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: They are indeed among Our faithful servants

text: Indeed Ilyas was one of the apostles

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed Ilyas was one of the apostles

text: When he said to his people, ‘Will you not be Godwary

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
citation.translation: When he said to his people, ‘Will you not be Godwary

text: Do you invoke Baal and abandon the best of creators

citation.arabic_text: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلࣰ ا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
citation.translation: Do you invoke Baal and abandon the best of creators

text: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?,’

citation.arabic_text: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?,’

text: they impugned him. So they will indeed be mustered [in hell]

citation.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
citation.translation: they impugned him. So they will indeed be mustered [in hell]

text: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
citation.translation: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

text: We left for him a good name in posterity

citation.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: We left for him a good name in posterity

text: ‘Peace be to Ilyas!’

citation.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ
citation.translation: ‘Peace be to Ilyas!’

text: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: Thus indeed do We reward the virtuous

text: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: He is indeed one of Our faithful servants

text: Indeed Lot was one of the apostles

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لُوطࣰ ا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed Lot was one of the apostles

text: When We delivered him and all his family

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
citation.translation: When We delivered him and all his family

text: excepting an old woman among those who remained behind

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عَجُوزࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
citation.translation: excepting an old woman among those who remained behind

text: We destroyed the rest

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
citation.translation: We destroyed the rest

text: Indeed you pass by them at dawn

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed you pass by them at dawn

text: and at night. Do you not exercise your reason

citation.arabic_text: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
citation.translation: and at night. Do you not exercise your reason

text: Indeed Jonah was one of the apostles

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed Jonah was one of the apostles

text: When he absconded toward the laden ship

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
citation.translation: When he absconded toward the laden ship

text: he drew lots with them and was the one to be condemned [as one to be thrown overboard]

citation.arabic_text: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُدۡحَضِينَ
citation.translation: he drew lots with them and was the one to be condemned [as one to be thrown overboard]

text: Then the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Then the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy

text: Had he not been one of those who celebrate Allah’s glory

citation.arabic_text: فَلَوۡلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحِينَ
citation.translation: Had he not been one of those who celebrate Allah’s glory

text: he would have surely remained in its belly till the day they will be resurrected

citation.arabic_text: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
citation.translation: he would have surely remained in its belly till the day they will be resurrected

text: Then We cast him on a bare shore, and he was sick

citation.arabic_text: ۞فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Then We cast him on a bare shore, and he was sick

text: So We made a gourd plant grow above him

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ شَجَرَةࣰ مِّن يَقۡطِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: So We made a gourd plant grow above him

text: We sent him to a [community of] hundred thousand or more

citation.arabic_text: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
citation.translation: We sent him to a [community of] hundred thousand or more

text: and they believed [in him]. So We provided for them for a while

citation.arabic_text: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: and they believed [in him]. So We provided for them for a while

text: Ask them, are daughters to be for your Lord while sons are to be for them

citation.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
citation.translation: Ask them, are daughters to be for your Lord while sons are to be for them

text: Did We create the angels females while they were present

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثࣰ ا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
citation.translation: Did We create the angels females while they were present

text: Be aware that it is out of their mendacity that they say

citation.arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ
citation.translation: Be aware that it is out of their mendacity that they say

text: ‘Allah has begotten [offsprings],’ and they indeed speak a falsehood

citation.arabic_text: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Allah has begotten [offsprings],’ and they indeed speak a falsehood

text: Has He preferred daughters to sons

citation.arabic_text: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ
citation.translation: Has He preferred daughters to sons

text: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

citation.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
citation.translation: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

text: Will you not then take admonition

citation.arabic_text: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
citation.translation: Will you not then take admonition

text: Do you have a manifest authority

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Do you have a manifest authority

text: Then produce your scripture, should you be truthful

citation.arabic_text: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: Then produce your scripture, should you be truthful

text: And they have set up a kinship between Him and the jinn, while the jinn certainly know that they will be presented [before Him]

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبࣰ اۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
citation.translation: And they have set up a kinship between Him and the jinn, while the jinn certainly know that they will be presented [before Him]

text: Clear is Allah of whatever they allege [about Him]

citation.arabic_text: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
citation.translation: Clear is Allah of whatever they allege [about Him]

text: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
citation.translation: —[all] except Allah’s exclusive servants

text: Indeed you and what you worship

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed you and what you worship

text: cannot mislead [anyone] about Him

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
citation.translation: cannot mislead [anyone] about Him

text: except someone who is bound for hell

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: except someone who is bound for hell

text: ‘There is none among us but has a known place

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامࣱ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: ‘There is none among us but has a known place

text: It is we who are the ranged ones

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
citation.translation: It is we who are the ranged ones

text: It is we who celebrate Allah’s glory.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحُونَ
citation.translation: It is we who celebrate Allah’s glory.’

text: They indeed, used to say

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ
citation.translation: They indeed, used to say

text: ‘Had we possessed a Reminder from our predecessors

citation.arabic_text: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: ‘Had we possessed a Reminder from our predecessors

text: we would have surely been Allah’s exclusive servants.’

citation.arabic_text: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
citation.translation: we would have surely been Allah’s exclusive servants.’

text: But they disbelieved it [when it came to them]. Soon they will know

citation.arabic_text: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: But they disbelieved it [when it came to them]. Soon they will know

text: Certainly Our decree has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants, the apostles

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ سَبَقَتۡ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: Certainly Our decree has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants, the apostles

text: that they will indeed receive [Allah’s] help

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ لَهُمُ ٱلۡمَنصُورُونَ
citation.translation: that they will indeed receive [Allah’s] help

text: and indeed Our hosts will be the victors

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
citation.translation: and indeed Our hosts will be the victors

text: So leave them alone for a while

citation.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: So leave them alone for a while

text: and watch them; soon they will see [the truth of the matter]

citation.arabic_text: وَأَبۡصِرۡهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: and watch them; soon they will see [the truth of the matter]

text: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment

citation.arabic_text: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
citation.translation: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment

text: But when it descends in their courtyard it will be a dismal dawn for those who had been warned

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
citation.translation: But when it descends in their courtyard it will be a dismal dawn for those who had been warned

text: So leave them alone for a while

citation.arabic_text: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: So leave them alone for a while

text: and watch; soon they will see

citation.arabic_text: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: and watch; soon they will see

text: Clear is your Lord, the Lord of Might, of whatever they allege [concerning Him]

citation.arabic_text: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
citation.translation: Clear is your Lord, the Lord of Might, of whatever they allege [concerning Him]

text: Peace be to the apostles

citation.arabic_text: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
citation.translation: Peace be to the apostles

text: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds

text: Suad. By the Quran bearing the Reminder

citation.arabic_text: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
citation.translation: Suad. By the Quran bearing the Reminder

text: the faithless indeed dwell in conceit and defiance

citation.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةࣲ وَشِقَاقࣲ‏
citation.translation: the faithless indeed dwell in conceit and defiance

text: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! They cried out [for help], but gone was the time for escape

citation.arabic_text: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲ‏
citation.translation: How many a generation We have destroyed before them! They cried out [for help], but gone was the time for escape

text: They consider it odd that there should come to them a warner from among themselves, and the faithless say, ‘This is a magician, a mendacious liar.’

citation.arabic_text: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابٌ
citation.translation: They consider it odd that there should come to them a warner from among themselves, and the faithless say, ‘This is a magician, a mendacious liar.’

text: ‘Has he reduced the gods to one god? This is indeed an odd thing!’

citation.arabic_text: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهࣰ ا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابࣱ‏
citation.translation: ‘Has he reduced the gods to one god? This is indeed an odd thing!’

text: Their elite go about [urging others]: ‘Go and stand by your gods! This is indeed the desirable thing [to do]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءࣱ يُرَادُ
citation.translation: Their elite go about [urging others]: ‘Go and stand by your gods! This is indeed the desirable thing [to do]

text: We did not hear of this in the latter-day creed. This is nothing but a fabrication

citation.arabic_text: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
citation.translation: We did not hear of this in the latter-day creed. This is nothing but a fabrication

text: Has the Reminder been sent down to him out of [all of] us?’ Indeed, they are in doubt concerning My Reminder. Indeed, they have not yet tasted My punishment

citation.arabic_text: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
citation.translation: Has the Reminder been sent down to him out of [all of] us?’ Indeed, they are in doubt concerning My Reminder. Indeed, they have not yet tasted My punishment

text: Do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-mighty, the All-munificent

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
citation.translation: Do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-mighty, the All-munificent

text: Do they own the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? [If so,] let them ascend [to the higher spheres] by the means [of ascension]

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
citation.translation: Do they own the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? [If so,] let them ascend [to the higher spheres] by the means [of ascension]

text: [They are but] a host routed out there of the factions

citation.arabic_text: جُندࣱ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
citation.translation: [They are but] a host routed out there of the factions

text: Before them Noah’s people impugned [their apostle] and [so did the people of] ‘Ad, and Pharaoh, the Impaler [of his victims]

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
citation.translation: Before them Noah’s people impugned [their apostle] and [so did the people of] ‘Ad, and Pharaoh, the Impaler [of his victims]

text: and Thamud, and the people of Lot, and the inhabitants of Aykah: those were the factions

citation.arabic_text: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
citation.translation: and Thamud, and the people of Lot, and the inhabitants of Aykah: those were the factions

text: There was not any one but such as impugned the apostles; so My retribution became due [against them]

citation.arabic_text: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
citation.translation: There was not any one but such as impugned the apostles; so My retribution became due [against them]

text: These [too] do not await but a single Cry, which will not grant [them] any respite

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقࣲ‏
citation.translation: These [too] do not await but a single Cry, which will not grant [them] any respite

text: They say, ‘Our Lord! Hasten on for us our share before the Day of Reckoning.’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
citation.translation: They say, ‘Our Lord! Hasten on for us our share before the Day of Reckoning.’

text: Be patient over what they say, and remember Our servant, David, [the man] of strength. Indeed he was a penitent [soul]

citation.arabic_text: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
citation.translation: Be patient over what they say, and remember Our servant, David, [the man] of strength. Indeed he was a penitent [soul]

text: We disposed the mountains to glorify [Allah] with him at evening and dawn

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
citation.translation: We disposed the mountains to glorify [Allah] with him at evening and dawn

text: and the birds [as well], mustered [in flocks]; all echoing him [in a chorus]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةࣰۖ كُلࣱّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ‏
citation.translation: and the birds [as well], mustered [in flocks]; all echoing him [in a chorus]

text: We consolidated his kingdom and gave him wisdom and conclusive speech

citation.arabic_text: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
citation.translation: We consolidated his kingdom and gave him wisdom and conclusive speech

text: Has there not come to you the account of the contenders, when they scaled the wall into the sanctuary

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
citation.translation: Has there not come to you the account of the contenders, when they scaled the wall into the sanctuary

text: When they entered into the presence of David, he was alarmed by them. They said, ‘Do not be afraid. [We are only] two contenders: one of us has bullied the other. So judge justly between us, and do not exceed [the bounds of justice], and show us the right path.’

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
citation.translation: When they entered into the presence of David, he was alarmed by them. They said, ‘Do not be afraid. [We are only] two contenders: one of us has bullied the other. So judge justly between us, and do not exceed [the bounds of justice], and show us the right path.’

text: ‘This brother of mine has ninety-nine ewes, while I have only a single ewe, and [yet] he says, ‘Commit it to my care,’ and he browbeats me in speech.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعࣱ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةࣰ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
citation.translation: ‘This brother of mine has ninety-nine ewes, while I have only a single ewe, and [yet] he says, ‘Commit it to my care,’ and he browbeats me in speech.’

text: He said, ‘He has certainly wronged you by asking your ewe in addition to his own ewes, and indeed many partners bully one another, except such as have faith and do righteous deeds, and few are they.’ Then David knew that We had tested him, whereat he pleaded with his Lord for forgiveness, and fell down in prostration and repented

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلࣱ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعࣰ اۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
citation.translation: He said, ‘He has certainly wronged you by asking your ewe in addition to his own ewes, and indeed many partners bully one another, except such as have faith and do righteous deeds, and few are they.’ Then David knew that We had tested him, whereat he pleaded with his Lord for forgiveness, and fell down in prostration and repented

text: So We forgave him that, and indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination

citation.arabic_text: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
citation.translation: So We forgave him that, and indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination

text: ‘O David! Indeed, We have made you a vicegerent on the earth. So judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires, or they will lead you astray from the way of Allah. Indeed there is a severe punishment for those who stray from the way of Allah, because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.’

citation.arabic_text: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
citation.translation: ‘O David! Indeed, We have made you a vicegerent on the earth. So judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires, or they will lead you astray from the way of Allah. Indeed there is a severe punishment for those who stray from the way of Allah, because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.’

text: We did not create the sky and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. That is a conjecture of the faithless. So woe to the faithless for the Fire

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
citation.translation: We did not create the sky and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. That is a conjecture of the faithless. So woe to the faithless for the Fire

text: Shall We treat those who have faith and do righteous deeds like those who cause corruption on the earth? Shall We treat the Godwary like the vicious

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
citation.translation: Shall We treat those who have faith and do righteous deeds like those who cause corruption on the earth? Shall We treat the Godwary like the vicious

text: [This is] a blessed Book that We have sent down to you, so that they may contemplate its signs, and that those who possess intellect may take admonition

citation.arabic_text: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكࣱ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
citation.translation: [This is] a blessed Book that We have sent down to you, so that they may contemplate its signs, and that those who possess intellect may take admonition

text: And to David We gave Solomon—what an excellent servant he was! Indeed, he was a penitent [soul]

citation.arabic_text: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
citation.translation: And to David We gave Solomon—what an excellent servant he was! Indeed, he was a penitent [soul]

text: One evening when there were displayed before him prancing steeds

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
citation.translation: One evening when there were displayed before him prancing steeds

text: he said, ‘Indeed I have preferred the love of [worldly] niceties to the remembrance of my Lord until [the sun] disappeared behind the [night’s] veil.’

citation.arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
citation.translation: he said, ‘Indeed I have preferred the love of [worldly] niceties to the remembrance of my Lord until [the sun] disappeared behind the [night’s] veil.’

text: ‘Bring it back for me!’ Then he [and others] began to wipe [their] legs and necks

citation.arabic_text: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
citation.translation: ‘Bring it back for me!’ Then he [and others] began to wipe [their] legs and necks

text: Certainly We tried Solomon, and cast a [lifeless] body on his throne. Thereupon he was penitent

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدࣰ ا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
citation.translation: Certainly We tried Solomon, and cast a [lifeless] body on his throne. Thereupon he was penitent

text: He said, ‘My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom that will not befit anyone except me. Indeed You are the All-munificent.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكࣰ ا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدࣲ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom that will not befit anyone except me. Indeed You are the All-munificent.’

text: So We disposed the wind for him, blowing softly wherever he intended by his command

citation.arabic_text: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
citation.translation: So We disposed the wind for him, blowing softly wherever he intended by his command

text: and every builder and diver from the demons

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءࣲ وَغَوَّاصࣲ‏
citation.translation: and every builder and diver from the demons

text: and others [too] bound together in chains

citation.arabic_text: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
citation.translation: and others [too] bound together in chains

text: ‘This is Our bounty: so withhold or bestow without any reckoning.’

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
citation.translation: ‘This is Our bounty: so withhold or bestow without any reckoning.’

text: Indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed he has [a station of] nearness with Us and a good destination

text: And remember Our servant Job [in the Quran]. When he called out to his Lord, ‘The devil has visited on me hardship and torment,’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبࣲ وَعَذَابٍ
citation.translation: And remember Our servant Job [in the Quran]. When he called out to his Lord, ‘The devil has visited on me hardship and torment,’

text: [We told him:] ‘Stamp your foot on the ground; this [ensuing spring] will be a cooling bath and drink.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدࣱ وَشَرَابࣱ‏
citation.translation: [We told him:] ‘Stamp your foot on the ground; this [ensuing spring] will be a cooling bath and drink.’

text: We gave [back] his family to him along with others like them, as a mercy from Us and an admonition for those who possess intellect

citation.arabic_text: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
citation.translation: We gave [back] his family to him along with others like them, as a mercy from Us and an admonition for those who possess intellect

text: [We told him:] ‘Take a faggot in your hand and then strike [your wife] with it, but do not break [your] oath.’ Indeed, We found him to be patient. What an excellent servant! Indeed he was a penitent [soul]

citation.arabic_text: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثࣰ ا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرࣰ اۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ‏
citation.translation: [We told him:] ‘Take a faggot in your hand and then strike [your wife] with it, but do not break [your] oath.’ Indeed, We found him to be patient. What an excellent servant! Indeed he was a penitent [soul]

text: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of strength and insight

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
citation.translation: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of strength and insight

text: Indeed We purified them with exclusive remembrance of the abode [of the Hereafter]

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةࣲ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ
citation.translation: Indeed We purified them with exclusive remembrance of the abode [of the Hereafter]

text: Indeed they are surely with Us among the elect of the best

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
citation.translation: Indeed they are surely with Us among the elect of the best

text: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhu’l-Kifl—each [of whom was] among the elect

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلࣱّ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
citation.translation: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhu’l-Kifl—each [of whom was] among the elect

text: This is a Reminder, and indeed the Godwary have a good destination

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرࣱۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
citation.translation: This is a Reminder, and indeed the Godwary have a good destination

text: the Gardens of Eden, whose gates will be flung open for them

citation.arabic_text: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنࣲ مُّفَتَّحَةࣰ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
citation.translation: the Gardens of Eden, whose gates will be flung open for them

text: Reclining therein [on couches], they will call for abundant fruits and drinks

citation.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ كَثِيرَةࣲ وَشَرَابࣲ‏
citation.translation: Reclining therein [on couches], they will call for abundant fruits and drinks

text: and there will be with them maidens of restrained glances, of a like age

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ
citation.translation: and there will be with them maidens of restrained glances, of a like age

text: This is what you are promised on the Day of Reckoning

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
citation.translation: This is what you are promised on the Day of Reckoning

text: This is Our provision, which will never be exhausted

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
citation.translation: This is Our provision, which will never be exhausted

text: This [will be for the righteous], and as for the rebellious there will surely be a bad destination

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
citation.translation: This [will be for the righteous], and as for the rebellious there will surely be a bad destination

text: hell, which they shall enter, an evil resting place

citation.arabic_text: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
citation.translation: hell, which they shall enter, an evil resting place

text: They will be told, ‘This is scalding water and pus; let them taste it

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمࣱ وَغَسَّاقࣱ‏
citation.translation: They will be told, ‘This is scalding water and pus; let them taste it

text: and other kinds [of torments] resembling it.’

citation.arabic_text: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ
citation.translation: and other kinds [of torments] resembling it.’

text: [The leaders of the faithless will be told,] ‘This is a group [of your followers] plunging [into hell] along with you.’ [They will repond,] ‘May wretchedness be their lot! For they will enter the Fire.’

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا فَوۡجࣱ مُّقۡتَحِمࣱ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
citation.translation: [The leaders of the faithless will be told,] ‘This is a group [of your followers] plunging [into hell] along with you.’ [They will repond,] ‘May wretchedness be their lot! For they will enter the Fire.’

text: They will say, ‘No, may wretchedness be your lot! You prepared this [hell] for us. What an evil abode!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
citation.translation: They will say, ‘No, may wretchedness be your lot! You prepared this [hell] for us. What an evil abode!’

text: They will say, ‘Our Lord! Whoever has prepared this for us, double his punishment in the Fire!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا ضِعۡفࣰ ا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
citation.translation: They will say, ‘Our Lord! Whoever has prepared this for us, double his punishment in the Fire!’

text: And they will say, ‘Why is it that we do not see [here] men whom we used to count among the bad ones

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالࣰ ا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
citation.translation: And they will say, ‘Why is it that we do not see [here] men whom we used to count among the bad ones

text: ridiculing them, or do [our] eyes miss them [here]?’

citation.arabic_text: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
citation.translation: ridiculing them, or do [our] eyes miss them [here]?’

text: That is indeed a true account of the contentions of the inmates of the Fire

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقࣱّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ
citation.translation: That is indeed a true account of the contentions of the inmates of the Fire

text: Say, ‘I am just a warner, and there is no god except Allah, the One, the All-paramount

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرࣱۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
citation.translation: Say, ‘I am just a warner, and there is no god except Allah, the One, the All-paramount

text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the All-mighty, the All-forgiver.’

citation.arabic_text: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
citation.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the All-mighty, the All-forgiver.’

text: Say, ‘It is a great prophesy

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
citation.translation: Say, ‘It is a great prophesy

text: of which you are disregardful

citation.arabic_text: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
citation.translation: of which you are disregardful

text: I have no knowledge of the Supernal Elite when they contend

citation.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
citation.translation: I have no knowledge of the Supernal Elite when they contend

text: All that is revealed to me is that I am just a manifest warner.’

citation.arabic_text: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
citation.translation: All that is revealed to me is that I am just a manifest warner.’

text: When your Lord said to the angels, ‘Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرࣰ ا مِّن طِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: When your Lord said to the angels, ‘Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay

text: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.’

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
citation.translation: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, then fall down in prostration before him.’

text: Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together

citation.arabic_text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
citation.translation: Thereat the angels prostrated, all of them together

text: but not Iblis; he acted arrogantly and he was one of the faithless

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
citation.translation: but not Iblis; he acted arrogantly and he was one of the faithless

text: He said, ‘O Iblis! What keeps you from prostrating before that which I have created with My [own] two hands? Are you arrogant, or are you one of the exalted ones?’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘O Iblis! What keeps you from prostrating before that which I have created with My [own] two hands? Are you arrogant, or are you one of the exalted ones?’

text: ‘I am better than him,’ he said. ‘You created me from fire and You created him from clay.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارࣲ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: ‘I am better than him,’ he said. ‘You created me from fire and You created him from clay.’

text: He said, ‘Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: He said, ‘Begone hence, for you are indeed an outcast

text: and indeed My curse will be on you till the Day of Retribution.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: and indeed My curse will be on you till the Day of Retribution.’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! Respite me till the day they will be resurrected.’

text: Said He, ‘You are indeed among the reprieved

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
citation.translation: Said He, ‘You are indeed among the reprieved

text: until the day of the known time.’

citation.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
citation.translation: until the day of the known time.’

text: He said, ‘By Your might, I will surely pervert them

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘By Your might, I will surely pervert them

text: except Your exclusive servants among them.’

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
citation.translation: except Your exclusive servants among them.’

text: Said He, ‘The truth is that—and I speak the truth—

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
citation.translation: Said He, ‘The truth is that—and I speak the truth—

text: I will surely fill hell with you and all those who follow you.’

citation.arabic_text: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
citation.translation: I will surely fill hell with you and all those who follow you.’

text: Say, ‘I do not ask you any reward for it, and I am no impostor

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرࣲ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘I do not ask you any reward for it, and I am no impostor

text: It is just a reminder for all the nations

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: It is just a reminder for all the nations

text: and you will surely learn its tidings in due time.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
citation.translation: and you will surely learn its tidings in due time.’

text: The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise

citation.arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
citation.translation: The [gradual] sending down of the Book is from Allah, the All-mighty, the All-wise

text: Indeed We have sent down the Book to you with the truth; so worship Allah, putting exclusive faith in Him

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصࣰ ا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
citation.translation: Indeed We have sent down the Book to you with the truth; so worship Allah, putting exclusive faith in Him

text: Indeed, only exclusive faith is worthy of Allah, and those who take other as awliya besides Him [claiming,] ‘We only worship them so that they may bring us near to Allah,’ Allah will judge between them concerning that about which they differ. Indeed Allah does not guide someone who is a liar and an ingrate

citation.arabic_text: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبࣱ كَفَّارࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed, only exclusive faith is worthy of Allah, and those who take other as awliya besides Him [claiming,] ‘We only worship them so that they may bring us near to Allah,’ Allah will judge between them concerning that about which they differ. Indeed Allah does not guide someone who is a liar and an ingrate

text: Had Allah intended to take a son, He could have chosen from those He has created whatever He wished. Immaculate is He! He is Allah, the One, the All-paramount

citation.arabic_text: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدࣰ ا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
citation.translation: Had Allah intended to take a son, He could have chosen from those He has created whatever He wished. Immaculate is He! He is Allah, the One, the All-paramount

text: He created the heavens and the earth with consummate wisdom. He winds the night over the day, and winds the day over the night, and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term. Indeed, He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiver

citation.arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلࣱّ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
citation.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with consummate wisdom. He winds the night over the day, and winds the day over the night, and He has disposed the sun and the moon, each moving for a specified term. Indeed, He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiver

text: He created you from a single soul, then made from it its mate, and He has sent down for you eight mates of the cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold darkness. That is Allah, your Lord! To Him belongs all sovereignty. There is no god except Him. Then where are you being led away

citation.arabic_text: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسࣲ وَٰحِدَةࣲ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجࣲۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقࣰ ا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقࣲ فِي ظُلُمَٰتࣲ ثَلَٰثࣲۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
citation.translation: He created you from a single soul, then made from it its mate, and He has sent down for you eight mates of the cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold darkness. That is Allah, your Lord! To Him belongs all sovereignty. There is no god except Him. Then where are you being led away

text: If you are ungrateful, Allah has indeed no need of you, though He does not approve ingratitude for His servants; and if you give thanks, He approves that for you. No bearer shall bear another’s burden; then your return will be to your Lord, whereat He will inform you concerning what you used to do. Indeed, He knows best what is in the breasts

citation.arabic_text: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةࣱ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
citation.translation: If you are ungrateful, Allah has indeed no need of you, though He does not approve ingratitude for His servants; and if you give thanks, He approves that for you. No bearer shall bear another’s burden; then your return will be to your Lord, whereat He will inform you concerning what you used to do. Indeed, He knows best what is in the breasts

text: When distress befalls man, he supplicates his Lord, turning to Him penitently. Then, when He grants him a blessing from Himself, he forgets that for which he had supplicated Him earlier and sets up equals to Allah, that he may lead [people] astray from His way. Say, ‘Revel in your ingratitude for a while. Indeed you are among the inmates of the Fire.’

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرࣱّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادࣰ ا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
citation.translation: When distress befalls man, he supplicates his Lord, turning to Him penitently. Then, when He grants him a blessing from Himself, he forgets that for which he had supplicated Him earlier and sets up equals to Allah, that he may lead [people] astray from His way. Say, ‘Revel in your ingratitude for a while. Indeed you are among the inmates of the Fire.’

text: Is he who supplicates in the watches of the night, prostrating and standing, apprehensive of the Hereafter and expecting the mercy of his Lord...? Say, ‘Are those who know equal to those who do not know?’ Only those who possess intellect take admonition

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدࣰ ا وَقَآئِمࣰ ا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
citation.translation: Is he who supplicates in the watches of the night, prostrating and standing, apprehensive of the Hereafter and expecting the mercy of his Lord...? Say, ‘Are those who know equal to those who do not know?’ Only those who possess intellect take admonition

text: Say, ‘[Allah declares:] “O My servants who have faith! Be wary of your Lord. For those who do good in this world there will be a good [reward], and Allah’s earth is vast. Indeed the patient will be paid in full their reward without any reckoning.” ’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣱۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
