citation.arabic_text: لَّيۡسَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلۡمَرِيضِ حَرَجࣱۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبۡهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: There is no blame on the blind, nor is there any blame on the lame, nor is there blame on the sick [if they are unable to go out with the troops to face the enemies]; and whoever obeys Allah and His Apostle, He will admit him into gardens with streams running in them, and whoever refuses to comply, He will punish him with a painful punishment

text: Allah was certainly pleased with the faithful when they swore allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down composure on them, and requited them with a victory near at hand

citation.arabic_text: ۞لَّقَدۡ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذۡ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحۡتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَثَٰبَهُمۡ فَتۡحࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا
citation.translation: Allah was certainly pleased with the faithful when they swore allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down composure on them, and requited them with a victory near at hand

text: and abundant spoils that they will capture, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise

citation.arabic_text: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةࣰ يَأۡخُذُونَهَاۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: and abundant spoils that they will capture, and Allah is all-mighty, all-wise

text: Allah has promised you abundant spoils, which you will capture. He has expedited this one for you, and withheld men’s hands from you, so that it may be a sign for the faithful, and that He may guide you to a straight path

citation.arabic_text: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةࣰ تَأۡخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمۡ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيۡدِيَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمۡ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَيَهۡدِيَكُمۡ صِرَٰطࣰ ا مُّسۡتَقِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: Allah has promised you abundant spoils, which you will capture. He has expedited this one for you, and withheld men’s hands from you, so that it may be a sign for the faithful, and that He may guide you to a straight path

text: And other [spoils as well] which you have not yet captured: Allah has comprehended them, and Allah has power over all things

citation.arabic_text: وَأُخۡرَىٰ لَمۡ تَقۡدِرُواْ عَلَيۡهَا قَدۡ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: And other [spoils as well] which you have not yet captured: Allah has comprehended them, and Allah has power over all things

text: If the faithless fight you, they will turn their backs [to flee]. Then they will not find any protector or helper

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوَلَّوُاْ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيࣰّ ا وَلَا نَصِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: If the faithless fight you, they will turn their backs [to flee]. Then they will not find any protector or helper

text: [It is] Allah’s precedent that has passed before, and you will never find any change in Allah’s precedent

citation.arabic_text: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبۡدِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: [It is] Allah’s precedent that has passed before, and you will never find any change in Allah’s precedent

text: It is He who withheld their hands from you, and your hands from them, in the valley of Makkah, after He had given you victory over them, and Allah sees best what you do

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي كَفَّ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ عَنكُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيَكُمۡ عَنۡهُم بِبَطۡنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَنۡ أَظۡفَرَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
citation.translation: It is He who withheld their hands from you, and your hands from them, in the valley of Makkah, after He had given you victory over them, and Allah sees best what you do

text: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and kept the offering from reaching its destination. And were it not for [certain] faithful men and faithful women, whom you did not know—lest you should trample them, and thus the blame for [killing] them should fall on you unawares; [He held you back] so that Allah may admit into His mercy whomever He wishes. Had they been separate, We would have surely punished the faithless among them with a painful punishment

citation.arabic_text: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَصَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ وَٱلۡهَدۡيَ مَعۡكُوفًا أَن يَبۡلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥۚ وَلَوۡلَا رِجَالࣱ مُّؤۡمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءࣱ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتࣱ لَّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوهُمۡ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمۡ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنۡهُم مَّعَرَّةُۢ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمࣲۖ لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ لَوۡ تَزَيَّلُواْ لَعَذَّبۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
citation.translation: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and kept the offering from reaching its destination. And were it not for [certain] faithful men and faithful women, whom you did not know—lest you should trample them, and thus the blame for [killing] them should fall on you unawares; [He held you back] so that Allah may admit into His mercy whomever He wishes. Had they been separate, We would have surely punished the faithless among them with a painful punishment

text: When the faithless nourished bigotry in their hearts, the bigotry of pagan ignorance, Allah sent down His composure upon His Apostle and the faithful, and made them abide by the word of Godwariness, for they were the worthiest of it and deserved it, and Allah has knowledge of all things

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَأَلۡزَمَهُمۡ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهۡلَهَاۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: When the faithless nourished bigotry in their hearts, the bigotry of pagan ignorance, Allah sent down His composure upon His Apostle and the faithful, and made them abide by the word of Godwariness, for they were the worthiest of it and deserved it, and Allah has knowledge of all things

text: Certainly Allah has fulfilled His Apostle’s vision in all truth: You will surely enter the Sacred Mosque, God willing, in safety and without any fear, with your heads shaven or hair cropped. So He knew what you did not know, and He assigned [you] besides that a victory near at hand

citation.arabic_text: لَّقَدۡ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءۡيَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ لَتَدۡخُلُنَّ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمۡ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُواْ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتۡحࣰ ا قَرِيبًا
citation.translation: Certainly Allah has fulfilled His Apostle’s vision in all truth: You will surely enter the Sacred Mosque, God willing, in safety and without any fear, with your heads shaven or hair cropped. So He knew what you did not know, and He assigned [you] besides that a victory near at hand

text: It is He who has sent His Apostle with guidance and the true religion, that He may make it prevail over all religions, and Allah suffices as witness

citation.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَرۡسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلۡحَقِّ لِيُظۡهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدࣰ ا
citation.translation: It is He who has sent His Apostle with guidance and the true religion, that He may make it prevail over all religions, and Allah suffices as witness

text: Muhammad, the Apostle of Allah, and those who are with him are hard against the faithless and merciful amongst themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in worship], seeking Allah’s grace, and [His] pleasure. Their mark is [visible] on their faces, from the effect of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah and their description in the Evangel. Like a tillage that sends out its shoots and builds them up, and they grow stout and settle on their stalks, impressing the sowers, so that He may enrage the faithless by them. Allah has promised those of them who have faith and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward

citation.arabic_text: مُّحَمَّدࣱ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ تَرَىٰهُمۡ رُكَّعࣰ ا سُجَّدࣰ ا يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنࣰ اۖ سِيمَاهُمۡ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِۚ وَمَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡإِنجِيلِ كَزَرۡعٍ أَخۡرَجَ شَطۡـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسۡتَغۡلَظَ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعۡجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنۡهُم مَّغۡفِرَةࣰ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمَۢا
citation.translation: Muhammad, the Apostle of Allah, and those who are with him are hard against the faithless and merciful amongst themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in worship], seeking Allah’s grace, and [His] pleasure. Their mark is [visible] on their faces, from the effect of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah and their description in the Evangel. Like a tillage that sends out its shoots and builds them up, and they grow stout and settle on their stalks, impressing the sowers, so that He may enrage the faithless by them. Allah has promised those of them who have faith and do righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward

text: O you who have faith! Do not venture ahead of Allah and His Apostle, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: O you who have faith! Do not venture ahead of Allah and His Apostle, and be wary of Allah. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-knowing

text: O you who have faith! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak aloud to him like you shout to one another, lest your works should fail without your being aware

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَرۡفَعُوٓاْ أَصۡوَٰتَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ صَوۡتِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجۡهَرُواْ لَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ كَجَهۡرِ بَعۡضِكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ أَن تَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
citation.translation: O you who have faith! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak aloud to him like you shout to one another, lest your works should fail without your being aware

text: Indeed those who lower their voices in the presence of the Apostle of Allah—they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for Godwariness. For them will be forgiveness and a great reward

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصۡوَٰتَهُمۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمۡتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰۚ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةࣱ وَأَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٌ
citation.translation: Indeed those who lower their voices in the presence of the Apostle of Allah—they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for Godwariness. For them will be forgiveness and a great reward

text: Indeed those who call you from behind the apartments, most of them do not use their reason

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلۡحُجُرَٰتِ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed those who call you from behind the apartments, most of them do not use their reason

text: Had they been patient until you came out for them, it would have been better for them, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخۡرُجَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَكَانَ خَيۡرࣰ ا لَّهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Had they been patient until you came out for them, it would have been better for them, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

text: O you who have faith! If a vicious character brings you some news, verify it, lest you should visit [harm] on some people out of ignorance, and then become regretful for what you have done

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن جَآءَكُمۡ فَاسِقُۢ بِنَبَإࣲ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْ أَن تُصِيبُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةࣲ فَتُصۡبِحُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نَٰدِمِينَ
citation.translation: O you who have faith! If a vicious character brings you some news, verify it, lest you should visit [harm] on some people out of ignorance, and then become regretful for what you have done

text: Know that the Apostle of Allah is among you. Should he comply with you in many matters, you would surely suffer. But Allah has endeared faith to you and made it appealing in your hearts, and He has made hateful to you faithlessness, transgression and disobedience. It is such who are the right-minded—

citation.arabic_text: وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ فِيكُمۡ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِۚ لَوۡ يُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي كَثِيرࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ لَعَنِتُّمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ وَٱلۡفُسُوقَ وَٱلۡعِصۡيَانَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
citation.translation: Know that the Apostle of Allah is among you. Should he comply with you in many matters, you would surely suffer. But Allah has endeared faith to you and made it appealing in your hearts, and He has made hateful to you faithlessness, transgression and disobedience. It is such who are the right-minded—

text: a grace and blessing from Allah, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

citation.arabic_text: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعۡمَةࣰۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: a grace and blessing from Allah, and Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

text: If two groups of the faithful fight one another, make peace between them. But if one party of them aggresses against the other, fight the one which aggresses until it returns to Allah’s ordinance. Then, if it returns, make peace between them fairly, and do justice. Indeed Allah loves the just

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱقۡتَتَلُواْ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّتِي تَبۡغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن فَآءَتۡ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَا بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَأَقۡسِطُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
citation.translation: If two groups of the faithful fight one another, make peace between them. But if one party of them aggresses against the other, fight the one which aggresses until it returns to Allah’s ordinance. Then, if it returns, make peace between them fairly, and do justice. Indeed Allah loves the just

text: The faithful are indeed brothers. Therefore, make peace between your brothers and be wary of Allah, so that you may receive [His] mercy

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِخۡوَةࣱ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَ أَخَوَيۡكُمۡۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
citation.translation: The faithful are indeed brothers. Therefore, make peace between your brothers and be wary of Allah, so that you may receive [His] mercy

text: O you who have faith! Let not any people ridicule another people: it may be that they are better than they are; nor let women [ridicule] women: it may be that they are better than they are. And do not defame one another, nor insult one another by [calling] nicknames. How evil are profane names subsequent to faith! As for those who are not penitent [of their past conduct]—such are the wrongdoers

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمࣱ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءࣱ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُنَّۖ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِٱلۡأَلۡقَٰبِۖ بِئۡسَ ٱلِٱسۡمُ ٱلۡفُسُوقُ بَعۡدَ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
citation.translation: O you who have faith! Let not any people ridicule another people: it may be that they are better than they are; nor let women [ridicule] women: it may be that they are better than they are. And do not defame one another, nor insult one another by [calling] nicknames. How evil are profane names subsequent to faith! As for those who are not penitent [of their past conduct]—such are the wrongdoers

text: O you who have faith! Avoid much suspicion; indeed some suspicions are sins. And do not spy on one another or backbite. Will any of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would hate it. Be wary of Allah; indeed Allah is all-clement, all-merciful

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱجۡتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثۡمࣱۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغۡتَب بَّعۡضُكُم بَعۡضًاۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن يَأۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ أَخِيهِ مَيۡتࣰ ا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوهُۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: O you who have faith! Avoid much suspicion; indeed some suspicions are sins. And do not spy on one another or backbite. Will any of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would hate it. Be wary of Allah; indeed Allah is all-clement, all-merciful

text: O mankind! Indeed, We created you from a male and a female, and made you nations and tribes that you may identify yourselves with one another. Indeed the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the most Godwary among you. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-aware

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرࣲ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ شُعُوبࣰ ا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ أَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتۡقَىٰكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: O mankind! Indeed, We created you from a male and a female, and made you nations and tribes that you may identify yourselves with one another. Indeed the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the most Godwary among you. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-aware

text: The Bedouins say, ‘We have faith.’ Say, ‘You do not have faith yet; rather, say, ‘‘We have embraced Islam,’’ for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. Yet if you obey Allah and His Apostle, He will not stint anything of [the reward of] your works. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.’

citation.arabic_text: ۞قَالَتِ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ ءَامَنَّاۖ قُل لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓاْ أَسۡلَمۡنَا وَلَمَّا يَدۡخُلِ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتۡكُم مِّنۡ أَعۡمَٰلِكُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمٌ
citation.translation: The Bedouins say, ‘We have faith.’ Say, ‘You do not have faith yet; rather, say, ‘‘We have embraced Islam,’’ for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. Yet if you obey Allah and His Apostle, He will not stint anything of [the reward of] your works. Indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful.’

text: The faithful are only those who have attained faith in Allah and His Apostle and then have never doubted, and who wage jihad with their possessions and their persons in the way of Allah. It is they who are the truthful

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَرۡتَابُواْ وَجَٰهَدُواْ بِأَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ وَأَنفُسِهِمۡ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
citation.translation: The faithful are only those who have attained faith in Allah and His Apostle and then have never doubted, and who wage jihad with their possessions and their persons in the way of Allah. It is they who are the truthful

text: Say, ‘Will you inform Allah about your faith while Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, and Allah has knowledge of all things?’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمۡ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Say, ‘Will you inform Allah about your faith while Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, and Allah has knowledge of all things?’

text: They count it as a favour to you that they have embraced Islam. Say, ‘Do not count your embracing of Islam as a favour to me. No, it is Allah who has done you a favour in that He has guided you to faith, if you are truthful [in your claim]

citation.arabic_text: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيۡكَ أَنۡ أَسۡلَمُواْۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّواْ عَلَيَّ إِسۡلَٰمَكُمۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ أَنۡ هَدَىٰكُمۡ لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: They count it as a favour to you that they have embraced Islam. Say, ‘Do not count your embracing of Islam as a favour to me. No, it is Allah who has done you a favour in that He has guided you to faith, if you are truthful [in your claim]

text: Indeed Allah knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah watches what you do.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed Allah knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah watches what you do.’

text: Qaf. By the glorious Quran

citation.arabic_text: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ
citation.translation: Qaf. By the glorious Quran

text: Indeed they consider it odd that a warner from among themselves should have come to them. So the faithless say, ‘This is an odd thing.’

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ
citation.translation: Indeed they consider it odd that a warner from among themselves should have come to them. So the faithless say, ‘This is an odd thing.’

text: ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust, [shall we be raised again]? That is a far-fetched return!’

citation.arabic_text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ اۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust, [shall we be raised again]? That is a far-fetched return!’

text: We know what the earth diminishes from them, and with Us is a preserving Book

citation.arabic_text: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
citation.translation: We know what the earth diminishes from them, and with Us is a preserving Book

text: Indeed, they denied the truth when it came to them; so they are now in a perplexed state of affairs

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرࣲ مَّرِيجٍ
citation.translation: Indeed, they denied the truth when it came to them; so they are now in a perplexed state of affairs

text: Have they not, then, observed the heaven above them, how We have built it and adorned it, and that there are no cracks in it

citation.arabic_text: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجࣲ‏
citation.translation: Have they not, then, observed the heaven above them, how We have built it and adorned it, and that there are no cracks in it

text: And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and caused every delightful kind [of vegetation] to grow in it

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجࣲ‏
citation.translation: And We spread out the earth, and cast in it firm mountains, and caused every delightful kind [of vegetation] to grow in it

text: [In this there is] an insight and admonition for every penitent servant

citation.arabic_text: تَبۡصِرَةࣰ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدࣲ مُّنِيبࣲ‏
citation.translation: [In this there is] an insight and admonition for every penitent servant

text: We send down from the sky salubrious water, with which We grow gardens and the grain which is harvested

citation.arabic_text: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ مُّبَٰرَكࣰ ا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
citation.translation: We send down from the sky salubrious water, with which We grow gardens and the grain which is harvested

text: and tall date palms with regularly set spathes

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتࣲ لَّهَا طَلۡعࣱ نَّضِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: and tall date palms with regularly set spathes

text: as a provision for Our servants, and with it We revive a dead country. Likewise will be the rising [from the dead]

citation.arabic_text: رِّزۡقࣰ ا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
citation.translation: as a provision for Our servants, and with it We revive a dead country. Likewise will be the rising [from the dead]

text: The people of Noah denied before them, and [so did] the people of Rass and Thamud

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
citation.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and [so did] the people of Rass and Thamud

text: and ‘Ad, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot

citation.arabic_text: وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطࣲ‏
citation.translation: and ‘Ad, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot

text: and the inhabitants of Aykah and the people of Tubbac. Each [of them] impugned the apostles, and so My threat became due [against them]

citation.arabic_text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲۚ كُلࣱّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
citation.translation: and the inhabitants of Aykah and the people of Tubbac. Each [of them] impugned the apostles, and so My threat became due [against them]

text: Have We been exhausted by the first creation? No, they are in doubt about a new creation

citation.arabic_text: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسࣲ مِّنۡ خَلۡقࣲ جَدِيدࣲ‏
citation.translation: Have We been exhausted by the first creation? No, they are in doubt about a new creation

text: Certainly We have created man and We know to what his soul tempts him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
citation.translation: Certainly We have created man and We know to what his soul tempts him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein

text: When the twin recorders record [his deeds], seated on the right hand and on the left

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: When the twin recorders record [his deeds], seated on the right hand and on the left

text: he says no word but that there is a ready observer beside him

citation.arabic_text: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: he says no word but that there is a ready observer beside him

text: The throes of death bring the truth: ‘This is what you used to shun!’

citation.arabic_text: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ
citation.translation: The throes of death bring the truth: ‘This is what you used to shun!’

text: And the Trumpet will be blown: ‘This is the promised day.’

citation.arabic_text: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ
citation.translation: And the Trumpet will be blown: ‘This is the promised day.’

text: Every soul will come accompanied by [two angels], a driver, and a witness

citation.arabic_text: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقࣱ وَشَهِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: Every soul will come accompanied by [two angels], a driver, and a witness

text: [he will be told] ‘You were certainly oblivious of this. We have removed your veil from you, and so today your eyesight is acute.’

citation.arabic_text: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: [he will be told] ‘You were certainly oblivious of this. We have removed your veil from you, and so today your eyesight is acute.’

text: Then his companion [angel] will say, ‘This is what is ready with me [of his record of deeds].’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
citation.translation: Then his companion [angel] will say, ‘This is what is ready with me [of his record of deeds].’

text: [The two angels accompany him will be told,] ‘Cast every obdurate ingrate into hell

citation.arabic_text: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدࣲ‏
citation.translation: [The two angels accompany him will be told,] ‘Cast every obdurate ingrate into hell

text: [every] hinderer of good, transgressor, and skeptic

citation.arabic_text: مَّنَّاعࣲ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدࣲ مُّرِيبٍ
citation.translation: [every] hinderer of good, transgressor, and skeptic

text: who had set up another god along with Allah and cast him into the severe punishment.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
citation.translation: who had set up another god along with Allah and cast him into the severe punishment.’

text: His companion [devil] will say, ‘Our Lord! I did not incite him to rebel [against You], but he was [himself] in extreme error.’

citation.arabic_text: ۞قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏
citation.translation: His companion [devil] will say, ‘Our Lord! I did not incite him to rebel [against You], but he was [himself] in extreme error.’

text: He will say, ‘Do not wrangle in My presence, for I had already warned you in advance

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ
citation.translation: He will say, ‘Do not wrangle in My presence, for I had already warned you in advance

text: The word [of judgement] is unalterable with Me, and I am not tyrannical to My servants.’

citation.arabic_text: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
citation.translation: The word [of judgement] is unalterable with Me, and I am not tyrannical to My servants.’

text: The day when We shall say to hell, ‘Are you full?’ It will say, ‘Is there any more?’

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدࣲ‏
citation.translation: The day when We shall say to hell, ‘Are you full?’ It will say, ‘Is there any more?’

text: And paradise will be brought near for the Godwary, it will not be distant [any more]

citation.arabic_text: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
citation.translation: And paradise will be brought near for the Godwary, it will not be distant [any more]

text: ‘This is what you were promised. [It is] for every penitent and dutiful [servant]

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظࣲ‏
citation.translation: ‘This is what you were promised. [It is] for every penitent and dutiful [servant]

text: who fears the All-beneficent in secret and comes with a penitent heart

citation.arabic_text: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبࣲ مُّنِيبٍ
citation.translation: who fears the All-beneficent in secret and comes with a penitent heart

text: Enter it in peace! This is the day of immortality.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمࣲۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ
citation.translation: Enter it in peace! This is the day of immortality.’

text: There they will have whatever they wish, and with Us there is yet more

citation.arabic_text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: There they will have whatever they wish, and with Us there is yet more

text: How many generations We have destroyed before them, who were stronger than these, insomuch that they ransacked the towns?! So, is there any escape [from Allah’s punishment]

citation.arabic_text: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
citation.translation: How many generations We have destroyed before them, who were stronger than these, insomuch that they ransacked the towns?! So, is there any escape [from Allah’s punishment]

text: There is indeed an admonition in that for one who has a heart, or gives ear, being attentive

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: There is indeed an admonition in that for one who has a heart, or gives ear, being attentive

text: Certainly We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days, and any fatigue did not touch Us

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We created the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, in six days, and any fatigue did not touch Us

text: So be patient at what they say, and celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the sunset

citation.arabic_text: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
citation.translation: So be patient at what they say, and celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the sunset

text: and glorify Him through part of the night and after the prostrations

citation.arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
citation.translation: and glorify Him through part of the night and after the prostrations

text: And be on the alert for the day when the caller calls from a close quarter

citation.arabic_text: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانࣲ قَرِيبࣲ‏
citation.translation: And be on the alert for the day when the caller calls from a close quarter

text: the day when they hear the Cry in all truth. That is the day of rising [from the dead]

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ
citation.translation: the day when they hear the Cry in all truth. That is the day of rising [from the dead]

text: Indeed it is We who give life and bring death, and toward Us is the [final] destination

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
citation.translation: Indeed it is We who give life and bring death, and toward Us is the [final] destination

text: The day the earth is split open for [disentombing] them, [they will come out] hastening. That mustering is easy for Us [to carry out]

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: The day the earth is split open for [disentombing] them, [they will come out] hastening. That mustering is easy for Us [to carry out]

text: We know well what they say, and you are not there to compel them. So admonish by the Quran those who fear My threat

citation.arabic_text: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارࣲۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
citation.translation: We know well what they say, and you are not there to compel them. So admonish by the Quran those who fear My threat

text: By the scattering [winds] that scatter [the clouds]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرۡوࣰ ا
citation.translation: By the scattering [winds] that scatter [the clouds]

text: by the [rain] bearing [clouds] laden [with water]

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: by the [rain] bearing [clouds] laden [with water]

text: by [the ships] which move gently [on the sea]

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: by [the ships] which move gently [on the sea]

text: by [the angels] who dispense [livelihood] by [His] command

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمۡرًا
citation.translation: by [the angels] who dispense [livelihood] by [His] command

text: indeed what you are promised is true

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقࣱ‏
citation.translation: indeed what you are promised is true

text: and indeed the retribution will surely come to pass

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
citation.translation: and indeed the retribution will surely come to pass

text: By the sky full of adornment [with stars]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡحُبُكِ
citation.translation: By the sky full of adornment [with stars]

text: indeed you are of different opinions

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّكُمۡ لَفِي قَوۡلࣲ مُّخۡتَلِفࣲ‏
citation.translation: indeed you are of different opinions

text: He who has been turned away [from the truth] is turned away from it

citation.arabic_text: يُؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ أُفِكَ
citation.translation: He who has been turned away [from the truth] is turned away from it

text: Perish the liars

citation.arabic_text: قُتِلَ ٱلۡخَرَّٰصُونَ
citation.translation: Perish the liars

text: who are heedless in a stupor

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةࣲ سَاهُونَ
citation.translation: who are heedless in a stupor

text: They ask, ‘When will be the Day of Retribution?’

citation.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: They ask, ‘When will be the Day of Retribution?’

text: It is the day when they will be tormented in the Fire

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ
citation.translation: It is the day when they will be tormented in the Fire

text: [and will be told]: ‘Taste your torment. This is what you used to hasten.’

citation.arabic_text: ذُوقُواْ فِتۡنَتَكُمۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
citation.translation: [and will be told]: ‘Taste your torment. This is what you used to hasten.’

text: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونٍ
citation.translation: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and springs

text: receiving what their Lord has given them, for they had been virtuous aforetime

citation.arabic_text: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: receiving what their Lord has given them, for they had been virtuous aforetime

text: They used to sleep a little during the night

citation.arabic_text: كَانُواْ قَلِيلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
citation.translation: They used to sleep a little during the night

text: and at dawns they would plead for forgiveness

citation.arabic_text: وَبِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ
citation.translation: and at dawns they would plead for forgiveness

text: and there was a share in their wealth for the beggar and the deprived

citation.arabic_text: وَفِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقࣱّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
citation.translation: and there was a share in their wealth for the beggar and the deprived

text: In the earth are signs for those who have conviction

citation.arabic_text: وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّلۡمُوقِنِينَ
citation.translation: In the earth are signs for those who have conviction

text: and in your souls [as well]. Will you not then perceive

citation.arabic_text: وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: and in your souls [as well]. Will you not then perceive

text: And in the sky is your provision and what you are promised

citation.arabic_text: وَفِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
citation.translation: And in the sky is your provision and what you are promised

text: By the Lord of the sky and the earth, it is indeed the truth, just as [it is a fact that] you speak

citation.arabic_text: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
citation.translation: By the Lord of the sky and the earth, it is indeed the truth, just as [it is a fact that] you speak

text: Did you receive the story of Abraham’s honoured guests

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيۡفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
citation.translation: Did you receive the story of Abraham’s honoured guests

text: When they entered into his presence, they said, ‘Peace!’ ‘Peace!’ He answered, ‘[You are] an unfamiliar folk.’

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ اۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡمࣱ مُّنكَرُونَ
citation.translation: When they entered into his presence, they said, ‘Peace!’ ‘Peace!’ He answered, ‘[You are] an unfamiliar folk.’

text: Then he retired to his family and brought a fat [roasted] calf

citation.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلࣲ سَمِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: Then he retired to his family and brought a fat [roasted] calf

text: and put it near them. He said, ‘Will you not eat?’

citation.arabic_text: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
citation.translation: and put it near them. He said, ‘Will you not eat?’

text: Then he felt a fear of them. They said, ‘Do not be afraid!’ and they gave him the good news of a wise son

citation.arabic_text: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةࣰۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Then he felt a fear of them. They said, ‘Do not be afraid!’ and they gave him the good news of a wise son

text: Then his wife came forward crying [with joy]. She beat her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman!’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَقۡبَلَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ فِي صَرَّةࣲ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Then his wife came forward crying [with joy]. She beat her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman!’

text: They said, ‘So has your Lord said. Indeed He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
citation.translation: They said, ‘So has your Lord said. Indeed He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.’

text: He said, ‘O messengers, what is now your errand?’

citation.arabic_text: ۞قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
citation.translation: He said, ‘O messengers, what is now your errand?’

text: They said, ‘We have been sent toward a guilty people

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ أُرۡسِلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمࣲ مُّجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘We have been sent toward a guilty people

text: that We may rain upon them stones of clay

citation.arabic_text: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةࣰ مِّن طِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: that We may rain upon them stones of clay

text: sent for the transgressors from your Lord

citation.arabic_text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
citation.translation: sent for the transgressors from your Lord

text: So We picked out those who were in it of the faithful

citation.arabic_text: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: So We picked out those who were in it of the faithful

text: but We did not find there other than one house of Muslims

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
citation.translation: but We did not find there other than one house of Muslims

text: and We have left therein a sign for those who fear a painful punishment.’

citation.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
citation.translation: and We have left therein a sign for those who fear a painful punishment.’

text: And in Moses [too there is a sign] when We sent him to Pharaoh with a manifest authority

citation.arabic_text: وَفِي مُوسَىٰٓ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: And in Moses [too there is a sign] when We sent him to Pharaoh with a manifest authority

text: But he turned away assured of his might, and said, ‘A magician or a crazy man!’

citation.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكۡنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونࣱ‏
citation.translation: But he turned away assured of his might, and said, ‘A magician or a crazy man!’

text: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea, while he was blameworthy

citation.arabic_text: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea, while he was blameworthy

text: And in ‘Ad when We unleashed upon them a barren wind

citation.arabic_text: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلۡعَقِيمَ
citation.translation: And in ‘Ad when We unleashed upon them a barren wind

text: It left nothing that it came upon without making it like decayed bones

citation.arabic_text: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
citation.translation: It left nothing that it came upon without making it like decayed bones

text: And in Thamud, when they were told, ‘Enjoy for a while.’

citation.arabic_text: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذۡ قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: And in Thamud, when they were told, ‘Enjoy for a while.’

text: Then they defied the command of their Lord; so the thunderbolt seized them as they looked on

citation.arabic_text: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
citation.translation: Then they defied the command of their Lord; so the thunderbolt seized them as they looked on

text: So they were neither able to rise up, nor to come to one another’s aid

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامࣲ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
citation.translation: So they were neither able to rise up, nor to come to one another’s aid

text: And the people of Noah aforetime. Indeed, they were a transgressing lot

citation.arabic_text: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
citation.translation: And the people of Noah aforetime. Indeed, they were a transgressing lot

text: We have built the heaven with might, and indeed it is We who are its expanders

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا بِأَيۡيْدࣲ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
citation.translation: We have built the heaven with might, and indeed it is We who are its expanders

text: And We have spread out the earth, so how excellent spreaders We have been

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنَٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَٰهِدُونَ
citation.translation: And We have spread out the earth, so how excellent spreaders We have been

text: In all things We have created pairs so that you may take admonition

citation.arabic_text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ
citation.translation: In all things We have created pairs so that you may take admonition

text: ‘So flee toward Allah. Indeed, I am from Him a manifest warner to you

citation.arabic_text: فَفِرُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: ‘So flee toward Allah. Indeed, I am from Him a manifest warner to you

text: Do not set up another god besides Allah. Indeed I am from Him a manifest warner to you.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنۡهُ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Do not set up another god besides Allah. Indeed I am from Him a manifest warner to you.’

text: So it was that there did not come any apostle to those who were before them but they said, ‘A magician,’ or ‘A crazy man!’

citation.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
citation.translation: So it was that there did not come any apostle to those who were before them but they said, ‘A magician,’ or ‘A crazy man!’

text: Did they enjoin this upon one another?! Rather, they were a rebellious lot

citation.arabic_text: أَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِهِۦۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
citation.translation: Did they enjoin this upon one another?! Rather, they were a rebellious lot

text: So turn away from them, as you will not be blameworthy

citation.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومࣲ‏
citation.translation: So turn away from them, as you will not be blameworthy

text: And admonish, for admonition indeed benefits the faithful

citation.arabic_text: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: And admonish, for admonition indeed benefits the faithful

text: I did not create the jinn and the humans except that they may worship Me

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
citation.translation: I did not create the jinn and the humans except that they may worship Me

text: I desire no provision from them, nor do I desire that they should feed Me

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقࣲ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
citation.translation: I desire no provision from them, nor do I desire that they should feed Me

text: Indeed it is Allah who is the All-provider, Powerful and All-strong

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
citation.translation: Indeed it is Allah who is the All-provider, Powerful and All-strong

text: Indeed the lot of those who do wrong [now] will be like the lot of their [earlier] counterparts. So let them not ask Me to hasten on [that fate]

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبࣰ ا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
citation.translation: Indeed the lot of those who do wrong [now] will be like the lot of their [earlier] counterparts. So let them not ask Me to hasten on [that fate]

text: Woe to the faithless for the day they are promised

citation.arabic_text: فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
citation.translation: Woe to the faithless for the day they are promised

text: By the Mount [Sinai]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلطُّورِ
citation.translation: By the Mount [Sinai]

text: by the Book inscribed

citation.arabic_text: وَكِتَٰبࣲ مَّسۡطُورࣲ‏
citation.translation: by the Book inscribed

text: on an unrolled parchment

citation.arabic_text: فِي رَقࣲّ مَّنشُورࣲ‏
citation.translation: on an unrolled parchment

text: by the House greatly frequented

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
citation.translation: by the House greatly frequented

text: by the vault raised high

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
citation.translation: by the vault raised high

text: by the surging sea

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
citation.translation: by the surging sea

text: indeed your Lord’s punishment will surely befall

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
citation.translation: indeed your Lord’s punishment will surely befall

text: There is none who can avert it

citation.arabic_text: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعࣲ‏
citation.translation: There is none who can avert it

text: On the day when the sky whirls violently

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: On the day when the sky whirls violently

text: and the mountains move with an awful motion

citation.arabic_text: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: and the mountains move with an awful motion

text: woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: فَوَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: woe to the deniers on that day

text: —those who play around in vain talk

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضࣲ يَلۡعَبُونَ
citation.translation: —those who play around in vain talk

text: the day when they will be shoved forcibly toward the fire of hell, [and told]

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
citation.translation: the day when they will be shoved forcibly toward the fire of hell, [and told]

text: ‘This is the Fire which you used to deny

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
citation.translation: ‘This is the Fire which you used to deny

text: Is this, then, [also] magic, or is it you who do not perceive

citation.arabic_text: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: Is this, then, [also] magic, or is it you who do not perceive

text: Enter it, and it will be the same for you whether you are patient or impatient. You are only being requited for what you used to do.’

citation.arabic_text: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: Enter it, and it will be the same for you whether you are patient or impatient. You are only being requited for what you used to do.’

text: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and bliss

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَعِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and bliss

text: rejoicing because of what their Lord has given them, and that their Lord has saved them from the punishment of hell

citation.arabic_text: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: rejoicing because of what their Lord has given them, and that their Lord has saved them from the punishment of hell

text: [They will be told:] ‘Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.’

citation.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: [They will be told:] ‘Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.’

text: They will be reclining on arrayed couches, and We will wed them to big-eyed houris

citation.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: They will be reclining on arrayed couches, and We will wed them to big-eyed houris

text: The faithful and their descendants who followed them in faith—We will make their descendants join them, and We will not stint anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Every person is hostage to what he has earned

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: The faithful and their descendants who followed them in faith—We will make their descendants join them, and We will not stint anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Every person is hostage to what he has earned

text: We will provide them with fruits and meat, such as they desire

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ وَلَحۡمࣲ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
citation.translation: We will provide them with fruits and meat, such as they desire

text: There they will pass from hand to hand a cup wherein there will be neither any vain talk nor sinful speech

citation.arabic_text: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: There they will pass from hand to hand a cup wherein there will be neither any vain talk nor sinful speech

text: They will be waited upon by their youths, as if they were guarded pearls

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
citation.translation: They will be waited upon by their youths, as if they were guarded pearls

text: They will turn to one another, questioning each other

citation.arabic_text: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
citation.translation: They will turn to one another, questioning each other

text: They will say, ‘Indeed, aforetime, we used to be apprehensive about our families

citation.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
citation.translation: They will say, ‘Indeed, aforetime, we used to be apprehensive about our families

text: But Allah showed us favour and He saved us from the punishment of the [infernal] miasma

citation.arabic_text: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
citation.translation: But Allah showed us favour and He saved us from the punishment of the [infernal] miasma

text: We used to supplicate Him aforetime. Indeed He is the All-benign, the All-merciful.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
citation.translation: We used to supplicate Him aforetime. Indeed He is the All-benign, the All-merciful.’

text: So admonish. By your Lord’s blessing, you are not a soothsayer, nor mad

citation.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
citation.translation: So admonish. By your Lord’s blessing, you are not a soothsayer, nor mad

text: Do they say, ‘[He is] a poet, for whom we await a fatal accident’

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
citation.translation: Do they say, ‘[He is] a poet, for whom we await a fatal accident’

text: Say, ‘Wait! I too am waiting along with you.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘Wait! I too am waiting along with you.’

text: Is it their intellect which prompts them to [say] this, or are they a rebellious lot

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
citation.translation: Is it their intellect which prompts them to [say] this, or are they a rebellious lot

text: Do they say, ‘He has improvised it [himself]?’ Rather, they have no faith

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: Do they say, ‘He has improvised it [himself]?’ Rather, they have no faith

text: Let them bring a discourse like it, if they are truthful

citation.arabic_text: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: Let them bring a discourse like it, if they are truthful

text: Were they created from nothing? Or are they [their own] creators

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
citation.translation: Were they created from nothing? Or are they [their own] creators

text: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they have no certainty

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
citation.translation: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they have no certainty

text: Do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or do they control [them]

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
citation.translation: Do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or do they control [them]

text: Do they have a ladder [leading up to heaven] whereby they eavesdrop? If so, let their eavesdropper produce a manifest authority

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
citation.translation: Do they have a ladder [leading up to heaven] whereby they eavesdrop? If so, let their eavesdropper produce a manifest authority

text: Does He have daughters while you have sons

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
citation.translation: Does He have daughters while you have sons

text: Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are [wary of] being weighed down with debt

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
citation.translation: Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are [wary of] being weighed down with debt

text: Do they have [access to] the Unseen, which they write down

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
citation.translation: Do they have [access to] the Unseen, which they write down

text: Do they seek to outmaneuver [Allah]? But it is the faithless who are the outmaneuvered ones

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
citation.translation: Do they seek to outmaneuver [Allah]? But it is the faithless who are the outmaneuvered ones

text: Do they have any god other than Allah? Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
citation.translation: Do they have any god other than Allah? Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]

text: Were they to see a fragment falling from the sky, they would say, ‘A cumulous cloud.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: Were they to see a fragment falling from the sky, they would say, ‘A cumulous cloud.’

text: So leave them until they encounter the day when they will be thunderstruck

citation.arabic_text: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
citation.translation: So leave them until they encounter the day when they will be thunderstruck

text: the day when their guile will not avail them in any way, nor will they be helped

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
citation.translation: the day when their guile will not avail them in any way, nor will they be helped

text: Indeed there is a punishment besides that for those who do wrong, but most of them do not know

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed there is a punishment besides that for those who do wrong, but most of them do not know

text: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, for indeed you fare before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise [at dawn]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
citation.translation: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, for indeed you fare before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise [at dawn]

text: and also glorify Him during the night and at the receding of the stars

citation.arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
citation.translation: and also glorify Him during the night and at the receding of the stars

text: By the star when it sets

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
citation.translation: By the star when it sets

text: your companion has neither gone astray, nor amiss

citation.arabic_text: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
citation.translation: your companion has neither gone astray, nor amiss

text: Nor does he speak out of [his own] desire

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Nor does he speak out of [his own] desire

text: it is just a revelation that is revealed [to him]

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيࣱ يُوحَىٰ
citation.translation: it is just a revelation that is revealed [to him]

text: taught him by one of great powers

citation.arabic_text: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ
citation.translation: taught him by one of great powers

text: possessed of sound judgement. He settled

citation.arabic_text: ذُو مِرَّةࣲ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ
citation.translation: possessed of sound judgement. He settled

text: while he was on the highest horizon

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
citation.translation: while he was on the highest horizon

text: Then he drew nearer and nearer

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: Then he drew nearer and nearer

text: until he was within two bows’ length or even nearer

citation.arabic_text: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: until he was within two bows’ length or even nearer

text: whereat He revealed to His servant whatever He revealed

citation.arabic_text: فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ
citation.translation: whereat He revealed to His servant whatever He revealed

text: The heart did not deny what it saw

citation.arabic_text: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
citation.translation: The heart did not deny what it saw

text: Will you then dispute with him about what he saw

citation.arabic_text: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
citation.translation: Will you then dispute with him about what he saw

text: Certainly he saw it yet another time

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: Certainly he saw it yet another time

text: by the Lote Tree of the Ultimate Boundary

citation.arabic_text: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
citation.translation: by the Lote Tree of the Ultimate Boundary

text: near which is the Garden of the Abode

citation.arabic_text: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ
citation.translation: near which is the Garden of the Abode

text: when there covered the Lote Tree what covered it

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: when there covered the Lote Tree what covered it

text: His gaze did not swerve, nor did it overstep the bounds

citation.arabic_text: مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
citation.translation: His gaze did not swerve, nor did it overstep the bounds

text: Certainly he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord

citation.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Certainly he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord

text: Have you considered Lat and ‘Uzza

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ
citation.translation: Have you considered Lat and ‘Uzza

text: and Manat, the third one

citation.arabic_text: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ
citation.translation: and Manat, the third one

text: Are you to have males and He females

citation.arabic_text: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
citation.translation: Are you to have males and He females

text: That, then, will be an unfair division

citation.arabic_text: تِلۡكَ إِذࣰ ا قِسۡمَةࣱ ضِيزَىٰٓ
citation.translation: That, then, will be an unfair division

text: These are but names, which you have coined—you and your fathers—for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjectures and the desires of the [lower] soul, while there has already come to them the guidance from their Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
citation.translation: These are but names, which you have coined—you and your fathers—for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjectures and the desires of the [lower] soul, while there has already come to them the guidance from their Lord

text: Shall man have whatever he yearns for

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
citation.translation: Shall man have whatever he yearns for

text: Yet to Allah belong this world and the Hereafter

citation.arabic_text: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
citation.translation: Yet to Allah belong this world and the Hereafter

text: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession is of not any avail, except after Allah permits whomever He wishes and approves of

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
citation.translation: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession is of not any avail, except after Allah permits whomever He wishes and approves of

text: Indeed those who do not believe in the Hereafter give female names to the angels

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
citation.translation: Indeed those who do not believe in the Hereafter give female names to the angels

text: They do not have any knowledge of that. They follow nothing but conjectures, and conjecture is no substitute for the truth

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
citation.translation: They do not have any knowledge of that. They follow nothing but conjectures, and conjecture is no substitute for the truth

text: So avoid those who turn away from Our remembrance and desire nothing but the life of the world

citation.arabic_text: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
citation.translation: So avoid those who turn away from Our remembrance and desire nothing but the life of the world

text: That is the ultimate reach of their knowledge. Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are [rightly] guided

citation.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
citation.translation: That is the ultimate reach of their knowledge. Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are [rightly] guided

text: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil for what they have done, and reward those who do good with the best [of rewards]

citation.arabic_text: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
citation.translation: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil for what they have done, and reward those who do good with the best [of rewards]

text: Those who avoid major sins and indecencies, apart from [minor and occasional] lapses. Indeed your Lord is expansive in [His] forgiveness. He knows you best since [the time] He produced you from the earth and since you were foetuses in the bellies of your mothers. So do not flaunt your piety: He knows best those who are Godwary

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةࣱ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Those who avoid major sins and indecencies, apart from [minor and occasional] lapses. Indeed your Lord is expansive in [His] forgiveness. He knows you best since [the time] He produced you from the earth and since you were foetuses in the bellies of your mothers. So do not flaunt your piety: He knows best those who are Godwary

text: Did you see him who turned away

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: Did you see him who turned away

text: gave a little and held off

citation.arabic_text: وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلࣰ ا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ
citation.translation: gave a little and held off

text: Does he have the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees

citation.arabic_text: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Does he have the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees

text: Has he not been informed of what is in the scriptures of Moses

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: Has he not been informed of what is in the scriptures of Moses

text: and of Abraham, who fulfilled [his summons]

citation.arabic_text: وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰٓ
citation.translation: and of Abraham, who fulfilled [his summons]

text: that no bearer shall bear another’s burden

citation.arabic_text: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةࣱ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: that no bearer shall bear another’s burden

text: that nothing belongs to man except what he strives for

citation.arabic_text: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
citation.translation: that nothing belongs to man except what he strives for

text: and that he will soon be shown his endeavour

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّ سَعۡيَهُۥ سَوۡفَ يُرَىٰ
citation.translation: and that he will soon be shown his endeavour

text: then he will be rewarded for it with the fullest reward

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَآءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ
citation.translation: then he will be rewarded for it with the fullest reward

text: that the terminus is toward your Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
citation.translation: that the terminus is toward your Lord

text: that it is He who makes [men] laugh, and weep

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ
citation.translation: that it is He who makes [men] laugh, and weep

text: that it is He who brings death and gives life

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحۡيَا
citation.translation: that it is He who brings death and gives life

text: that it is He who created the mates, the male and the female

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
citation.translation: that it is He who created the mates, the male and the female

text: from a drop of [seminal] fluid when emitted

citation.arabic_text: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ إِذَا تُمۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: from a drop of [seminal] fluid when emitted

text: that with Him lies the second genesis

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: that with Him lies the second genesis

text: that it is He who enriches and grants possessions

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغۡنَىٰ وَأَقۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: that it is He who enriches and grants possessions

text: that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius

text: that it is He who destroyed the former ‘Ad

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهۡلَكَ عَادًا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
citation.translation: that it is He who destroyed the former ‘Ad

text: and Thamud, sparing none [of them]

citation.arabic_text: وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ أَبۡقَىٰ
citation.translation: and Thamud, sparing none [of them]

text: and the people of Noah before that; indeed they were more unjust and rebellious

citation.arabic_text: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
citation.translation: and the people of Noah before that; indeed they were more unjust and rebellious

text: and He overthrew the town that was overturned

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ
citation.translation: and He overthrew the town that was overturned

text: covering it with what covered it

citation.arabic_text: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
citation.translation: covering it with what covered it

text: Then which of the bounties of your Lord will you dispute

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
citation.translation: Then which of the bounties of your Lord will you dispute

text: This is a warner, [in the tradition] of the warners of old

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا نَذِيرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
citation.translation: This is a warner, [in the tradition] of the warners of old

text: The Imminent [Hour] is near at hand

citation.arabic_text: أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ
citation.translation: The Imminent [Hour] is near at hand

text: There is none who may unveil it besides Allah

citation.arabic_text: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
citation.translation: There is none who may unveil it besides Allah

text: Will you then wonder at this discourse

citation.arabic_text: أَفَمِنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ تَعۡجَبُونَ
citation.translation: Will you then wonder at this discourse

text: and laugh and not weep

citation.arabic_text: وَتَضۡحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبۡكُونَ
citation.translation: and laugh and not weep

text: while you remain heedless

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنتُمۡ سَٰمِدُونَ
citation.translation: while you remain heedless

text: So prostrate yourselves to Allah and worship Him

citation.arabic_text: فَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ۩
citation.translation: So prostrate yourselves to Allah and worship Him

text: The Hour has drawn near and the moon is split

citation.arabic_text: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
citation.translation: The Hour has drawn near and the moon is split

text: If they see a sign, they turn away, and say, ‘An incessant magic!’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةࣰ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرࣱ مُّسۡتَمِرࣱّ‏
citation.translation: If they see a sign, they turn away, and say, ‘An incessant magic!’

text: They denied and followed their own desires, and every matter has a setting [appropriate to it]

citation.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرࣲ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
citation.translation: They denied and followed their own desires, and every matter has a setting [appropriate to it]

text: There have already come to them reports containing admonishment

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
citation.translation: There have already come to them reports containing admonishment

text: [and representing] far-reaching wisdom; but warnings are of no avail

citation.arabic_text: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةࣱۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
citation.translation: [and representing] far-reaching wisdom; but warnings are of no avail

text: So turn away from them! The day when the Caller calls to a dire thing

citation.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءࣲ نُّكُرٍ
citation.translation: So turn away from them! The day when the Caller calls to a dire thing

text: they will emerge from the graves as if they were scattered locusts with a humbled look [in their eyes]

citation.arabic_text: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادࣱ مُّنتَشِرࣱ‏
citation.translation: they will emerge from the graves as if they were scattered locusts with a humbled look [in their eyes]

text: scrambling toward the summoner. The faithless will say, ‘This is a hard day!’

citation.arabic_text: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرࣱ‏
citation.translation: scrambling toward the summoner. The faithless will say, ‘This is a hard day!’

text: The people of Noah impugned before them. So they impugned Our servant and said, ‘A crazy man,’ and he was reviled

citation.arabic_text: ۞كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونࣱ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
citation.translation: The people of Noah impugned before them. So they impugned Our servant and said, ‘A crazy man,’ and he was reviled

text: Thereat he invoked his Lord, [saying,] ‘I have been overcome, so help [me].’

citation.arabic_text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبࣱ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
citation.translation: Thereat he invoked his Lord, [saying,] ‘I have been overcome, so help [me].’

text: Then We opened the gates of the sky with pouring waters

citation.arabic_text: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءࣲ مُّنۡهَمِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Then We opened the gates of the sky with pouring waters

text: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and the waters met for a preordained purpose

citation.arabic_text: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونࣰ ا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣲ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
citation.translation: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and the waters met for a preordained purpose

text: We bore him on a vessel made of planks and nails

citation.arabic_text: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحࣲ وَدُسُرࣲ‏
citation.translation: We bore him on a vessel made of planks and nails

text: which sailed [over the flood waters] in Our sight, as a retribution for him who was met with disbelief

citation.arabic_text: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءࣰ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
citation.translation: which sailed [over the flood waters] in Our sight, as a retribution for him who was met with disbelief

text: Certainly We have left it as a sign; so is there anyone who will be admonished

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We have left it as a sign; so is there anyone who will be admonished

text: So how were My punishment and warnings

citation.arabic_text: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
citation.translation: So how were My punishment and warnings
