text: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

text: [The people of] ‘Ad impugned [their apostle]. So how were My punishment and warnings

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادࣱ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
citation.translation: [The people of] ‘Ad impugned [their apostle]. So how were My punishment and warnings

text: Indeed We unleashed upon them an icy gale on an incessantly ill-fated day

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحࣰ ا صَرۡصَرࣰ ا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسࣲ مُّسۡتَمِرࣲّ‏
citation.translation: Indeed We unleashed upon them an icy gale on an incessantly ill-fated day

text: knocking down people as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees

citation.arabic_text: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: knocking down people as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees

text: So how were My punishment and warnings

citation.arabic_text: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
citation.translation: So how were My punishment and warnings

text: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

text: [The people of] Thamud denied the warnings

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
citation.translation: [The people of] Thamud denied the warnings

text: and they said, ‘Are we to follow a lone human from ourselves?! Indeed then we would be in error and madness.’

citation.arabic_text: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرࣰ ا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدࣰ ا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرٍ
citation.translation: and they said, ‘Are we to follow a lone human from ourselves?! Indeed then we would be in error and madness.’

text: ‘Has the Reminder been cast upon him from among us? No, he is a self-conceited liar.’

citation.arabic_text: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرࣱ‏
citation.translation: ‘Has the Reminder been cast upon him from among us? No, he is a self-conceited liar.’

text: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is a self-conceited liar

citation.arabic_text: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدࣰ ا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
citation.translation: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is a self-conceited liar

text: We are sending the She-camel as a trial for them; so watch them and be steadfast

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةࣰ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
citation.translation: We are sending the She-camel as a trial for them; so watch them and be steadfast

text: Inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each of them showing up at his turn.’

citation.arabic_text: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبࣲ مُّحۡتَضَرࣱ‏
citation.translation: Inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each of them showing up at his turn.’

text: But they called their companion, and he took [a knife] and hamstrung [her]

citation.arabic_text: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
citation.translation: But they called their companion, and he took [a knife] and hamstrung [her]

text: So how were My punishment and My warnings

citation.arabic_text: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
citation.translation: So how were My punishment and My warnings

text: We sent against them a single Cry, and they became like the dry sticks of a corral builder

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
citation.translation: We sent against them a single Cry, and they became like the dry sticks of a corral builder

text: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

text: And the people of Lot denied the warnings

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
citation.translation: And the people of Lot denied the warnings

text: We unleashed upon them a rain of stones, excepting the family of Lot, whom We delivered at dawn

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطࣲۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرࣲ‏
citation.translation: We unleashed upon them a rain of stones, excepting the family of Lot, whom We delivered at dawn

text: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks

citation.arabic_text: نِّعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
citation.translation: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks

text: He had already warned them of Our punishment, but they disputed the warnings

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
citation.translation: He had already warned them of Our punishment, but they disputed the warnings

text: They even solicited of him his guests, whereat We blotted out their eyes, [saying,] ‘Taste My punishment and My warnings!’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
citation.translation: They even solicited of him his guests, whereat We blotted out their eyes, [saying,] ‘Taste My punishment and My warnings!’

text: Early at dawn there visited them an abiding punishment

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابࣱ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
citation.translation: Early at dawn there visited them an abiding punishment

text: ‘Taste My punishment and warnings!’

citation.arabic_text: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
citation.translation: ‘Taste My punishment and warnings!’

text: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We have made the Quran simple for the sake of admonishment. So is there anyone who will be admonished

text: Certainly the warnings did come to Pharaoh’s clan

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
citation.translation: Certainly the warnings did come to Pharaoh’s clan

text: who denied all of Our signs. So We seized them with the seizing of One [who is] all-mighty, Omnipotent

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
citation.translation: who denied all of Our signs. So We seized them with the seizing of One [who is] all-mighty, Omnipotent

text: Are your faithless better than those? Have you [been granted] [some sort of] immunity in the scriptures

citation.arabic_text: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةࣱ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
citation.translation: Are your faithless better than those? Have you [been granted] [some sort of] immunity in the scriptures

text: Do they say, ‘We are a confederate league’

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعࣱ مُّنتَصِرࣱ‏
citation.translation: Do they say, ‘We are a confederate league’

text: The league will be routed and turn its back [to flee]

citation.arabic_text: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
citation.translation: The league will be routed and turn its back [to flee]

text: Indeed, the Hour is their tryst; and the Hour will be most calamitous and bitter

citation.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
citation.translation: Indeed, the Hour is their tryst; and the Hour will be most calamitous and bitter

text: Indeed the guilty are steeped in error and madness

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the guilty are steeped in error and madness

text: The day when they are dragged on their faces into the Fire, [it will be said to them,] ‘Taste the touch of hell!’

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
citation.translation: The day when they are dragged on their faces into the Fire, [it will be said to them,] ‘Taste the touch of hell!’

text: Indeed We have created everything in a measure

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed We have created everything in a measure

text: and Our command is but a single [word], like the twinkling of an eye

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةࣱ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
citation.translation: and Our command is but a single [word], like the twinkling of an eye

text: Certainly We have destroyed your likes. So is there anyone who will be admonished

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We have destroyed your likes. So is there anyone who will be admonished

text: Everything they have done is in the books

citation.arabic_text: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءࣲ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
citation.translation: Everything they have done is in the books

text: and everything big and small is committed to writing

citation.arabic_text: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرࣲ وَكَبِيرࣲ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
citation.translation: and everything big and small is committed to writing

text: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and streams

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَهَرࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and streams

text: in the abode of truthfulness with an omnipotent King

citation.arabic_text: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
citation.translation: in the abode of truthfulness with an omnipotent King

text: The All-beneficent

citation.arabic_text: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ
citation.translation: The All-beneficent

text: has taught the Quran

citation.arabic_text: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ
citation.translation: has taught the Quran

text: He created man

citation.arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ
citation.translation: He created man

text: [and] taught him articulate speech

citation.arabic_text: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ
citation.translation: [and] taught him articulate speech

text: The sun and the moon are [disposed] calculatedly

citation.arabic_text: ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانࣲ‏
citation.translation: The sun and the moon are [disposed] calculatedly

text: and the herb and the tree prostrate [to Allah]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ
citation.translation: and the herb and the tree prostrate [to Allah]

text: He raised the heaven high and set up the balance

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
citation.translation: He raised the heaven high and set up the balance

text: declaring, ‘Do not infringe the balance

citation.arabic_text: أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ
citation.translation: declaring, ‘Do not infringe the balance

text: Maintain the weights with justice, and do not shorten the balance!’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
citation.translation: Maintain the weights with justice, and do not shorten the balance!’

text: And the earth—He laid it out for mankind

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ
citation.translation: And the earth—He laid it out for mankind

text: In it are fruits and date-palms with sheaths

citation.arabic_text: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ
citation.translation: In it are fruits and date-palms with sheaths

text: grain with husk, and fragrant herbs

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ
citation.translation: grain with husk, and fragrant herbs

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: He created man out of dry clay, like the potter’s

citation.arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلࣲ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ
citation.translation: He created man out of dry clay, like the potter’s

text: and created the jinn out of a flame of a fire

citation.arabic_text: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجࣲ مِّن نَّارࣲ‏
citation.translation: and created the jinn out of a flame of a fire

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Lord of the two easts, and Lord of the two wests

citation.arabic_text: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ
citation.translation: Lord of the two easts, and Lord of the two wests

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: He merged the two seas, meeting each other

citation.arabic_text: مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ
citation.translation: He merged the two seas, meeting each other

text: There is a barrier between them, which they do not overstep

citation.arabic_text: بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخࣱ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ
citation.translation: There is a barrier between them, which they do not overstep

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: From them emerge the pearl and the coral

citation.arabic_text: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
citation.translation: From them emerge the pearl and the coral

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: His are the sailing ships on the sea [appearing] like landmarks

citation.arabic_text: وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
citation.translation: His are the sailing ships on the sea [appearing] like landmarks

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Everyone on it is ephemeral

citation.arabic_text: كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانࣲ‏
citation.translation: Everyone on it is ephemeral

text: yet lasting is the majestic and munificent Face of your Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
citation.translation: yet lasting is the majestic and munificent Face of your Lord

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks Him. Every day He is engaged in some work

citation.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنࣲ‏
citation.translation: Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks Him. Every day He is engaged in some work

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Soon We shall make Ourselves unoccupied for you, O you notable two

citation.arabic_text: سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
citation.translation: Soon We shall make Ourselves unoccupied for you, O you notable two

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: O company of jinn and humans! If you can pass through the confines of the heavens and the earth, then do pass through. But you will not pass through except by an authority [from Allah]

citation.arabic_text: يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ‏
citation.translation: O company of jinn and humans! If you can pass through the confines of the heavens and the earth, then do pass through. But you will not pass through except by an authority [from Allah]

text: There will be unleashed upon you a flash of fire and a smoke; then you will not be able to help one another

citation.arabic_text: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظࣱ مِّن نَّارࣲ وَنُحَاسࣱ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
citation.translation: There will be unleashed upon you a flash of fire and a smoke; then you will not be able to help one another

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: When the sky is split open, and turns crimson like tanned leather

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةࣰ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
citation.translation: When the sky is split open, and turns crimson like tanned leather

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: On that day neither humans will be questioned about their sins nor jinn

citation.arabic_text: فَيَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسࣱ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
citation.translation: On that day neither humans will be questioned about their sins nor jinn

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: The guilty will be recognized by their mark; so they will be seized by their forelocks and feet

citation.arabic_text: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
citation.translation: The guilty will be recognized by their mark; so they will be seized by their forelocks and feet

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: ‘This is the hell which the guilty would deny!’

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
citation.translation: ‘This is the hell which the guilty would deny!’

text: They shall circuit between it and boiling hot water

citation.arabic_text: يَطُوفُونَ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانࣲ‏
citation.translation: They shall circuit between it and boiling hot water

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: For him who stands in awe of his Lord will be two gardens

citation.arabic_text: وَلِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
citation.translation: For him who stands in awe of his Lord will be two gardens

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Both abounding in branches

citation.arabic_text: ذَوَاتَآ أَفۡنَانࣲ‏
citation.translation: Both abounding in branches

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: In both of them will be two flowing springs

citation.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ تَجۡرِيَانِ
citation.translation: In both of them will be two flowing springs

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: In both of them will be two kinds of every fruit

citation.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةࣲ زَوۡجَانِ
citation.translation: In both of them will be two kinds of every fruit

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: [They will be] reclining on beds lined with green silk. And the fruit of the two gardens will be near at hand

citation.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانࣲ‏
citation.translation: [They will be] reclining on beds lined with green silk. And the fruit of the two gardens will be near at hand

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: In them are maidens of restrained glances, whom no human has touched before, nor jinn

citation.arabic_text: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
citation.translation: In them are maidens of restrained glances, whom no human has touched before, nor jinn

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: As though they were rubies and corals

citation.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلۡيَاقُوتُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ
citation.translation: As though they were rubies and corals

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Is the requital of goodness anything but goodness

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنُ
citation.translation: Is the requital of goodness anything but goodness

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Beside these two, there will be two [other] gardens

citation.arabic_text: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
citation.translation: Beside these two, there will be two [other] gardens

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Dark green

citation.arabic_text: مُدۡهَآمَّتَانِ
citation.translation: Dark green

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: In both of them will be two gushing springs

citation.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
citation.translation: In both of them will be two gushing springs

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: In both of them will be fruits, date-palms and pomegranates

citation.arabic_text: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ وَنَخۡلࣱ وَرُمَّانࣱ‏
citation.translation: In both of them will be fruits, date-palms and pomegranates

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: In them are maidens good and lovely

citation.arabic_text: فِيهِنَّ خَيۡرَٰتٌ حِسَانࣱ‏
citation.translation: In them are maidens good and lovely

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Houris secluded in pavilions

citation.arabic_text: حُورࣱ مَّقۡصُورَٰتࣱ فِي ٱلۡخِيَامِ
citation.translation: Houris secluded in pavilions

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Whom no human has touched before, nor jinn

citation.arabic_text: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنࣱّ‏
citation.translation: Whom no human has touched before, nor jinn

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Reclining on green cushions and lovely carpets

citation.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرࣲ وَعَبۡقَرِيٍّ حِسَانࣲ‏
citation.translation: Reclining on green cushions and lovely carpets

text: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
citation.translation: So which of your Lord’s bounties will you both deny

text: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Majestic and the Munificent

citation.arabic_text: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
citation.translation: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Majestic and the Munificent

text: When the Imminent [Hour] befalls

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ
citation.translation: When the Imminent [Hour] befalls

text: —there is no denying that it will befall—

citation.arabic_text: لَيۡسَ لِوَقۡعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
citation.translation: —there is no denying that it will befall—

text: [it will be] lowering and exalting

citation.arabic_text: خَافِضَةࣱ رَّافِعَةٌ
citation.translation: [it will be] lowering and exalting

text: When the earth is shaken violently

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ رَجࣰّ ا
citation.translation: When the earth is shaken violently

text: and the mountains are shattered into bits

citation.arabic_text: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ بَسࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and the mountains are shattered into bits

text: and become scattered dust

citation.arabic_text: فَكَانَتۡ هَبَآءࣰ مُّنۢبَثࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and become scattered dust

text: you will be three groups

citation.arabic_text: وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا ثَلَٰثَةࣰ‏
citation.translation: you will be three groups

text: The People of the Right Hand—and what are the People of the Right Hand

citation.arabic_text: فَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
citation.translation: The People of the Right Hand—and what are the People of the Right Hand

text: And the People of the Left Hand—and what are the People of the Left Hand

citation.arabic_text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
citation.translation: And the People of the Left Hand—and what are the People of the Left Hand

text: And the Foremost Ones are the foremost ones

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
citation.translation: And the Foremost Ones are the foremost ones

text: they are the ones brought near [to Allah]

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
citation.translation: they are the ones brought near [to Allah]

text: [who will reside] in the gardens of bliss

citation.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
citation.translation: [who will reside] in the gardens of bliss

text: A multitude from the former [generations]

citation.arabic_text: ثُلَّةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: A multitude from the former [generations]

text: and a few from the latter ones

citation.arabic_text: وَقَلِيلࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: and a few from the latter ones

text: On brocaded couches

citation.arabic_text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّوۡضُونَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: On brocaded couches

text: reclining on them, face to face

citation.arabic_text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيۡهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
citation.translation: reclining on them, face to face

text: They will be waited upon by immortal youths

citation.arabic_text: يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنࣱ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
citation.translation: They will be waited upon by immortal youths

text: with goblets and ewers and a cup of a clear wine

citation.arabic_text: بِأَكۡوَابࣲ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأۡسࣲ مِّن مَّعِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: with goblets and ewers and a cup of a clear wine

text: which causes them neither headache nor stupefaction

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنۡهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
citation.translation: which causes them neither headache nor stupefaction

text: and such fruits as they prefer

citation.arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةࣲ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
citation.translation: and such fruits as they prefer

text: and such flesh of fowls as they desire

citation.arabic_text: وَلَحۡمِ طَيۡرࣲ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
citation.translation: and such flesh of fowls as they desire

text: and big-eyed houris

citation.arabic_text: وَحُورٌ عِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: and big-eyed houris

text: like guarded pearls

citation.arabic_text: كَأَمۡثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤۡلُوِٕ ٱلۡمَكۡنُونِ
citation.translation: like guarded pearls

text: a reward for what they used to do

citation.arabic_text: جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: a reward for what they used to do

text: They will not hear therein any vain talk or sinful speech

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوࣰ ا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا
citation.translation: They will not hear therein any vain talk or sinful speech

text: but only the watchword, ‘Peace!’ ‘Peace!’

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا قِيلࣰ ا سَلَٰمࣰ ا سَلَٰمࣰ ا
citation.translation: but only the watchword, ‘Peace!’ ‘Peace!’

text: And the People of the Right Hand—what are the People of the Right Hand

citation.arabic_text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: And the People of the Right Hand—what are the People of the Right Hand

text: Amid thornless lote trees

citation.arabic_text: فِي سِدۡرࣲ مَّخۡضُودࣲ‏
citation.translation: Amid thornless lote trees

text: and clustered spathes

citation.arabic_text: وَطَلۡحࣲ مَّنضُودࣲ‏
citation.translation: and clustered spathes

text: and extended shade

citation.arabic_text: وَظِلࣲّ مَّمۡدُودࣲ‏
citation.translation: and extended shade

text: and ever-flowing water

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآءࣲ مَّسۡكُوبࣲ‏
citation.translation: and ever-flowing water

text: and abundant fruits

citation.arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةࣲ كَثِيرَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: and abundant fruits

text: neither inaccessible, nor forbidden

citation.arabic_text: لَّا مَقۡطُوعَةࣲ وَلَا مَمۡنُوعَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: neither inaccessible, nor forbidden

text: and noble spouses

citation.arabic_text: وَفُرُشࣲ مَّرۡفُوعَةٍ
citation.translation: and noble spouses

text: We have created them with a special creation

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءࣰ‏
citation.translation: We have created them with a special creation

text: and made them virgins

citation.arabic_text: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُنَّ أَبۡكَارًا
citation.translation: and made them virgins

text: loving, of a like age

citation.arabic_text: عُرُبًا أَتۡرَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: loving, of a like age

text: for the People of the Right Hand

citation.arabic_text: لِّأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: for the People of the Right Hand

text: A multitude from the former [generations]

citation.arabic_text: ثُلَّةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: A multitude from the former [generations]

text: and a multitude from the latter [ones]

citation.arabic_text: وَثُلَّةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: and a multitude from the latter [ones]

text: And the People of the Left Hand—what are the People of the Left Hand

citation.arabic_text: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
citation.translation: And the People of the Left Hand—what are the People of the Left Hand

text: Amid infernal miasma and boiling water

citation.arabic_text: فِي سَمُومࣲ وَحَمِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Amid infernal miasma and boiling water

text: and the shadow of a dense black smoke

citation.arabic_text: وَظِلࣲّ مِّن يَحۡمُومࣲ‏
citation.translation: and the shadow of a dense black smoke

text: neither cool nor beneficial

citation.arabic_text: لَّا بَارِدࣲ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
citation.translation: neither cool nor beneficial

text: Indeed they had been affluent before this

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتۡرَفِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed they had been affluent before this

text: and they used to persist in the great sin

citation.arabic_text: وَكَانُواْ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلۡحِنثِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: and they used to persist in the great sin

text: And they used to say, ‘What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected

citation.arabic_text: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
citation.translation: And they used to say, ‘What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected

text: And our forefathers too?!’

citation.arabic_text: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
citation.translation: And our forefathers too?!’

text: Say, ‘Indeed the former and latter generations

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘Indeed the former and latter generations

text: will all be gathered for the tryst of a known day

citation.arabic_text: لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
citation.translation: will all be gathered for the tryst of a known day

text: Then indeed, you, astray deniers

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبُونَ
citation.translation: Then indeed, you, astray deniers

text: will surely eat from the Zaqqum tree

citation.arabic_text: لَأٓكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرࣲ مِّن زَقُّومࣲ‏
citation.translation: will surely eat from the Zaqqum tree

text: and stuff your bellies with it

citation.arabic_text: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
citation.translation: and stuff your bellies with it

text: and drink boiling water on top of it

citation.arabic_text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
citation.translation: and drink boiling water on top of it

text: drinking like thirsty camels.’

citation.arabic_text: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ
citation.translation: drinking like thirsty camels.’

text: Such will be the hospitality they receive on the Day of Retribution

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: Such will be the hospitality they receive on the Day of Retribution

text: We created you. Then why do you not acknowledge it

citation.arabic_text: نَحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ فَلَوۡلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
citation.translation: We created you. Then why do you not acknowledge it

text: Have you considered the sperm that you emit

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تُمۡنُونَ
citation.translation: Have you considered the sperm that you emit

text: Is it you who create it, or are We the creator

citation.arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَخۡلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
citation.translation: Is it you who create it, or are We the creator

text: We have ordained death among you, and We are not to be outmaneuvered

citation.arabic_text: نَحۡنُ قَدَّرۡنَا بَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
citation.translation: We have ordained death among you, and We are not to be outmaneuvered

text: from replacing you with your likes and recreating you in [a realm] you do not know

citation.arabic_text: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمۡثَٰلَكُمۡ وَنُنشِئَكُمۡ فِي مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: from replacing you with your likes and recreating you in [a realm] you do not know

text: Certainly you have known the first genesis, then why do you not take admonition

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ فَلَوۡلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
citation.translation: Certainly you have known the first genesis, then why do you not take admonition

text: Have you considered what you sow

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَحۡرُثُونَ
citation.translation: Have you considered what you sow

text: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the grower

citation.arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمۡ تَزۡرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
citation.translation: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the grower

text: If We wish, We turn it into chaff, whereat you are left stunned [saying to yourselves]

citation.arabic_text: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ حُطَٰمࣰ ا فَظَلۡتُمۡ تَفَكَّهُونَ
citation.translation: If We wish, We turn it into chaff, whereat you are left stunned [saying to yourselves]

text: ‘Indeed we have suffered loss

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا لَمُغۡرَمُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Indeed we have suffered loss

text: No, we are deprived!’

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ
citation.translation: No, we are deprived!’

text: Have you considered the water that you drink

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱلَّذِي تَشۡرَبُونَ
citation.translation: Have you considered the water that you drink

text: Is it you who bring it down from the rain cloud, or is it We who bring [it] down

citation.arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنزَلۡتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُزۡنِ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنزِلُونَ
citation.translation: Is it you who bring it down from the rain cloud, or is it We who bring [it] down

text: If We wish We can make it bitter. Then why do you not give thanks

citation.arabic_text: لَوۡ نَشَآءُ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ أُجَاجࣰ ا فَلَوۡلَا تَشۡكُرُونَ
citation.translation: If We wish We can make it bitter. Then why do you not give thanks

text: Have you considered the fire that you kindle

citation.arabic_text: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِي تُورُونَ
citation.translation: Have you considered the fire that you kindle

text: Was it you who caused its tree to grow, or were We the grower

citation.arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَنشَأۡتُمۡ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمۡ نَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُنشِـُٔونَ
citation.translation: Was it you who caused its tree to grow, or were We the grower

text: It was We who made it a reminder and a boon for the desert-dwellers

citation.arabic_text: نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَمَتَٰعࣰ ا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ
citation.translation: It was We who made it a reminder and a boon for the desert-dwellers

text: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme

citation.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme

text: I swear by the places where the stars set

citation.arabic_text: ۞فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
citation.translation: I swear by the places where the stars set

text: And indeed it is a great oath, should you know

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمࣱ لَّوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
citation.translation: And indeed it is a great oath, should you know

text: This is indeed a noble Quran

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرۡءَانࣱ كَرِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: This is indeed a noble Quran

text: in a guarded Book

citation.arabic_text: فِي كِتَٰبࣲ مَّكۡنُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: in a guarded Book

text: —no one touches it except the pure ones—

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُطَهَّرُونَ
citation.translation: —no one touches it except the pure ones—

text: sent down gradually from the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: تَنزِيلࣱ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: sent down gradually from the Lord of all the worlds

text: What! Do you take lightly this discourse

citation.arabic_text: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدۡهِنُونَ
citation.translation: What! Do you take lightly this discourse

text: And make your denial of it your vocation

citation.arabic_text: وَتَجۡعَلُونَ رِزۡقَكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ
citation.translation: And make your denial of it your vocation

text: So when it reaches the throat [of the dying person]

citation.arabic_text: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلۡحُلۡقُومَ
citation.translation: So when it reaches the throat [of the dying person]

text: and at that moment you are looking on [at his bedside]

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنتُمۡ حِينَئِذࣲ تَنظُرُونَ
citation.translation: and at that moment you are looking on [at his bedside]

text: —and We are nearer to him than you are, though you do not perceive—

citation.arabic_text: وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنكُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: —and We are nearer to him than you are, though you do not perceive—

text: then why do you not restore it, if you are not subject

citation.arabic_text: فَلَوۡلَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَدِينِينَ
citation.translation: then why do you not restore it, if you are not subject

text: [to Divine dispensation], if you are truthful

citation.arabic_text: تَرۡجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: [to Divine dispensation], if you are truthful

text: Then, if he be of those brought near

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
citation.translation: Then, if he be of those brought near

text: then ease, abundance, and a garden of bliss

citation.arabic_text: فَرَوۡحࣱ وَرَيۡحَانࣱ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: then ease, abundance, and a garden of bliss

text: And if he be of the People of the Right Hand

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: And if he be of the People of the Right Hand

text: then [he will be told,] ‘Peace be on you, from the People of the Right Hand!’

citation.arabic_text: فَسَلَٰمࣱ لَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: then [he will be told,] ‘Peace be on you, from the People of the Right Hand!’

text: But if he be of the impugners, the astray ones

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
citation.translation: But if he be of the impugners, the astray ones

text: then a treat of boiling water

citation.arabic_text: فَنُزُلࣱ مِّنۡ حَمِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: then a treat of boiling water

text: and entry into hell

citation.arabic_text: وَتَصۡلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
citation.translation: and entry into hell

text: Indeed this is certain truth

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
citation.translation: Indeed this is certain truth

text: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme

citation.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme

text: Whatever there is in the heavens and [whatever there is on] the earth glorifies Allah and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise

citation.arabic_text: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
citation.translation: Whatever there is in the heavens and [whatever there is on] the earth glorifies Allah and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise

text: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth: He gives life and brings death, and He has power over all things

citation.arabic_text: لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرٌ
citation.translation: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth: He gives life and brings death, and He has power over all things

text: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has knowledge of all things

citation.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
citation.translation: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has knowledge of all things

text: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days; then settled on the Throne. He knows whatever enters the earth and whatever emerges from it and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends to it, and He is with you wherever you may be, and Allah watches what you do

citation.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: It is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days; then settled on the Throne. He knows whatever enters the earth and whatever emerges from it and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends to it, and He is with you wherever you may be, and Allah watches what you do

text: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned

citation.arabic_text: لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
citation.translation: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned

text: He makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night, and He knows best what is in the breasts

citation.arabic_text: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
citation.translation: He makes the night pass into the day and makes the day pass into the night, and He knows best what is in the breasts

text: Have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and spend out of that of which He has made you heirs. There is a great reward for those of you who have faith and spend [in Allah’s way]

citation.arabic_text: ءَامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسۡتَخۡلَفِينَ فِيهِۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَأَنفَقُواْ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرࣱ كَبِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: Have faith in Allah and His Apostle, and spend out of that of which He has made you heirs. There is a great reward for those of you who have faith and spend [in Allah’s way]

text: Why should you not have faith in Allah when the Apostle invites you to have faith in your Lord, and He has certainly made a covenant with you, if you are [genuinely] faithful

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا لَكُمۡ لَا تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ وَقَدۡ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
citation.translation: Why should you not have faith in Allah when the Apostle invites you to have faith in your Lord, and He has certainly made a covenant with you, if you are [genuinely] faithful

text: It is He who sends down manifest signs to His servant that He may bring you out of darkness into light, and indeed Allah is most kind and merciful to you

citation.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتࣲ لِّيُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمۡ لَرَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: It is He who sends down manifest signs to His servant that He may bring you out of darkness into light, and indeed Allah is most kind and merciful to you

text: Why should you not spend in the way of Allah, when to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Those of you who spent [their means] and fought before the victory are not equal [to others]. They are greater in rank than those who have spent and fought afterwards. Yet Allah has promised the best reward to each and Allah is well aware of what you do

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا لَكُمۡ أَلَّا تُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ لَا يَسۡتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنۡ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبۡلِ ٱلۡفَتۡحِ وَقَٰتَلَۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَعۡظَمُ دَرَجَةࣰ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدُ وَقَٰتَلُواْۚ وَكُلࣰّ ا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: Why should you not spend in the way of Allah, when to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Those of you who spent [their means] and fought before the victory are not equal [to others]. They are greater in rank than those who have spent and fought afterwards. Yet Allah has promised the best reward to each and Allah is well aware of what you do

text: Who is it that will lend Allah a good loan, that He may multiply it for him and [that] there may be a noble reward for him

citation.arabic_text: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يُقۡرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ ا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجۡرࣱ كَرِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Who is it that will lend Allah a good loan, that He may multiply it for him and [that] there may be a noble reward for him

text: The day you will see the faithful, men and women, with their light moving swiftly in front of them and on their right, [and they are greeted with the words:] ‘There is good news for you today! Gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. That is the great success.’

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تَرَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَسۡعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۖ بُشۡرَىٰكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
citation.translation: The day you will see the faithful, men and women, with their light moving swiftly in front of them and on their right, [and they are greeted with the words:] ‘There is good news for you today! Gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever]. That is the great success.’

text: The day the hypocrites, men and women, will say to the faithful, ‘Please wait, that we may glean something from your light!’ They will be told: ‘Go back and grope for light!’ Then there will be set up between them a wall with a gate, with mercy within and punishment without

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقۡتَبِسۡ مِن نُّورِكُمۡ قِيلَ ٱرۡجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمۡ فَٱلۡتَمِسُواْ نُورࣰ اۖ فَضُرِبَ بَيۡنَهُم بِسُورࣲ لَّهُۥ بَابُۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُ
citation.translation: The day the hypocrites, men and women, will say to the faithful, ‘Please wait, that we may glean something from your light!’ They will be told: ‘Go back and grope for light!’ Then there will be set up between them a wall with a gate, with mercy within and punishment without

text: They will call out to them, ‘Did we not use to be with you?’ They will say, ‘Yes! But you cast yourselves into perdition. You awaited and were skeptical, and [false] hopes deceived you until the edict of Allah came, and the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah

citation.arabic_text: يُنَادُونَهُمۡ أَلَمۡ نَكُن مَّعَكُمۡۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمۡ فَتَنتُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَتَرَبَّصۡتُمۡ وَٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡأَمَانِيُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡغَرُورُ
citation.translation: They will call out to them, ‘Did we not use to be with you?’ They will say, ‘Yes! But you cast yourselves into perdition. You awaited and were skeptical, and [false] hopes deceived you until the edict of Allah came, and the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah

text: So today no ransom shall be taken from you or the faithless. The Fire will be your abode: it is your [ultimate] refuge and an evil destination.’

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنكُمۡ فِدۡيَةࣱ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ مَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ هِيَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
citation.translation: So today no ransom shall be taken from you or the faithless. The Fire will be your abode: it is your [ultimate] refuge and an evil destination.’

text: Is it not time yet for those who have faith that their hearts should be humbled for Allah’s remembrance and toward the truth which has come down [to them], and to be not like those who were given the Book before? Time took its toll on them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are transgressors

citation.arabic_text: ۞أَلَمۡ يَأۡنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن تَخۡشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمۡ لِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُواْ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡأَمَدُ فَقَسَتۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡۖ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ
citation.translation: Is it not time yet for those who have faith that their hearts should be humbled for Allah’s remembrance and toward the truth which has come down [to them], and to be not like those who were given the Book before? Time took its toll on them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are transgressors

text: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death. We have certainly made the signs clear for you, so that you may exercise your reason

citation.arabic_text: ٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاۚ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
citation.translation: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death. We have certainly made the signs clear for you, so that you may exercise your reason

text: Indeed the charitable men and women and those who lend Allah a good loan—it shall be multiplied for them, and there will be a noble reward for them

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلۡمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقۡرَضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ ا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمۡ وَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرࣱ كَرِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the charitable men and women and those who lend Allah a good loan—it shall be multiplied for them, and there will be a noble reward for them

text: Those who have faith in Allah and His apostles—it is they who are the truthful and witnesses with their Lord; they shall have their reward and their light. But as for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, they shall be the inmates of hell

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ وَنُورُهُمۡۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: Those who have faith in Allah and His apostles—it is they who are the truthful and witnesses with their Lord; they shall have their reward and their light. But as for those who are faithless and deny Our signs, they shall be the inmates of hell

text: Know that the life of this world is mere diversion and play, glamour and mutual vainglory among you and rivalry for wealth and children—like rain, whose growth impresses the farmer. Then it withers and you see it turn yellow, then it becomes chaff. Whereas in the Hereafter there is forgiveness from Allah and His approval and a severe punishment. The life of this world is nothing but the wares of delusion

citation.arabic_text: ٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعِبࣱ وَلَهۡوࣱ وَزِينَةࣱ وَتَفَاخُرُۢ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَتَكَاثُرࣱ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰلِ وَٱلۡأَوۡلَٰدِۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيۡثٍ أَعۡجَبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرࣰّ ا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمࣰ اۖ وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدࣱ وَمَغۡفِرَةࣱ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنࣱۚ وَمَا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡغُرُورِ
citation.translation: Know that the life of this world is mere diversion and play, glamour and mutual vainglory among you and rivalry for wealth and children—like rain, whose growth impresses the farmer. Then it withers and you see it turn yellow, then it becomes chaff. Whereas in the Hereafter there is forgiveness from Allah and His approval and a severe punishment. The life of this world is nothing but the wares of delusion

text: Take the lead towards forgiveness from your Lord and a paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who have faith in Allah and His apostles. That is Allah’s grace, which He grants to whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace

citation.arabic_text: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا كَعَرۡضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: Take the lead towards forgiveness from your Lord and a paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who have faith in Allah and His apostles. That is Allah’s grace, which He grants to whomever He wishes, and Allah is dispenser of a great grace

text: No affliction visits the land or yourselves but it is in a Book before We bring it about—that is indeed easy for Allah—

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةࣲ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّبۡرَأَهَآۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: No affliction visits the land or yourselves but it is in a Book before We bring it about—that is indeed easy for Allah—

text: so that you may not grieve for what escapes you, nor boast for what comes your way, and Allah does not like any swaggering braggart

citation.arabic_text: لِّكَيۡلَا تَأۡسَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَفۡرَحُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمۡۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالࣲ فَخُورٍ
citation.translation: so that you may not grieve for what escapes you, nor boast for what comes your way, and Allah does not like any swaggering braggart

text: Such as are [themselves] stingy and bid [other] people to be stingy. And whoever refuses to comply [should know that] indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبۡخَلُونَ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبُخۡلِۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
citation.translation: Such as are [themselves] stingy and bid [other] people to be stingy. And whoever refuses to comply [should know that] indeed Allah is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable

text: Certainly We sent Our apostles with manifest proofs, and We sent down with them the Book and the Balance, so that mankind may maintain justice; and We sent down iron, in which there is great might and uses for mankind, and so that Allah may know those who help Him and His apostles [with faith] in the Unseen. Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty

citation.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِۖ وَأَنزَلۡنَا ٱلۡحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأۡسࣱ شَدِيدࣱ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزࣱ‏
citation.translation: Certainly We sent Our apostles with manifest proofs, and We sent down with them the Book and the Balance, so that mankind may maintain justice; and We sent down iron, in which there is great might and uses for mankind, and so that Allah may know those who help Him and His apostles [with faith] in the Unseen. Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty

text: Certainly We sent Noah and Abraham and We ordained among their descendants prophethood and the Book. Some of them are [rightly] guided, and many of them are transgressors

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحࣰ ا وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلۡكِتَٰبَۖ فَمِنۡهُم مُّهۡتَدࣲۖ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ
citation.translation: Certainly We sent Noah and Abraham and We ordained among their descendants prophethood and the Book. Some of them are [rightly] guided, and many of them are transgressors

text: Then We followed them up with Our apostles and We followed [them] with Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him the Evangel, and We put kindness and mercy into the hearts of those who followed him. But as for monasticism, they innovated it—We had not prescribed it for them—only seeking Allah’s pleasure. Yet they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave to the faithful among them their [due] reward, but many of them are transgressors

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَفَّيۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيۡنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبۡنِ مَرۡيَمَ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡإِنجِيلَۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأۡفَةࣰ وَرَحۡمَةࣰۚ وَرَهۡبَانِيَّةً ٱبۡتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبۡنَٰهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ رِضۡوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوۡهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَاۖ فَـَٔاتَيۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُمۡۖ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَٰسِقُونَ
citation.translation: Then We followed them up with Our apostles and We followed [them] with Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him the Evangel, and We put kindness and mercy into the hearts of those who followed him. But as for monasticism, they innovated it—We had not prescribed it for them—only seeking Allah’s pleasure. Yet they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave to the faithful among them their [due] reward, but many of them are transgressors

text: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah and have faith in His Apostle. He will grant you a double share of His mercy and a light to walk by, and He will forgive you, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُواْ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤۡتِكُمۡ كِفۡلَيۡنِ مِن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ نُورࣰ ا تَمۡشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: O you who have faith! Be wary of Allah and have faith in His Apostle. He will grant you a double share of His mercy and a light to walk by, and He will forgive you, and Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

text: so that the People of the Book may know that they do not control Allah grace in any wise and that in Allah’s hand is all grace, which He grants to whomever He wishes and Allah is dispenser of a mighty grace

citation.arabic_text: لِّئَلَّا يَعۡلَمَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءࣲ مِّن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡفَضۡلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: so that the People of the Book may know that they do not control Allah grace in any wise and that in Allah’s hand is all grace, which He grants to whomever He wishes and Allah is dispenser of a mighty grace

text: Allah has certainly heard the speech of her who pleads with you about her husband and complains to Allah. Allah hears the conversation between the two of you. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing

citation.arabic_text: قَدۡ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوۡلَ ٱلَّتِي تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِي زَوۡجِهَا وَتَشۡتَكِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسۡمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ
citation.translation: Allah has certainly heard the speech of her who pleads with you about her husband and complains to Allah. Allah hears the conversation between the two of you. Indeed Allah is all-hearing, all-seeing

text: As for those of you who repudiate their wives by zihar, they are not their mothers; their mothers are only those who bore them, and indeed they utter an outrage and a lie. Indeed Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمۡۖ إِنۡ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔي وَلَدۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَزُورࣰ اۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورࣱ‏
citation.translation: As for those of you who repudiate their wives by zihar, they are not their mothers; their mothers are only those who bore them, and indeed they utter an outrage and a lie. Indeed Allah is all-excusing, all-forgiving

text: Those who repudiate their wives by ³ih¡r and then retract what they have said, shall set free a slave before they may touch each other. This you are advised [to carry out], and Allah is well aware of what you do

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: Those who repudiate their wives by ³ih¡r and then retract what they have said, shall set free a slave before they may touch each other. This you are advised [to carry out], and Allah is well aware of what you do

text: He who cannot afford [to free a slave] shall fast for two successive months before they may touch each other. If he cannot [do so], he shall feed sixty needy persons. This, that you may have faith in Allah and His Apostle. These are Allah’s bounds, and there is a painful punishment for the faithless

citation.arabic_text: فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ شَهۡرَيۡنِ مُتَتَابِعَيۡنِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۖ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَسۡتَطِعۡ فَإِطۡعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسۡكِينࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
citation.translation: He who cannot afford [to free a slave] shall fast for two successive months before they may touch each other. If he cannot [do so], he shall feed sixty needy persons. This, that you may have faith in Allah and His Apostle. These are Allah’s bounds, and there is a painful punishment for the faithless

text: Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle will be subdued just as those who passed before them were subdued. We have certainly sent down manifest signs, and there is a humiliating punishment for the faithless

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُواْ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ وَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتࣲۚ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابࣱ مُّهِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle will be subdued just as those who passed before them were subdued. We have certainly sent down manifest signs, and there is a humiliating punishment for the faithless

text: The day when Allah will raise them all together, He will inform them about what they have done. Allah has kept account of it, while they have forgotten, and Allah is witness to all things

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعࣰ ا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۚ أَحۡصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ
citation.translation: The day when Allah will raise them all together, He will inform them about what they have done. Allah has kept account of it, while they have forgotten, and Allah is witness to all things

text: Have you not regarded that Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth? There dost not takes place any secret talk among three, but He is their fourth [companion], nor among five but He is their sixth, nor when they are less than that or more but He is with them wherever they may be. Then He will inform them about what they have done on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجۡوَىٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمۡ وَلَا خَمۡسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكۡثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كَانُواْۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded that Allah knows whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth? There dost not takes place any secret talk among three, but He is their fourth [companion], nor among five but He is their sixth, nor when they are less than that or more but He is with them wherever they may be. Then He will inform them about what they have done on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah has knowledge of all things

text: Have you not regarded those who were forbidden from secret talks but again resumed what they had been forbidden from, and hold secret talks [imbued] with sin and transgression and disobedience to the Apostle? And when they come to you they greet you with words with which Allah never greeted you, and they say to themselves, ‘Why does not Allah punish us for what we say?!’ Let hell suffice them: they shall enter it, and it is an evil destination

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نُهُواْ عَنِ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُواْ عَنۡهُ وَيَتَنَٰجَوۡنَ بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٰنِ وَمَعۡصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِۖ وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوۡكَ بِمَا لَمۡ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَوۡلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا ٱللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُۚ حَسۡبُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded those who were forbidden from secret talks but again resumed what they had been forbidden from, and hold secret talks [imbued] with sin and transgression and disobedience to the Apostle? And when they come to you they greet you with words with which Allah never greeted you, and they say to themselves, ‘Why does not Allah punish us for what we say?!’ Let hell suffice them: they shall enter it, and it is an evil destination

text: O you who have faith! When you converse secretly, do not hold private conversations [imbued] with sin and aggression and disobedience to the Apostle, but converse in [a spirit of] piety and Godfearing, and be wary of Allah toward whom you will be gathered

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا تَنَٰجَيۡتُمۡ فَلَا تَتَنَٰجَوۡاْ بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٰنِ وَمَعۡصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَتَنَٰجَوۡاْ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقۡوَىٰۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
citation.translation: O you who have faith! When you converse secretly, do not hold private conversations [imbued] with sin and aggression and disobedience to the Apostle, but converse in [a spirit of] piety and Godfearing, and be wary of Allah toward whom you will be gathered

text: Indeed [malicious] secret talks are from Satan, that he may upset the faithful, but he cannot harm them in any way except by Allah’s leave, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ لِيَحۡزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيۡسَ بِضَآرِّهِمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed [malicious] secret talks are from Satan, that he may upset the faithful, but he cannot harm them in any way except by Allah’s leave, and in Allah let all the faithful put their trust

text: O you who have faith! When you are told, ‘Make room,’ in sittings, then do make room; Allah will make room for you. And when you are told, ‘Rise up!’ Do rise up. Allah will raise in rank those of you who have faith and those who have been given knowledge, and Allah is well aware of what you do

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمۡ تَفَسَّحُواْ فِي ٱلۡمَجَٰلِسِ فَٱفۡسَحُواْ يَفۡسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُواْ فَٱنشُزُواْ يَرۡفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ دَرَجَٰتࣲۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱ‏
citation.translation: O you who have faith! When you are told, ‘Make room,’ in sittings, then do make room; Allah will make room for you. And when you are told, ‘Rise up!’ Do rise up. Allah will raise in rank those of you who have faith and those who have been given knowledge, and Allah is well aware of what you do

text: O you who have faith! When you converse privately with the Apostle, offer a charity before your private talk. That is better for you and purer. But if you cannot afford [to make the offering], then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نَٰجَيۡتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ نَجۡوَىٰكُمۡ صَدَقَةࣰۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡ وَأَطۡهَرُۚ فَإِن لَّمۡ تَجِدُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمٌ
citation.translation: O you who have faith! When you converse privately with the Apostle, offer a charity before your private talk. That is better for you and purer. But if you cannot afford [to make the offering], then Allah is indeed all-forgiving, all-merciful

text: Were you dismayed by having to offer charities before your private talks? Since you did not do it, and Allah has excused you [for not be able to comply], now maintain the prayer and pay the zakat, and obey Allah and His Apostle. Allah is well aware of what you do

citation.arabic_text: ءَأَشۡفَقۡتُمۡ أَن تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ نَجۡوَىٰكُمۡ صَدَقَٰتࣲۚ فَإِذۡ لَمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: Were you dismayed by having to offer charities before your private talks? Since you did not do it, and Allah has excused you [for not be able to comply], now maintain the prayer and pay the zakat, and obey Allah and His Apostle. Allah is well aware of what you do

text: Have you not regarded those who befriend a people at whom Allah is wrathful? They neither belong to you, nor to them, and they swear false oaths [that they are with you] and they know

citation.arabic_text: ۞أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوۡاْ قَوۡمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمۡ وَلَا مِنۡهُمۡ وَيَحۡلِفُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَذِبِ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded those who befriend a people at whom Allah is wrathful? They neither belong to you, nor to them, and they swear false oaths [that they are with you] and they know

text: Allah has prepared a severe punishment for them. Evil indeed is what they used to do

citation.arabic_text: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا شَدِيدًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: Allah has prepared a severe punishment for them. Evil indeed is what they used to do

text: They make a shield of their oaths and bar [people] from the way of Allah; so there is a humiliating punishment for them

citation.arabic_text: ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةࣰ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ مُّهِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: They make a shield of their oaths and bar [people] from the way of Allah; so there is a humiliating punishment for them

text: Their possessions and children will not avail them in any way against Allah. They shall be the inmates of the Fire and they shall remain in it [forever]

citation.arabic_text: لَّن تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
citation.translation: Their possessions and children will not avail them in any way against Allah. They shall be the inmates of the Fire and they shall remain in it [forever]

text: The day when Allah will raise them all together, they will swear to Him, just like they swear to you [now], supposing that they stand on something. Look! They are indeed liars

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعࣰ ا فَيَحۡلِفُونَ لَهُۥ كَمَا يَحۡلِفُونَ لَكُمۡ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٍۚ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰذِبُونَ
citation.translation: The day when Allah will raise them all together, they will swear to Him, just like they swear to you [now], supposing that they stand on something. Look! They are indeed liars

text: Satan has prevailed upon them, so he has caused them to forget the remembrance of Allah. They are Satan’s confederates. Look! Indeed, it is Satan’s confederates who are the losers

citation.arabic_text: ٱسۡتَحۡوَذَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمۡ ذِكۡرَ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
citation.translation: Satan has prevailed upon them, so he has caused them to forget the remembrance of Allah. They are Satan’s confederates. Look! Indeed, it is Satan’s confederates who are the losers

text: Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle—they will be among the most abased

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ٱلۡأَذَلِّينَ
citation.translation: Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Apostle—they will be among the most abased

text: Allah has ordained: ‘I shall surely prevail, I and My apostles.’ Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَغۡلِبَنَّ أَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِيٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزࣱ‏
citation.translation: Allah has ordained: ‘I shall surely prevail, I and My apostles.’ Indeed Allah is all-strong, all-mighty

text: You will not find a people believing in Allah and the Last Day endearing those who oppose Allah and His Apostle even though they were their own parents, or children, or brothers, or kinsfolk. [For] such, He has written faith into their hearts and strengthened them with a spirit from Him. He will admit them into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. They are Allah’s confederates. Look! The confederates of Allah are indeed felicitous

citation.arabic_text: لَّا تَجِدُ قَوۡمࣰ ا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنۡ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوۡ كَانُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ إِخۡوَٰنَهُمۡ أَوۡ عَشِيرَتَهُمۡۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحࣲ مِّنۡهُۖ وَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱللَّهِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
citation.translation: You will not find a people believing in Allah and the Last Day endearing those who oppose Allah and His Apostle even though they were their own parents, or children, or brothers, or kinsfolk. [For] such, He has written faith into their hearts and strengthened them with a spirit from Him. He will admit them into gardens with streams running in them, to remain in them [forever], Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. They are Allah’s confederates. Look! The confederates of Allah are indeed felicitous

text: Whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth glorifies Allah, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise

citation.arabic_text: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
citation.translation: Whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth glorifies Allah, and He is the All-mighty, the All-wise

text: It is He who expelled the faithless belonging to the People of the Book from their homes at the outset of [their] en masse banishment. You did not think that they would go out, and they thought their fortresses would protect them from Allah. But Allah came at them from whence they did not suppose and He cast terror into their hearts. They demolish their houses with their own hands and the hands of the faithful. So take lesson, O you who have insight

citation.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمۡ لِأَوَّلِ ٱلۡحَشۡرِۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْۖ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمۡ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَمۡ يَحۡتَسِبُواْۖ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعۡبَۚ يُخۡرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَأَيۡدِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ فَٱعۡتَبِرُواْ يَٰٓأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
citation.translation: It is He who expelled the faithless belonging to the People of the Book from their homes at the outset of [their] en masse banishment. You did not think that they would go out, and they thought their fortresses would protect them from Allah. But Allah came at them from whence they did not suppose and He cast terror into their hearts. They demolish their houses with their own hands and the hands of the faithful. So take lesson, O you who have insight

text: If Allah had not ordained banishment for them, He would have surely punished them in this world, and in the Hereafter, there is the punishment of the Fire for them

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ
citation.translation: If Allah had not ordained banishment for them, He would have surely punished them in this world, and in the Hereafter, there is the punishment of the Fire for them
