citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: Say, ‘Its knowledge is only with Allah; I am only a manifest warner.’

text: When they see it brought near, the countenances of the faithless will be contorted, and [they will be] told, ‘This is what you were asking for!’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةࣰ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
citation.translation: When they see it brought near, the countenances of the faithless will be contorted, and [they will be] told, ‘This is what you were asking for!’

text: Say, ‘Tell me, whether Allah destroys me and those who are with me, or He has mercy on us, who will shelter the faithless from a painful punishment?’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Say, ‘Tell me, whether Allah destroys me and those who are with me, or He has mercy on us, who will shelter the faithless from a painful punishment?’

text: Say, ‘He is the All-beneficent; we have faith in Him, and in Him do we trust. Soon you will know who is in manifest error.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: Say, ‘He is the All-beneficent; we have faith in Him, and in Him do we trust. Soon you will know who is in manifest error.’

text: Say, ‘Tell me, should your water sink down [into the ground], who will bring you running water?’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرࣰ ا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءࣲ مَّعِينِۭ
citation.translation: Say, ‘Tell me, should your water sink down [into the ground], who will bring you running water?’

text: Nun. By the Pen and what they write

citation.arabic_text: نٓۚ وَٱلۡقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسۡطُرُونَ
citation.translation: Nun. By the Pen and what they write

text: by your Lord’s blessing, you are not, crazy

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجۡنُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: by your Lord’s blessing, you are not, crazy

text: and yours indeed will be an everlasting reward

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجۡرًا غَيۡرَ مَمۡنُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: and yours indeed will be an everlasting reward

text: and indeed you possess a great character

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: and indeed you possess a great character

text: You will see and they will see

citation.arabic_text: فَسَتُبۡصِرُ وَيُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: You will see and they will see

text: which one of you is crazy

citation.arabic_text: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلۡمَفۡتُونُ
citation.translation: which one of you is crazy

text: Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are guided

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are guided

text: So do not obey the deniers

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: So do not obey the deniers

text: who are eager that you should be flexible, so that they [too] may be flexible [towards you]

citation.arabic_text: وَدُّواْ لَوۡ تُدۡهِنُ فَيُدۡهِنُونَ
citation.translation: who are eager that you should be flexible, so that they [too] may be flexible [towards you]

text: And do not obey any vile swearer

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تُطِعۡ كُلَّ حَلَّافࣲ مَّهِينٍ
citation.translation: And do not obey any vile swearer

text: scandal-monger, talebearer

citation.arabic_text: هَمَّازࣲ مَّشَّآءِۭ بِنَمِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: scandal-monger, talebearer

text: hinderer of all good, sinful transgressor

citation.arabic_text: مَّنَّاعࣲ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
citation.translation: hinderer of all good, sinful transgressor

text: callous and, on top of that, baseborn

citation.arabic_text: عُتُلِّۭ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
citation.translation: callous and, on top of that, baseborn

text: —[who behaves in such a manner only] because he has wealth and children

citation.arabic_text: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالࣲ وَبَنِينَ
citation.translation: —[who behaves in such a manner only] because he has wealth and children

text: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, ‘Myths of the ancients!’

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, ‘Myths of the ancients!’

text: Soon We shall brand him on his snout

citation.arabic_text: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلۡخُرۡطُومِ
citation.translation: Soon We shall brand him on his snout

text: Indeed we have tested them just as We tested the People of the Garden when they vowed they would gather its fruit at dawn

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed we have tested them just as We tested the People of the Garden when they vowed they would gather its fruit at dawn

text: and they did not make any exception

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يَسۡتَثۡنُونَ
citation.translation: and they did not make any exception

text: Then, a visitation from your Lord visited it while they were asleep

citation.arabic_text: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
citation.translation: Then, a visitation from your Lord visited it while they were asleep

text: So, by dawn it was like a harvested field

citation.arabic_text: فَأَصۡبَحَتۡ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
citation.translation: So, by dawn it was like a harvested field

text: At dawn they called out to one another

citation.arabic_text: فَتَنَادَوۡاْ مُصۡبِحِينَ
citation.translation: At dawn they called out to one another

text: ‘Get off early to your field if you have to gather [the fruits].’

citation.arabic_text: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
citation.translation: ‘Get off early to your field if you have to gather [the fruits].’

text: So off they went, murmuring to one another

citation.arabic_text: فَٱنطَلَقُواْ وَهُمۡ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
citation.translation: So off they went, murmuring to one another

text: ‘Today no needy man shall come to you in it.’

citation.arabic_text: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينࣱ‏
citation.translation: ‘Today no needy man shall come to you in it.’

text: And they set out at early morning, [considering themselves] able to deprive [the poor of its fruit]

citation.arabic_text: وَغَدَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡدࣲ قَٰدِرِينَ
citation.translation: And they set out at early morning, [considering themselves] able to deprive [the poor of its fruit]

text: But when they saw it, they said, ‘We have indeed lost our way!’

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهَا قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
citation.translation: But when they saw it, they said, ‘We have indeed lost our way!’

text: ‘No, it is we who have been deprived!’

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ نَحۡنُ مَحۡرُومُونَ
citation.translation: ‘No, it is we who have been deprived!’

text: The most upright among them said, ‘Did I not tell you, ‘‘Why do you not glorify [Allah]?’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
citation.translation: The most upright among them said, ‘Did I not tell you, ‘‘Why do you not glorify [Allah]?’’ ’

text: They said, ‘Immaculate is our Lord! We have indeed been wrongdoers!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Immaculate is our Lord! We have indeed been wrongdoers!’

text: Then they turned to one another, blaming each other

citation.arabic_text: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
citation.translation: Then they turned to one another, blaming each other

text: They said, ‘Woe to us! Indeed, we have been rebellious

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
citation.translation: They said, ‘Woe to us! Indeed, we have been rebellious

text: Maybe our Lord will give us a better one in its place. Indeed we earnestly beseech our Lord.’

citation.arabic_text: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
citation.translation: Maybe our Lord will give us a better one in its place. Indeed we earnestly beseech our Lord.’

text: Such was their punishment; and the punishment of the Hereafter is surely greater, had they known

citation.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: Such was their punishment; and the punishment of the Hereafter is surely greater, had they known

text: Indeed for the Godwary there will be gardens of bliss near their Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
citation.translation: Indeed for the Godwary there will be gardens of bliss near their Lord

text: Shall We treat those who submit [to Us] as [We treat] the guilty

citation.arabic_text: أَفَنَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ كَٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: Shall We treat those who submit [to Us] as [We treat] the guilty

text: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

citation.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
citation.translation: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

text: Do you possess a scripture in which you read

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ كِتَٰبࣱ فِيهِ تَدۡرُسُونَ
citation.translation: Do you possess a scripture in which you read

text: that you shall have in it whatever you choose

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
citation.translation: that you shall have in it whatever you choose

text: Do you have a pledge binding on Us until the Day of Resurrection, that you shall indeed have whatever you decide

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
citation.translation: Do you have a pledge binding on Us until the Day of Resurrection, that you shall indeed have whatever you decide

text: Ask them, which of them will aver [any of] that

citation.arabic_text: سَلۡهُمۡ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
citation.translation: Ask them, which of them will aver [any of] that

text: Do they have any ‘partners’ [that they claim for Allah]? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
citation.translation: Do they have any ‘partners’ [that they claim for Allah]? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful

text: The day when the catastrophe occurs and they are summoned to prostrate themselves, they will not be able [to do it]

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقࣲ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
citation.translation: The day when the catastrophe occurs and they are summoned to prostrate themselves, they will not be able [to do it]

text: With a humbled look [in their eyes], they will be overcast by abasement. Certainly, they were summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet sound

citation.arabic_text: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
citation.translation: With a humbled look [in their eyes], they will be overcast by abasement. Certainly, they were summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet sound

text: So leave Me with those who deny this discourse. We will draw them imperceptibly [into ruin], whence they do not know

citation.arabic_text: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: So leave Me with those who deny this discourse. We will draw them imperceptibly [into ruin], whence they do not know

text: I will grant them respite, for My devising is indeed sure

citation.arabic_text: وَأُمۡلِي لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ كَيۡدِي مَتِينٌ
citation.translation: I will grant them respite, for My devising is indeed sure

text: Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are weighed down with debt

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
citation.translation: Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are weighed down with debt

text: Do they possess [access to] the Unseen, so that they write it down

citation.arabic_text: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
citation.translation: Do they possess [access to] the Unseen, so that they write it down

text: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, and do not be like the Man of the Fish who called out as he choked with grief

citation.arabic_text: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, and do not be like the Man of the Fish who called out as he choked with grief

text: Had it not been for a blessing that came to his rescue from his Lord, he would surely have been cast on the bare shore, being blameworthy

citation.arabic_text: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: Had it not been for a blessing that came to his rescue from his Lord, he would surely have been cast on the bare shore, being blameworthy

text: So his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous

citation.arabic_text: فَٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
citation.translation: So his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous

text: Indeed the faithless almost devour you with their eyes when they hear this Reminder, and they say, ‘He is indeed crazy.’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the faithless almost devour you with their eyes when they hear this Reminder, and they say, ‘He is indeed crazy.’

text: Yet it is just a reminder for all the nations

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: Yet it is just a reminder for all the nations

text: The Besieger

citation.arabic_text: ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
citation.translation: The Besieger

text: What is the Besieger

citation.arabic_text: مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
citation.translation: What is the Besieger

text: What will show you what is the Besieger

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
citation.translation: What will show you what is the Besieger

text: Thamudand ‘Ad denied the Cataclysm

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ وَعَادُۢ بِٱلۡقَارِعَةِ
citation.translation: Thamudand ‘Ad denied the Cataclysm

text: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the Cry

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
citation.translation: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the Cry

text: And as for ‘Ad, they were destroyed by a fierce icy gale

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحࣲ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: And as for ‘Ad, they were destroyed by a fierce icy gale

text: which He clamped on them for seven gruelling nights and eight days, so that you could see the people there lying about prostrate as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees

citation.arabic_text: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: which He clamped on them for seven gruelling nights and eight days, so that you could see the people there lying about prostrate as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees

text: So do you see any remaining trace of them

citation.arabic_text: فَهَلۡ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: So do you see any remaining trace of them

text: Then Pharaoh and those who were before him, and the towns that were overturned, brought about iniquity

citation.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
citation.translation: Then Pharaoh and those who were before him, and the towns that were overturned, brought about iniquity

text: They disobeyed the apostle of their Lord, so He seized them with a terrible seizing

citation.arabic_text: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةً
citation.translation: They disobeyed the apostle of their Lord, so He seized them with a terrible seizing

text: Indeed when the Flood rose high, We carried you in a floating ark

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
citation.translation: Indeed when the Flood rose high, We carried you in a floating ark

text: that We might make it a reminder for you, and that receptive ears might remember it

citation.arabic_text: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: that We might make it a reminder for you, and that receptive ears might remember it

text: When the Trumpet is blown with a single blast

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: When the Trumpet is blown with a single blast

text: and the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with a single levelling

citation.arabic_text: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ‏
citation.translation: and the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with a single levelling

text: then, on that day, will the Imminent [Hour] befall

citation.arabic_text: فَيَوۡمَئِذࣲ وَقَعَتِ ٱلۡوَاقِعَةُ
citation.translation: then, on that day, will the Imminent [Hour] befall

text: and the sky will be split open—for it will be frail on that day—

citation.arabic_text: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِيَ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ وَاهِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: and the sky will be split open—for it will be frail on that day—

text: with the angels all over it, and the Throne of your Lord will be borne that day by eight [angels]

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: with the angels all over it, and the Throne of your Lord will be borne that day by eight [angels]

text: That day you will be presented [before your Lord]: none of your secrets will remain hidden

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: That day you will be presented [before your Lord]: none of your secrets will remain hidden

text: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, ‘Here, take and read my book

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
citation.translation: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, ‘Here, take and read my book

text: Indeed I knew that I will encounter my account [of deeds].’

citation.arabic_text: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهۡ
citation.translation: Indeed I knew that I will encounter my account [of deeds].’

text: So he will have a pleasant life

citation.arabic_text: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةࣲ رَّاضِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: So he will have a pleasant life

text: in an elevated garden

citation.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: in an elevated garden

text: whose clusters [of fruits] will be within easy reach

citation.arabic_text: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: whose clusters [of fruits] will be within easy reach

text: [He will be told]: ‘Enjoy your food and drink, for what you had sent in advance in past days [for your future life].’

citation.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
citation.translation: [He will be told]: ‘Enjoy your food and drink, for what you had sent in advance in past days [for your future life].’

text: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, ‘I wish I had not been given my book

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
citation.translation: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, ‘I wish I had not been given my book

text: nor had I ever known what my account is

citation.arabic_text: وَلَمۡ أَدۡرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهۡ
citation.translation: nor had I ever known what my account is

text: I wish death had been the end of it all

citation.arabic_text: يَٰلَيۡتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلۡقَاضِيَةَ
citation.translation: I wish death had been the end of it all

text: My wealth did not avail me

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهۡۜ
citation.translation: My wealth did not avail me

text: My authority has left me.’

citation.arabic_text: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلۡطَٰنِيَهۡ
citation.translation: My authority has left me.’

text: [The angels will be told:] ‘Seize him, and fetter him

citation.arabic_text: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
citation.translation: [The angels will be told:] ‘Seize him, and fetter him

text: Then put him into hell

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
citation.translation: Then put him into hell

text: Then bind him in a chain, seventy cubits in length

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةࣲ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعࣰ ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
citation.translation: Then bind him in a chain, seventy cubits in length

text: Indeed he had no faith in Allah, the All-supreme

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: Indeed he had no faith in Allah, the All-supreme

text: and he did not urge the feeding of the needy

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
citation.translation: and he did not urge the feeding of the needy

text: so he has no friend here today

citation.arabic_text: فَلَيۡسَ لَهُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: so he has no friend here today

text: nor any food except pus

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنۡ غِسۡلِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: nor any food except pus

text: which no one shall eat except the iniquitous.’

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يَأۡكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡخَٰطِـُٔونَ
citation.translation: which no one shall eat except the iniquitous.’

text: I swear by what you see

citation.arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِمَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: I swear by what you see

text: and what you do not see

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
citation.translation: and what you do not see

text: it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولࣲ كَرِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle

text: and it is not the speech of a poet. Little is the faith that you have

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: and it is not the speech of a poet. Little is the faith that you have

text: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer. Little is the admonition that you take

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
citation.translation: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer. Little is the admonition that you take

text: Gradually sent down from the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: تَنزِيلࣱ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: Gradually sent down from the Lord of all the worlds

text: Had he faked any sayings in Our name

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيۡنَا بَعۡضَ ٱلۡأَقَاوِيلِ
citation.translation: Had he faked any sayings in Our name

text: We would have surely seized him by the right hand

citation.arabic_text: لَأَخَذۡنَا مِنۡهُ بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: We would have surely seized him by the right hand

text: and then cut off his aorta

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعۡنَا مِنۡهُ ٱلۡوَتِينَ
citation.translation: and then cut off his aorta

text: and none of you could have held Us off from him

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
citation.translation: and none of you could have held Us off from him

text: Indeed it is a reminder for the Godwary

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذۡكِرَةࣱ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed it is a reminder for the Godwary

text: Indeed We know that there are some among you who deny [it]

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَعۡلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed We know that there are some among you who deny [it]

text: And indeed it will be a [matter of] regret for the faithless

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسۡرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
citation.translation: And indeed it will be a [matter of] regret for the faithless

text: It is indeed certain truth

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
citation.translation: It is indeed certain truth

text: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme

citation.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme

text: An asker asked for a punishment sure to befall

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلَ سَآئِلُۢ بِعَذَابࣲ وَاقِعࣲ‏
citation.translation: An asker asked for a punishment sure to befall

text: —which none can avert from the faithless —

citation.arabic_text: لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ لَيۡسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعࣱ‏
citation.translation: —which none can avert from the faithless —

text: from Allah, Lord of the lofty stations

citation.arabic_text: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِي ٱلۡمَعَارِجِ
citation.translation: from Allah, Lord of the lofty stations

text: The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a day whose span is fifty thousand years

citation.arabic_text: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمࣲ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a day whose span is fifty thousand years

text: So be patient, with a patience that is graceful

citation.arabic_text: فَٱصۡبِرۡ صَبۡرࣰ ا جَمِيلًا
citation.translation: So be patient, with a patience that is graceful

text: Indeed they see it to be far off

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ يَرَوۡنَهُۥ بَعِيدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed they see it to be far off

text: and We see it to be near

citation.arabic_text: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبࣰ ا
citation.translation: and We see it to be near

text: The day when the sky will be like molten copper

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ
citation.translation: The day when the sky will be like molten copper

text: and the mountains like [tufts of] dyed wool

citation.arabic_text: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ
citation.translation: and the mountains like [tufts of] dyed wool

text: and no friend will inquire about [the welfare of his] friend

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يَسۡـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: and no friend will inquire about [the welfare of his] friend

text: [though] they will be placed within each other’s sight. The guilty one will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children

citation.arabic_text: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ
citation.translation: [though] they will be placed within each other’s sight. The guilty one will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children

text: his spouse and his brother

citation.arabic_text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
citation.translation: his spouse and his brother

text: his kin, which had sheltered him

citation.arabic_text: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِي تُـٔۡوِيهِ
citation.translation: his kin, which had sheltered him

text: and all those who are upon the earth, if that might deliver him

citation.arabic_text: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
citation.translation: and all those who are upon the earth, if that might deliver him

text: Never! Indeed, it is a blazing fire

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
citation.translation: Never! Indeed, it is a blazing fire

text: which strips away the scalp

citation.arabic_text: نَزَّاعَةࣰ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
citation.translation: which strips away the scalp

text: It invites him, who has turned back [from the truth] and forsaken [it]

citation.arabic_text: تَدۡعُواْ مَنۡ أَدۡبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: It invites him, who has turned back [from the truth] and forsaken [it]

text: amassing [wealth] and hoarding [it]

citation.arabic_text: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوۡعَىٰٓ
citation.translation: amassing [wealth] and hoarding [it]

text: Indeed man has been created covetous

citation.arabic_text: ۞إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
citation.translation: Indeed man has been created covetous

text: anxious when an ill befalls him

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعࣰ ا
citation.translation: anxious when an ill befalls him

text: and grudging [charity] when good comes his way

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلۡخَيۡرُ مَنُوعًا
citation.translation: and grudging [charity] when good comes his way

text: —[all are such] except the prayerful

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ
citation.translation: —[all are such] except the prayerful

text: those who persevere in their prayers

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ دَآئِمُونَ
citation.translation: those who persevere in their prayers

text: and there is a known share in whose wealth

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقࣱّ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: and there is a known share in whose wealth

text: for the beggar and the deprived

citation.arabic_text: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلۡمَحۡرُومِ
citation.translation: for the beggar and the deprived

text: and who affirm the Day of Retribution

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: and who affirm the Day of Retribution

text: and those who are apprehensive of the punishment of their Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
citation.translation: and those who are apprehensive of the punishment of their Lord

text: there is indeed no security from the punishment of their Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمۡ غَيۡرُ مَأۡمُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: there is indeed no security from the punishment of their Lord

text: and those who guard their private parts

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ
citation.translation: and those who guard their private parts

text: apart from their spouses and their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
citation.translation: apart from their spouses and their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy

text: but whoever seeks beyond that—it is they who are the transgressors

citation.arabic_text: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
citation.translation: but whoever seeks beyond that—it is they who are the transgressors

text: and those who keep their trusts and covenants

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ
citation.translation: and those who keep their trusts and covenants

text: and those who are observant of their testimonies

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمۡ قَآئِمُونَ
citation.translation: and those who are observant of their testimonies

text: and those who are watchful of their prayers

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ
citation.translation: and those who are watchful of their prayers

text: They will be in gardens, held in honour

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ مُّكۡرَمُونَ
citation.translation: They will be in gardens, held in honour

text: What is the matter with the faithless that they scramble toward you

citation.arabic_text: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهۡطِعِينَ
citation.translation: What is the matter with the faithless that they scramble toward you

text: from left and right, in groups

citation.arabic_text: عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
citation.translation: from left and right, in groups

text: Does each man among them hope to enter the garden of bliss

citation.arabic_text: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Does each man among them hope to enter the garden of bliss

text: Never! Indeed, We created them from what they know

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: Never! Indeed, We created them from what they know

text: So I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We are able

citation.arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
citation.translation: So I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We are able

text: to replace them with [others] better than them and We are not to be outmaneuvered

citation.arabic_text: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
citation.translation: to replace them with [others] better than them and We are not to be outmaneuvered

text: So leave them to gossip and play till they encounter the day they are promised

citation.arabic_text: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
citation.translation: So leave them to gossip and play till they encounter the day they are promised

text: the day when they emerge from graves, hastening, as if racing toward a target

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعࣰ ا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ
citation.translation: the day when they emerge from graves, hastening, as if racing toward a target

text: with a humbled look [in their eyes], overcast by abasement. That is the day they had been promised

citation.arabic_text: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
citation.translation: with a humbled look [in their eyes], overcast by abasement. That is the day they had been promised

text: Indeed We sent Noah to his people, [saying,] ‘Warn your people before a painful punishment overtakes them.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed We sent Noah to his people, [saying,] ‘Warn your people before a painful punishment overtakes them.’

text: He said, ‘O my people! Indeed, I am a manifest warner to you

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
citation.translation: He said, ‘O my people! Indeed, I am a manifest warner to you

text: Worship Allah and be wary of Him, and obey me

citation.arabic_text: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
citation.translation: Worship Allah and be wary of Him, and obey me

text: that He may forgive you some of your sins and respite you until a specified time. Indeed when Allah’s [appointed] time comes, it cannot be deferred, if you know.’

citation.arabic_text: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: that He may forgive you some of your sins and respite you until a specified time. Indeed when Allah’s [appointed] time comes, it cannot be deferred, if you know.’

text: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed, I have summoned my people night and day

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلࣰ ا وَنَهَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed, I have summoned my people night and day

text: but my summons only increases their evasion

citation.arabic_text: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: but my summons only increases their evasion

text: Indeed whenever I have summoned them, so that You might forgive them, they would put their fingers into their ears and draw their cloaks over their heads, and they were persistent [in their unfaith], and disdainful in [their] arrogance

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed whenever I have summoned them, so that You might forgive them, they would put their fingers into their ears and draw their cloaks over their heads, and they were persistent [in their unfaith], and disdainful in [their] arrogance

text: Again I summoned them aloud

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: Again I summoned them aloud

text: and again appealed to them publicly and confided with them privately

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: and again appealed to them publicly and confided with them privately

text: telling [them]: ‘‘Plead to your Lord for forgiveness. Indeed, He is all-forgiving

citation.arabic_text: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰ ا
citation.translation: telling [them]: ‘‘Plead to your Lord for forgiveness. Indeed, He is all-forgiving

text: He will send for you abundant rains from the sky

citation.arabic_text: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: He will send for you abundant rains from the sky

text: and aid you with wealth and sons, and provide you with gardens and provide you with streams

citation.arabic_text: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا
citation.translation: and aid you with wealth and sons, and provide you with gardens and provide you with streams

text: What is the matter with you that you do not look upon Allah with veneration

citation.arabic_text: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: What is the matter with you that you do not look upon Allah with veneration

text: though He has created you in [various] stages

citation.arabic_text: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا
citation.translation: though He has created you in [various] stages

text: Have you not seen how Allah has created the seven heavens in layers

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا
citation.translation: Have you not seen how Allah has created the seven heavens in layers

text: and has made therein the moon for a light and the sun for a lamp

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجࣰ ا
citation.translation: and has made therein the moon for a light and the sun for a lamp

text: Allah made you grow from the earth, with a [vegetable] growth

citation.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتࣰ ا
citation.translation: Allah made you grow from the earth, with a [vegetable] growth

text: Then He makes you return to it, and He will bring you forth [without fail]

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجࣰ ا
citation.translation: Then He makes you return to it, and He will bring you forth [without fail]

text: Allah has made the earth a vast expanse for you

citation.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطࣰ ا
citation.translation: Allah has made the earth a vast expanse for you

text: so that you may travel over its spacious ways.’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلࣰ ا فِجَاجࣰ ا
citation.translation: so that you may travel over its spacious ways.’’ ’

text: Noah said, ‘My Lord! They have disobeyed me, following someone whose wealth and children only add to his loss

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: Noah said, ‘My Lord! They have disobeyed me, following someone whose wealth and children only add to his loss

text: and they have devised an outrageous plot

citation.arabic_text: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرࣰ ا كُبَّارࣰ ا
citation.translation: and they have devised an outrageous plot

text: They say, ‘‘Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, Ya‘uq and Nasr,’’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدࣰّ ا وَلَا سُوَاعࣰ ا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: They say, ‘‘Do not abandon your gods. Do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, Ya‘uq and Nasr,’’

text: and already they have led many astray. Do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but error.’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرࣰ اۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلࣰ ا
citation.translation: and already they have led many astray. Do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but error.’

text: They were drowned because of their iniquities, then made to enter a Fire, and they did not find any helpers for themselves besides Allah

citation.arabic_text: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارࣰ ا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارࣰ ا
citation.translation: They were drowned because of their iniquities, then made to enter a Fire, and they did not find any helpers for themselves besides Allah

text: And Noah said, ‘My Lord! ‘Do not leave on the earth any inhabitant from among the faithless

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
citation.translation: And Noah said, ‘My Lord! ‘Do not leave on the earth any inhabitant from among the faithless

text: If You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants, and will beget none except vicious ingrates

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرࣰ ا كَفَّارࣰ ا
citation.translation: If You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants, and will beget none except vicious ingrates

text: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and the faithful men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but ruin.’

citation.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا
citation.translation: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and the faithful men and women, and do not increase the wrongdoers in anything but ruin.’

text: Say, ‘It has been revealed to me that a team of the jinn listened [to the Quran] and they said, “Indeed we heard a wonderful Quran

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘It has been revealed to me that a team of the jinn listened [to the Quran] and they said, “Indeed we heard a wonderful Quran

text: which guides to rectitude. Hence, we have believed in it and we will never ascribe any partner to our Lord

citation.arabic_text: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: which guides to rectitude. Hence, we have believed in it and we will never ascribe any partner to our Lord

text: Exalted be the majesty of our Lord; He has taken neither any spouse nor son

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Exalted be the majesty of our Lord; He has taken neither any spouse nor son

text: The foolish ones among us used to speak atrocious lies concerning Allah

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطࣰ ا
citation.translation: The foolish ones among us used to speak atrocious lies concerning Allah

text: We thought that humans and jinn would never utter any falsehood concerning Allah

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا
citation.translation: We thought that humans and jinn would never utter any falsehood concerning Allah

text: Indeed some persons from the humans would seek the protection of some persons from the jinn, thus only adding to their rebellion

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمۡ رَهَقࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed some persons from the humans would seek the protection of some persons from the jinn, thus only adding to their rebellion

text: They thought, just as you think, that Allah will not raise anyone from the dead

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمۡ أَن لَّن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: They thought, just as you think, that Allah will not raise anyone from the dead

text: Indeed we made for the heaven and found it full of mighty sentries and flames

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنَٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَشُهُبࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed we made for the heaven and found it full of mighty sentries and flames

text: We used to sit in its positions to eavesdrop, but anyone listening now finds a flame waiting for him

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِۖ فَمَن يَسۡتَمِعِ ٱلۡأٓنَ يَجِدۡ لَهُۥ شِهَابࣰ ا رَّصَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: We used to sit in its positions to eavesdrop, but anyone listening now finds a flame waiting for him

text: We do not know whether ill is intended for those who are on the earth, or whether their Lord intends good for them

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: We do not know whether ill is intended for those who are on the earth, or whether their Lord intends good for them

text: Among us some are righteous and some are otherwise: we are various sects

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Among us some are righteous and some are otherwise: we are various sects

text: We know that we cannot frustrate Allah on the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by fleeing

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبࣰ ا
citation.translation: We know that we cannot frustrate Allah on the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by fleeing

text: When we heard the [message of] guidance, we believed in it. Whoever that has faith in his Lord will fear neither privation nor oppression

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسࣰ ا وَلَا رَهَقࣰ ا
citation.translation: When we heard the [message of] guidance, we believed in it. Whoever that has faith in his Lord will fear neither privation nor oppression

text: Among us some are Muslims and some of us are perverse.” ’ Those who submit [to Allah]—it is they who pursue rectitude

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Among us some are Muslims and some of us are perverse.” ’ Those who submit [to Allah]—it is they who pursue rectitude

text: As for the perverse, they will be firewood for hell

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبࣰ ا
citation.translation: As for the perverse, they will be firewood for hell

text: If they are steadfast on the path [of Allah], We shall provide them with abundant water

citation.arabic_text: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقࣰ ا
citation.translation: If they are steadfast on the path [of Allah], We shall provide them with abundant water

text: so that We may test them therein, and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will let him into an escalating punishment

citation.arabic_text: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: so that We may test them therein, and whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will let him into an escalating punishment

text: The places of worship belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone along with Allah

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: The places of worship belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone along with Allah

text: When the servant of Allah rose to pray to Him, they almost crowded around him

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدۡعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: When the servant of Allah rose to pray to Him, they almost crowded around him

text: Say, ‘I pray only to my Lord, and I do not ascribe any partner to Him.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘I pray only to my Lord, and I do not ascribe any partner to Him.’

text: Say, ‘I have no power to bring you any harm or good [of my own accord].’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا رَشَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Say, ‘I have no power to bring you any harm or good [of my own accord].’

text: Say, ‘Neither can anyone shelter me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge besides Him

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدࣱ وَلَنۡ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلۡتَحَدًا
citation.translation: Say, ‘Neither can anyone shelter me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge besides Him

text: [I have no duty] except to transmit from Allah, and [to communicate] His messages; and whoever disobeys Allah and His apostle, there will indeed be for him the fire of hell, to remain in it forever.’

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا بَلَٰغࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۚ وَمَن يَعۡصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
citation.translation: [I have no duty] except to transmit from Allah, and [to communicate] His messages; and whoever disobeys Allah and His apostle, there will indeed be for him the fire of hell, to remain in it forever.’

text: When they see what they are promised, they will know who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرࣰ ا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: When they see what they are promised, they will know who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers

text: Say, ‘I do not know if what you are promised is near, or if my Lord has set a [long] term for it.’

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
citation.translation: Say, ‘I do not know if what you are promised is near, or if my Lord has set a [long] term for it.’

text: Knower of the Unseen, He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] Unseen to anyone

citation.arabic_text: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
citation.translation: Knower of the Unseen, He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] Unseen to anyone

text: except to an apostle He approves of. Then He dispatches a sentinel before and behind him

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولࣲ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدࣰ ا
citation.translation: except to an apostle He approves of. Then He dispatches a sentinel before and behind him

text: so that He may ascertain that they have communicated the messages of their Lord, and He encompasses all that is with them, and He keeps an count of all things

citation.arabic_text: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا
citation.translation: so that He may ascertain that they have communicated the messages of their Lord, and He encompasses all that is with them, and He keeps an count of all things

text: O you wrapped up in your mantle

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُزَّمِّلُ
citation.translation: O you wrapped up in your mantle

text: Stand vigil through the night, except for a little [of it]

citation.arabic_text: قُمِ ٱلَّيۡلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Stand vigil through the night, except for a little [of it]

text: a half, or reduce a little from that

citation.arabic_text: نِّصۡفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصۡ مِنۡهُ قَلِيلًا
citation.translation: a half, or reduce a little from that

text: or add to it, and recite the Quran in a measured tone

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
citation.translation: or add to it, and recite the Quran in a measured tone

text: Indeed soon We shall cast on you a weighty discourse

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلࣰ ا ثَقِيلًا
citation.translation: Indeed soon We shall cast on you a weighty discourse

text: Indeed the watch of the night is firmer in tread and more upright in respect to speech

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـࣰٔ ا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
citation.translation: Indeed the watch of the night is firmer in tread and more upright in respect to speech

text: for indeed during the day you have drawn-out engagements

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحࣰ ا طَوِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: for indeed during the day you have drawn-out engagements

text: So celebrate the Name of your Lord and dedicate yourself to Him with total dedication

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: So celebrate the Name of your Lord and dedicate yourself to Him with total dedication

text: Lord of the east and the west, there is no god except Him; so take Him for your trustee

citation.arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Lord of the east and the west, there is no god except Him; so take Him for your trustee

text: and be patient over what they say, and distance yourself from them in a graceful manner

citation.arabic_text: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرࣰ ا جَمِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: and be patient over what they say, and distance yourself from them in a graceful manner

text: Leave Me [to deal] with the deniers, the opulent, and give them a little respite

citation.arabic_text: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا
citation.translation: Leave Me [to deal] with the deniers, the opulent, and give them a little respite

text: Indeed with Us are heavy fetters and a fierce fire

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالࣰ ا وَجَحِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed with Us are heavy fetters and a fierce fire

text: and a food that chokes [those who eat it], and a painful punishment [prepared for]

citation.arabic_text: وَطَعَامࣰ ا ذَا غُصَّةࣲ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: and a food that chokes [those who eat it], and a painful punishment [prepared for]

text: the day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will be like dunes of shifting sand

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبࣰ ا مَّهِيلًا
citation.translation: the day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will be like dunes of shifting sand

text: Indeed We have sent to you an apostle, to be a witness to you, just as We sent an apostle to Pharaoh

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ رَسُولࣰ ا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ رَسُولࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed We have sent to you an apostle, to be a witness to you, just as We sent an apostle to Pharaoh

text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the apostle; so We seized him with a terrible seizing

citation.arabic_text: فَعَصَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ أَخۡذࣰ ا وَبِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the apostle; so We seized him with a terrible seizing

text: So, if you disbelieve, how will you avoid the day, which will make children white-headed

citation.arabic_text: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا
citation.translation: So, if you disbelieve, how will you avoid the day, which will make children white-headed

text: and wherein the sky will be rent apart? His promise is bound to be fulfilled

citation.arabic_text: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۚ كَانَ وَعۡدُهُۥ مَفۡعُولًا
citation.translation: and wherein the sky will be rent apart? His promise is bound to be fulfilled

text: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
citation.translation: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord

text: Indeed your Lord knows that you stand vigil for nearly two thirds of the night—or [at times] a half or a third of it—along with a group of those who are with you. Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot calculate it [exactly], and so He was lenient toward you. So recite as much of the Quran as is feasible. He knows that some of you will be sick, while others will travel in the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and yet others will fight in the way of Allah. So recite as much of it as is feasible, and maintain the prayer and pay the zakat and lend Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send ahead for your souls you will find it with Allah [in a form] that is better and greater with respect to reward. And plead to Allah for forgiveness; indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

citation.arabic_text: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ اۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرࣲ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرࣰ ا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرࣰ اۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمُۢ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord knows that you stand vigil for nearly two thirds of the night—or [at times] a half or a third of it—along with a group of those who are with you. Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot calculate it [exactly], and so He was lenient toward you. So recite as much of the Quran as is feasible. He knows that some of you will be sick, while others will travel in the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and yet others will fight in the way of Allah. So recite as much of it as is feasible, and maintain the prayer and pay the zakat and lend Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send ahead for your souls you will find it with Allah [in a form] that is better and greater with respect to reward. And plead to Allah for forgiveness; indeed Allah is all-forgiving, all-merciful

text: O you wrapped up in your mantle

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُدَّثِّرُ
citation.translation: O you wrapped up in your mantle

text: Rise up and warn

citation.arabic_text: قُمۡ فَأَنذِرۡ
citation.translation: Rise up and warn

text: Magnify your Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرۡ
citation.translation: Magnify your Lord

text: and purify your clothes

citation.arabic_text: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرۡ
citation.translation: and purify your clothes

text: and keep away from all impurity

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلرُّجۡزَ فَٱهۡجُرۡ
citation.translation: and keep away from all impurity

text: Do not grant a favour seeking a greater gain

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تَمۡنُن تَسۡتَكۡثِرُ
citation.translation: Do not grant a favour seeking a greater gain

text: and be patient for the sake of your Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصۡبِرۡ
citation.translation: and be patient for the sake of your Lord

text: When the Trumpet will be sounded

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي ٱلنَّاقُورِ
citation.translation: When the Trumpet will be sounded

text: that will be a day of hardship

citation.arabic_text: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَوۡمٌ عَسِيرٌ
citation.translation: that will be a day of hardship

text: not at all easy for the faithless

citation.arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ غَيۡرُ يَسِيرࣲ‏
citation.translation: not at all easy for the faithless

text: Leave Me [to deal] with him whom I created alone

citation.arabic_text: ذَرۡنِي وَمَنۡ خَلَقۡتُ وَحِيدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Leave Me [to deal] with him whom I created alone

text: and furnished him with extensive means

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡتُ لَهُۥ مَالࣰ ا مَّمۡدُودࣰ ا
citation.translation: and furnished him with extensive means

text: [gave him] sons to be at his side

citation.arabic_text: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودࣰ ا
citation.translation: [gave him] sons to be at his side

text: and facilitated [all matters] for him

citation.arabic_text: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمۡهِيدࣰ ا
citation.translation: and facilitated [all matters] for him

text: Still he is eager that I should give him more

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يَطۡمَعُ أَنۡ أَزِيدَ
citation.translation: Still he is eager that I should give him more

text: No indeed! He is an obstinate opponent of Our signs

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِأٓيَٰتِنَا عَنِيدࣰ ا
citation.translation: No indeed! He is an obstinate opponent of Our signs

text: Soon I will overwhelm him with hardship

citation.arabic_text: سَأُرۡهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
citation.translation: Soon I will overwhelm him with hardship

text: Indeed he reflected and decided

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
citation.translation: Indeed he reflected and decided

text: Perish he, how he decided

citation.arabic_text: فَقُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ
citation.translation: Perish he, how he decided

text: Again, perish he, how he decided

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ
citation.translation: Again, perish he, how he decided

text: Then he looked

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
citation.translation: Then he looked

text: then frowned and scowled

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
citation.translation: then frowned and scowled

text: Then he walked away disdainfully

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ
citation.translation: Then he walked away disdainfully

text: saying, ‘It is nothing but traditional sorcery

citation.arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ يُؤۡثَرُ
citation.translation: saying, ‘It is nothing but traditional sorcery

text: It is nothing but the speech of a human.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوۡلُ ٱلۡبَشَرِ
citation.translation: It is nothing but the speech of a human.’

text: Soon I will cast him into Saqar

citation.arabic_text: سَأُصۡلِيهِ سَقَرَ
citation.translation: Soon I will cast him into Saqar

text: And what will show you what is Saqar

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
citation.translation: And what will show you what is Saqar

text: It neither spares, nor leaves [anything]

citation.arabic_text: لَا تُبۡقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ
citation.translation: It neither spares, nor leaves [anything]

text: It burns the skin

citation.arabic_text: لَوَّاحَةࣱ لِّلۡبَشَرِ
citation.translation: It burns the skin

text: There are nineteen [keepers] over it

citation.arabic_text: عَلَيۡهَا تِسۡعَةَ عَشَرَ
citation.translation: There are nineteen [keepers] over it

text: We have assigned only angels as keepers of the Fire, and We have made their number merely a stumbling block for the faithless, and so that those who were given the Book may be reassured, and the faithful may increase in [their] faith, and so that those who were given the Book and the faithful may not be in doubt, and so that the faithless and those in whose hearts is a sickness may say, ‘What did Allah mean by this description?’ Thus does Allah lead astray whomever He wishes and guides whomever He wishes. No one knows the hosts of your Lord except Him, and it is just an admonition for all humans

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰ ا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ
citation.translation: We have assigned only angels as keepers of the Fire, and We have made their number merely a stumbling block for the faithless, and so that those who were given the Book may be reassured, and the faithful may increase in [their] faith, and so that those who were given the Book and the faithful may not be in doubt, and so that the faithless and those in whose hearts is a sickness may say, ‘What did Allah mean by this description?’ Thus does Allah lead astray whomever He wishes and guides whomever He wishes. No one knows the hosts of your Lord except Him, and it is just an admonition for all humans

text: No indeed! By the Moon

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا وَٱلۡقَمَرِ
citation.translation: No indeed! By the Moon

text: By the night when it recedes

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذۡ أَدۡبَرَ
citation.translation: By the night when it recedes

text: By the dawn when it brightens

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَآ أَسۡفَرَ
citation.translation: By the dawn when it brightens

text: Indeed they are one of the greatest [signs of God]

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهَا لَإِحۡدَى ٱلۡكُبَرِ
citation.translation: Indeed they are one of the greatest [signs of God]

text: —a warner to all humans

citation.arabic_text: نَذِيرࣰ ا لِّلۡبَشَرِ
citation.translation: —a warner to all humans

text: [alike] for those of you who like to advance ahead and those who would remain behind

citation.arabic_text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ
citation.translation: [alike] for those of you who like to advance ahead and those who would remain behind

text: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned

citation.arabic_text: كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ رَهِينَةٌ
citation.translation: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned

text: except the People of the Right Hand

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
citation.translation: except the People of the Right Hand

text: [They will be] in gardens, questioning

citation.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
citation.translation: [They will be] in gardens, questioning

text: the guilty

citation.arabic_text: عَنِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: the guilty

text: ‘What drew you into Hell?’

citation.arabic_text: مَا سَلَكَكُمۡ فِي سَقَرَ
citation.translation: ‘What drew you into Hell?’

text: They will answer, ‘We were not among those who prayed

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ لَمۡ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُصَلِّينَ
citation.translation: They will answer, ‘We were not among those who prayed

text: Nor did we feed the poor

citation.arabic_text: وَلَمۡ نَكُ نُطۡعِمُ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينَ
citation.translation: Nor did we feed the poor

text: We used to indulge in [profane] gossip along with the gossipers

citation.arabic_text: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلۡخَآئِضِينَ
citation.translation: We used to indulge in [profane] gossip along with the gossipers

text: and we used to deny the Day of Retribution

citation.arabic_text: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: and we used to deny the Day of Retribution

text: until death came to us.’

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلۡيَقِينُ
citation.translation: until death came to us.’

text: So the intercession of the intercessors will not avail them

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمۡ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
citation.translation: So the intercession of the intercessors will not avail them

text: What is the matter with them that they evade the Reminder

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلتَّذۡكِرَةِ مُعۡرِضِينَ
citation.translation: What is the matter with them that they evade the Reminder

text: as if they were terrified asses

citation.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُمۡ حُمُرࣱ مُّسۡتَنفِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: as if they were terrified asses

text: fleeing from a lion

citation.arabic_text: فَرَّتۡ مِن قَسۡوَرَةِۭ
citation.translation: fleeing from a lion

text: But everyone of them desires to be given unrolled scriptures [from Allah]

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُؤۡتَىٰ صُحُفࣰ ا مُّنَشَّرَةࣰ‏
citation.translation: But everyone of them desires to be given unrolled scriptures [from Allah]

text: No! Indeed, they do not fear the Hereafter

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ
citation.translation: No! Indeed, they do not fear the Hereafter

text: No! It is indeed a reminder

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذۡكِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: No! It is indeed a reminder

text: So let anyone who wishes be mindful of it

citation.arabic_text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: So let anyone who wishes be mindful of it

text: And they will not be mindful unless Allah wishes. He is worthy of [your] being wary [of Him] and He is worthy to forgive

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يَذۡكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ هُوَ أَهۡلُ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ وَأَهۡلُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ
citation.translation: And they will not be mindful unless Allah wishes. He is worthy of [your] being wary [of Him] and He is worthy to forgive

text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

citation.arabic_text: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ
citation.translation: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

text: And I swear by the self-critical soul

citation.arabic_text: وَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلنَّفۡسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
citation.translation: And I swear by the self-critical soul

text: Does man suppose that We will not put together his bones [at resurrection]

citation.arabic_text: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجۡمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
citation.translation: Does man suppose that We will not put together his bones [at resurrection]

text: Yes indeed, We are able to [re]shape [even] his fingertips

citation.arabic_text: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ
citation.translation: Yes indeed, We are able to [re]shape [even] his fingertips

text: Indeed, man desires to go on living viciously

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفۡجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
citation.translation: Indeed, man desires to go on living viciously

text: He asks, ‘When will be this “day of resurrection”?!’

citation.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ
citation.translation: He asks, ‘When will be this “day of resurrection”?!’

text: But when the eyes are dazzled

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ
citation.translation: But when the eyes are dazzled

text: the moon is eclipsed

citation.arabic_text: وَخَسَفَ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
citation.translation: the moon is eclipsed

text: and the sun and the moon are brought together

citation.arabic_text: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ
citation.translation: and the sun and the moon are brought together

text: that day man will say, ‘Where is the escape [from this day]?’

citation.arabic_text: يَقُولُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ أَيۡنَ ٱلۡمَفَرُّ
citation.translation: that day man will say, ‘Where is the escape [from this day]?’

text: No indeed! There will be no refuge

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
citation.translation: No indeed! There will be no refuge

text: That day the [final] goal will be toward your Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقَرُّ
citation.translation: That day the [final] goal will be toward your Lord

text: That day man will be informed about what [works] he had sent ahead [to the scene of judgement] and [the legacy that he had] left behind

citation.arabic_text: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
citation.translation: That day man will be informed about what [works] he had sent ahead [to the scene of judgement] and [the legacy that he had] left behind

text: Indeed, man is a witness to himself

citation.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed, man is a witness to himself

text: though he should offer excuses [to justify his failings]

citation.arabic_text: وَلَوۡ أَلۡقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
citation.translation: though he should offer excuses [to justify his failings]

text: Do not move your tongue with it to hasten it

citation.arabic_text: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
citation.translation: Do not move your tongue with it to hasten it

text: Indeed it is up to Us to put it together and to recite it

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا جَمۡعَهُۥ وَقُرۡءَانَهُۥ
citation.translation: Indeed it is up to Us to put it together and to recite it

text: And when We have recited it, follow its recitation

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعۡ قُرۡءَانَهُۥ
citation.translation: And when We have recited it, follow its recitation

text: Then, its exposition [also] lies with Us

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
citation.translation: Then, its exposition [also] lies with Us

text: No! Indeed, you love this transitory life

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ
citation.translation: No! Indeed, you love this transitory life

text: and forsake the Hereafter

citation.arabic_text: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ
citation.translation: and forsake the Hereafter

text: Some faces will be fresh on that day

citation.arabic_text: وُجُوهࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ نَّاضِرَةٌ
citation.translation: Some faces will be fresh on that day

text: looking to their Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: looking to their Lord

text: and some faces will be scowling on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَوُجُوهࣱ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَاسِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: and some faces will be scowling on that day

text: knowing that they will be dealt out a punishment breaking the spine

citation.arabic_text: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفۡعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: knowing that they will be dealt out a punishment breaking the spine

text: No indeed! When it reaches up to the collar bones

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِيَ
citation.translation: No indeed! When it reaches up to the collar bones

text: and it is said, ‘Who will take him up?’

citation.arabic_text: وَقِيلَ مَنۡۜ رَاقࣲ‏
citation.translation: and it is said, ‘Who will take him up?’

text: and he knows that it is the [time of] parting

citation.arabic_text: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡفِرَاقُ
citation.translation: and he knows that it is the [time of] parting

text: and each shank clasps the other shank

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
citation.translation: and each shank clasps the other shank

text: that day he shall be driven toward your Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ٱلۡمَسَاقُ
citation.translation: that day he shall be driven toward your Lord

text: He neither confirmed [the messages of Allah], nor did he pray

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: He neither confirmed [the messages of Allah], nor did he pray

text: but denied [them] and turned away

citation.arabic_text: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: but denied [them] and turned away

text: and went back swaggering to his family

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
citation.translation: and went back swaggering to his family

text: So, woe to you! Woe to you

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰ
citation.translation: So, woe to you! Woe to you

text: Again, woe to you! Woe to you

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Again, woe to you! Woe to you

text: Does man suppose that he has been abandoned to futility

citation.arabic_text: أَيَحۡسَبُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتۡرَكَ سُدًى
citation.translation: Does man suppose that he has been abandoned to futility

text: Was he not a drop of emitted semen

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةࣰ مِّن مَّنِيࣲّ يُمۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: Was he not a drop of emitted semen

text: and then a clinging mass? Whereat He created and proportioned [him]

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةࣰ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
citation.translation: and then a clinging mass? Whereat He created and proportioned [him]

text: and made of him the two sexes, male and female

citation.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَ مِنۡهُ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
citation.translation: and made of him the two sexes, male and female

text: Is not [someone like] that able to revive the dead

citation.arabic_text: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ
citation.translation: Is not [someone like] that able to revive the dead

text: Has there been a period of time for man when he was not anything worthy of mention

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينࣱ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـࣰٔ ا مَّذۡكُورًا
citation.translation: Has there been a period of time for man when he was not anything worthy of mention

text: Indeed We created man from the drop of a mixed fluid so that We may put him to test, so We endowed with hearing and sight

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجࣲ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
citation.translation: Indeed We created man from the drop of a mixed fluid so that We may put him to test, so We endowed with hearing and sight

text: Indeed We have guided him to the way, be he grateful or ungrateful

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرࣰ ا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
citation.translation: Indeed We have guided him to the way, be he grateful or ungrateful

text: Indeed for the faithless We have prepared chains, iron collars, and a blaze

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا وَسَعِيرًا
citation.translation: Indeed for the faithless We have prepared chains, iron collars, and a blaze

text: Indeed the pious will drink from a cup seasoned with Kafur

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسࣲ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
citation.translation: Indeed the pious will drink from a cup seasoned with Kafur

text: a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, making it gush forth as they please

citation.arabic_text: عَيۡنࣰ ا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, making it gush forth as they please

text: They fulfill their vows and fear a day whose ill will be widespread

citation.arabic_text: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمࣰ ا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: They fulfill their vows and fear a day whose ill will be widespread

text: For the love of Him, they feed the needy, the orphan and the prisoner

citation.arabic_text: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينࣰ ا وَيَتِيمࣰ ا وَأَسِيرًا
citation.translation: For the love of Him, they feed the needy, the orphan and the prisoner

text: [saying,] ‘We feed you only for the sake of Allah. We desire no reward from you, nor thanks

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ وَلَا شُكُورًا
