citation.translation: [saying,] ‘We feed you only for the sake of Allah. We desire no reward from you, nor thanks

text: Indeed we fear a frowning and fateful day from our Lord.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسࣰ ا قَمۡطَرِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed we fear a frowning and fateful day from our Lord.’

text: So Allah saved them from that day’s ills and graced them with freshness [on this faces] and joy [in their hearts]

citation.arabic_text: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةࣰ وَسُرُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: So Allah saved them from that day’s ills and graced them with freshness [on this faces] and joy [in their hearts]

text: He rewarded them for their patience with a garden and [garments of] silk

citation.arabic_text: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةࣰ وَحَرِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: He rewarded them for their patience with a garden and [garments of] silk

text: reclining therein on couches, without facing any [scorching] sun, or [biting] cold

citation.arabic_text: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسࣰ ا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: reclining therein on couches, without facing any [scorching] sun, or [biting] cold

text: Its shades will be close over them and its clusters [of fruits] will be hanging low

citation.arabic_text: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Its shades will be close over them and its clusters [of fruits] will be hanging low

text: They will be served around with vessels of silver and goblets of crystal

citation.arabic_text: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةࣲ مِّن فِضَّةࣲ وَأَكۡوَابࣲ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠
citation.translation: They will be served around with vessels of silver and goblets of crystal

text: —crystal of silver— [from] which they will dispense in a precise measure

citation.arabic_text: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةࣲ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: —crystal of silver— [from] which they will dispense in a precise measure

text: They will be served therein with a cup of a drink seasoned with Zanjabeel

citation.arabic_text: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
citation.translation: They will be served therein with a cup of a drink seasoned with Zanjabeel

text: from a spring in it named Salsabeel

citation.arabic_text: عَيۡنࣰ ا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: from a spring in it named Salsabeel

text: They will be waited upon by immortal youths, whom, were you to see them, you will suppose them to be scattered pearls

citation.arabic_text: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنࣱ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣰ ا مَّنثُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: They will be waited upon by immortal youths, whom, were you to see them, you will suppose them to be scattered pearls

text: As you look on, you will see there bliss and a great kingdom

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمࣰ ا وَمُلۡكࣰ ا كَبِيرًا
citation.translation: As you look on, you will see there bliss and a great kingdom

text: Upon them will be cloaks of green silk and brocade and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them to drink a pure drink

citation.arabic_text: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرࣱ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣱۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةࣲ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابࣰ ا طَهُورًا
citation.translation: Upon them will be cloaks of green silk and brocade and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them to drink a pure drink

text: [They will be told]: ‘This is your reward, and your efforts have been well-appreciated.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا
citation.translation: [They will be told]: ‘This is your reward, and your efforts have been well-appreciated.’

text: Indeed We have sent down to you the Quran in a gradual descent

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed We have sent down to you the Quran in a gradual descent

text: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord and do not obey any sinner or ingrate from among them

citation.arabic_text: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord and do not obey any sinner or ingrate from among them

text: and celebrate the Name of your Lord morning and evening

citation.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: and celebrate the Name of your Lord morning and evening

text: and worship Him for a watch of the night and glorify Him the night long

citation.arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلࣰ ا طَوِيلًا
citation.translation: and worship Him for a watch of the night and glorify Him the night long

text: Indeed they love this transitory life, and disregard a heavy day that is ahead of them

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا ثَقِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed they love this transitory life, and disregard a heavy day that is ahead of them

text: We created them and strengthened their joints, and We will replace them with others like them whenever We like

citation.arabic_text: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا
citation.translation: We created them and strengthened their joints, and We will replace them with others like them whenever We like

text: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلࣰ ا
citation.translation: This is indeed a reminder. So let anyone who wishes take the way toward his Lord

text: But you will not wish unless it is willed by Allah. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمࣰ ا
citation.translation: But you will not wish unless it is willed by Allah. Indeed Allah is all-knowing, all-wise

text: He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy, and He has prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers

citation.arabic_text: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا
citation.translation: He admits whomever He wishes into His mercy, and He has prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers

text: By the [angelic] emissaries sent successively

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡمُرۡسَلَٰتِ عُرۡفࣰ ا
citation.translation: By the [angelic] emissaries sent successively

text: by those who sweep along like gale

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصۡفࣰ ا
citation.translation: by those who sweep along like gale

text: by those who publish [the Divine messages] far and wide

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: by those who publish [the Divine messages] far and wide

text: by those who separate [the truth from falsehood] distinctly

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرۡقࣰ ا
citation.translation: by those who separate [the truth from falsehood] distinctly

text: by those who inspire [God’s] remembrance

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡمُلۡقِيَٰتِ ذِكۡرًا
citation.translation: by those who inspire [God’s] remembrance

text: as exemption or warning

citation.arabic_text: عُذۡرًا أَوۡ نُذۡرًا
citation.translation: as exemption or warning

text: what you are promised will surely befall

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
citation.translation: what you are promised will surely befall

text: When the stars are blotted out

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتۡ
citation.translation: When the stars are blotted out

text: and the sky is cleft

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتۡ
citation.translation: and the sky is cleft

text: when the mountains are scattered [like dust]

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ نُسِفَتۡ
citation.translation: when the mountains are scattered [like dust]

text: and time is set for the apostles [to bear witness]

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتۡ
citation.translation: and time is set for the apostles [to bear witness]

text: —for what day has [all] that been set [to occur]

citation.arabic_text: لِأَيِّ يَوۡمٍ أُجِّلَتۡ
citation.translation: —for what day has [all] that been set [to occur]

text: For the Day of Judgement

citation.arabic_text: لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ
citation.translation: For the Day of Judgement

text: And what will show you what is the Day of Judgement

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ
citation.translation: And what will show you what is the Day of Judgement

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: Did We not destroy the former generations

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: Did We not destroy the former generations

text: [and] then made the latter ones follow them

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُتۡبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
citation.translation: [and] then made the latter ones follow them

text: That is how We deal with the guilty

citation.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
citation.translation: That is how We deal with the guilty

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: Have We not created you from a base fluid

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءࣲ مَّهِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: Have We not created you from a base fluid

text: [and] then lodged it in a secure abode

citation.arabic_text: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ فِي قَرَارࣲ مَّكِينٍ
citation.translation: [and] then lodged it in a secure abode

text: until a known span [of time]

citation.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ قَدَرࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏
citation.translation: until a known span [of time]

text: Then We determined; and how excellent determiners We are

citation.arabic_text: فَقَدَرۡنَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡقَٰدِرُونَ
citation.translation: Then We determined; and how excellent determiners We are

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ كِفَاتًا
citation.translation: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

text: for the living and the dead

citation.arabic_text: أَحۡيَآءࣰ وَأَمۡوَٰتࣰ ا
citation.translation: for the living and the dead

text: and set in it lofty [and] firm mountains, and given you agreeable water to drink

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتࣲ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءࣰ فُرَاتࣰ ا
citation.translation: and set in it lofty [and] firm mountains, and given you agreeable water to drink

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: [The faithless will be told:] ‘Proceed toward what you used to deny

citation.arabic_text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
citation.translation: [The faithless will be told:] ‘Proceed toward what you used to deny

text: Proceed toward the triple-forked shadow

citation.arabic_text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلࣲّ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبࣲ‏
citation.translation: Proceed toward the triple-forked shadow

text: neither shady nor of any avail against the flames

citation.arabic_text: لَّا ظَلِيلࣲ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
citation.translation: neither shady nor of any avail against the flames

text: Indeed it throws up [giant] sparks like castles

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهَا تَرۡمِي بِشَرَرࣲ كَٱلۡقَصۡرِ
citation.translation: Indeed it throws up [giant] sparks like castles

text: [bright] like yellow camels

citation.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتࣱ صُفۡرࣱ‏
citation.translation: [bright] like yellow camels

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: This is a day wherein they will not speak

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
citation.translation: This is a day wherein they will not speak

text: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يُؤۡذَنُ لَهُمۡ فَيَعۡتَذِرُونَ
citation.translation: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: ‘This is the Day of Judgement. We have brought you together with the former generations

citation.arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: ‘This is the Day of Judgement. We have brought you together with the former generations

text: If you have any stratagems [left], try them out against Me!’

citation.arabic_text: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡدࣱ فَكِيدُونِ
citation.translation: If you have any stratagems [left], try them out against Me!’

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: Indeed the Godwary will be amid shades and springs

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the Godwary will be amid shades and springs

text: and [enjoying] such fruits as they desire

citation.arabic_text: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
citation.translation: and [enjoying] such fruits as they desire

text: [They will be told:] ‘Enjoy your food and drink, [a reward] for what you used to do

citation.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
citation.translation: [They will be told:] ‘Enjoy your food and drink, [a reward] for what you used to do

text: Thus do We reward the virtuous.’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
citation.translation: Thus do We reward the virtuous.’

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: ‘Eat and enjoy a little! You are indeed guilty.’

citation.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجۡرِمُونَ
citation.translation: ‘Eat and enjoy a little! You are indeed guilty.’

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: When they are told, ‘Bow down [in prayer],’ they do not bow down

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ
citation.translation: When they are told, ‘Bow down [in prayer],’ they do not bow down

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: So what discourse will they believe after this

citation.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: So what discourse will they believe after this

text: What is it that they are questioning each other about

citation.arabic_text: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
citation.translation: What is it that they are questioning each other about

text: [Is it] about the Great Tiding

citation.arabic_text: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
citation.translation: [Is it] about the Great Tiding

text: the one about which they differ

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ
citation.translation: the one about which they differ

text: No indeed! Soon they will know

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: No indeed! Soon they will know

text: No indeed! Soon they will know for once again

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: No indeed! Soon they will know for once again

text: Did We not make the earth a resting place

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Did We not make the earth a resting place

text: and the mountains stakes

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَوۡتَادࣰ ا
citation.translation: and the mountains stakes

text: and create you in pairs

citation.arabic_text: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا
citation.translation: and create you in pairs

text: and make your sleep for rest

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتࣰ ا
citation.translation: and make your sleep for rest

text: and make the night a covering

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسࣰ ا
citation.translation: and make the night a covering

text: and make the day for livelihood

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشࣰ ا
citation.translation: and make the day for livelihood

text: and build above you the seven mighty heavens

citation.arabic_text: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعࣰ ا شِدَادࣰ ا
citation.translation: and build above you the seven mighty heavens

text: and make [the sun for] a radiant lamp

citation.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجࣰ ا وَهَّاجࣰ ا
citation.translation: and make [the sun for] a radiant lamp

text: and send down water pouring from the rain-clouds

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءࣰ ثَجَّاجࣰ ا
citation.translation: and send down water pouring from the rain-clouds

text: that We may bring forth with it grains and plants

citation.arabic_text: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبࣰّ ا وَنَبَاتࣰ ا
citation.translation: that We may bring forth with it grains and plants

text: and luxuriant gardens

citation.arabic_text: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا
citation.translation: and luxuriant gardens

text: Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst

text: the day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will come in groups

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
citation.translation: the day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will come in groups

text: and the sky will be opened and become gates

citation.arabic_text: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبࣰ ا
citation.translation: and the sky will be opened and become gates

text: and the mountains will be set moving and become a mirage

citation.arabic_text: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًا
citation.translation: and the mountains will be set moving and become a mirage

text: Indeed hell is in ambush

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed hell is in ambush

text: a resort for the rebels

citation.arabic_text: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابࣰ ا
citation.translation: a resort for the rebels

text: to reside therein for ages

citation.arabic_text: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحۡقَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: to reside therein for ages

text: tasting in it neither any coolness nor drink

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدࣰ ا وَلَا شَرَابًا
citation.translation: tasting in it neither any coolness nor drink

text: except boiling water and pus

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا حَمِيمࣰ ا وَغَسَّاقࣰ ا
citation.translation: except boiling water and pus

text: a fitting requital

citation.arabic_text: جَزَآءࣰ وِفَاقًا
citation.translation: a fitting requital

text: Indeed they did not expect any reckoning

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed they did not expect any reckoning

text: and they denied Our signs mendaciously

citation.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابࣰ ا
citation.translation: and they denied Our signs mendaciously

text: and We have figured everything in a Book

citation.arabic_text: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبࣰ ا
citation.translation: and We have figured everything in a Book

text: So [now] taste! We shall increase you in nothing but punishment

citation.arabic_text: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
citation.translation: So [now] taste! We shall increase you in nothing but punishment

text: Indeed a triumph awaits the Godwary

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
citation.translation: Indeed a triumph awaits the Godwary

text: gardens and vineyards

citation.arabic_text: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣰ ا
citation.translation: gardens and vineyards

text: and buxom maidens of a like age

citation.arabic_text: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: and buxom maidens of a like age

text: and brimming cups

citation.arabic_text: وَكَأۡسࣰ ا دِهَاقࣰ ا
citation.translation: and brimming cups

text: Therein they shall hear neither vain talk nor lies

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوࣰ ا وَلَا كِذَّٰبࣰ ا
citation.translation: Therein they shall hear neither vain talk nor lies

text: —a reward and a sufficing bounty from your Lord

citation.arabic_text: جَزَآءࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: —a reward and a sufficing bounty from your Lord

text: the All-beneficent, the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. They will not be able to address Him

citation.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: the All-beneficent, the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. They will not be able to address Him

text: on the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in an array: none shall speak except someone who is permitted by the All-beneficent and says what is rightful

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفࣰّ اۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابࣰ ا
citation.translation: on the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in an array: none shall speak except someone who is permitted by the All-beneficent and says what is rightful

text: That day is true for certain. So let anyone who wishes take resort with his Lord

citation.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
citation.translation: That day is true for certain. So let anyone who wishes take resort with his Lord

text: Indeed We have warned you of a punishment near at hand—the day when a person will observe what his hands have sent ahead and the faithless one will say, ‘I wish I were dust!’

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
citation.translation: Indeed We have warned you of a punishment near at hand—the day when a person will observe what his hands have sent ahead and the faithless one will say, ‘I wish I were dust!’

text: By those [angels] who wrest [the soul] violently

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقࣰ ا
citation.translation: By those [angels] who wrest [the soul] violently

text: by those who draw [it] out gently

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطࣰ ا
citation.translation: by those who draw [it] out gently

text: by those who swim smoothly

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحࣰ ا
citation.translation: by those who swim smoothly

text: by those who, racing, take the lead

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبۡقࣰ ا
citation.translation: by those who, racing, take the lead

text: by those who direct the affairs [of creatures]

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: by those who direct the affairs [of creatures]

text: the day when the Quaker quakes

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
citation.translation: the day when the Quaker quakes

text: and is followed by the Successor

citation.arabic_text: تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
citation.translation: and is followed by the Successor

text: hearts will be trembling on that day

citation.arabic_text: قُلُوبࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ وَاجِفَةٌ
citation.translation: hearts will be trembling on that day

text: bearing a humbled look

citation.arabic_text: أَبۡصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: bearing a humbled look

text: They will say, ‘Are we being returned to our earlier state

citation.arabic_text: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرۡدُودُونَ فِي ٱلۡحَافِرَةِ
citation.translation: They will say, ‘Are we being returned to our earlier state

text: What, even after we have been decayed bones?!’

citation.arabic_text: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمࣰ ا نَّخِرَةࣰ‏
citation.translation: What, even after we have been decayed bones?!’

text: They will say, ‘This is, then, a ruinous return!’

citation.arabic_text: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذࣰ ا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: They will say, ‘This is, then, a ruinous return!’

text: Yet it will be only a single shout

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: Yet it will be only a single shout

text: and behold, they will be awake

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
citation.translation: and behold, they will be awake

text: Did you receive the story of Moses

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Did you receive the story of Moses

text: when his Lord called out to him in the holy valley of Tuwa

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
citation.translation: when his Lord called out to him in the holy valley of Tuwa

text: [And said,] ‘Go to Pharaoh, for indeed he has rebelled

citation.arabic_text: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
citation.translation: [And said,] ‘Go to Pharaoh, for indeed he has rebelled

text: and say, ‘‘Would you purify yourself

citation.arabic_text: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
citation.translation: and say, ‘‘Would you purify yourself

text: I will guide you to your Lord, that you may fear [Him]?’’ ’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: I will guide you to your Lord, that you may fear [Him]?’’ ’

text: Then he showed him the greatest sign

citation.arabic_text: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: Then he showed him the greatest sign

text: But he denied, and disobeyed

citation.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
citation.translation: But he denied, and disobeyed

text: Then he turned back, walking swiftly

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ
citation.translation: Then he turned back, walking swiftly

text: and gathered [the people] and proclaimed

citation.arabic_text: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
citation.translation: and gathered [the people] and proclaimed

text: saying, ‘I am your exalted lord!’

citation.arabic_text: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
citation.translation: saying, ‘I am your exalted lord!’

text: So Allah seized him with the punishment of this life and the Hereafter

citation.arabic_text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
citation.translation: So Allah seized him with the punishment of this life and the Hereafter

text: There is indeed a moral in that for someone who fears

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةࣰ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
citation.translation: There is indeed a moral in that for someone who fears

text: Is your creation more prodigious or that of the heaven He has built

citation.arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
citation.translation: Is your creation more prodigious or that of the heaven He has built

text: He raised its vault and fashioned it

citation.arabic_text: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
citation.translation: He raised its vault and fashioned it

text: and darkened its night, and brought forth its forenoon

citation.arabic_text: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
citation.translation: and darkened its night, and brought forth its forenoon

text: Thereafter He spread out the earth

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
citation.translation: Thereafter He spread out the earth

text: brought forth from it its water and pastures

citation.arabic_text: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا
citation.translation: brought forth from it its water and pastures

text: setting firm the mountains

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا
citation.translation: setting firm the mountains

text: as a [place of] sustenance for you and your livestock

citation.arabic_text: مَتَٰعࣰ ا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
citation.translation: as a [place of] sustenance for you and your livestock

text: When the Greatest Catastrophe befalls

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: When the Greatest Catastrophe befalls

text: —the day when man will remember his endeavours

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
citation.translation: —the day when man will remember his endeavours

text: and hell is brought into view for those who can see—

citation.arabic_text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
citation.translation: and hell is brought into view for those who can see—

text: as for him who has been rebellious

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
citation.translation: as for him who has been rebellious

text: and preferred the life of this world

citation.arabic_text: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
citation.translation: and preferred the life of this world

text: his refuge will indeed be hell

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
citation.translation: his refuge will indeed be hell

text: But as for him who is awed to stand before his Lord and restrains his soul from [following] desires

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
citation.translation: But as for him who is awed to stand before his Lord and restrains his soul from [following] desires

text: his refuge will indeed be paradise

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
citation.translation: his refuge will indeed be paradise

text: They ask you concerning the Hour, “When will it set in

citation.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَا
citation.translation: They ask you concerning the Hour, “When will it set in

text: considering your frequent mention of it?”

citation.arabic_text: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ
citation.translation: considering your frequent mention of it?”

text: Its outcome is with your Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
citation.translation: Its outcome is with your Lord

text: You are only a warner for those who are afraid it

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا
citation.translation: You are only a warner for those who are afraid it

text: The day they see it, it shall be as if they had not stayed [in the world] except for an evening or forenoon

citation.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
citation.translation: The day they see it, it shall be as if they had not stayed [in the world] except for an evening or forenoon

text: He frowned and turned away

citation.arabic_text: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
citation.translation: He frowned and turned away

text: when the blind man approached him

citation.arabic_text: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ
citation.translation: when the blind man approached him

text: And how do you know, maybe he would purify himself

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
citation.translation: And how do you know, maybe he would purify himself

text: or take admonition, and the admonition would benefit him

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ
citation.translation: or take admonition, and the admonition would benefit him

text: But as for someone who is wealthy

citation.arabic_text: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: But as for someone who is wealthy

text: you attend to him

citation.arabic_text: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
citation.translation: you attend to him

text: though you are not liable if he does not purify himself

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا عَلَيۡكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
citation.translation: though you are not liable if he does not purify himself

text: But as for someone who comes hurrying to you

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسۡعَىٰ
citation.translation: But as for someone who comes hurrying to you

text: while he fears [Allah]

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ يَخۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: while he fears [Allah]

text: you are neglectful of him

citation.arabic_text: فَأَنتَ عَنۡهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
citation.translation: you are neglectful of him

text: No indeed! These [verses of the Quran ] are a reminder

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: No indeed! These [verses of the Quran ] are a reminder

text: —so let anyone who wishes remember—

citation.arabic_text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: —so let anyone who wishes remember—

text: in honoured scriptures

citation.arabic_text: فِي صُحُفࣲ مُّكَرَّمَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: in honoured scriptures

text: exalted and purified

citation.arabic_text: مَّرۡفُوعَةࣲ مُّطَهَّرَةِۭ
citation.translation: exalted and purified

text: in the hands of envoys

citation.arabic_text: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: in the hands of envoys

text: noble and pious

citation.arabic_text: كِرَامِۭ بَرَرَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: noble and pious

text: Perish man! How ungrateful is he

citation.arabic_text: قُتِلَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكۡفَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: Perish man! How ungrateful is he

text: From what did He create him

citation.arabic_text: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
citation.translation: From what did He create him

text: He created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid; then proportioned him

citation.arabic_text: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
citation.translation: He created him from a drop of [seminal] fluid; then proportioned him

text: Then He made the way easy for him

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
citation.translation: Then He made the way easy for him

text: then He made him die and buried him

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: then He made him die and buried him

text: and then, when He wished, resurrected him

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: and then, when He wished, resurrected him

text: No indeed! He has not yet carried out what He has commanded him

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقۡضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: No indeed! He has not yet carried out what He has commanded him

text: Let man consider his food

citation.arabic_text: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
citation.translation: Let man consider his food

text: We pour down plenteous water [from the sky]

citation.arabic_text: أَنَّا صَبَبۡنَا ٱلۡمَآءَ صَبࣰّ ا
citation.translation: We pour down plenteous water [from the sky]

text: then We split the earth making fissures in it

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ شَقَقۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ شَقࣰّ ا
citation.translation: then We split the earth making fissures in it

text: and make the grain grow in it

citation.arabic_text: فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا حَبࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and make the grain grow in it

text: as well as vines and vegetables

citation.arabic_text: وَعِنَبࣰ ا وَقَضۡبࣰ ا
citation.translation: as well as vines and vegetables

text: olives and date palms

citation.arabic_text: وَزَيۡتُونࣰ ا وَنَخۡلࣰ ا
citation.translation: olives and date palms

text: and densely-planted gardens

citation.arabic_text: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبࣰ ا
citation.translation: and densely-planted gardens

text: fruits and pastures

citation.arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةࣰ وَأَبࣰّ ا
citation.translation: fruits and pastures

text: as a sustenance for you and your livestock

citation.arabic_text: مَّتَٰعࣰ ا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
citation.translation: as a sustenance for you and your livestock

text: So when the deafening Cry comes—

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
citation.translation: So when the deafening Cry comes—

text: the day when a man will evade his brother

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ
citation.translation: the day when a man will evade his brother

text: his mother and his father

citation.arabic_text: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
citation.translation: his mother and his father

text: his spouse and his sons—

citation.arabic_text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
citation.translation: his spouse and his sons—

text: each of them will have a task to keep him preoccupied on that day

citation.arabic_text: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ شَأۡنࣱ يُغۡنِيهِ
citation.translation: each of them will have a task to keep him preoccupied on that day

text: Some faces will be bright on that day

citation.arabic_text: وُجُوهࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ مُّسۡفِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: Some faces will be bright on that day

text: laughing and joyous

citation.arabic_text: ضَاحِكَةࣱ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: laughing and joyous

text: and some faces on that day will be covered with dust

citation.arabic_text: وَوُجُوهࣱ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: and some faces on that day will be covered with dust

text: overcast with gloom

citation.arabic_text: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
citation.translation: overcast with gloom

text: It is they who are the faithless, the vicious

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ
citation.translation: It is they who are the faithless, the vicious

text: When the sun is wound up

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ
citation.translation: When the sun is wound up

text: when the stars scatter

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ
citation.translation: when the stars scatter

text: when the mountains are set moving

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ
citation.translation: when the mountains are set moving

text: when the pregnant camels are neglected

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ
citation.translation: when the pregnant camels are neglected

text: when the wild beasts are mustered

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ
citation.translation: when the wild beasts are mustered

text: when the seas are set afire

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ
citation.translation: when the seas are set afire

text: when the souls are assorted

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ
citation.translation: when the souls are assorted

text: when the girl buried-alive will be asked

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ
citation.translation: when the girl buried-alive will be asked

text: for what sin she was killed

citation.arabic_text: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبࣲ قُتِلَتۡ
citation.translation: for what sin she was killed

text: When the records [of deeds] are unfolded

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
citation.translation: When the records [of deeds] are unfolded

text: when the sky is stripped off

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ
citation.translation: when the sky is stripped off

text: when hell is set ablaze

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ
citation.translation: when hell is set ablaze

text: when paradise is brought near

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ
citation.translation: when paradise is brought near

text: then a soul shall know what it has readied [for itself]

citation.arabic_text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسࣱ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ
citation.translation: then a soul shall know what it has readied [for itself]

text: So I swear by the stars that return

citation.arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ
citation.translation: So I swear by the stars that return

text: the comets

citation.arabic_text: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ
citation.translation: the comets

text: by the night as it approaches

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ
citation.translation: by the night as it approaches

text: by the dawn as it breathes

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
citation.translation: by the dawn as it breathes

text: it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولࣲ كَرِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: it is indeed the speech of a noble apostle

text: powerful and eminent with the Lord of the Throne

citation.arabic_text: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: powerful and eminent with the Lord of the Throne

text: one who is obeyed and is trustworthy as well

citation.arabic_text: مُّطَاعࣲ ثَمَّ أَمِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: one who is obeyed and is trustworthy as well

text: Your companion is not crazy

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: Your companion is not crazy

text: certainly he saw him on the manifest horizon

citation.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
citation.translation: certainly he saw him on the manifest horizon

text: and he is not miserly concerning the Unseen

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينࣲ‏
citation.translation: and he is not miserly concerning the Unseen

text: And it is not the speech of an outcast Satan

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ رَّجِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: And it is not the speech of an outcast Satan

text: So where are you going

citation.arabic_text: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ
citation.translation: So where are you going

text: It is just a reminder for all the nations

citation.arabic_text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: It is just a reminder for all the nations

text: for those of you who wish to walk straight

citation.arabic_text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ
citation.translation: for those of you who wish to walk straight

text: but you will not wish unless it is wished by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: but you will not wish unless it is wished by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds

text: When the sky is rent apart

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ
citation.translation: When the sky is rent apart

text: when the stars are scattered

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ
citation.translation: when the stars are scattered

text: when the seas are merged

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ
citation.translation: when the seas are merged

text: when the graves are overturned

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ
citation.translation: when the graves are overturned

text: then a soul shall know what it has sent ahead and left behind

citation.arabic_text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسࣱ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ
citation.translation: then a soul shall know what it has sent ahead and left behind

text: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
citation.translation: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord

text: who created you and proportioned you, and gave you an upright nature

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
citation.translation: who created you and proportioned you, and gave you an upright nature

text: and composed you in any form that He wished

citation.arabic_text: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةࣲ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
citation.translation: and composed you in any form that He wished

text: No! Indeed, you deny the Retribution

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: No! Indeed, you deny the Retribution

text: Indeed, there are over you watchers

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
citation.translation: Indeed, there are over you watchers

text: noble writers

citation.arabic_text: كِرَامࣰ ا كَٰتِبِينَ
citation.translation: noble writers

text: who know whatever you do

citation.arabic_text: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
citation.translation: who know whatever you do

text: Indeed the pious shall be amid bliss

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the pious shall be amid bliss

text: and indeed the vicious shall be in hell

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: and indeed the vicious shall be in hell

text: entering it on the Day of Retribution

citation.arabic_text: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: entering it on the Day of Retribution

text: and they shall not be absent from it

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
citation.translation: and they shall not be absent from it

text: And what will show you what is the Day of Retribution

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: And what will show you what is the Day of Retribution

text: Again, what will show you what is the Day of Retribution

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: Again, what will show you what is the Day of Retribution

text: It is a day when no soul will be of any avail to another soul and all command that day will belong to Allah

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسࣱ لِّنَفۡسࣲ شَيۡـࣰٔ اۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلَّهِ
citation.translation: It is a day when no soul will be of any avail to another soul and all command that day will belong to Allah

text: Woe to the defrauders, who use short measures

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the defrauders, who use short measures

text: who, when they measure [a commodity bought] from the people, take the full measure

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
citation.translation: who, when they measure [a commodity bought] from the people, take the full measure

text: but diminish when they measure or weigh for them

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ
citation.translation: but diminish when they measure or weigh for them

text: Do they not know that they will be resurrected

citation.arabic_text: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ
citation.translation: Do they not know that they will be resurrected

text: on a tremendous day

citation.arabic_text: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: on a tremendous day

text: a day when mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
citation.translation: a day when mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds

text: Indeed, the record of the vicious is in Sijjeen

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed, the record of the vicious is in Sijjeen

text: And what will show you what is Sijjeen

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينࣱ‏
citation.translation: And what will show you what is Sijjeen

text: It is a written record

citation.arabic_text: كِتَٰبࣱ مَّرۡقُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: It is a written record

text: Woe to the deniers on that day

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
citation.translation: Woe to the deniers on that day

text: who deny the Day of Retribution

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: who deny the Day of Retribution

text: and none denies it except every sinful transgressor

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
citation.translation: and none denies it except every sinful transgressor

text: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, ‘Myths of the ancients!’

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
citation.translation: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, ‘Myths of the ancients!’

text: No, that is not the case! Rather, their hearts have been sullied by what they have been earning

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
citation.translation: No, that is not the case! Rather, their hearts have been sullied by what they have been earning

text: Indeed, they will be alienated from their Lord on that day

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed, they will be alienated from their Lord on that day

text: Afterward they will enter hell

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
citation.translation: Afterward they will enter hell

text: then told, ‘This is what you used to deny!’

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
citation.translation: then told, ‘This is what you used to deny!’

text: Indeed, the record of the pious is in Illeeyun

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
citation.translation: Indeed, the record of the pious is in Illeeyun

text: And what will show you what is Illeeyun

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
citation.translation: And what will show you what is Illeeyun

text: It is a written record

citation.arabic_text: كِتَٰبࣱ مَّرۡقُومࣱ‏
citation.translation: It is a written record

text: witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]

citation.arabic_text: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
citation.translation: witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]

text: The pious shall be amid bliss

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
citation.translation: The pious shall be amid bliss

text: observing, [as they recline] on couches

citation.arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
citation.translation: observing, [as they recline] on couches

text: You will perceive in their faces the freshness of bliss

citation.arabic_text: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
citation.translation: You will perceive in their faces the freshness of bliss

text: They will be served with a sealed pure wine

citation.arabic_text: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقࣲ مَّخۡتُومٍ
citation.translation: They will be served with a sealed pure wine

text: whose seal is musk—for such let the viers vie—

citation.arabic_text: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكࣱۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
citation.translation: whose seal is musk—for such let the viers vie—

text: and whose seasoning is from Tasneem

citation.arabic_text: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ
citation.translation: and whose seasoning is from Tasneem

text: a spring where those brought near [to Allah] drink

citation.arabic_text: عَيۡنࣰ ا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
citation.translation: a spring where those brought near [to Allah] drink

text: Indeed the guilty used to laugh at the faithful

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed the guilty used to laugh at the faithful

text: and when they passed them by they would wink at each other

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
citation.translation: and when they passed them by they would wink at each other

text: and when they returned to their folks they would return amused

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
citation.translation: and when they returned to their folks they would return amused

text: and when they saw them they would say, ‘Indeed those are the astray!’

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
citation.translation: and when they saw them they would say, ‘Indeed those are the astray!’

text: Though they were not sent to watch over them

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
citation.translation: Though they were not sent to watch over them

text: So today the faithful will laugh at the faithless

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
citation.translation: So today the faithful will laugh at the faithless

text: observing from their couches

citation.arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
citation.translation: observing from their couches

text: Have the faithless been requited for what they used to do

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
citation.translation: Have the faithless been requited for what they used to do

text: When the sky is split open

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ
citation.translation: When the sky is split open

text: and gives ear to its Lord as it should

citation.arabic_text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
citation.translation: and gives ear to its Lord as it should

text: When the earth is spread out

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ
citation.translation: When the earth is spread out

text: and throws out what is in it, emptying itself

citation.arabic_text: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ
citation.translation: and throws out what is in it, emptying itself

text: and gives ear to its Lord as it should

citation.arabic_text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
citation.translation: and gives ear to its Lord as it should

text: O man! You are labouring toward your Lord laboriously, and you will encounter Him

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحࣰ ا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
citation.translation: O man! You are labouring toward your Lord laboriously, and you will encounter Him

text: Then, as for him who is given his record [of deeds] in his right hand

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
citation.translation: Then, as for him who is given his record [of deeds] in his right hand

text: he will receive an easy reckoning

citation.arabic_text: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابࣰ ا يَسِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: he will receive an easy reckoning

text: and he will return to his folks joyfully

citation.arabic_text: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: and he will return to his folks joyfully

text: But as for him who is given his record from behind his back

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
citation.translation: But as for him who is given his record from behind his back

text: he will pray for annihilation

citation.arabic_text: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورࣰ ا
citation.translation: he will pray for annihilation

text: and enter the Blaze

citation.arabic_text: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
citation.translation: and enter the Blaze

text: Indeed he used to be joyful among his folk

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا
citation.translation: Indeed he used to be joyful among his folk

text: and he thought that he would never return

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
citation.translation: and he thought that he would never return

text: Yes, his Lord had been watching him

citation.arabic_text: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Yes, his Lord had been watching him

text: I swear by the evening glow

citation.arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
citation.translation: I swear by the evening glow

text: by the night and what it is fraught with

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
citation.translation: by the night and what it is fraught with

text: by the moon when it blooms full

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
citation.translation: by the moon when it blooms full

text: you will surely fare from stage to stage

citation.arabic_text: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقࣲ‏
citation.translation: you will surely fare from stage to stage

text: What is the matter with them that they will not believe

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
citation.translation: What is the matter with them that they will not believe

text: and will not prostrate when the Quran is recited to them

citation.arabic_text: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
citation.translation: and will not prostrate when the Quran is recited to them

text: Indeed, the faithless impugn [the Apostle]

citation.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
citation.translation: Indeed, the faithless impugn [the Apostle]

text: and Allah knows best what they keep to themselves

citation.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
citation.translation: and Allah knows best what they keep to themselves

text: So inform them of a painful punishment

citation.arabic_text: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
citation.translation: So inform them of a painful punishment

text: excepting such as are faithful and do righteous deeds: for them there will be an everlasting reward

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
citation.translation: excepting such as are faithful and do righteous deeds: for them there will be an everlasting reward

text: By the heaven with its Houses

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ
citation.translation: By the heaven with its Houses

text: by the Promised Day

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ
citation.translation: by the Promised Day

text: by the Witness and the Witnessed

citation.arabic_text: وَشَاهِدࣲ وَمَشۡهُودࣲ‏
citation.translation: by the Witness and the Witnessed

text: perish the People of the Ditch

citation.arabic_text: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ
citation.translation: perish the People of the Ditch

text: The fire abounding in fuel

citation.arabic_text: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ
citation.translation: The fire abounding in fuel

text: above which they sat

citation.arabic_text: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودࣱ‏
citation.translation: above which they sat

text: as they were themselves witnesses to what they did to the faithful

citation.arabic_text: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودࣱ‏
citation.translation: as they were themselves witnesses to what they did to the faithful

text: They were vindictive towards them only because they had faith in Allah, the All-mighty and the All-laudable

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
citation.translation: They were vindictive towards them only because they had faith in Allah, the All-mighty and the All-laudable

text: to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is witness to all things

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ
citation.translation: to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is witness to all things

text: Indeed those who persecute the faithful, men and women, and do not repent thereafter, there is the punishment of hell for them and the punishment of burning

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
citation.translation: Indeed those who persecute the faithful, men and women, and do not repent thereafter, there is the punishment of hell for them and the punishment of burning

text: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—for them will be gardens with streams running in them. That is the supreme success

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
citation.translation: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—for them will be gardens with streams running in them. That is the supreme success

text: Indeed your Lord’s striking is severe

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord’s striking is severe

text: It is indeed He who originates and brings back

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
citation.translation: It is indeed He who originates and brings back

text: and He is the All-forgiving, the All-affectionate

citation.arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ
citation.translation: and He is the All-forgiving, the All-affectionate

text: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious

citation.arabic_text: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ
citation.translation: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious

text: doer of what He desires

citation.arabic_text: فَعَّالࣱ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
citation.translation: doer of what He desires

text: Did you receive the story of the hosts

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ
citation.translation: Did you receive the story of the hosts

text: of Pharaoh and Thamud

citation.arabic_text: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ
citation.translation: of Pharaoh and Thamud

text: Indeed the faithless dwell in denial

citation.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبࣲ‏
citation.translation: Indeed the faithless dwell in denial

text: and Allah besieges them from all around

citation.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ
citation.translation: and Allah besieges them from all around

text: Indeed it is a glorious Quran

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡءَانࣱ مَّجِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed it is a glorious Quran

text: in a preserved tablet

citation.arabic_text: فِي لَوۡحࣲ مَّحۡفُوظِۭ
citation.translation: in a preserved tablet

text: By the heaven, and by the nightly visitor

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
citation.translation: By the heaven, and by the nightly visitor

text: and what will show you what is the nightly visitor

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
citation.translation: and what will show you what is the nightly visitor

text: It is the brilliant star

citation.arabic_text: ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
citation.translation: It is the brilliant star

text: there is a guard over every soul

citation.arabic_text: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظࣱ‏
citation.translation: there is a guard over every soul

text: So let man consider from what he was created

citation.arabic_text: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
citation.translation: So let man consider from what he was created

text: He was created from an effusing fluid

citation.arabic_text: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءࣲ دَافِقࣲ‏
citation.translation: He was created from an effusing fluid

text: which issues from between the loins and the breast-bones

citation.arabic_text: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
citation.translation: which issues from between the loins and the breast-bones

text: Indeed He is able to bring him back [after death]

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed He is able to bring him back [after death]

text: on the day when the secrets are examined

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
citation.translation: on the day when the secrets are examined

text: and he shall have neither power nor helper

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةࣲ وَلَا نَاصِرࣲ‏
citation.translation: and he shall have neither power nor helper

text: By the resurgent heaven

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ
citation.translation: By the resurgent heaven

text: and by the furrowed earth

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ
citation.translation: and by the furrowed earth

text: it is indeed a conclusive discourse

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلࣱ فَصۡلࣱ‏
citation.translation: it is indeed a conclusive discourse

text: and not a jest

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ
citation.translation: and not a jest

text: Indeed they are devising a stratagem

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed they are devising a stratagem

text: and I [too] am devising a plan

citation.arabic_text: وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدࣰ ا
citation.translation: and I [too] am devising a plan

text: So respite the faithless; give them a gentle respite

citation.arabic_text: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا
citation.translation: So respite the faithless; give them a gentle respite

text: Celebrate the Name of your Lord, the Most Exalted

citation.arabic_text: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى
citation.translation: Celebrate the Name of your Lord, the Most Exalted

text: who created and proportioned

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
citation.translation: who created and proportioned

text: who determined and guided

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
citation.translation: who determined and guided

text: who brought forth the pasture

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلۡمَرۡعَىٰ
citation.translation: who brought forth the pasture

text: and then turned it into a black scum

citation.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ
citation.translation: and then turned it into a black scum

text: We shall have you recite [the Quran], then you will not forget [any of it]

citation.arabic_text: سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
citation.translation: We shall have you recite [the Quran], then you will not forget [any of it]

text: except what Allah may wish. Indeed, He knows the open and what is hidden

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
citation.translation: except what Allah may wish. Indeed, He knows the open and what is hidden

text: And We shall ease you into facility

citation.arabic_text: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: And We shall ease you into facility

text: So admonish, for admonition is indeed beneficial

citation.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: So admonish, for admonition is indeed beneficial

text: he who fears [God] will take admonition

citation.arabic_text: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: he who fears [God] will take admonition

text: and the most wretched will shun it

citation.arabic_text: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
citation.translation: and the most wretched will shun it

text: —he who will enter the Great Fire

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي يَصۡلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: —he who will enter the Great Fire

text: then he will neither live in it, nor die

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
citation.translation: then he will neither live in it, nor die

text: ‘Felicitous is he who purifies himself

citation.arabic_text: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
citation.translation: ‘Felicitous is he who purifies himself

text: celebrates the Name of his Lord, and prays

citation.arabic_text: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: celebrates the Name of his Lord, and prays

text: But you prefer the life of this world

citation.arabic_text: بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
citation.translation: But you prefer the life of this world

text: while the Hereafter is better and more lasting.’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرࣱ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
citation.translation: while the Hereafter is better and more lasting.’

text: This is indeed in the former scriptures

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
citation.translation: This is indeed in the former scriptures

text: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses

citation.arabic_text: صُحُفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
citation.translation: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses

text: Did you receive the account of the Enveloper

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ
citation.translation: Did you receive the account of the Enveloper

text: Some faces on that day will be humbled

citation.arabic_text: وُجُوهࣱ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
citation.translation: Some faces on that day will be humbled

text: wrought-up and weary

citation.arabic_text: عَامِلَةࣱ نَّاصِبَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: wrought-up and weary

text: they will enter a scorching fire

citation.arabic_text: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةࣰ‏
citation.translation: they will enter a scorching fire

text: and made to drink from a boiling spring

citation.arabic_text: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: and made to drink from a boiling spring

text: They will have no food except cactus

citation.arabic_text: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعࣲ‏
citation.translation: They will have no food except cactus

text: neither nourishing, nor of avail against hunger

citation.arabic_text: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعࣲ‏
citation.translation: neither nourishing, nor of avail against hunger

text: Some faces on that day will be joyous

citation.arabic_text: وُجُوهࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ نَّاعِمَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: Some faces on that day will be joyous

text: pleased with their endeavour

citation.arabic_text: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: pleased with their endeavour

text: in a lofty garden

citation.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: in a lofty garden

text: where they will not hear any vain talk

citation.arabic_text: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةࣰ‏
citation.translation: where they will not hear any vain talk

text: In it is a flowing spring

citation.arabic_text: فِيهَا عَيۡنࣱ جَارِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: In it is a flowing spring

text: and raised couches

citation.arabic_text: فِيهَا سُرُرࣱ مَّرۡفُوعَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: and raised couches

text: with goblets set

citation.arabic_text: وَأَكۡوَابࣱ مَّوۡضُوعَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: with goblets set

text: and cushions laid out in an array

citation.arabic_text: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: and cushions laid out in an array

text: and carpets spread out

citation.arabic_text: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ
citation.translation: and carpets spread out

text: Do they not observe the camel, [to see] how it has been created

citation.arabic_text: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
citation.translation: Do they not observe the camel, [to see] how it has been created

text: and the sky, how it has been raised

citation.arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ
citation.translation: and the sky, how it has been raised

text: and the mountains, how they have been set

citation.arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ
citation.translation: and the mountains, how they have been set

text: and the earth, how it has been surfaced

citation.arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ
citation.translation: and the earth, how it has been surfaced

text: So admonish—for you are only an admonisher

citation.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرࣱ‏
citation.translation: So admonish—for you are only an admonisher

text: and not a taskmaster over them—

citation.arabic_text: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ
citation.translation: and not a taskmaster over them—

text: except him who turns back and disbelieves

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
citation.translation: except him who turns back and disbelieves

text: Him Allah will punish with the greatest punishment

citation.arabic_text: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ
citation.translation: Him Allah will punish with the greatest punishment

text: Indeed to Us will be their return

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ
citation.translation: Indeed to Us will be their return

text: Then, indeed, their reckoning will lie with Us

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم
citation.translation: Then, indeed, their reckoning will lie with Us

text: By the Dawn

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ
citation.translation: By the Dawn

text: by the ten nights

citation.arabic_text: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرࣲ‏
citation.translation: by the ten nights

text: by the Even and the Odd

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ
citation.translation: by the Even and the Odd

text: by the night when it departs

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ
citation.translation: by the night when it departs

text: Is there an oath in that for one possessing intellect

citation.arabic_text: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمࣱ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
citation.translation: Is there an oath in that for one possessing intellect

text: Have you not regarded how your Lord dealt with [the people of] ‘Ad

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded how your Lord dealt with [the people of] ‘Ad

text: [and] Iram, [the city] of the pillars

citation.arabic_text: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ
citation.translation: [and] Iram, [the city] of the pillars

text: the like of which was not created among cities

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
citation.translation: the like of which was not created among cities

text: and [the people of] Thamud, who hollowed out the rocks in the valley

citation.arabic_text: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ
citation.translation: and [the people of] Thamud, who hollowed out the rocks in the valley

text: and Pharaoh, the impaler

citation.arabic_text: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
citation.translation: and Pharaoh, the impaler

text: —those who rebelled [against Allah] in their cities

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
citation.translation: —those who rebelled [against Allah] in their cities

text: and caused much corruption in them

citation.arabic_text: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ
citation.translation: and caused much corruption in them

text: so your Lord poured on them lashes of punishment

citation.arabic_text: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ
citation.translation: so your Lord poured on them lashes of punishment

text: Indeed your Lord is in ambush

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ
citation.translation: Indeed your Lord is in ambush

text: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and grants him honour, and blesses him, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me.’

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
citation.translation: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and grants him honour, and blesses him, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me.’

text: But when He tests him and tightens for him his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
citation.translation: But when He tests him and tightens for him his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’

text: No indeed! No, you do not honour the orphan

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
citation.translation: No indeed! No, you do not honour the orphan

text: and do not urge the feeding of the needy

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
citation.translation: and do not urge the feeding of the needy

text: You eat the inheritance rapaciously

citation.arabic_text: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلࣰ ا لَّمࣰّ ا
citation.translation: You eat the inheritance rapaciously

text: and love wealth with much fondness

citation.arabic_text: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبࣰّ ا جَمࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and love wealth with much fondness

text: No indeed! When the earth is levelled to a plain

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكࣰّ ا دَكࣰّ ا
citation.translation: No indeed! When the earth is levelled to a plain

text: and your Lord [’s edict] arrives with the angels in ranks

citation.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفࣰّ ا صَفࣰّ ا
citation.translation: and your Lord [’s edict] arrives with the angels in ranks

text: the day when hell is brought [near], man will take admonition on that day, but what will that admonition avail him

citation.arabic_text: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: the day when hell is brought [near], man will take admonition on that day, but what will that admonition avail him

text: He will say, ‘Alas, had I sent ahead for my life [in the Hereafter]!’

citation.arabic_text: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي
citation.translation: He will say, ‘Alas, had I sent ahead for my life [in the Hereafter]!’

text: On that day none shall punish as He punishes

citation.arabic_text: فَيَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدࣱ‏
citation.translation: On that day none shall punish as He punishes

text: and none shall bind as He binds

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدࣱ‏
citation.translation: and none shall bind as He binds

text: ‘O soul at peace

citation.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ
citation.translation: ‘O soul at peace

text: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing

citation.arabic_text: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةࣰ مَّرۡضِيَّةࣰ‏
citation.translation: Return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing

text: Then enter among My servants

citation.arabic_text: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي
citation.translation: Then enter among My servants

text: and enter My paradise!’

citation.arabic_text: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي
citation.translation: and enter My paradise!’

text: I swear by this town

citation.arabic_text: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
citation.translation: I swear by this town

text: as you reside in this town

citation.arabic_text: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
citation.translation: as you reside in this town

text: [and] by the father and him whom he begot

citation.arabic_text: وَوَالِدࣲ وَمَا وَلَدَ
citation.translation: [and] by the father and him whom he begot

text: certainly We created man in travail

citation.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ
citation.translation: certainly We created man in travail

text: Does he suppose that no one will ever have power over him

citation.arabic_text: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدࣱ‏
citation.translation: Does he suppose that no one will ever have power over him

text: He says, ‘I have squandered immense wealth.’

citation.arabic_text: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالࣰ ا لُّبَدًا
citation.translation: He says, ‘I have squandered immense wealth.’

text: Does he suppose that no one sees him

citation.arabic_text: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
citation.translation: Does he suppose that no one sees him

text: Have We not made for him two eyes

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ
citation.translation: Have We not made for him two eyes

text: a tongue, and two lips

citation.arabic_text: وَلِسَانࣰ ا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ
citation.translation: a tongue, and two lips

text: and shown him the two paths [of good and evil]

citation.arabic_text: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ
citation.translation: and shown him the two paths [of good and evil]

text: Yet he has not embarked upon the uphill task

citation.arabic_text: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ
citation.translation: Yet he has not embarked upon the uphill task

text: And what will show you what is the uphill task

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ
citation.translation: And what will show you what is the uphill task

text: [It is] the freeing of a slave

citation.arabic_text: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
citation.translation: [It is] the freeing of a slave

text: or feeding, during days of [general] starvation

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمࣱ فِي يَوۡمࣲ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: or feeding, during days of [general] starvation

text: an orphan among relatives

citation.arabic_text: يَتِيمࣰ ا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ
citation.translation: an orphan among relatives

text: or a needy man in desolation

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينࣰ ا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: or a needy man in desolation

text: while being one of those who have faith and enjoin one another to patience, and enjoin one another to compassion

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
