citation.translation: while being one of those who have faith and enjoin one another to patience, and enjoin one another to compassion

text: They are the People of the Right Hand

citation.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
citation.translation: They are the People of the Right Hand

text: But those who defy Our signs, they are the People of the Left Hand

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
citation.translation: But those who defy Our signs, they are the People of the Left Hand

text: A closed Fire will be [imposed] upon them

citation.arabic_text: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارࣱ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ
citation.translation: A closed Fire will be [imposed] upon them

text: By the sun and her forenoon splendour

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
citation.translation: By the sun and her forenoon splendour

text: by the moon when he follows her

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
citation.translation: by the moon when he follows her

text: by the day when it reveals her

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
citation.translation: by the day when it reveals her

text: by the night when it covers her

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا
citation.translation: by the night when it covers her

text: by the sky and Him who built it

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
citation.translation: by the sky and Him who built it

text: by the earth and Him who spread it

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
citation.translation: by the earth and Him who spread it

text: by the soul and Him who fashioned it

citation.arabic_text: وَنَفۡسࣲ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
citation.translation: by the soul and Him who fashioned it

text: and inspired it with [discernment between] its virtues and vices

citation.arabic_text: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا
citation.translation: and inspired it with [discernment between] its virtues and vices

text: one who purifies it is felicitous

citation.arabic_text: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
citation.translation: one who purifies it is felicitous

text: and one who betrays it fails

citation.arabic_text: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
citation.translation: and one who betrays it fails

text: The [people of] Thamud denied [Allah’s signs] out of their rebellion

citation.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ
citation.translation: The [people of] Thamud denied [Allah’s signs] out of their rebellion

text: when the most wretched of them rose up

citation.arabic_text: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا
citation.translation: when the most wretched of them rose up

text: The apostle of Allah had told them, ‘This is Allah’s she-camel, let her drink!’

citation.arabic_text: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
citation.translation: The apostle of Allah had told them, ‘This is Allah’s she-camel, let her drink!’

text: But they impugned him and hamstrung her. So their Lord took them unawares by night because of their sin, and levelled it

citation.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
citation.translation: But they impugned him and hamstrung her. So their Lord took them unawares by night because of their sin, and levelled it

text: And He does not fear its outcome

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا
citation.translation: And He does not fear its outcome

text: By the night when it envelops

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ
citation.translation: By the night when it envelops

text: by the day when it brightens

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: by the day when it brightens

text: by Him who created the male and the female

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
citation.translation: by Him who created the male and the female

text: your endeavours are indeed diverse

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ
citation.translation: your endeavours are indeed diverse

text: As for him who gives and is Godwary

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
citation.translation: As for him who gives and is Godwary

text: and confirms the best promise

citation.arabic_text: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: and confirms the best promise

text: We will surely ease him toward facility

citation.arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: We will surely ease him toward facility

text: But as for him, who is stingy and self-complacent

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: But as for him, who is stingy and self-complacent

text: and denies the best promise

citation.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: and denies the best promise

text: We will surely ease him toward hardship

citation.arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ
citation.translation: We will surely ease him toward hardship

text: His wealth will not avail him when he perishes

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
citation.translation: His wealth will not avail him when he perishes

text: Indeed guidance rests with Us

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ
citation.translation: Indeed guidance rests with Us

text: and to Us belong the world and the Hereafter

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
citation.translation: and to Us belong the world and the Hereafter

text: So I warn you of a blazing fire

citation.arabic_text: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارࣰ ا تَلَظَّىٰ
citation.translation: So I warn you of a blazing fire

text: which none shall enter except the most wretched [of persons]

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
citation.translation: which none shall enter except the most wretched [of persons]

text: —he who impugns [God’s prophets] and turns his back

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
citation.translation: —he who impugns [God’s prophets] and turns his back

text: The Godwary [person] will be spared of that

citation.arabic_text: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى
citation.translation: The Godwary [person] will be spared of that

text: —he who gives his wealth to purify himself

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
citation.translation: —he who gives his wealth to purify himself

text: and does not expect any reward from anyone

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةࣲ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
citation.translation: and does not expect any reward from anyone

text: but seek only the pleasure of their Lord, the Most Exalted

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
citation.translation: but seek only the pleasure of their Lord, the Most Exalted

text: and, surely, soon they will be well-pleased

citation.arabic_text: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
citation.translation: and, surely, soon they will be well-pleased

text: By the morning brightness

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
citation.translation: By the morning brightness

text: and by the night when it is calm

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
citation.translation: and by the night when it is calm

text: Your Lord has neither forsaken you, nor is He displeased with you

citation.arabic_text: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
citation.translation: Your Lord has neither forsaken you, nor is He displeased with you

text: and the Hereafter shall be better for you than the world

citation.arabic_text: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
citation.translation: and the Hereafter shall be better for you than the world

text: Soon your Lord will give you [that with which] you will be pleased

citation.arabic_text: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Soon your Lord will give you [that with which] you will be pleased

text: Did He not find you an orphan, and shelter you

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمࣰ ا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
citation.translation: Did He not find you an orphan, and shelter you

text: Did He not find you astray, and guide you

citation.arabic_text: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلࣰّ ا فَهَدَىٰ
citation.translation: Did He not find you astray, and guide you

text: Did He not find you needy, and enrich you

citation.arabic_text: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلࣰ ا فَأَغۡنَىٰ
citation.translation: Did He not find you needy, and enrich you

text: So, as for the orphan, do not oppress him

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ
citation.translation: So, as for the orphan, do not oppress him

text: and as for the beggar, do not chide him

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنۡهَرۡ
citation.translation: and as for the beggar, do not chide him

text: and as for your Lord’s blessing, proclaim it

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ
citation.translation: and as for your Lord’s blessing, proclaim it

text: Did We not open your breast for you

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ
citation.translation: Did We not open your breast for you

text: and relieve you of your burden

citation.arabic_text: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ
citation.translation: and relieve you of your burden

text: which [almost] broke your back

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ
citation.translation: which [almost] broke your back

text: Did We not exalt your name

citation.arabic_text: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ
citation.translation: Did We not exalt your name

text: Indeed ease accompanies hardship

citation.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
citation.translation: Indeed ease accompanies hardship

text: Indeed ease accompanies hardship

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرࣰ ا
citation.translation: Indeed ease accompanies hardship

text: So when you are done, appoint

citation.arabic_text: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ
citation.translation: So when you are done, appoint

text: and supplicate your Lord

citation.arabic_text: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب
citation.translation: and supplicate your Lord

text: By the fig and the olive

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ
citation.translation: By the fig and the olive

text: by Mount Sinai

citation.arabic_text: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
citation.translation: by Mount Sinai

text: and by this secure town

citation.arabic_text: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ
citation.translation: and by this secure town

text: We certainly created man in the best of forms

citation.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمࣲ‏
citation.translation: We certainly created man in the best of forms

text: then We relegated him to the lowest of the low

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
citation.translation: then We relegated him to the lowest of the low

text: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. There will be an everlasting reward for them

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونࣲ‏
citation.translation: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. There will be an everlasting reward for them

text: So what makes you deny the Retribution

citation.arabic_text: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: So what makes you deny the Retribution

text: Is not Allah the fairest of all judges

citation.arabic_text: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ
citation.translation: Is not Allah the fairest of all judges

text: Read in the Name of your Lord who created

citation.arabic_text: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ
citation.translation: Read in the Name of your Lord who created

text: created man from a clinging mass

citation.arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ
citation.translation: created man from a clinging mass

text: Read, and your Lord is the most generous

citation.arabic_text: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ
citation.translation: Read, and your Lord is the most generous

text: who taught by the pen

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ
citation.translation: who taught by the pen

text: taught man what he did not know

citation.arabic_text: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ
citation.translation: taught man what he did not know

text: Indeed man becomes rebellious

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Indeed man becomes rebellious

text: when he considers himself without need

citation.arabic_text: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ
citation.translation: when he considers himself without need

text: Indeed to your Lord is the return

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ
citation.translation: Indeed to your Lord is the return

text: Tell me, he who forbids

citation.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ
citation.translation: Tell me, he who forbids

text: a servant when he prays

citation.arabic_text: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
citation.translation: a servant when he prays

text: tell me, should he be on [true] guidance

citation.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
citation.translation: tell me, should he be on [true] guidance

text: or bid [others] to Godwariness

citation.arabic_text: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ
citation.translation: or bid [others] to Godwariness

text: tell me, should he call him a liar and turn away

citation.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
citation.translation: tell me, should he call him a liar and turn away

text: —does he not know that Allah sees [him]

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
citation.translation: —does he not know that Allah sees [him]

text: No indeed! If he does not cease, We shall seize him by the forelock

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
citation.translation: No indeed! If he does not cease, We shall seize him by the forelock

text: a lying, sinful forelock

citation.arabic_text: نَاصِيَةࣲ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: a lying, sinful forelock

text: Then let him call out his gang

citation.arabic_text: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
citation.translation: Then let him call out his gang

text: We [too] shall call the keepers of hell

citation.arabic_text: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
citation.translation: We [too] shall call the keepers of hell

text: No indeed! Do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near [to Allah]

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩
citation.translation: No indeed! Do not obey him, but prostrate and draw near [to Allah]

text: Indeed We sent it down on the Night of Ordainment

citation.arabic_text: ٱلرَّحِيمِإِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
citation.translation: Indeed We sent it down on the Night of Ordainment

text: And what will show you what is the Night of Ordainment

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
citation.translation: And what will show you what is the Night of Ordainment

text: The Night of Ordainment is better than a thousand months

citation.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرࣲ‏
citation.translation: The Night of Ordainment is better than a thousand months

text: In it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, with every command

citation.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرࣲ‏
citation.translation: In it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, with every command

text: It is peaceful until the rising of the dawn

citation.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ
citation.translation: It is peaceful until the rising of the dawn

text: The faithless from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not set apart [from the community of the faithful] until the proof had come to them

citation.arabic_text: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
citation.translation: The faithless from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not set apart [from the community of the faithful] until the proof had come to them

text: an apostle from Allah reciting impeccable scriptures

citation.arabic_text: رَسُولࣱ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفࣰ ا مُّطَهَّرَةࣰ‏
citation.translation: an apostle from Allah reciting impeccable scriptures

text: wherein are upright writings

citation.arabic_text: فِيهَا كُتُبࣱ قَيِّمَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: wherein are upright writings

text: Those who were given the Book did not divide except after the proof had come to them

citation.arabic_text: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
citation.translation: Those who were given the Book did not divide except after the proof had come to them

text: Though they were not commanded except to worship Allah, dedicating their faith to Him as men of pure faith, and to maintain the prayer and pay the zakat. That is the upright religion

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
citation.translation: Though they were not commanded except to worship Allah, dedicating their faith to Him as men of pure faith, and to maintain the prayer and pay the zakat. That is the upright religion

text: Indeed the faithless from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of hell, to remain in it [forever]. It is they who are the worst of creatures

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
citation.translation: Indeed the faithless from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of hell, to remain in it [forever]. It is they who are the worst of creatures

text: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—it is they who are the best of creatures

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
citation.translation: Indeed those who have faith and do righteous deeds—it is they who are the best of creatures

text: Their reward, near their Lord, is the Gardens of Eden, with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for those who fear their Lord

citation.arabic_text: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدࣰ اۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
citation.translation: Their reward, near their Lord, is the Gardens of Eden, with streams running in them, to remain in them forever. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for those who fear their Lord

text: When the earth is rocked with a terrible quake

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
citation.translation: When the earth is rocked with a terrible quake

text: and discharges its burdens

citation.arabic_text: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا
citation.translation: and discharges its burdens

text: and man says, ‘What is the matter with her?’

citation.arabic_text: وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
citation.translation: and man says, ‘What is the matter with her?’

text: On that day she will relate her chronicles

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا
citation.translation: On that day she will relate her chronicles

text: for her Lord will have inspired her

citation.arabic_text: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا
citation.translation: for her Lord will have inspired her

text: On that day, mankind will issue forth in various groups to be shown their deeds

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰ ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
citation.translation: On that day, mankind will issue forth in various groups to be shown their deeds

text: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it

citation.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰ ا يَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it

text: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it

citation.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّ ا يَرَهُۥ
citation.translation: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it

text: By the snorting chargers

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبۡحࣰ ا
citation.translation: By the snorting chargers

text: by the strikers of sparks [with their hoofs]

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡمُورِيَٰتِ قَدۡحࣰ ا
citation.translation: by the strikers of sparks [with their hoofs]

text: by the raiders at dawn

citation.arabic_text: فَٱلۡمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبۡحࣰ ا
citation.translation: by the raiders at dawn

text: raising therein a trail of dust

citation.arabic_text: فَأَثَرۡنَ بِهِۦ نَقۡعࣰ ا
citation.translation: raising therein a trail of dust

text: and cleaving therein a host

citation.arabic_text: فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهِۦ جَمۡعًا
citation.translation: and cleaving therein a host

text: Indeed man is ungrateful to his Lord

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed man is ungrateful to his Lord

text: and indeed he is [himself] witness to that

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدࣱ‏
citation.translation: and indeed he is [himself] witness to that

text: And indeed he is an avid lover of wealth

citation.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
citation.translation: And indeed he is an avid lover of wealth

text: Does he not know, when what is [buried] in the graves is turned over

citation.arabic_text: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
citation.translation: Does he not know, when what is [buried] in the graves is turned over

text: and what is [concealed] in the breasts is divulged

citation.arabic_text: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ
citation.translation: and what is [concealed] in the breasts is divulged

text: on that day their Lord will be well informed about them [and their deeds]

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّخَبِيرُۢ
citation.translation: on that day their Lord will be well informed about them [and their deeds]

text: The Catastrophe

citation.arabic_text: ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
citation.translation: The Catastrophe

text: What is the Catastrophe

citation.arabic_text: مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
citation.translation: What is the Catastrophe

text: What will show you what is the Catastrophe

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
citation.translation: What will show you what is the Catastrophe

text: [It is] the day when mankind will be like scattered moths

citation.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ
citation.translation: [It is] the day when mankind will be like scattered moths

text: and the mountains like carded wool

citation.arabic_text: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٱلۡمَنفُوشِ
citation.translation: and the mountains like carded wool

text: As for him, whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales

citation.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
citation.translation: As for him, whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales

text: he will have a pleasing life

citation.arabic_text: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةࣲ رَّاضِيَةࣲ‏
citation.translation: he will have a pleasing life

text: But as for him, whose deeds weigh light in the scales

citation.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
citation.translation: But as for him, whose deeds weigh light in the scales

text: his home will be the Abyss

citation.arabic_text: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: his home will be the Abyss

text: And what will show you what it is

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهۡ
citation.translation: And what will show you what it is

text: It is a scorching fire

citation.arabic_text: نَارٌ حَامِيَةُۢ
citation.translation: It is a scorching fire

text: Rivalry [and vainglory] distracted you

citation.arabic_text: أَلۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
citation.translation: Rivalry [and vainglory] distracted you

text: until you visited [even] the graves

citation.arabic_text: حَتَّىٰ زُرۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَقَابِرَ
citation.translation: until you visited [even] the graves

text: No indeed, soon you will know

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: No indeed, soon you will know

text: No indeed, soon you will know for yet another time

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
citation.translation: No indeed, soon you will know for yet another time

text: Indeed, were you to know with certain knowledge

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عِلۡمَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
citation.translation: Indeed, were you to know with certain knowledge

text: you would have surely seen hell [in this very life]

citation.arabic_text: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ
citation.translation: you would have surely seen hell [in this very life]

text: Afterward you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
citation.translation: Afterward you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

text: Then, on that day, you will surely be questioned concerning the Blessing

citation.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
citation.translation: Then, on that day, you will surely be questioned concerning the Blessing

text: By Time

citation.arabic_text: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ
citation.translation: By Time

text: Man is indeed in loss

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَفِي خُسۡرٍ
citation.translation: Man is indeed in loss

text: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds, and enjoin one another to [follow] the truth, and enjoin one another to patience

citation.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
citation.translation: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds, and enjoin one another to [follow] the truth, and enjoin one another to patience

text: Woe to every scandal-monger and slanderer

citation.arabic_text: وَيۡلࣱ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةࣲ لُّمَزَةٍ
citation.translation: Woe to every scandal-monger and slanderer

text: who amasses wealth and counts it over

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالࣰ ا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
citation.translation: who amasses wealth and counts it over

text: He supposes his wealth will make him immortal

citation.arabic_text: يَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَهُۥ
citation.translation: He supposes his wealth will make him immortal

text: No indeed! He will surely be cast into the Crusher

citation.arabic_text: كَلَّاۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِي ٱلۡحُطَمَةِ
citation.translation: No indeed! He will surely be cast into the Crusher

text: And what will show you what is the Crusher

citation.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحُطَمَةُ
citation.translation: And what will show you what is the Crusher

text: [It is] the fire of Allah, set ablaze

citation.arabic_text: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُوقَدَةُ
citation.translation: [It is] the fire of Allah, set ablaze

text: which will overspread the hearts

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةِ
citation.translation: which will overspread the hearts

text: Indeed it will close in upon them

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّهَا عَلَيۡهِم مُّؤۡصَدَةࣱ‏
citation.translation: Indeed it will close in upon them

text: in outstretched columns

citation.arabic_text: فِي عَمَدࣲ مُّمَدَّدَةِۭ
citation.translation: in outstretched columns

text: Have you not regarded how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephants

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
citation.translation: Have you not regarded how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephants

text: Did He not make their stratagems go awry

citation.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ كَيۡدَهُمۡ فِي تَضۡلِيلࣲ‏
citation.translation: Did He not make their stratagems go awry

text: and send against them flocks of birds

citation.arabic_text: وَأَرۡسَلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيۡرًا أَبَابِيلَ
citation.translation: and send against them flocks of birds

text: pelting them with stones of shale

citation.arabic_text: تَرۡمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةࣲ مِّن سِجِّيلࣲ‏
citation.translation: pelting them with stones of shale

text: thus making them like chewed-up straw

citation.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ كَعَصۡفࣲ مَّأۡكُولِۭ
citation.translation: thus making them like chewed-up straw

text: [In gratitude] for solidarity among the Quraysh

citation.arabic_text: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيۡشٍ
citation.translation: [In gratitude] for solidarity among the Quraysh

text: their solidarity during winter and summer journeys

citation.arabic_text: إِۦلَٰفِهِمۡ رِحۡلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيۡفِ
citation.translation: their solidarity during winter and summer journeys

text: let them worship the Lord of this House

citation.arabic_text: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ
citation.translation: let them worship the Lord of this House

text: who has fed them [and saved them] from hunger, and secured them from fear

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعࣲ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
citation.translation: who has fed them [and saved them] from hunger, and secured them from fear

text: Did you see him who denies the Retribution

citation.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
citation.translation: Did you see him who denies the Retribution

text: That is the one, who drives away the orphan

citation.arabic_text: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَدُعُّ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
citation.translation: That is the one, who drives away the orphan

text: and does not urge the feeding of the needy

citation.arabic_text: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
citation.translation: and does not urge the feeding of the needy

text: Woe to those who pray

citation.arabic_text: فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلۡمُصَلِّينَ
citation.translation: Woe to those who pray

text: but are heedless of their prayers

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَن صَلَاتِهِمۡ سَاهُونَ
citation.translation: but are heedless of their prayers

text: —who show off

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ
citation.translation: —who show off

text: but deny aid

citation.arabic_text: وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ
citation.translation: but deny aid

text: Indeed We have given you abundance

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ
citation.translation: Indeed We have given you abundance

text: So pray to your Lord, and sacrifice [the sacrificial camel]

citation.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنۡحَرۡ
citation.translation: So pray to your Lord, and sacrifice [the sacrificial camel]

text: Indeed it is your enemy who is without posterity

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلۡأَبۡتَرُ
citation.translation: Indeed it is your enemy who is without posterity

text: Say, ‘O faithless ones

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
citation.translation: Say, ‘O faithless ones

text: I do not worship what you worship

citation.arabic_text: لَآ أَعۡبُدُ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
citation.translation: I do not worship what you worship

text: nor do you worship what I worship

citation.arabic_text: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
citation.translation: nor do you worship what I worship

text: nor will I worship what you have worshipped

citation.arabic_text: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدࣱ مَّا عَبَدتُّمۡ
citation.translation: nor will I worship what you have worshipped

text: nor will you worship what I worship

citation.arabic_text: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
citation.translation: nor will you worship what I worship

text: To you your religion, and to me my religion.’

citation.arabic_text: لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ
citation.translation: To you your religion, and to me my religion.’

text: When Allah’s help comes with victory

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ
citation.translation: When Allah’s help comes with victory

text: and you see the people entering Allah’s religion in throngs

citation.arabic_text: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
citation.translation: and you see the people entering Allah’s religion in throngs

text: celebrate the praise of your Lord, and plead to Him for forgiveness. Indeed, He is all-clement

citation.arabic_text: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
citation.translation: celebrate the praise of your Lord, and plead to Him for forgiveness. Indeed, He is all-clement

text: Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and perish he

citation.arabic_text: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبࣲ وَتَبَّ
citation.translation: Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and perish he

text: Neither his wealth availed him, nor what he had earned

citation.arabic_text: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
citation.translation: Neither his wealth availed him, nor what he had earned

text: Soon he will enter the blazing fire

citation.arabic_text: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارࣰ ا ذَاتَ لَهَبࣲ‏
citation.translation: Soon he will enter the blazing fire

text: and his wife [too], the firewood carrier

citation.arabic_text: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ
citation.translation: and his wife [too], the firewood carrier

text: with a rope of palm fibre around her neck

citation.arabic_text: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلࣱ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ
citation.translation: with a rope of palm fibre around her neck

text: Say, ‘He is Allah, the One

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
citation.translation: Say, ‘He is Allah, the One

text: Allah is the All-embracing

citation.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
citation.translation: Allah is the All-embracing

text: He neither begat, nor was begotten

citation.arabic_text: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ
citation.translation: He neither begat, nor was begotten

text: nor has He any equal.’

citation.arabic_text: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
citation.translation: nor has He any equal.’

text: Say, ‘I seek the protection of the Lord of the daybreak

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ
citation.translation: Say, ‘I seek the protection of the Lord of the daybreak

text: from the evil of what He has created

citation.arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
citation.translation: from the evil of what He has created

text: and from the evil of the dark night when it falls

citation.arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
citation.translation: and from the evil of the dark night when it falls

text: and from the evil of the witches, who blow on knots

citation.arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ
citation.translation: and from the evil of the witches, who blow on knots

text: and from the evil of the envious one when he envies.’

citation.arabic_text: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
citation.translation: and from the evil of the envious one when he envies.’

text: Say, ‘I seek the protection of the Lord of humans

citation.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
citation.translation: Say, ‘I seek the protection of the Lord of humans

text: Sovereign of humans

citation.arabic_text: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
citation.translation: Sovereign of humans

text: God of humans

citation.arabic_text: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
citation.translation: God of humans

text: from the evil of the sneaky tempter

citation.arabic_text: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ
citation.translation: from the evil of the sneaky tempter

text: who puts temptations into the breasts of humans

citation.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
citation.translation: who puts temptations into the breasts of humans

text: from among the jinn and humans.’

citation.arabic_text: مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
citation.translation: from among the jinn and humans.’
